# iTrack Wave 4 — Screens and copy — Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Extract every screen out of `app/ITrackApp.tsx` onto the Wave 3 design system as it is redesigned — Home as the urgency-sorted ledger with the timeline / "Needs attention" / "Best next action" column, Credentials with search and a state filter, a six-section Credential detail with a categories editor and a real archived state, a two-step Log activity sheet with a sticky Save and an opt-in certificate scan, a paginated and filterable Activity log with CSV export, an Account screen that owns Momentum, reminders with quiet hours, install help, a full data export and the four account operations (display name, password, email re-verify, delete), a packet re-themed on the tokens with its internal ids removed, and the whole copy rewritten to the §6 rules — leaving `app/ITrackApp.tsx` as a ≤ 160-line composition root, the seven legacy stylesheets and the LEGACY ALIASES block deleted, and every screen gated by its own Playwright spec in all four projects.

**Architecture:** One React context, `WorkspaceProvider` / `useWorkspace()` in `app/lib/workspaceStore.tsx`, replaces the 43 `useState` slices, 51 handlers and 72 view props of the monolith: it owns the workspace fetch, the pending-key array, the thirteen modal slices, the row-level actions with their Undo toasts and the single `run(action, payload, options)` write path, whose failures come back as `{ ok: false, copy }` from a pure error map (`app/lib/copy.ts`) instead of a global string — a form modal owns its own `ErrorSummary`, the page banner keeps only load and row-level failures (architecture-04, app-ux-24). Pure modules leave first (`workspaceTypes`, `credentialRules` + `credentialFamily()`, `activityRules`, `nextAction`, `allocation`, `format`, `actionKeys`), then the store, `ModalsHost` and the composition root land at pixel parity, then each screen is extracted into `app/screens/<Screen>.tsx` with a first-class-token stylesheet of the same name, its legacy stylesheet and the alias names it alone consumed deleted in the same commit, and its e2e spec rewritten in the same commit; the account operations are gateway-orchestrated JSON routes under `/account/*` (`deploy/railway/account-routes.mjs`) that call one internal-secret-guarded worker action `deleteWorkspace` and an auth-store `email_changes` table, with the workspace identity pinned to the sign-up address (`users.identity_email`) so an email change never re-keys D1 or R2; the last screen deletes `legacy-shared.css`, the alias block and the `.button*` family, and a composition-root guard in `tests/app-source-guards.test.mjs` keeps `ITrackApp.tsx` empty of state for good.

**Tech Stack:** Node 22 (`node:test`, `node:sqlite` behind `--experimental-sqlite`), Vinext 0.0.50 / Next App Router on workerd via wrangler 4.92, React 19.2 (context + `useMemo`'d store value, `useId`, no external state library — spec §1 decision 5 "no fresh client"), TypeScript 5.9 (`tsc --outDir .test-build --module nodenext` for pure-module tests), plain CSS with `@import` on `app/styles/tokens.css` first-class tokens only, tesseract.js 7.0.0 lazy-loaded behind an explicit notice, Playwright 1.63 with `@axe-core/playwright` 4.13.0 (four Chromium projects — scheme × viewport), the Node gateway (`deploy/railway/*.mjs`, node:sqlite auth store at `/data/auth.db`), Docker, Railway CLI 5.26. **No dependency is added or removed this wave**; `package.json` changes only in `build:lib-test` (one entry per pure module, enumerated in Global Constraints).

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-10-itrack-web-redesign-design.md` — this plan implements **section 6** (Wave 4 — Screens and copy: Home, Credentials + Credential detail, Log activity, Activity log, Account, Packet, and the copy rules), the Wave 4 row of the **section 2** table (ships: Home, Credentials, Credential detail, Log activity, Activity log (History), Account (Profile), packet — each extracted to its own file as redesigned; copy rewritten; finish gate: Playwright e2e per screen; no code left in ITrackApp.tsx beyond composition), **section 8** (account deletion and email change as the first operations touching both `/data/auth.db` and D1: a gateway-orchestrated sequence auth row → worker action `deleteWorkspace(identity)` → R2 prefix delete with an idempotent retry; identity stays `sha256(email)` with the `license-lantern:` salt — this plan pins the hashed address to the sign-up email and records that reading as a §8 amendment in Task 19), the **section 1** decisions (everything free — no tiers, no "Pro", no prices; decompose while restyling; no fresh client) and the Wave 4 lines of **section 9** (Playwright e2e per screen in both schemes at 1440×900 and 390×844; axe on every route with zero serious/critical; the contrast audit with zero literals outside token files; Docker run-check before merge; live smoke after deploy). Section 7 (landing, auth pages, privacy/terms, SEO, ops floor) is Wave 5 and is not built here — the five gateway pages under `deploy/railway/pages/` keep the OLD palette. The design system Wave 3 shipped is `docs/DESIGN-SYSTEM.md` (read it first); the **approved mockup A** is `docs/design/2026-09-10-mockup-a/README.md` + `home-desktop.html` + `home-phone.html`, whose Home ledger rows, two-column grid `minmax(0, 1fr) var(--ledger-aside-width)`, page header, "Needs attention" and "Best next action" cards are BINDING for Home (where the mockup and the spec disagree the spec wins: the rem scale over the 40 px numeral, the state filter over an undrawn list). Audit finding ids refer to `docs/audits/2026-09-10-audit/findings.json`; the ten verified code maps that accompany this plan are the source for every line number below (main @ `c6b1fe4`, Waves 1–3 live on https://itrackceu.com, production deployment `42dff6ad`).

- **Test entry points:** `npm test` = `npm run build && npm run build:lib-test && node --experimental-sqlite --test tests/*.test.mjs`. A full worker build takes minutes: while iterating run only your file, `node --experimental-sqlite --test tests/<file>.test.mjs` (after `npm run build:lib-test` for anything that imports `.test-build/`). Tests that import `dist/server/index.js` (`tests/rendered-html.test.mjs`, `tests/real-sqlite-seed.test.mjs`, `tests/isolation.test.mjs`, `tests/workspace-credential-actions.test.mjs`, `tests/workspace-cycles.test.mjs`, the new `tests/workspace-account-actions.test.mjs`) and `tests/dist-hygiene.test.mjs`'s dist assertions need `npm run build` first. `npm run test:e2e` (all four projects), `npm run test:e2e:desktop` and `npm run test:e2e:phone` are separate scripts and are never chained into `npm test`. `npm run typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`, which also typechecks `tests/e2e/*.ts`, `tests/live/*.ts` and `playwright.live.config.ts`) and `npm run lint` (`eslint .`, which lints `tests/` and runs eslint-plugin-react-hooks 7 — `refs`, `purity`, `set-state-in-effect`, `set-state-in-render`, `static-components`, `preserve-manual-memoization`, `immutability` at error) are safe at any time. `node tools/contrast-audit.mjs` is build-free and must exit 0 at every commit. The unauthenticated Playwright live smoke (`tests/live/live-smoke.spec.ts` under `playwright.live.config.ts`, `LIVE_BASE_URL=<origin>` required, no `webServer`, one desktop project, exactly one failed login per run) runs only against a gateway — the Docker run-check container or production — never against the dev server (which has no gateway) and never inside `npm run test:e2e`.
- **Green at every commit:** each task rewrites the tests its change breaks in the same commit; `npm test`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `node tools/contrast-audit.mjs` must pass at every task's final step, and every task that touches `app/` or `tests/e2e/` also runs `E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3100 npm run test:e2e` with the dev server up (all four projects green; `screenshots.spec.ts` — and `parity.spec.ts` until Task 19 deletes it — are the only specs allowed to report `skipped`, and only when their env var is unset). The app renders at every commit: no task leaves a route without a screen, a modal without a host, or a button without a handler.
- **Pins are deleted, never edited (ios-coupling-15):** a source-regex assertion is removed whole (with its `readFile` binding) or its whole subtest is removed; no regex is re-pointed at moved code. An e2e assertion that names copy or markup this wave changes is rewritten to the new contract in the same commit as the change (never left dangling, never weakened to a regex that matches both). No file under `tests/` may read `app/ITrackApp.tsx`, `app/globals.css`, `app/layout.tsx`, `app/styles/*`, `app/components/*`, `app/screens/*` or `app/lib/workspaceStore.tsx` as text, except the generic walkers in `tests/app-source-guards.test.mjs`, `tests/protected-identifiers.test.mjs` and the `tools/contrast-audit.mjs` importer in `tests/contrast-audit.test.mjs`; Task 1 widens the `no test file reads client source text` regex to `screens\/` and `lib\/workspaceStore`. The two guards Wave 3 edited under this rule (the source-read regex, the `LEGACY_STYLESHEETS` allow-list) may be edited again the same way: a guard's scan list or floor is re-pinned in the task that changes what it scans, and Task 18 rewrites `tests/contrast-audit.test.mjs`'s alias tests to assert the block's absence. Server-source pins in `tests/rendered-html.test.mjs` (`runtimeSource`, `workspaceRouteSource`, `exportRouteSource`, `reminderSource` …) stay this wave; the packet subtests there are behaviour tests over the built worker and are rewritten to the new packet contract in Task 17, not deleted.

- **Copy rules (spec §6, §1.3):** no "beta", "Pro", prices, "ad-supported" or tiers; no "ChatGPT", "OpenAI", "TestFlight", "Capacitor", native-app or "the shell" prose. One verb for logging — "Log activity" — everywhere; "Record" is the milestone verb (Record submission / Record acceptance / Record compliance); no capitalised "Today" as a screen name ("Due today" the state word and the timeline's lowercase "today" stay); check-in titles Home authors are ≤ 9 words (catalog task titles are derived through `checkInTitle`, user-typed personal titles are shown verbatim and clamped to two lines); "credits that count" / "credits still needed" — never "countable units" or "classification gaps"; "categorize" replaces "classify" in user copy; "evidence" replaces "proof"; every functional screen has a functional H1 ("Your renewals", "Credentials", the credential name, "Activity log", "Your account"); errors say what happened and what to do; a server string is never the visible sentence — `describeApiError` maps every code to copy and the raw sentence sits only inside a "Technical details" disclosure. **The copy table is the only source of new strings**: every user-facing string a task writes is in the copy table with its owner; a task adds no other prose.
- **The error map is the only way server codes reach the UI:** `app/lib/copy.ts` (`ERROR_COPY`, `describeApiError`, `CONFLICT_CODES`) is consumed by the store's `run()`, `reload()`, the evidence and push helpers and the account sheets; no screen or modal switches on a `code` string or renders `result.error`; `tests/copy.test.mjs` proves every code the API can emit (route.ts `RequestError` third arguments, `code:` literals, `EvidenceApiError`, the packet/export/catalog literals, the two defaults) has an entry.
- **Dates:** no file under `app/` computes today in UTC (`new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)`, `const todayIso`); `today` is the store's `today()` (`todayLocal(dateZone)`) passed down as a prop or read from `useWorkspace()`; clock reads (`Date.now()`) stay in module-level helpers, never inside a component render (`react-hooks/purity`); every pure module added to `app/lib/` (`workspaceTypes`, `credentialRules`, `activityRules`, `nextAction`, `allocation`, `format`, `actionKeys`, `copy`, `quietHours`, `ledger`, `credentialFilters`, `logActivityForm`, `pagination`, `activityLog`, `zipStore`, `packetTheme`, `renewalPacket`) has no React/DOM/D1 import, uses the `./x.js` import suffix, and is appended to the `build:lib-test` tsc list in the task that creates it; React/fetch files (`workspaceStore.tsx`, `workspaceApi.ts`, the hooks) stay out of that list.
- **Every screen leaves `ITrackApp.tsx` whole:** a screen task moves the view function out of `app/ITrackApp.tsx` into `app/screens/<Screen>.tsx`, rewrites its stylesheet `app/styles/<screen>.css` on first-class tokens (the Activity log's is renamed `activity-log.css`; `modals.css` is born in Task 6), deletes from `legacy-shared.css`/`home.css`/`log-activity.css` the blocks that screen alone consumed, removes its file from `LEGACY_STYLESHEETS` in `tests/contrast-audit.test.mjs`, deletes from the LEGACY ALIASES block only the alias names whose sole remaining consumer was the file it replaced (`grep -rn 'var(--<name>' app/styles` first), and rewrites the screen's e2e spec — all in one commit. The alias block, `legacy-shared.css`, the LEGACY DISPLAY FACE rule, the `.button*` family and `.action-spinner` are deleted with the last screen (Task 18), which also lands the composition-root guard (`app/ITrackApp.tsx` ≤ 160 lines, only `div` as a host element, only the provider tree and the route switch as components, no `useState`/`useReducer`/`useEffect`/`useRef`/`fetch`/`localStorage`/`onClick=`).
- **Account data operations are gateway-orchestrated (spec §8):** delete = `POST /account/delete` → `store.beginDeletion` (row parked, every session dropped) → worker action `deleteWorkspace` (one D1 batch in dependency order, then an R2 prefix delete) called by the gateway with the identity headers plus `x-itrack-internal-secret` → `store.deleteUser` → cleared cookie; every step is idempotent and retried in-request (3 attempts) and by the 15-minute cron sweep (`runPendingDeletions`); email change = `POST /account/email` → `email_changes` token mailed → `/verify` + password → `store.confirmEmailChange` (auth.db only: the identity stays the sign-up address). **No account operation runs against production in any test or run-check**: `runcheck.sh account` and `throwaway-empty` run only in the Docker container against the bootstrap throwaway `wave4-throwaway@example.test`; `matrix` stays login-free; Chris's account is never deleted, renamed or re-addressed by any step.
- **No route split (architecture-M-05 deferred):** `app/api/workspace/route.ts` gains `deleteWorkspace`, the archived-credential gates, the `setReminderState` "active" branch, the activity `format`/`notes` fields and the quiet-hours preference — contained edits only; no function moves out of the file this wave. `WORKSPACE_ACTIONS` (`tests/helpers/workspaceActions.mjs`) goes from 27 to 28 (`deleteWorkspace`, appended after `deleteCredential`), `tests/isolation.test.mjs:557` is re-pinned to 28 with a `NO_FOREIGN_ID_ACTIONS` entry whose empty-payload dispatch answers 403 `internal_only`.
- **Migrations / identity:** D1 — one additive change, named `0015_wave4_fields`: `activities.format TEXT`, `activities.notes TEXT`, `reminder_preferences.quiet_hours_start INTEGER`, `reminder_preferences.quiet_hours_end INTEGER` — added to the `CREATE TABLE` statements in `db/runtime.ts` for fresh databases, to `RICH_RULE_COLUMNS` (so `ensureRichRuleColumns` ALTERs an existing database on boot, idempotently), to `db/schema.ts`, and as `drizzle/0015_wave4_fields.sql` + journal idx 15 for the record (Task 4). auth.db — the store's own `#upgradeSchema()` gains `users.deleting_at INTEGER`, `users.identity_email TEXT` (backfilled from `email`, unique NOCASE index) and the new table `email_changes` in `SCHEMA` (Tasks 13–14), each proven by an "upgraded on open" test over the legacy DDL. Identity: the worker keeps `usr_sha256("license-lantern:" + identityEmail)`; the gateway forwards `oai-authenticated-user-email` = `users.identity_email` (never changes) and `oai-authenticated-user-contact-email` = `users.email` (Task 14). Chris's production data under `christophertskerritt@gmail.com` is untouched: his identity_email backfills to the same address. **§8 reading — Chris's gate before Task 14:** spec §8 (approved) says identity "remains `sha256(email)`" and lists email change beside deletion as a gateway-orchestrated two-store sequence; Task 14 instead pins the hash to the sign-up address (`users.identity_email`), moves only the contact address on an email change, and accepts the consequence that a sign-up address can never register a second account while the first lives (the identity triggers forbid `UPDATE … SET user_id`, R2 has no rename). That amends an approved design, so Chris approves the reading — in the wording of Task 19 Step 9's `spec-s8.md` — before Task 14 begins (Task 14 Step 0); Task 19 splices the approved wording into the spec as the record.

## Copy table

Every user-facing string Wave 4 writes is here with its owner; a task adds no prose that is not in this table. Line numbers are `app/ITrackApp.tsx` at main @ `c6b1fe4` unless a path is given. `{…}` marks an interpolation; `Mon D, YYYY` is `formatDate` (en-US short month); pluralisation follows the rule "one …" / "{n} …s" unless a form is spelled out. "Keep" means the string survives verbatim (its pin survives too). A string with two owners is written by the first and only re-pinned by the second.

### J. Error code → copy (`ERROR_COPY`, Task 2)

Shape: `{ what, next, recovery }` — `what` ≤ 12 words ending with a period; `next` one imperative sentence; `recovery` ∈ retry | reopen | reload | sign-in | none. Every code below is a key; codes sharing a family share strings. `tests/copy.test.mjs` extracts every code from `app/api/**` and fails on a missing key.

| Family / codes | what | next | recovery |
|---|---|---|---|
| `authentication_required` | (SESSION_ENDED_MESSAGE) | "Reload and sign in to continue." | sign-in |
| `internal_error` | "iTrack couldn’t finish that request." | "Try again in a moment. Your saved record is unchanged." | retry |
| `cross_origin_request` | "That request came from another site." | "Open iTrack directly and try again." | reload |
| `invalid_content_type`, `multipart_required`, `invalid_multipart`, `body_too_large`, `unsupported_action`, `client_identity_forbidden` | "This request wasn’t in a form iTrack accepts." | "Reload the page and try again." | reload |
| `invalid_request` (both defaults), `invalid_revision`, `invalid_date` | "Something in this form wasn’t accepted." | "Check the highlighted values and save again." | retry |
| `template_field_locked`, `next_template_not_allowed`, `*_next_template_not_selectable` | "That field can’t be changed for this template." | "Keep the template’s value, or switch to a custom credential." | retry |
| 404s: `credential_not_found`, `activity_not_found`, `allocation_not_found`, `requirement_not_found`, `task_not_found`, `quest_not_found`, `reminder_not_found`, `rule_set_not_found`, `rule_category_not_found`, `dental_checkpoint_not_found`, `push_subscription_not_found`, `push_delivery_not_found`, `evidence_not_found`, `evidence_object_not_found`, `invalid_credential_id` | "That item is no longer in your record." | "It may have been deleted in another tab. ### Task 1: Pure modules leave the monolith: workspaceTypes, credentialRules (+credentialFamily), activityRules, nextAction, allocation, format, actionKeys — verbatim moves, explicit clock args, seven node:test suites, source-read guard widened

**Rationale:** spec §1 decision 5 ("Decompose while restyling. `app/ITrackApp.tsx` is split into screen files and a small component library as each screen is redesigned … No fresh client"), the §2 Wave 4 row (finish gate: "Playwright e2e per screen; no code left in ITrackApp.tsx beyond composition") and §9 Unit ("node:test for … extracted `app/lib/*` modules"). At `main@c6b1fe4` `app/ITrackApp.tsx` is 10,868 lines, and the first 1,325 of them are not a component: 16 hand-mirrored API types, 12 constants and 58 module-level helpers (formatters, the credential-family predicates, catalog date defaults, the NREMT/CRC FormData payload builders, `bestNextAction`, the pending-key builders), with three more helper islands lower down (`cycleStatusLabel`/`cycleCountdownLabel` at 7504–7529, `allocationFigure`/`seedAllocationAmounts`/`allocationAmount` at 10105–10160, `dayPart` at 10863–10868). Every screen task after this one (Tasks 5–11, 16, 17) imports these names from `app/lib/`, so they move first, exactly as audit architecture-01's extraction order says ("pure modules first (types, format, credentialKinds, allocationPayloads, guidedAction)"). architecture-06 ("the client hand-mirrors 13 API shape types that the server never exports … every extracted screen file will import these types, so the split is the moment to make them real") is closed on the client side by `app/lib/workspaceTypes.ts`. architecture-07 ("credential-family logic is duplicated … then re-branched in JSX 132 times"; `isNremtCredential` alone is called 42 times in what remains of the root) is closed by `app/lib/credentialRules.ts` plus the `credentialFamily()` discriminator it asked for. critic-01 ("today" and the clock read in the wrong place) is closed for these helpers by making the four clock-reading ones — `daysUntil`, `credentialCountdown`, `credentialInstrumentState`/`credentialRingState`, `cycleCountdownLabel`, `dayPart` — take the instant as an argument, and `bestNextAction` take `today` (the app's `todayLocal(dateZone)`), so no pure module reads `Date.now()` or `new Date()` and `react-hooks/purity` (error-level through eslint-config-next) never meets a clock in a render body: `ITrackApp.tsx` keeps six module-level `…Now` wrappers, the same pattern its `credentialCountdown` used at `:488`. Nothing visible changes — the e2e suite runs unchanged as the no-regression proof. Every number below was verified with `grep -n`/`sed -n` against the file, and the whole task (modules, suites, the edit script, the guard change) was dry-run on a copy of the tree: `tsc --noEmit` clean, `eslint .` clean, the seven suites 41/41 in four time zones, `tests/app-source-guards.test.mjs` + `tests/protected-identifiers.test.mjs` 22/22, `node tools/contrast-audit.mjs` unchanged at 18 stylesheets / 0 / 0.

**Decisions (binding for the later tasks):**

1. **Move, do not rewrite.** Every function and type body is copied byte for byte from its line range. The complete list of edits, and there are no others: (a) `export` in front of every moved declaration; (b) the `./x.js` import suffixes between the pure modules (`npm run build:lib-test` compiles them with `tsc --module nodenext`, which rejects a bare `./x` with TS2835; `moduleResolution: "bundler"` maps `./x.js` to `x.ts` for `npm run typecheck` and the vinext build); (c) the clock parameters — `daysUntil(value, nowMs)`, `credentialCountdown(credential, nowMs)`, `credentialInstrumentState(credential, nowMs)`, `credentialRingState(credential, nowMs)`, `cycleCountdownLabel(credential, nowMs)`, `dayPart(now: Date)`; (d) `bestNextAction(credential, missingEvidence, today)` whose overdue-task test becomes `task.dueDate! < today` (was `daysUntil(task.dueDate!) < 0`); (e) two optional fields on `GuidedAction` — `dueDate?: string` (set in both checklist branches: the overdue task's date, or `openTask.dueDate ?? undefined`) and `count?: number` (set in both records branches: the classification-issue count, or `missingEvidence`) — so Task 8's Home formats dates and counts itself; (f) `activityIsMutable`'s second parameter widens from `Credential[]` to `readonly Credential[]` (the interface contract; every caller passes a `Credential[]`); (g) two NEW functions in `credentialRules.ts`, `credentialFamily()` and `ruleReviewState()`, unused by `ITrackApp.tsx` this task; (h) `REMINDERS_ACTION_KEY` and `reminderActionKey()` appended to `actionKeys.ts` for Tasks 8 and 16, so that file is written once. The comments above `daysUntil`/`credentialCountdown` at `:486–494`, which described the clock read that no longer happens there, are rewritten (comments are not bodies).
2. **What stays in `ITrackApp.tsx`, and why.** The six constants at `:132–136` (`DENTAL_LINKED_APPLICABILITY_CHILD_CATEGORY_IDS`) and `:434–458` (`CFP_2027_GENERAL_CATEGORY_ID`, `NJ_LCSW_CREDIT_CATEGORY_GROUP`, `DENTAL_AGGREGATE_PARENT_CATEGORY_ID_SET`, `DENTAL_AGGREGATE_BY_SUBTYPE_CATEGORY_ID`, `DENTAL_SUBTYPE_CATEGORY_IDS_BY_AGGREGATE`) are consumed only by UI code — the setup modal (`:4992`, `:5010`) and `RequirementPicker` (`:10571`, `:10584`, `:10594–10595`, `:10610`, `:10643`, `:10660`) — and they import `@/db/catalog/dental`. They cannot join a pure module: `tsc app/lib/dates.ts db/catalog/dental.ts --outDir X --module nodenext --target es2022` was run and emits `X/app/lib/dates.js` + `X/db/catalog/dental.js` (tsc re-roots the output at the inputs' common directory), which would move every existing `.test-build/<name>.js` and break the `../.test-build/` import in 18 suites. They leave in Task 5, whose generator moves them verbatim into `app/lib/catalogCategories.ts` (exported; it keeps the `@/db/catalog/dental` import and stays outside `build:lib-test`) for the setup modal and `RequirementPicker`. `pushSubscriptionIdentity` (`:460–463`, over the keep-list `webPush.ts`) stays for Task 16's `usePushDevice`. `AllocationTally` (`:10109–10144`) is JSX and stays for Task 10; only `allocationFigure` and its rounding comment (`:10099–10107`) and `seedAllocationAmounts`/`allocationAmount` (`:10146–10160`) leave that island.
3. **The overdue-task boundary moves by one day, deliberately.** `daysUntil(d) < 0` is `ceil((d 23:59:59 − now) / 1 day) < 0`, true only from the END of the day AFTER the due date; `d < today` is true from the day after. The Best next action card is the only consumer; Home's checklist row (`:7274`) keeps the old test through `daysUntilNow` (Task 7 moves that row and aligns it). No e2e pins either (the demo's tasks are due 2026-11-30).
4. **Dependency direction, as built:** `workspaceTypes` (types only; one `import type` from `./certificateOcr.js`) ← `credentialRules` (imports `./dates.js`, `./carryover.js`, `./expandedCertifications.js`; `import type { InstrumentState } from "./instruments.js"` — type-only, erased at emit, so no runtime edge to instruments) ← `activityRules` (+ `./carryover.js`); `format` imports `workspaceTypes`, `credentialRules`, `./cycles.js`, `./instruments.js`, `./readiness.js`; `nextAction` imports `workspaceTypes`, `credentialRules`, `format`, `./readiness.js`; `allocation` imports `workspaceTypes`, `format` (`compactNumber`), `./readiness.js`; `actionKeys` imports nothing. No cycle. `carryover.ts` and `expandedCertifications.ts` are import-free, so `.test-build/` gains `carryover.js` and `expandedCertifications.js` beside the seven new files (24 files, still flat).
5. **The `ITrackApp.tsx` edit is a script, not hand surgery.** Six line-range deletions bottom-up with every boundary line asserted, seven once-only call-site substitutions, seven header-import edits, one import block, six wrappers — `apply-itrackapp.mjs` (Step 6) refuses to run on a drifted file. Afterwards the file is 9,753 lines, `Date.now()` appears exactly 5 times (the wrappers) and `new Date(` exactly twice (the `dayPartNow` wrapper and the reminders modal's `new Date(2020, 0, 1, hour)` clock-face formatter at old `:5872`).

```ts
// app/lib/workspaceTypes.ts — types only, no runtime export
export type Requirement, RenewalTask, Credential, CatalogCategory, CatalogRule, ActivityAllocation, Activity,
  EvidenceFile, Badge, WeeklyQuest, Progression, Workspace, Reminder, CredentialEditInput, ActivityDraft,
  ActivityScanState, InstallPromptEvent, RequirementMatchPayload, CrcApprovalPayload;   // bodies = ITrackApp.tsx:138–432, 733–742
export type GuidedAction = {
  kind: "acceptance" | "conditions" | "history" | "learning" | "records" | "checklist" | "submission";
  title: string; body: string; buttonLabel: string;
  dueDate?: string;   // ISO date of the task a "checklist" action names (absent when it has none)
  count?: number;     // the n of a "records" action (classification issues, or records missing proof)
};

// app/lib/credentialRules.ts
export function isIsc2AutomaticRenewalCredential(credential: Credential | null | undefined): boolean;  // ruleSetId startsWith "isc2-"

export function isCrcCredential(credential: Credential | null | undefined): boolean;                   // "crcc-"

export function reminderActionKey(reminderKey: string): string;               // `reminder:${key}`
```

```js
// `app/lib/workspaceTypes.ts` is the client's one copy of the workspace

});
```

```js
// `app/lib/credentialRules.ts` is the one home of the credential-family

import {

  requiresOfficialCatalogDates,
  requiresOfficialNextPeriodAttestation,
  ruleReviewClass,
  ruleReviewLabel,
  ruleReviewState,
} from "../.test-build/credentialRules.js";

const cred = (ruleSetId, profession = "Counseling", extra = {}) => ({
  id: "c",
  ruleSetId,
  credentialName: "Credential",
  profession,
  jurisdiction: "NJ",
  cycleStart: "2026-01-01",
  deadline: "2027-12-31",

  unitLabel: "hours",
  cycleMonths: 24,
  status: "active",
  totalEarned: 0,

const rule = (id, extra = {}) => ({

test("the credential predicates test the rule-set id prefix and answer false for nothing", () => {
  assert.equal(isNremtCredential(cred("nremt-emt-nccp-ce-2025-v1")), true);
  assert.equal(isNremtCredential(cred("crcc-crc-2026-v1")), false);
  assert.equal(isNremtCredential(cred(null)), false);
  assert.equal(isNremtCredential(null), false);
  assert.equal(isNremtCredential(undefined), false);
  assert.equal(isIsc2AutomaticRenewalCredential(cred("isc2-cc-2026-v1")), true);
  assert.equal(isCrcCredential(cred("crcc-crc-2026-v1")), true);
  assert.equal(isAbveCredential(cred("abve-fellow-2025-v1")), true);

  assert.equal(isExpandedCertificationCredential(cred("nj-lcsw-2026-v1")), false);
});

  assert.equal(isManagedPharmacistCredential(cred("nj-pharmacist-2026-v1", "Pharmacy")), true);
  assert.equal(isManagedPharmacistCredential(cred(null, "Pharmacy")), false);
  assert.equal(isManagedPharmacistCredential(cred("nj-pharmacist-2026-v1", "Nursing")), false);

test("the catalog-rule predicates mirror the credential ones on the template id", () => {
  assert.equal(isNremtCatalogRule(rule("nremt-emt-nccp-ce-2025-v1")), true);

test("nremtLevelKey reads the level and currentNremtCatalogRule finds that level's template", () => {
  assert.equal(nremtLevelKey("nremt-emt-nccp-ce-2025-v1"), "emt");

  assert.equal(currentNremtCatalogRule(catalog, cred("nremt-emr-nccp-ce-2025-v1")), null);

test("the next-period rules: which families need the current template, an attestation, non-overlapping dates", () => {
  assert.equal(requiresCurrentNextTemplate(cred("fl-insurance-producer-2026-v1")), true);
  assert.equal(requiresCurrentNextTemplate(cred("fl-lcsw-lmft-lmhc-telehealth-phase-2026-v1")), true);
  assert.equal(requiresCurrentNextTemplate(cred("nremt-emt-nccp-ce-2025-v1")), false);
  assert.equal(requiresOfficialNextPeriodAttestation(cred("isc2-cc-2026-v1")), true);
  assert.equal(requiresOfficialNextPeriodAttestation(cred("nremt-emt-nccp-ce-2025-v1")), true);
  assert.equal(requiresOfficialNextPeriodAttestation(cred("nj-rn-2026-v1", "Nursing")), true);
  assert.equal(requiresOfficialNextPeriodAttestation(cred("nj-lcsw-2026-v1")), false);
  assert.equal(requiresOfficialNextPeriodAttestation(cred(null)), false);
  // NREMT is the one attested family whose next cycle may overlap (the fixed expiration).
  assert.equal(requiresNonOverlappingNextPeriod(cred("isc2-cc-2026-v1")), true);
  assert.equal(requiresNonOverlappingNextPeriod(cred("nremt-emt-nccp-ce-2025-v1")), false);
  assert.equal(requiresNonOverlappingNextPeriod(cred("nj-lcsw-2026-v1")), false);
});

test("credentialFamily is the first matching family in the fixed order, generic for nothing", () => {
  assert.equal(credentialFamily(cred("isc2-cc-2026-v1")), "isc2");
  assert.equal(credentialFamily(cred("nremt-emt-nccp-ce-2025-v1")), "nremt");
  assert.equal(credentialFamily(cred("crcc-crc-2026-v1")), "crc");
  assert.equal(credentialFamily(cred("abve-fellow-2025-v1")), "abve");
  assert.equal(credentialFamily(cred("fl-lcsw-lmft-lmhc-ethics-boundaries-phase-2026-v1")), "fl-mental-health");
  assert.equal(credentialFamily(cred("fl-insurance-producer-2026-v1")), "compliance-period");
  assert.equal(credentialFamily(cred("pa-professional-educator-act-48-2026-v1")), "compliance-period");
  assert.equal(credentialFamily(cred("nj-pharmacist-2026-v1", "Pharmacy")), "managed-pharmacist");
  assert.equal(credentialFamily(cred("nj-rn-2026-v1", "Nursing")), "managed-nursing");
  assert.equal(credentialFamily(cred("nj-dentist-2026-v1", "Dental")), "managed-dental");
  assert.equal(credentialFamily(cred("nbcot-otr-2026-v1")), "expanded");
  assert.equal(credentialFamily(cred("nj-lcsw-2026-v1")), "generic");
  assert.equal(credentialFamily(cred(null)), "generic");
  assert.equal(credentialFamily(cred(null, "Pharmacy")), "generic");
  assert.equal(credentialFamily(null), "generic");
  assert.equal(credentialFamily(undefined), "generic");
  // The order is binding: a Vocational Rehabilitation CRCC/ABVE credential is
  // its certification family first, so "managed-rehab" is never produced today.
  assert.equal(credentialFamily(cred("crcc-crc-2026-v1", "Vocational Rehabilitation")), "crc");
  assert.equal(credentialFamily(cred("abve-fellow-2025-v1", "Vocational Rehabilitation")), "abve");
  // A managed profession wins over an expanded-certification prefix.
  assert.equal(credentialFamily(cred("nbcot-otr-2026-v1", "Nursing")), "managed-nursing");
});

test("defaultCatalogCycleStart / defaultCatalogDeadline anchor on the caller's today; ABVE is fixed", () => {
  assert.equal(defaultCatalogCycleStart(null, "2026-09-15"), "2025-09-15");
  assert.equal(defaultCatalogCycleStart(rule("nj-lcsw-2026-v1", { cycleMonths: 24 }), "2026-09-15"), "2025-09-15");
  assert.equal(defaultCatalogCycleStart(rule("nj-lcsw-2026-v1", { cycleMonths: 36 }), "2026-09-15"), "2024-09-15");
  assert.equal(defaultCatalogCycleStart(rule("nj-rn-2026-v1", { cycleMonths: 12 }), "2026-09-15"), "2026-09-15");
  assert.equal(defaultCatalogCycleStart(rule("abve-fellow-2025-v1"), "2026-09-15"), "2025-01-01");
  // 29 February clamps through the month arithmetic instead of rolling into March.
  assert.equal(defaultCatalogCycleStart(null, "2024-02-29"), "2023-02-28");
  assert.equal(defaultCatalogDeadline(null, "2026-09-15"), "2027-09-15");
  assert.equal(defaultCatalogDeadline(rule("nj-lcsw-2026-v1"), "2026-09-15"), "2027-09-15");
  assert.equal(defaultCatalogDeadline(rule("abve-fellow-2025-v1"), "2026-09-15"), "2027-12-31");
});

test("confirmedCarryoverWindowStart looks back the longest applying carry-over category; else null", () => {
  const applies = (ruleCategoryId, extra = {}) => ({
    id: ruleCategoryId,
    ruleCategoryId,
    name: ruleCategoryId,
    requiredUnits: 0,
    earnedUnits: 0,
    applicabilityStatus: "applies",
    isActive: true,
    ...extra,
  });
  assert.equal(
    confirmedCarryoverWindowStart(cred("nj-rn-2026-v1", "Nursing", { requirements: [applies("nj-rn-2026-confirmed-carryover")] })),
    "2024-01-01",
  );
  assert.equal(
    confirmedCarryoverWindowStart(
      cred("nj-pharmacist-2026-v1", "Pharmacy", {
        requirements: [applies("nj-pharmacist-2026-confirmed-carryover"), applies("nj-rn-2026-confirmed-carryover")],
      }),
    ),
    "2024-01-01",
  );
  assert.equal(
    confirmedCarryoverWindowStart(cred("nj-pharmacist-2026-v1", "Pharmacy", { requirements: [applies("nj-pharmacist-2026-confirmed-carryover")] })),
    "2025-07-01",
  );
  // Only a requirement that applies and is active counts; a category with no look-back never does.
  assert.equal(
    confirmedCarryoverWindowStart(cred("nj-rn-2026-v1", "Nursing", { requirements: [applies("nj-rn-2026-confirmed-carryover", { applicabilityStatus: undefined })] })),
    null,
  );
  assert.equal(
    confirmedCarryoverWindowStart(cred("nj-rn-2026-v1", "Nursing", { requirements: [applies("nj-rn-2026-confirmed-carryover", { isActive: false })] })),
    null,
  );
  assert.equal(confirmedCarryoverWindowStart(cred("nj-rn-2026-v1", "Nursing", { requirements: [applies("nj-rn-2026-general")] })), null);
  assert.equal(confirmedCarryoverWindowStart(null), null);
});
```

Create `tests/activity-rules.test.mjs`:

```js
// `app/lib/activityRules.ts` decides whether an activity fits a credential's
// cycle (or its confirmed-carryover window), which allocations a record
// carries, whether it is still mutable, and the prior-period carry-over test.
// Moved verbatim from ITrackApp.tsx; tested against the ESM
// `npm run build:lib-test` emits. Every date is a fixed YYYY-MM-DD string.
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import {
  activityDateFitsCredential,
  activityIsMutable,
  allocationsFor,
  hasPortalConfirmedCarryover,
  isPriorPeriodCarryoverEntry,
  requirementRawEarned,
} from "../.test-build/activityRules.js";

const carryoverRequirement = (extra = {}) => ({
  id: "req-carry",
  ruleCategoryId: "nj-rn-2026-confirmed-carryover",
  name: "Confirmed carry-over",
  requiredUnits: 0,
  earnedUnits: 0,
  applicabilityStatus: "applies",
  isActive: true,
  ...extra,
});

function credential(overrides = {}) {
  return {
    id: "cred-1",
    ruleSetId: null,
    credentialName: "E2E credential",
    profession: "Nursing",
    jurisdiction: "NJ",
    cycleStart: "2026-01-01",
    deadline: "2027-12-31",
    totalRequired: 10,
    unitLabel: "hours",
    cycleMonths: 24,
    status: "active",
    totalEarned: 0,
    requirements: [],
    tasks: [],
    archivedTasks: [],
    revision: 1,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

function activity(overrides = {}) {
  return {
    id: "act-1",
    title: "E2E course",
    completionDate: "2026-06-02",
    totalUnits: 2,
    evidenceStatus: "missing",
    evidenceCount: 0,
    allocatedUnits: 2,
    revision: 1,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

test("activityDateFitsCredential accepts the cycle inclusively and a confirmed carry-over window before it", () => {
  const plain = credential();
  assert.equal(activityDateFitsCredential("2026-01-01", plain), true);
  assert.equal(activityDateFitsCredential("2027-12-31", plain), true);
  assert.equal(activityDateFitsCredential("2026-06-02", plain), true);
  assert.equal(activityDateFitsCredential("2025-12-31", plain), false);
  assert.equal(activityDateFitsCredential("2028-01-01", plain), false);
  // A 24-month carry-over category opens [2024-01-01, 2026-01-01).
  const carry = credential({ requirements: [carryoverRequirement()] });
  assert.equal(activityDateFitsCredential("2025-06-01", carry), true);
  assert.equal(activityDateFitsCredential("2024-01-01", carry), true);
  assert.equal(activityDateFitsCredential("2023-12-31", carry), false);
  assert.equal(activityDateFitsCredential("2028-01-01", carry), false);
});

test("allocationsFor returns the payload's allocations, synthesises one from the legacy fields, or none", () => {
  const allocations = [
    { id: "alloc-1", credentialId: "cred-1", credentialName: "E2E credential", allocatedUnits: 2 },
  ];
  assert.equal(allocationsFor(activity({ allocations })), allocations);
  assert.deepEqual(
    allocationsFor(
      activity({
        credentialId: "cred-1",
        credentialName: "E2E credential",
        requirementId: "req-general",
        categoryName: "General",
        allocatedUnits: 1.5,
      }),
    ),
    [
      {
        id: "act-1:cred-1",
        credentialId: "cred-1",
        credentialName: "E2E credential",
        requirementId: "req-general",
        categoryName: "General",
        allocatedUnits: 1.5,
      },
    ],
  );
  // An empty allocations array falls back to the legacy fields too.
  assert.equal(
    allocationsFor(activity({ allocations: [], credentialId: "cred-1", credentialName: "E2E credential" })).length,
    1,
  );
  assert.deepEqual(allocationsFor(activity()), []);
  assert.deepEqual(allocationsFor(activity({ credentialId: "cred-1" })), []);
});

test("activityIsMutable needs every allocated credential to be listed and open (active or submitted)", () => {
  const active = credential({ id: "cred-1", status: "active" });
  const submitted = credential({ id: "cred-2", status: "submitted" });
  const renewed = credential({ id: "cred-3", status: "renewed" });
  const both = activity({
    allocations: [
      { id: "a1", credentialId: "cred-1", credentialName: "One", allocatedUnits: 1 },
      { id: "a2", credentialId: "cred-2", credentialName: "Two", allocatedUnits: 1 },
    ],
  });
  assert.equal(activityIsMutable(both, [active, submitted]), true);
  assert.equal(activityIsMutable(both, [active]), false);
  assert.equal(
    activityIsMutable(
      activity({ allocations: [{ id: "a3", credentialId: "cred-3", credentialName: "Three", allocatedUnits: 1 }] }),
      [active, submitted, renewed],
    ),
    false,
  );
  // An archived credential is absent from the open list, so its records freeze.
  assert.equal(
    activityIsMutable(activity({ credentialId: "cred-9", credentialName: "Archived" }), [active]),
    false,
  );
  // No allocations at all: nothing forbids the edit.
  assert.equal(activityIsMutable(activity(), []), true);
});

test("requirementRawEarned prefers rawEarned, then earnedUnits, then 0", () => {
  assert.equal(requirementRawEarned({ id: "r", name: "R", requiredUnits: 10, earnedUnits: 4, rawEarned: 6 }), 6);
  assert.equal(requirementRawEarned({ id: "r", name: "R", requiredUnits: 10, earnedUnits: 4 }), 4);
  assert.equal(requirementRawEarned({ id: "r", name: "R", requiredUnits: 10, earnedUnits: undefined }), 0);
  assert.equal(requirementRawEarned({ id: "r", name: "R", requiredUnits: 10, earnedUnits: 4, rawEarned: 0 }), 0);
});

test("hasPortalConfirmedCarryover / isPriorPeriodCarryoverEntry: only a carry-over credential, only before cycleStart", () => {
  const carry = credential({ requirements: [carryoverRequirement()] });
  assert.equal(hasPortalConfirmedCarryover(carry), true);
  assert.equal(hasPortalConfirmedCarryover(credential()), false);
  assert.equal(
    hasPortalConfirmedCarryover(credential({ requirements: [carryoverRequirement({ applicabilityStatus: "not_applicable" })] })),
    false,
  );
  assert.equal(hasPortalConfirmedCarryover(credential({ requirements: [carryoverRequirement({ isActive: false })] })), false);
  // Unlike confirmedCarryoverWindowStart, an undecided status still counts here.
  assert.equal(
    hasPortalConfirmedCarryover(credential({ requirements: [carryoverRequirement({ applicabilityStatus: undefined })] })),
    true,
  );
  assert.equal(hasPortalConfirmedCarryover(null), false);
  assert.equal(isPriorPeriodCarryoverEntry("2025-06-01", carry), true);
  assert.equal(isPriorPeriodCarryoverEntry("2026-01-01", carry), false);
  assert.equal(isPriorPeriodCarryoverEntry("2026-03-01", carry), false);
  assert.equal(isPriorPeriodCarryoverEntry("2025-06-01", credential()), false);
  assert.equal(isPriorPeriodCarryoverEntry(null, carry), false);
  assert.equal(isPriorPeriodCarryoverEntry("2025-06-01", null), false);
});
```

Create `tests/next-action.test.mjs` (the titles and button labels are the moved strings as they are at `c6b1fe4` — "Log qualifying learning", "Add completed learning", "Classify 1 learning record" — pinned here as moved behaviour; Task 8 rewrites them under the copy table and re-pins in the same commit):

```js
// `app/lib/nextAction.ts` is Home's "Best next action" ladder, moved verbatim
// from ITrackApp.tsx with `today` (YYYY-MM-DD) as a parameter, so the
// overdue-task test is a string comparison and no case reads the clock. The
// titles and button labels pinned here are the moved strings as they are at
// c6b1fe4; the Home task rewrites them under the copy table and re-pins.
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import { bestNextAction } from "../.test-build/nextAction.js";

const TODAY = "2026-09-15";

const clinical = (earnedUnits = 5) => ({
  id: "req-clinical",
  ruleCategoryId: null,
  name: "Clinical",
  requiredUnits: 20,
  earnedUnits,
  kind: "minimum",
  applicabilityStatus: "applies",
  isActive: true,
});

const task = (overrides = {}) => ({
  id: "task-1",
  title: "Upload ethics certificate",
  kind: "progress",
  status: "pending",
  dueDate: null,
  completedAt: null,
  revision: 1,
  isPersonal: false,
  ...overrides,
});

function credential(overrides = {}) {
  return {
    id: "cred-1",
    ruleSetId: null,
    credentialName: "E2E credential",
    profession: "Counseling",
    jurisdiction: "Rhode Island",
    cycleStart: "2026-01-01",
    deadline: "2027-12-31",
    totalRequired: 40,
    unitLabel: "credits",
    cycleMonths: 24,
    status: "active",
    totalEarned: 5,
    unclassifiedUnits: 0,
    classificationIssues: [],
    requirements: [clinical()],
    tasks: [],
    archivedTasks: [],
    revision: 1,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

// The credits-complete shape every later rung is tested on.
const complete = (overrides = {}) =>
  credential({ totalEarned: 40, requirements: [clinical(20)], ...overrides });

test("a short active minimum is the learning rung (the button label is the c6b1fe4 string)", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(bestNextAction(credential(), 0, TODAY), {
    kind: "learning",
    title: "Complete 15 more Clinical credits",
    body: "35 credits remain overall; prioritize this category.",
    buttonLabel: "Log qualifying learning",
  });
  // The overall total met, the category still short.
  assert.deepEqual(bestNextAction(credential({ totalEarned: 40 }), 0, TODAY).body,
    "Your overall total is met, but this active category minimum is still short.");
});

test("an overdue task is a checklist rung carrying its ISO due date; the same task is not overdue before it", () => {
  const withTask = credential({ tasks: [task({ dueDate: "2026-01-01" })] });
  assert.deepEqual(bestNextAction(withTask, 0, "2026-02-01"), {
    kind: "checklist",
    title: "Upload ethics certificate",
    body: "This checklist step was due Jan 1, 2026.",
    buttonLabel: "Open checklist",
    dueDate: "2026-01-01",
  });
  assert.equal(bestNextAction(withTask, 0, "2025-12-01").kind, "learning");
  // Due today is not yet overdue (strictly before today).
  assert.equal(bestNextAction(withTask, 0, "2026-01-01").kind, "learning");
  // A completed task never counts, whatever its date.
  assert.equal(
    bestNextAction(credential({ tasks: [task({ dueDate: "2026-01-01", status: "completed" })] }), 0, "2026-02-01").kind,
    "learning",
  );
});

test("a renewed cycle is history; a submitted one asks for acceptance in its family's words", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(bestNextAction(credential({ status: "renewed" }), 0, TODAY), {
    kind: "history",
    title: "Review the preserved record for this completed cycle",
    body: "Your credits, proof, submission, and acceptance remain together.",
    buttonLabel: "View cycle history",
  });
  assert.deepEqual(bestNextAction(credential({ status: "submitted" }), 0, TODAY), {
    kind: "acceptance",

  assert.equal(bestNextAction(credential({ status: "submitted", ruleSetId: "isc2-cc-2026-v1" }), 0, TODAY).buttonLabel, "Confirm renewed cycle");
  assert.equal(bestNextAction(credential({ status: "submitted", ruleSetId: "fl-insurance-producer-2026-v1" }), 0, TODAY).buttonLabel, "Start next period");
  assert.equal(
    bestNextAction(credential({ status: "submitted", ruleSetId: "nremt-emt-nccp-ce-2025-v1" }), 0, TODAY).title,
    "Confirm the renewed dates in your National Registry dashboard",
  );
});

test("an undecided rule outranks everything on an open cycle", () => {
  const undecided = credential({
    tasks: [task({ dueDate: "2026-01-01" })],
    requirements: [clinical(), { ...clinical(), id: "req-cond", name: "Supervision", applicabilityStatus: "needs_confirmation" }],
  });

test("the two records rungs carry their count: classification issues first, then records missing proof", () => {

  assert.deepEqual(bestNextAction(credential({ classificationIssues: [issue], unclassifiedUnits: 3 }), 2, TODAY), {
    kind: "records",

  });

    buttonLabel: "Review records",
    count: 2,
  });

});

test("with the minimum met, the overall remainder is the learning rung (singular unit at 1)", () => {

  const checkpoint = {
```

Create `tests/allocation.test.mjs` (`FormData` is a global in Node 22, so the builders are driven exactly as the sheet drives them):

```js
// `app/lib/allocation.ts` builds the exact-allocation payloads the NREMT and
// CRCC allocators post and holds the allocator amount helpers, moved verbatim
// from ITrackApp.tsx. They read FormData — a web standard Node 22 provides —
// so the suite drives them exactly as the sheet does, against the ESM
// `npm run build:lib-test` emits.
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import {
  allocationAmount,
  allocationFigure,
  crcApprovalPayload,
  crcRequirementMatchPayload,
  nremtRequirementMatchPayload,
  seedAllocationAmounts,
} from "../.test-build/allocation.js";

const requirement = (id, ruleCategoryId, name, extra = {}) => ({
  id,
  ruleCategoryId,
  name,
  requiredUnits: 10,
  earnedUnits: 0,
  applicabilityStatus: "applies",
  isActive: true,
  ...extra,
});

function form(fields) {
  const data = new FormData();
  for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(fields)) data.set(name, value);
  return data;
}

const nremtCredential = {
  id: "nremt-1",
  ruleSetId: "nremt-emt-nccp-ce-2025-v1",
  credentialName: "NREMT EMT",
  profession: "EMS",
  jurisdiction: "National",
  cycleStart: "2025-04-01",
  deadline: "2027-03-31",
  totalRequired: 40,
  unitLabel: "credits",
  cycleMonths: 24,
  status: "active",
  totalEarned: 0,
  requirements: [
    requirement("req-national", "nremt-emt-2025-national", "National"),
    requirement("req-local", "nremt-emt-2025-local", "Local/State"),
    requirement("req-individual", "nremt-emt-2025-individual", "Individual"),
    requirement("req-airway", "nremt-emt-2025-national-airway", "Airway", {
      relation: "nested",
      parentRequirementId: "req-national",
    }),
    requirement("req-pediatric", "nremt-emt-2025-pediatric", "Pediatric overlap", {
      relation: "overlapping",
    }),
    // Not applicable this cycle: never read, never emitted.
    requirement("req-skipped", "nremt-emt-2025-skipped", "Skipped", { applicabilityStatus: "not_applicable" }),
  ],
  tasks: [],
  archivedTasks: [],
  revision: 1,
};

const crcCredential = {
  ...nremtCredential,
  id: "crc-1",
  ruleSetId: "crcc-crc-2026-v1",
  credentialName: "CRC",
  requirements: [
    requirement("req-general", "crcc-crc-2026-general", "General / Other Accepted CRC Credit"),
    requirement("req-pd", "crcc-crc-2026-professional-development", "Professional Development"),
    requirement("req-ethics", "crcc-crc-2026-ethics", "Ethics"),
  ],
};

test("nremtRequirementMatchPayload emits every applying requirement with an amount when the components and topics balance", () => {
  const data = form({
    "requirementMatch:req-national": "3",
    "requirementMatch:req-local": "2",
    "requirementMatch:req-individual": "1",
    "requirementMatch:req-airway": "3",
    "requirementMatch:req-pediatric": "1",
    acceptedEducationAttested: "on",
  });
  assert.deepEqual(nremtRequirementMatchPayload(data, nremtCredential, 6), [
    { requirementId: "req-national", matchedUnits: 3 },
    { requirementId: "req-local", matchedUnits: 2 },
    { requirementId: "req-individual", matchedUnits: 1 },
    { requirementId: "req-airway", matchedUnits: 3 },
    { requirementId: "req-pediatric", matchedUnits: 1 },
  ]);
  // A zero amount is dropped from the payload rather than sent as 0.
  const zeros = form({
    "requirementMatch:req-national": "0",
    "requirementMatch:req-local": "4",
    "requirementMatch:req-individual": "2",
    acceptedEducationAttested: "on",
  });
  assert.deepEqual(nremtRequirementMatchPayload(zeros, nremtCredential, 6), [
    { requirementId: "req-local", matchedUnits: 4 },
    { requirementId: "req-individual", matchedUnits: 2 },
  ]);
});

test("nremtRequirementMatchPayload throws the sheet's sentences for every imbalance and the missing attestation", () => {
  const balanced = {
    "requirementMatch:req-national": "3",
    "requirementMatch:req-local": "2",
    "requirementMatch:req-individual": "1",
    "requirementMatch:req-airway": "3",
    acceptedEducationAttested: "on",
  };
  assert.throws(
    () => nremtRequirementMatchPayload(form({ ...balanced, "requirementMatch:req-individual": "2" }), nremtCredential, 6),
    { message: "National, Local/State, and Individual must total 6 credits." },
  );
  assert.throws(
    () => nremtRequirementMatchPayload(form({ ...balanced, "requirementMatch:req-airway": "2" }), nremtCredential, 6),
    { message: "The five National topic amounts must total 3 National credits." },
  );
  assert.throws(
    () => nremtRequirementMatchPayload(form({ ...balanced, "requirementMatch:req-pediatric": "4" }), nremtCredential, 6),
    { message: "Pediatric overlap is overlapping National content and cannot exceed the National amount." },
  );
  assert.throws(
    () => nremtRequirementMatchPayload(form({ ...balanced, "requirementMatch:req-national": "7" }), nremtCredential, 6),
    { message: "National cannot exceed the 6 credits applied to this credential." },
  );
  assert.throws(
    () => nremtRequirementMatchPayload(form({ ...balanced, "requirementMatch:req-local": "-1" }), nremtCredential, 6),
    { message: "Enter a valid accepted-credit amount for Local/State." },
  );
  const unattested = { ...balanced };
  delete unattested.acceptedEducationAttested;
  assert.throws(() => nremtRequirementMatchPayload(form(unattested), nremtCredential, 6), {
    message: "Confirm that the provider, course, and post-cap credit are accepted by the National Registry.",
  });
  assert.throws(
    () => nremtRequirementMatchPayload(form(balanced), { ...nremtCredential, requirements: nremtCredential.requirements.slice(1) }, 6),
    { message: "This National Registry template is missing a component requirement. Refresh the credential before saving." },
  );
});

test("crcRequirementMatchPayload balances General + Professional Development to the hours and caps Ethics at General", () => {
  const data = form({
    "requirementMatch:req-general": "3",
    "requirementMatch:req-pd": "2",
    "requirementMatch:req-ethics": "1",
  });
  assert.deepEqual(crcRequirementMatchPayload(data, crcCredential, 5), [
    { requirementId: "req-general", matchedUnits: 3 },
    { requirementId: "req-pd", matchedUnits: 2 },
    { requirementId: "req-ethics", matchedUnits: 1 },
  ]);
  // Hundredths survive (CRC hours go to 0.01), and a zero ethics amount is dropped.
  assert.deepEqual(
    crcRequirementMatchPayload(form({ "requirementMatch:req-general": "2.25", "requirementMatch:req-pd": "0.75" }), crcCredential, 3),
    [
      { requirementId: "req-general", matchedUnits: 2.25 },
      { requirementId: "req-pd", matchedUnits: 0.75 },
    ],
  );
  assert.throws(
    () => crcRequirementMatchPayload(form({ "requirementMatch:req-general": "3", "requirementMatch:req-pd": "1" }), crcCredential, 5),
    { message: "General / Other Accepted CRC Credit and Professional Development must total 5 clock hours." },
  );
  assert.throws(
    () => crcRequirementMatchPayload(form({ "requirementMatch:req-general": "3", "requirementMatch:req-pd": "2", "requirementMatch:req-ethics": "4" }), crcCredential, 5),
    { message: "Ethics overlaps General / Other Accepted CRC Credit and cannot exceed the General amount." },
  );
  assert.throws(
    () => crcRequirementMatchPayload(form({ "requirementMatch:req-general": "6", "requirementMatch:req-pd": "0" }), crcCredential, 5),
    { message: "General / Other Accepted CRC Credit cannot exceed the 5 clock hours applied to this CRC." },
  );
  assert.throws(
    () => crcRequirementMatchPayload(form({}), { ...crcCredential, requirements: crcCredential.requirements.slice(0, 2) }, 5),
    { message: "This CRC template is missing an exact-allocation requirement. Refresh the credential before saving." },
  );
});

test("crcApprovalPayload reads the pathway, the trimmed reference and the attestation, and refuses each when missing", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(
    crcApprovalPayload(form({ crcApprovalType: "pre_approved", crcProgramReference: "  60007-1234  ", crcApprovalAttested: "on" })),
    { crcApprovalType: "pre_approved", crcProgramReference: "60007-1234", crcApprovalAttested: true },
  );
  assert.equal(
    crcApprovalPayload(form({ crcApprovalType: "post_approved", crcProgramReference: "TRN-9", crcApprovalAttested: "on" })).crcApprovalType,
    "post_approved",
  );
  assert.throws(() => crcApprovalPayload(form({ crcProgramReference: "x", crcApprovalAttested: "on" })), {
    message: "Choose the CRCC pre-approved or post-approved pathway.",
  });
  assert.throws(() => crcApprovalPayload(form({ crcApprovalType: "pre_approved", crcProgramReference: "   ", crcApprovalAttested: "on" })), {
    message: "Enter the CRCC approval number or post-approval program reference.",
  });
  assert.throws(() => crcApprovalPayload(form({ crcApprovalType: "pre_approved", crcProgramReference: "x" })), {
    message: "Confirm that the activity and entered hours are accepted by CRCC.",
  });
});

test("allocationFigure keeps the entered step, and the amount helpers round-trip the allocator's strings", () => {
  assert.equal(allocationFigure(2.25), "2.25");
  assert.equal(allocationFigure(0.1 + 0.2), "0.3");
  assert.equal(allocationFigure(3), "3");
  assert.equal(allocationFigure(-0.05), "-0.05");
  assert.deepEqual(
    seedAllocationAmounts([
      { requirementId: "a", matchedUnits: 2.5 },
      { requirementId: "b", matchedUnits: 3 },
    ]),
    { a: "2.5", b: "3" },
  );
  assert.deepEqual(seedAllocationAmounts([]), {});
  assert.equal(allocationAmount({ a: "2.5" }, "a"), 2.5);
  assert.equal(allocationAmount({}, "a"), 0);
  assert.equal(allocationAmount({ a: "" }, "a"), 0);
  assert.equal(allocationAmount({ a: "abc" }, "a"), 0);
});
```

Create `tests/format.test.mjs`:

```js
// `app/lib/format.ts` holds the formatters and the clock-taking countdown /
// state helpers moved out of ITrackApp.tsx (architecture-07). Every helper
// that used to read Date.now() / new Date() now takes the instant as an
// argument, so these cases pass a fixed `NOW` (the tests/instruments.test.mjs
// convention) and the suite holds in any zone the runner starts in.
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import { daysUntilDate } from "../.test-build/readiness.js";
import {
  allocationCategoryLabel,
  catalogCategorySummary,
  compactNumber,
  credentialCountdown,
  credentialInstrumentState,
  credentialRingState,
  cycleCountdownLabel,
  cycleStatusLabel,
  dayPart,
  daysUntil,
  firstName,
  formatDate,
  formatFileSize,
} from "../.test-build/format.js";

// 09:00 local on 2026-09-15 — the demo LCSW deadline (2026-11-30) reads 77 days.
const NOW = Date.parse("2026-09-15T09:00:00");

function credential(overrides = {}) {
  return {
    id: "cred-1",
    ruleSetId: null,
    credentialName: "E2E credential",
    profession: "Counseling",
    jurisdiction: "Rhode Island",
    cycleStart: "2026-01-01",
    deadline: "2026-11-30",
    totalRequired: 40,
    unitLabel: "credits",
    cycleMonths: 24,
    status: "active",
    totalEarned: 5,
    requirements: [],
    tasks: [],
    archivedTasks: [],
    revision: 1,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

test("formatDate is en-US short month, 'Not set' for nothing, and echoes an unparseable value", () => {
  assert.equal(formatDate("2026-11-30"), "Nov 30, 2026");
  assert.equal(formatDate("2026-11-30T23:15:00Z"), "Nov 30, 2026");
  assert.equal(formatDate(null), "Not set");
  assert.equal(formatDate(undefined), "Not set");
  assert.equal(formatDate(""), "Not set");
  assert.equal(formatDate("not-a-date"), "not-a-date");
  assert.equal(formatDate("2026-11-30", { month: "long" }), "November 30, 2026");
  assert.equal(formatDate("2026-11-30", { year: undefined }), "Nov 30");
});

test("formatFileSize reads KB below a mebibyte (never 0 KB) and MB with one decimal above", () => {
  assert.equal(formatFileSize(0), "1 KB");
  assert.equal(formatFileSize(512), "1 KB");
  assert.equal(formatFileSize(2048), "2 KB");
  assert.equal(formatFileSize(1_048_575), "1024 KB");
  assert.equal(formatFileSize(1_048_576), "1.0 MB");
  assert.equal(formatFileSize(2_621_440), "2.5 MB");
});

test("compactNumber keeps integers whole and rounds fractions to one decimal", () => {
  assert.equal(compactNumber(12), "12");
  assert.equal(compactNumber(12.5), "12.5");
  assert.equal(compactNumber(2.25), "2.3");
  assert.equal(compactNumber(0), "0");
});

test("firstName takes the email local part or the first word, else 'there'", () => {
  assert.equal(firstName("alex@example.com"), "alex");
  assert.equal(firstName("Alex Morgan"), "Alex");
  assert.equal(firstName("Alex"), "Alex");
  assert.equal(firstName(""), "there");
});

test("daysUntil counts to the end of the deadline day at the given instant (due today reads 1)", () => {
  assert.equal(daysUntil("2026-09-15", NOW), 1);
  assert.equal(daysUntil("2026-09-15", NOW), daysUntilDate("2026-09-15", NOW));
  assert.equal(daysUntil("2026-11-30", NOW), 77);
  assert.equal(daysUntil("2026-09-01", NOW), -13);
});

test("credentialCountdown is the cycle's countdown at the given instant, or the closed marker", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(credentialCountdown(credential(), NOW), { kind: "due", days: 77 });
  assert.deepEqual(credentialCountdown(credential({ deadline: "2026-09-01" }), NOW), {
    kind: "overdue",
    days: -13,
  });
  assert.deepEqual(
    credentialCountdown(credential({ status: "renewed", acceptedAt: "2026-06-15" }), NOW),
    { kind: "closed", acceptedAt: "2026-06-15" },
  );
  assert.deepEqual(credentialCountdown(credential({ status: "renewed" }), NOW), {
    kind: "closed",
    acceptedAt: null,
  });
});

test("credentialInstrumentState follows the cycle; credentialRingState turns complete on credits alone", () => {
  assert.equal(credentialInstrumentState(credential(), NOW), "due-soon");
  assert.equal(credentialInstrumentState(credential({ deadline: "2028-03-31" }), NOW), "on-track");
  assert.equal(credentialInstrumentState(credential({ deadline: "2026-09-01" }), NOW), "overdue");
  assert.equal(credentialInstrumentState(credential({ status: "submitted" }), NOW), "submitted");
  assert.equal(credentialInstrumentState(credential({ status: "renewed" }), NOW), "complete");
  assert.equal(credentialRingState(credential(), NOW), "due-soon");
  assert.equal(credentialRingState(credential({ totalEarned: 40 }), NOW), "complete");
  assert.equal(credentialRingState(credential({ totalEarned: 40, deadline: "2026-09-01" }), NOW), "complete");
  // A checklist-only credential never completes by credits.
  assert.equal(credentialRingState(credential({ totalRequired: 0, totalEarned: 0 }), NOW), "due-soon");
});

test("allocationCategoryLabel joins the matched names, falls back to the single name, then 'General'", () => {
  assert.equal(
    allocationCategoryLabel({ id: "a", credentialId: "c", credentialName: "C", allocatedUnits: 1, categoryNames: ["Ethics", "Clinical"] }),
    "Ethics · Clinical",
  );
  assert.equal(
    allocationCategoryLabel({ id: "a", credentialId: "c", credentialName: "C", allocatedUnits: 1, categoryNames: [], categoryName: "Ethics" }),
    "Ethics",
  );
  assert.equal(
    allocationCategoryLabel({ id: "a", credentialId: "c", credentialName: "C", allocatedUnits: 1 }),
    "General",
  );
});

test("catalogCategorySummary words a minimum, a cap, an informational line and the conditional qualifier", () => {
  assert.equal(catalogCategorySummary({ id: "c1", name: "Clinical", requiredUnits: 20 }), "20 Clinical");
  assert.equal(
    catalogCategorySummary({ id: "c2", name: "Self-study", requiredUnits: 10, kind: "maximum" }),
    "Up to 10 Self-study",
  );
  assert.equal(
    catalogCategorySummary({ id: "c3", name: "CPR", requiredUnits: 0, kind: "informational", applicability: "conditional" }),
    "Track CPR if applicable",
  );
  assert.equal(
    catalogCategorySummary({ id: "c4", name: "Ethics", requiredUnits: 2.5, applicability: "conditional" }),
    "2.5 Ethics if applicable",
  );
});

test("cycleStatusLabel and cycleCountdownLabel are the Credentials list's row words", () => {
  assert.equal(cycleStatusLabel(credential()), "active");
  assert.equal(cycleStatusLabel(credential({ status: "submitted" })), "submitted");
  assert.equal(cycleStatusLabel(credential({ status: "submitted", ruleSetId: "isc2-cc-2026-v1" })), "awaiting ISC2 renewal");
  assert.equal(

  assert.equal(cycleCountdownLabel(credential({ deadline: "2026-09-01" }), NOW), "13 days overdue");
  assert.equal(
    cycleCountdownLabel(credential({ status: "renewed", acceptedAt: "2026-06-15" }), NOW),
    "Renewed Jun 15, 2026",
  );
  assert.equal(cycleCountdownLabel(credential({ status: "renewed" }), NOW), "Renewed Not set");
});

  assert.equal(dayPart(new Date("2026-09-15T08:00:00")), "morning");
  assert.equal(dayPart(new Date("2026-09-15T11:59:59")), "morning");
  assert.equal(dayPart(new Date("2026-09-15T12:00:00")), "afternoon");
  assert.equal(dayPart(new Date("2026-09-15T14:00:00")), "afternoon");
  assert.equal(dayPart(new Date("2026-09-15T17:59:59")), "afternoon");

  assert.equal(dayPart(new Date("2026-09-15T20:00:00")), "evening");
});
```

```js
  assert.equal(

    4,
  );
});

  assert.equal(questActionKey("log-activity"), "quest:log-activity");
  assert.equal(reminderActionKey("deadline:c-1"), "reminder:deadline:c-1");

});
```
