```tsx
"use client";

import {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  useState,
  type ReactNode,
} from "react";
import { useToast } from "../components/Toast";
import {
  FORM_ACTION_KEY,
  TIME_ZONE_ACTION_KEY,
  WEEKLY_GOAL_ACTION_KEY,
  activityActionKey,
  credentialActionKey,
  questActionKey,
  reminderActionKey,
  requirementActionKey,
  taskActionKey,
} from "./actionKeys";
import {
  FALLBACK_ERROR,
  OFFLINE_ERROR,
  SERVER_UNAVAILABLE_ERROR,
  SESSION_ENDED_ERROR,
  describeApiError,
  isConflictCode,
  type DescribedError,
  type ErrorCopy,
} from "./copy";
import { isAbveCredential } from "./credentialRules";
import {
  UTC_FALLBACK_ZONE,
  addDaysIso,
  deviceZoneSuggestion,
  effectiveDateZone,
  todayLocal,
} from "./dates";
import type { Navigation } from "./useNavigation";
import { deviceTimeZone } from "./webPush";
import {
  fetchWorkspace,
  postWorkspaceAction,
  type ActionEnvelope,
  type ActionName,
} from "./workspaceApi";
import type {
  Activity,
  ActivityAllocation,
  Credential,
  Reminder,
  RenewalTask,
  Requirement,
  WeeklyQuest,
  Workspace,
} from "./workspaceTypes";

// One store above the route switch (spec §1.5; architecture-04/05/14). It
// owns the workspace and its load status, the pending-key array, the page
// error, the thirteen modal slices and the row-level actions; screens read
// it through useWorkspace() and never receive a closure over root state.

export type WorkspaceStatus =
  | { kind: "loading" }
  | { kind: "offline" }
  | { kind: "failed"; httpStatus: number | null; copy: DescribedError }
  | { kind: "ready" };

export type ActionResult =
  | { ok: true; id: string }
  | { ok: false; copy: DescribedError; code: string | null };

// `key` defaults to FORM_ACTION_KEY — a sheet or modal submit, whose failure
// is returned to the caller and never written to the page banner. Any other
// key is a row-level write and reaches the banner unless `surface` says the
// caller renders it (the delete dialog: its banner would sit inert behind it).
export type RunOptions = {
  key?: string;
  success?: string;
  surface?: "page" | "caller";
};

export type ModalRequest =
  | { kind: "logActivity"; preselectCredentialId: string }
  | { kind: "credentialSetup" }
  | { kind: "submission"; credentialId: string }
  | { kind: "acceptance"; credentialId: string }
  | { kind: "reminders" }
  | { kind: "installHelp" }
  | { kind: "editActivity"; activity: Activity }
  | { kind: "editCredential"; credential: Credential }
  | { kind: "deleteCredential"; credential: Credential }
  | { kind: "task"; credential: Credential; task: RenewalTask | null }
  | { kind: "allocate"; activity: Activity }
  | { kind: "classify"; activity: Activity; allocation: ActivityAllocation }
  | { kind: "evidence"; activity: Activity };

export type ModalKind = ModalRequest["kind"];

export type WorkspaceStore = {
  workspace: Workspace | null;
  status: WorkspaceStatus;
  isOnline: boolean;
  dateZone: string;
  today(): string;
  nowMs(): number;
  reload(): Promise<boolean>;
  pending: {
    keys: readonly string[];
    isPending(key: string): boolean;
    form: boolean;
  };
  error: {
    page: DescribedError | null;
    clearPage(): void;
    showPage(copy: DescribedError): void;
  };
  run(
    action: ActionName,
    payload: Record<string, unknown>,
    options?: RunOptions,
  ): Promise<ActionResult>;
  actions: {
    toggleTask(task: RenewalTask): Promise<ActionResult>;
    setReminderState(
      reminder: Reminder,
      status: "dismissed" | "snoozed",
    ): Promise<ActionResult>;
    archiveActivity(activity: Activity): Promise<ActionResult>;
    restoreActivity(activity: Activity): Promise<ActionResult>;
    archiveCredential(credential: Credential): Promise<ActionResult>;
    restoreCredential(credential: Credential): Promise<ActionResult>;
    deleteCredential(
      credential: Credential,
      confirmName: string,
      deleteOrphanedEvidence: boolean,
    ): Promise<ActionResult>;
    archivePersonalTask(task: RenewalTask): Promise<ActionResult>;
    restorePersonalTask(task: RenewalTask): Promise<ActionResult>;
    setRequirementApplicability(
      credentialId: string,
      requirement: Requirement,
      status: "applies" | "not_applicable",
    ): Promise<ActionResult>;
    saveDentalCheckpoint(
      credentialId: string,
      requirement: Requirement,
      completed: boolean,
      evidenceNote: string,
    ): Promise<ActionResult>;
    claimWeeklyQuest(quest: WeeklyQuest): Promise<ActionResult>;
    updateWeeklyGoal(weeklyGoal: number): Promise<ActionResult>;
    adoptDeviceTimeZone(): Promise<ActionResult>;
  };
  modals: {
    open(request: ModalRequest): void;
    close(kind: ModalKind): void;
    closeAllEditors(): void;
    activityOpen: boolean;
    activityPreselectId: string;
    credentialOpen: boolean;
    submissionCredentialId: string | null;
    acceptanceCredentialId: string | null;
    remindersOpen: boolean;
    installHelpOpen: boolean;
    editingActivity: Activity | null;
    credentialEditor: Credential | null;
    credentialDeletion: Credential | null;
    taskEditor: { credential: Credential; task: RenewalTask | null } | null;
    allocationActivity: Activity | null;
    classificationRepair: {
      activity: Activity;
      allocation: ActivityAllocation;
    } | null;
    evidenceActivity: Activity | null;
  };
  openCredentialDetail(id: string): void;
  nav: Navigation;
  focusRequest: string | null;
  requestFocus(target: string | null): void;
  recentlyClosedSeriesId: string | null;
  markSeriesClosed(seriesId: string): void;
  // A 401 from any fetch: drops the workspace and closes every modal.
  sessionEnded(): void;
};

// A fetch that never reached the server (DNS, a dropped connection, a
// blocked request) is not a status, so the error map has no code for it.
export const NETWORK_ERROR: DescribedError = {
  what: "We couldn’t reach your workspace.",
  next: "Check your connection, then try again.",
  recovery: "retry",
  code: null,
  detail: null,
};

const ABVE_NEXT_CYCLE_UNAVAILABLE =
  "ABVE has not yet published a verified Fellow or Diplomate template for the cycle after December 31, 2027. Keep this completed cycle open until the next official requirements and dates are available.";

const CREDENTIAL_ARCHIVED_TOAST =
  "This credential is archived. Restore it to make changes.";

function described(
  copy: ErrorCopy,
  code: string | null = null,
  detail: string | null = null,
): DescribedError {
  return { ...copy, code, detail };
}

const WorkspaceContext = createContext<WorkspaceStore | null>(null);

export function WorkspaceProvider({
  nav,
  children,
}: {
  nav: Navigation;
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  const toast = useToast();
  // `nav` is a fresh object every render; its callbacks are stable and its
  // route is state, so a navigation rebuilt from those parts is stable per
  // route and the value memo below does not churn.
  const { route, navigations, setTab, openCredential, back, scrubQuery } = nav;
  const navigation = useMemo<Navigation>(
    () => ({ route, navigations, setTab, openCredential, back, scrubQuery }),
    [route, navigations, setTab, openCredential, back, scrubQuery],
  );

  const [workspace, setWorkspace] = useState<Workspace | null>(null);
  const [loadStatus, setLoadStatus] = useState<WorkspaceStatus>({
    kind: "loading",
  });
  const [isOnline, setIsOnline] = useState(true);
  const [pendingActionKeys, setPendingActionKeys] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [pageError, setPageError] = useState<DescribedError | null>(null);
  // The thirteen modal slices, one plain useState each (the modal-site guard
  // derives setter names from the identifiers in an ungated condition, and
  // independent slices keep a nested open working).
  const [activityOpen, setActivityOpen] = useState(false);
  const [activityPreselectId, setActivityPreselectId] = useState("");
  const [credentialOpen, setCredentialOpen] = useState(false);
  const [submissionCredentialId, setSubmissionCredentialId] = useState<
    string | null
  >(null);
  const [acceptanceCredentialId, setAcceptanceCredentialId] = useState<
    string | null
  >(null);
  const [remindersOpen, setRemindersOpen] = useState(false);
  const [installHelpOpen, setInstallHelpOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingActivity, setEditingActivity] = useState<Activity | null>(null);
  const [credentialEditor, setCredentialEditor] = useState<Credential | null>(
    null,
  );
  const [credentialDeletion, setCredentialDeletion] =
    useState<Credential | null>(null);
  const [taskEditor, setTaskEditor] = useState<{
    credential: Credential;
    task: RenewalTask | null;
  } | null>(null);
  const [allocationActivity, setAllocationActivity] =
    useState<Activity | null>(null);
  const [classificationRepair, setClassificationRepair] = useState<{
    activity: Activity;
    allocation: ActivityAllocation;
  } | null>(null);

  const handleSessionEnded = useCallback(() => {

    const requestId = (workspaceLoadSequence.current += 1);
    const superseded = () => requestId !== workspaceLoadSequence.current;
    const fail = (httpStatus: number | null, copy: DescribedError) => {
      setLoadStatus({ kind: "failed", httpStatus, copy });
      setPageError(copy);
    };
    setLoadStatus({ kind: "loading" });

      const parsed = await fetchWorkspace();

        // banner's reload, the refetch after a write). Drop it so the

        if (!superseded()) handleSessionEnded();

          parsed.status,

            ? described(SERVER_UNAVAILABLE_ERROR, null, parsed.text)
            : describeApiError(parsed),

      if (!parsed.ok) {
        const envelope = parsed.data as unknown as ActionEnvelope;
        fail(
          parsed.status,
          describeApiError({
            kind: "json",
            status: parsed.status,
            code: envelope.code,
            error: envelope.error,
          }),
        );
        return false;
      }
      setWorkspace(parsed.data);
      setLoadStatus({ kind: "ready" });
      setPageError(null);
      return true;
    } catch {
      if (superseded()) return false;
      fail(null, NETWORK_ERROR);

            kind: "json",
            status: parsed.status,
            code: result.code,
            error: result.error,

            } else if (toPage) {

            return { ok: false, copy, code };
          }
          if (toPage) setPageError(copy);
          return { ok: false, copy, code };
        }

      } catch {
        const copy = described(FALLBACK_ERROR);
        if (toPage) setPageError(copy);
        return { ok: false, copy, code: null };
      } finally {
        setPendingActionKeys((current) => {
          const index = current.indexOf(actionKey);
          if (index === -1) return current;
          const next = current.slice();
          next.splice(index, 1);
          return next;
        });

  );

      () => setIsOnline(window.navigator.onLine),

  const actions = useMemo<WorkspaceStore["actions"]>(
    () => ({
      async toggleTask(task) {

          "toggleTask",

      case "editCredential":

    () => ({

    () => (!isOnline && !workspace ? { kind: "offline" } : loadStatus),

  const value = useMemo<WorkspaceStore>(
    () => ({
      workspace,
      status,
      isOnline,
      dateZone,
      today,
      nowMs,
      reload,
      pending,
      error,
      run,
      actions,

      actions,
      dateZone,
      error,
      focusRequest,
      handleSessionEnded,
      isOnline,
      markSeriesClosed,
      modals,
      navigation,
      nowMs,
      openCredentialDetail,
      pending,
      recentlyClosedSeriesId,
      reload,
      requestFocus,
      run,
      status,
      today,
      workspace,
    ],
  );

  return (
    <WorkspaceContext value={value}>{children}</WorkspaceContext>
  );
}

export function useWorkspace(): WorkspaceStore {
  const store = useContext(WorkspaceContext);
  if (!store) throw new Error("useWorkspace() needs a WorkspaceProvider");
  return store;
}
```

```ts
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useToast } from "../components/Toast";
import { isOpenCycle } from "./cycles";
import type { Navigation } from "./useNavigation";
import { safeReminderLaunchTarget, type ReminderLaunchTarget } from "./webPush";
import { fetchDelivery } from "./workspaceApi";
import type { WorkspaceStore } from "./workspaceStore";

// The push-alert launch path: the service-worker registration, the one-time
// `?delivery=` token or an OPEN_REMINDER message from the worker, the
// resolver that turns either into a highlighted Home check-in, and the scroll
// to that row. Mounted once by the composition root, on every route.
export function useReminderLaunch(
  store: WorkspaceStore,
  nav: Navigation,
): { highlightedReminderKey: string } {
  const toast = useToast();
  const { workspace, sessionEnded } = store;
  const { setTab: navigateToTab, scrubQuery } = nav;
  const view = nav.route.tab;
  const [pendingReminderLaunch, setPendingReminderLaunch] =
    useState<ReminderLaunchTarget | null>(null);
  const [highlightedReminderKey, setHighlightedReminderKey] = useState("");

  // Keep-list (ITrackApp.tsx:1863-1879 at c6b1fe4): the registration call,
  // its scope and updateViaCache are unchanged. The `.then` that cached the
  // registration in a push ref is gone: usePushDevice, which owns that ref,
  // awaits navigator.serviceWorker.ready wherever it needs the registration.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (
      "serviceWorker" in navigator &&
      window.isSecureContext
    ) {
      void navigator.serviceWorker
        .register("/sw.js", {
          scope: "/",
          updateViaCache: "none",
        })
        .catch(() => undefined);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const launchTarget = safeReminderLaunchTarget(window.location.href);
    const launchTimeout = launchTarget
      ? window.setTimeout(() => setPendingReminderLaunch(launchTarget), 0)
      : null;

    const handleServiceWorkerMessage = (event: MessageEvent<unknown>) => {
      if (
        !event.data ||
        typeof event.data !== "object" ||
        !("type" in event.data) ||
        event.data.type !== "OPEN_REMINDER" ||
        !("path" in event.data) ||
        typeof event.data.path !== "string"
      ) {
        return;
      }
      const target = safeReminderLaunchTarget(event.data.path);
      if (target) setPendingReminderLaunch(target);
    };
    navigator.serviceWorker?.addEventListener(
      "message",
      handleServiceWorkerMessage,
    );
    return () => {
      if (launchTimeout !== null) window.clearTimeout(launchTimeout);
      navigator.serviceWorker?.removeEventListener(
        "message",
        handleServiceWorkerMessage,
      );
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!workspace || !pendingReminderLaunch) return;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    // Scrub the one-time `?delivery=` token out of the address bar so a
    // refresh cannot replay it; the route itself is not touched.
    scrubQuery();
    void (async () => {
      try {
        const parsed = await fetchDelivery(
          pendingReminderLaunch.deliveryId,
          controller.signal,
        );
        if (parsed.kind === "session-ended") {
          if (!controller.signal.aborted) sessionEnded();
          return;
        }
        const delivered = parsed.kind === "json" && parsed.ok;
        const result = parsed.kind === "json" ? parsed.data : {};
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        setPendingReminderLaunch(null);
        if (
          !delivered ||
          typeof result.target?.credentialId !== "string" ||
          typeof result.target.reminderKey !== "string"
        ) {
          setHighlightedReminderKey("");
          toast.show({
            message:
              "That check-in is no longer available in this signed-in workspace.",
          });
          return;
        }
        const credential = workspace.credentials.find(
          (candidate) =>
            candidate.id === result.target?.credentialId &&
            isOpenCycle(candidate),
        );
        const reminder = workspace.reminders.find(
          (candidate) =>
            candidate.key === result.target?.reminderKey &&
            candidate.credentialId === result.target?.credentialId,
        );
        if (!credential) {
          setHighlightedReminderKey("");
          toast.show({
            message:
              "That check-in is no longer available in this signed-in workspace.",
          });
          return;
        }
        navigateToTab("home");
        setHighlightedReminderKey(reminder?.key ?? "");
        if (!reminder) {
          toast.show({
            message:
              "That check-in may already be complete. The related credential is open.",
          });
        }
      } catch {
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        setPendingReminderLaunch(null);
        setHighlightedReminderKey("");
        toast.show({
          message:
            "That check-in could not be opened. Reconnect and try the alert again.",
        });
      }
    })();
    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [
    navigateToTab,
    pendingReminderLaunch,
    scrubQuery,
    sessionEnded,
    toast,
    workspace,
  ]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!highlightedReminderKey || view !== "home") return;
    const timeout = window.setTimeout(() => {
      const reminderElement = Array.from(
        document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-reminder-key]"),
      ).find(
        (element) =>
          element.dataset.reminderKey === highlightedReminderKey,
      );
      reminderElement?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
      reminderElement?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }, 100);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timeout);
  }, [highlightedReminderKey, view, workspace?.reminders]);

  return { highlightedReminderKey };
}
```

```ts
"use client";

import { useCallback, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { currentNremtCatalogRule } from "./credentialRules";
import { fetchCatalog } from "./workspaceApi";
import type { WorkspaceStore } from "./workspaceStore";
import type { CatalogRule, Credential } from "./workspaceTypes";

export type CatalogStatus = "idle" | "loading" | "ready" | "error";
export type CatalogGroup = { profession: string; rules: CatalogRule[] };

// The searchable template catalog is global reference data, fetched once per
// mount of the chooser instead of riding along on every workspace read. A
// failed attempt clears the cached request so the next load() retries.
export function useCatalog(store: WorkspaceStore) {
  const { sessionEnded, workspace } = store;
  const [catalogRules, setCatalogRules] = useState<CatalogRule[] | null>(null);
  const [catalogStatus, setCatalogStatus] = useState<CatalogStatus>("idle");
  const [catalogQuery, setCatalogQuery] = useState("");
  const [selectedRuleId, setSelectedRuleId] = useState("");
  const [customCredential, setCustomCredential] = useState(false);
  const catalogRequest = useRef<Promise<void> | null>(null);

  const load = useCallback(async (): Promise<void> => {
    if (catalogRequest.current) return catalogRequest.current;
    setCatalogStatus("loading");
    const request = (async () => {
      try {
        const parsed = await fetchCatalog();
        if (parsed.kind === "session-ended") {
          sessionEnded();
          throw new Error("session ended");
        }
        if (
          parsed.kind !== "json" ||
          !parsed.ok ||
          !Array.isArray(parsed.data.catalog)
        ) {
          throw new Error("catalog unavailable");
        }
        setCatalogRules(parsed.data.catalog);
        setCatalogStatus("ready");
      } catch {
        catalogRequest.current = null;
        setCatalogStatus("error");
      }
    })();
    catalogRequest.current = request;
    return request;
  }, [sessionEnded]);

  // The workspace payload carries only the templates this user's credentials
  // already reach; the chooser searches the lazily loaded global catalog and
  // falls back to those owned templates until it arrives.
  const catalogTemplates = useMemo(
    () => catalogRules ?? workspace?.catalog ?? [],
    [catalogRules, workspace],
  );

  const selectedRule = useMemo(
    () => catalogTemplates.find((rule) => rule.id === selectedRuleId) ?? null,
    [catalogTemplates, selectedRuleId],
  );

  const catalogMatches = useMemo(() => {
    const query = catalogQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!query) return catalogTemplates;
    return catalogTemplates.filter((rule) =>
      [
        rule.profession,
        rule.credentialName,
        rule.jurisdiction,
        rule.issuer,
      ]
        .join(" ")
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(query),
    );
  }, [catalogQuery, catalogTemplates]);

  const catalogGroups = useMemo<CatalogGroup[]>(() => {
    const groups = new Map<string, CatalogRule[]>();
    for (const rule of catalogMatches) {
      const rules = groups.get(rule.profession) ?? [];
      rules.push(rule);
      groups.set(rule.profession, rules);
    }
    return [...groups.entries()].map(([profession, rules]) => ({
      profession,
      rules,
    }));
  }, [catalogMatches]);

  const selectedNremtNextRule = useCallback(
    (credential: Credential | null) =>
      currentNremtCatalogRule(workspace?.catalog ?? [], credential),
    [workspace],
  );

  return {
    catalogRules,
    catalogStatus,
    catalogQuery,
    setCatalogQuery,
    selectedRuleId,
    setSelectedRuleId,
    customCredential,
    setCustomCredential,
    catalogTemplates,
    selectedRule,
    catalogMatches,
    catalogGroups,
    selectedNremtNextRule,
    load,
  };
}
```

```ts
"use client";

import {
  useCallback,
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  useState,
  type Dispatch,
  type SetStateAction,
} from "react";
import { useToast } from "../../components/Toast";
import {
  activityDraftShouldBePurged,
  activityDraftStorageKey,
  hasMeaningfulActivityDraft,
  legacyActivityDraftStorageKey,
  parseActivityDraft,
  serializeActivityDraft,
  type SavedActivityDraft,
} from "../../lib/activityDraft";
import type { ActivityDraft } from "../../lib/workspaceTypes";

export type ActivityDraftStatus = "idle" | "saving" | "saved" | "unavailable";

function blankDraft(today: string): ActivityDraft {
  return {
    title: "",
    completionDate: today,
    totalUnits: "",
    allocatedUnits: "",
    provider: "",
  };
}

// The read that used to be split between the workspace-load effect (purge an
// expired draft, migrate the pre-namespace email-keyed draft) and the sheet's
// open handler (parse, and drop a draft that no longer parses). Performed at
// read time in that order, so an expired draft can never be restored on the
// first open after a load. Storage restrictions must not block entry, so any
// throw reads as "no draft".
export function readSavedActivityDraft(
  namespace: string,
  legacyEmail: string,
): SavedActivityDraft | null {
  try {
    const draftStorageKey = activityDraftStorageKey(namespace);
    const legacyDraftStorageKey = legacyEmail
      ? legacyActivityDraftStorageKey(legacyEmail)
      : null;
    let serialized = window.localStorage.getItem(draftStorageKey);
    if (activityDraftShouldBePurged(serialized)) {
      window.localStorage.removeItem(draftStorageKey);
      serialized = null;
    }
    if (legacyDraftStorageKey && legacyDraftStorageKey !== draftStorageKey) {
      const legacySerialized =
        window.localStorage.getItem(legacyDraftStorageKey);
      const legacyDraft = parseActivityDraft(legacySerialized);
      if (!serialized && legacySerialized && legacyDraft) {
        window.localStorage.setItem(draftStorageKey, legacySerialized);
        serialized = legacySerialized;
      }
      if (serialized || (legacySerialized && !legacyDraft)) {
        window.localStorage.removeItem(legacyDraftStorageKey);
      }
    }
    const saved = parseActivityDraft(serialized);
    if (!saved && serialized) window.localStorage.removeItem(draftStorageKey);
    return saved;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function useActivityDraft(input: {
  namespace: string;
  legacyEmail: string;
  open: boolean;
  credentialId: string;
  preselectCredentialId: string;
  today: string;
}) {
  const { namespace, legacyEmail, open, credentialId, today } = input;
  const toast = useToast();
  const draftStorageKey = useMemo(() => {
    try {
      return namespace ? activityDraftStorageKey(namespace) : null;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }, [namespace]);
  const legacyDraftStorageKey = useMemo(
    () => (legacyEmail ? legacyActivityDraftStorageKey(legacyEmail) : null),
    [legacyEmail],
  );
  // Restored once, when the sheet mounts (the sheet unmounts on close, so a
  // mount is an open). A restored draft's fields are put back as they were
  // saved; where they land is the sheet's own credential choice.
  const [initial] = useState<SavedActivityDraft | null>(() =>
    namespace ? readSavedActivityDraft(namespace, legacyEmail) : null,
  );
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<ActivityDraft>(() =>
    initial
      ? {
          title: initial.title,
          completionDate: initial.completionDate,
          totalUnits: initial.totalUnits,
          allocatedUnits: initial.allocatedUnits || initial.totalUnits,
          provider: initial.provider,
        }
      : blankDraft(today),
  );
  const [restored, setRestored] = useState(Boolean(initial));
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<ActivityDraftStatus>(
    initial ? "saved" : "idle",
  );
  // Bumped by reset/discard so an autosave timer started before either runs
  // does not write the cleared draft back.
  const generation = useRef(0);

  const flush = useCallback((): boolean => {
    if (!draftStorageKey) return true;
    try {
      if (!hasMeaningfulActivityDraft(draft)) {
        window.localStorage.removeItem(draftStorageKey);
        setStatus("idle");
        return true;
      }
      window.localStorage.setItem(
        draftStorageKey,
        serializeActivityDraft({ credentialId, ...draft }),
      );
      setStatus("saved");
      return true;
    } catch {
      setStatus("unavailable");
      return false;
    }
  }, [credentialId, draft, draftStorageKey]);

  const clearSaved = useCallback((): boolean => {
    if (!draftStorageKey) return true;
    try {
      window.localStorage.removeItem(draftStorageKey);
      if (legacyDraftStorageKey) {
        window.localStorage.removeItem(legacyDraftStorageKey);
      }
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }, [draftStorageKey, legacyDraftStorageKey]);

  const reset = useCallback(() => {
    generation.current += 1;
    setDraft(blankDraft(today));
    setRestored(false);
    setStatus("idle");
  }, [today]);

  const discard = useCallback(() => {
    const cleared = clearSaved();
    reset();
    toast.show({
      message: cleared
        ? "The browser-saved course draft was cleared."
        : "The form was cleared, but this browser would not remove its saved draft. Clear iTrack site data to remove it.",
    });
  }, [clearSaved, reset, toast]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open || !draftStorageKey) return;
    const hasDraft = hasMeaningfulActivityDraft(draft);
    const current = generation.current;
    const statusTimeout = window.setTimeout(() => {
      setStatus(hasDraft ? "saving" : "idle");
    }, 0);
    const timeout = window.setTimeout(() => {
      if (current !== generation.current) return;
      flush();
    }, 250);
    return () => {
      window.clearTimeout(statusTimeout);
      window.clearTimeout(timeout);
    };
  }, [draft, draftStorageKey, flush, open]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const flushActivityDraft = () => flush();
    window.addEventListener("pagehide", flushActivityDraft);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("pagehide", flushActivityDraft);
  }, [flush, open]);

  return {
    draft,
    setDraft: setDraft as Dispatch<SetStateAction<ActivityDraft>>,
    restored,
    // A restored draft whose credential is no longer an open cycle lands on
    // no credential; the sheet shows the warning until one is chosen.
    restoreWarning: restored && credentialId === "",
    restoredCredentialId: initial?.credentialId ?? null,
    status,
    discard,
    clearSaved,
    flush,
    reset,
  };
}
```

```ts
"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useToast } from "../../components/Toast";
import {
  SESSION_ENDED_ERROR,
  describeApiError,
  type DescribedError,
} from "../../lib/copy";
import {
  applicationServerKeyBytes,
  detectedPushCapability,
  friendlyDeviceLabel,
  installedDisplayMode,
  pushSubscriptionUsesApplicationServerKey,
  serializePushSubscription,
  type PushDeviceState,
} from "../../lib/webPush";
import {
  postWorkspaceAction,
  type ActionEnvelope,
  type ActionName,
} from "../../lib/workspaceApi";
import type { WorkspaceStore } from "../../lib/workspaceStore";
import type { InstallPromptEvent } from "../../lib/workspaceTypes";

const pushSubscriptionIdentity = (
  subscription: ReturnType<typeof serializePushSubscription>,
) =>
  `${subscription.endpoint}|${subscription.keys.p256dh}|${subscription.keys.auth}`;

// A refusal the API answered, already mapped to copy. Anything else the
// handlers throw is one of their own sentences.
class PushActionError extends Error {
  constructor(readonly copy: DescribedError) {
    super(copy.what);
  }
}

// The handlers' own sentences become a banner entry with no second
// sentence; Banners renders `next` only when it is set.
function ownSentence(message: string): DescribedError {
  return { what: message, next: "", recovery: "retry", code: null, detail: null };
}

function failureCopy(error: unknown, fallback: string): DescribedError {
  if (error instanceof PushActionError) return error.copy;
  return ownSentence(error instanceof Error ? error.message : fallback);
}

export function usePushDevice(store: WorkspaceStore) {
  const toast = useToast();
  const { workspace, modals, reload, sessionEnded } = store;
  const { showPage, clearPage } = store.error;
  const [installPrompt, setInstallPrompt] =
    useState<InstallPromptEvent | null>(null);
  const [isStandalone, setIsStandalone] = useState(false);
  const [pushDeviceState, setPushDeviceState] =
    useState<PushDeviceState>("checking");
  const [pushPending, setPushPending] = useState(false);
  const [currentPushSubscription, setCurrentPushSubscription] =
    useState<PushSubscription | null>(null);
  const pushRegistrationRef = useRef<ServiceWorkerRegistration | null>(null);
  const savedPushSubscriptionRef = useRef<string | null>(null);

  const workspaceLoaded = Boolean(workspace);
  const webPushConfigured = Boolean(
    workspace?.reminderPreferences.webPushConfigured,
  );
  const vapidPublicKey = workspace?.reminderPreferences.vapidPublicKey ?? null;

  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
    const capability = detectedPushCapability(isStandalone);
    if (capability !== "available") {
      setCurrentPushSubscription(null);
      setPushDeviceState(capability);
      return;
    }
    if (!workspaceLoaded) {
      setPushDeviceState("checking");
      return;
    }
    if (!webPushConfigured || !vapidPublicKey) {
      setCurrentPushSubscription(null);
      setPushDeviceState("unconfigured");
      return;
    }
    try {
      const registration =
        pushRegistrationRef.current ??
        (await navigator.serviceWorker.ready);
      pushRegistrationRef.current = registration;
      const subscription = await registration.pushManager.getSubscription();
      if (
        subscription &&
        !pushSubscriptionUsesApplicationServerKey(
          subscription,
          vapidPublicKey,
        )
      ) {
        setCurrentPushSubscription(subscription);
        setPushDeviceState("available");
        return;
      }
      if (subscription) {
        const serializedSubscription = serializePushSubscription(subscription);
        const identity = pushSubscriptionIdentity(serializedSubscription);
        if (savedPushSubscriptionRef.current !== identity) {
          const { response } = await postWorkspaceAction("savePushSubscription", {
            subscription: serializedSubscription,
            deviceLabel: friendlyDeviceLabel(),
            enableAccountPush: false,
          });
          if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error(
              "This device could not refresh its alert connection.",
            );
          }
          savedPushSubscriptionRef.current = identity;
        }
      }
      setCurrentPushSubscription(subscription);
      setPushDeviceState(subscription ? "subscribed" : "available");
    } catch {
      setCurrentPushSubscription(null);
      setPushDeviceState("error");
    }
  }, [isStandalone, vapidPublicKey, webPushConfigured, workspaceLoaded]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const standalone = installedDisplayMode();
    const standaloneTimeout = window.setTimeout(
      () => setIsStandalone(standalone),
      0,
    );
    const handleInstallPrompt = (event: Event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      setInstallPrompt(event as InstallPromptEvent);
    };
    const handleInstalled = () => {
      setIsStandalone(true);
      setInstallPrompt(null);
    };
    window.addEventListener("beforeinstallprompt", handleInstallPrompt);
    window.addEventListener("appinstalled", handleInstalled);
    return () => {
      window.clearTimeout(standaloneTimeout);
      window.removeEventListener("beforeinstallprompt", handleInstallPrompt);
      window.removeEventListener("appinstalled", handleInstalled);
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timeout = window.setTimeout(() => {
      void refresh();
    }, 0);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timeout);
  }, [refresh]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const refreshOnVisibility = () => {
      if (document.visibilityState === "visible") {
        void refresh();
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", refreshOnVisibility);
    return () =>
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", refreshOnVisibility);
  }, [refresh]);

  const postPushAction = useCallback(
    async (
      action: ActionName,
      payload: Record<string, unknown>,
    ): Promise<ActionEnvelope> => {
      if (!window.navigator.onLine) {
        throw new Error(
          "Reconnect before changing phone-alert settings on this device.",
        );
      }
      const { response, parsed } = await postWorkspaceAction(action, payload);
      if (parsed.kind === "session-ended") {
        sessionEnded();
        throw new PushActionError({
          ...SESSION_ENDED_ERROR,
          code: "authentication_required",
          detail: null,
        });
      }
      if (parsed.kind === "unexpected") {
        throw new PushActionError(describeApiError(parsed));
      }
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new PushActionError(
          describeApiError({
            kind: "json",
            status: parsed.status,
            code: parsed.data.code,
            error: parsed.data.error,
          }),
        );
      }
      return parsed.data;
    },
    [sessionEnded],
  );

  const install = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!installPrompt) {
      modals.open({ kind: "installHelp" });
      return;
    }
    await installPrompt.prompt();
    const choice = await installPrompt.userChoice;
    setInstallPrompt(null);
    if (choice.outcome === "accepted") {
      setIsStandalone(true);
      toast.show({ message: "iTrack was added to this device." });
    }
  }, [installPrompt, modals, toast]);

  const enable = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!workspace) return;
    const capability = detectedPushCapability(isStandalone);
    if (capability === "install_required") {
      modals.open({ kind: "installHelp" });
      return;
    }
    if (capability === "denied") {
      setPushDeviceState("denied");
      toast.show({
        message:
          "Alerts are blocked in this device’s notification settings. Change that setting, then return here.",
      });
      return;
    }
    if (
      capability !== "available" ||
      !workspace.reminderPreferences.webPushConfigured ||
      !workspace.reminderPreferences.vapidPublicKey
    ) {
      toast.show({
        message:
          "Phone alerts are not available on this device yet. Calendar check-ins still work.",
      });
      return;
    }

    setPushPending(true);
    clearPage();
    let createdSubscription: PushSubscription | null = null;
    let savedOnServer = false;
    try {
      const registration =
        pushRegistrationRef.current ??
        (await navigator.serviceWorker.ready);
      pushRegistrationRef.current = registration;
      let subscription = await registration.pushManager.getSubscription();
      let replacedEndpoint: string | null = null;
      if (
        subscription &&
        !pushSubscriptionUsesApplicationServerKey(
          subscription,
          workspace.reminderPreferences.vapidPublicKey,
        )
      ) {
        replacedEndpoint = subscription.endpoint;
        await subscription.unsubscribe();
        subscription = null;
      }
      if (!subscription) {
        subscription = await registration.pushManager.subscribe({
          userVisibleOnly: true,
          applicationServerKey: applicationServerKeyBytes(
            workspace.reminderPreferences.vapidPublicKey,
          ),
        });
        createdSubscription = subscription;
      }
      const serializedSubscription = serializePushSubscription(subscription);
      await postPushAction("savePushSubscription", {
        subscription: serializedSubscription,
        deviceLabel: friendlyDeviceLabel(),
        enableAccountPush: true,
      });
      savedOnServer = true;
      savedPushSubscriptionRef.current = pushSubscriptionIdentity(
        serializedSubscription,
      );
      if (replacedEndpoint && replacedEndpoint !== subscription.endpoint) {
        await postPushAction("removePushSubscription", {
          endpoint: replacedEndpoint,
        }).catch(() => undefined);
      }
      setCurrentPushSubscription(subscription);
      setPushDeviceState("subscribed");
      await reload();
      toast.show({
        message:
          "Phone alerts are on for this device. Lock-screen previews stay private.",
      });
    } catch (pushError) {
      if (createdSubscription && !savedOnServer) {
        await createdSubscription.unsubscribe().catch(() => false);
      }
      setPushDeviceState(
        Notification.permission === "denied"
          ? "denied"
          : savedOnServer
            ? "subscribed"
            : "error",
      );
      showPage(failureCopy(pushError, "Phone-alert setup did not finish."));
    } finally {
      setPushPending(false);
    }
  }, [clearPage, isStandalone, modals, postPushAction, reload, showPage, toast, workspace]);

  const disable = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!workspace) return;
    setPushPending(true);
    clearPage();
    try {
      const registration = await navigator.serviceWorker.ready;
      const subscription =
        currentPushSubscription ??
        (await registration.pushManager.getSubscription());
      if (subscription) {
        await postPushAction("removePushSubscription", {
          endpoint: subscription.endpoint,
        });
        await subscription.unsubscribe();
      }
      savedPushSubscriptionRef.current = null;
      setCurrentPushSubscription(null);
      setPushDeviceState("available");
      await reload();
      toast.show({
        message:
          workspace.reminderPreferences.activePushDeviceCount > 1
            ? "Phone alerts are off on this device. Other connected devices are unchanged."
            : "Phone alerts are off.",
      });
    } catch (pushError) {
      showPage(
        failureCopy(
          pushError,
          "Phone alerts could not be turned off on this device.",
        ),
      );
      await refresh();
    } finally {
      setPushPending(false);
    }
  }, [clearPage, currentPushSubscription, postPushAction, refresh, reload, showPage, toast, workspace]);

  const test = useCallback(async () => {
    const subscription = currentPushSubscription;
    if (!subscription) {
      await refresh();
      toast.show({
        message: "Turn on phone alerts for this device before sending a test.",
      });
      return;
    }
    setPushPending(true);
    clearPage();
    try {
      await postPushAction("sendTestPush", {
        endpoint: subscription.endpoint,
      });
      toast.show({
        message:
          "Test sent. Your device will show a private iTrack check-in.",
      });
    } catch (pushError) {
      showPage(failureCopy(pushError, "The test alert could not be sent."));
    } finally {
      setPushPending(false);
    }
  }, [clearPage, currentPushSubscription, postPushAction, refresh, showPage, toast]);

  return {
    pushDeviceState,
    pushPending,
    isStandalone,
    installAvailable: Boolean(installPrompt),
    refresh,
    enable,
    disable,
    test,
    install,
  };
}
```

```ts
"use client";

import { useCallback } from "react";
import { useToast } from "../../components/Toast";
import { offerCalendarInvite, type CalendarInviteEvent } from "../../lib/calendarInvite";
import {
  allCheckInCalendarEvents,
  credentialDeadlineCalendarEvent,
  normalizedCalendarLeadDays,
  reminderCalendarEvent,
} from "../../lib/checkInCalendar";
import type { DescribedError } from "../../lib/copy";
import { isCompliancePeriodCredential } from "../../lib/credentialRules";
import type { WorkspaceStore } from "../../lib/workspaceStore";
import type { Credential, Reminder } from "../../lib/workspaceTypes";

const CALENDAR_UNAVAILABLE: DescribedError = {
  what: "The calendar file could not be opened on this device.",
  next: "Try again from your browser.",
  recovery: "retry",
  code: null,
  detail: null,
};

export function useCalendarActions(store: WorkspaceStore) {
  const toast = useToast();
  const { workspace } = store;
  const { showPage } = store.error;

  const deliverCalendarInvite = useCallback(
    async (
      events: CalendarInviteEvent[],
      fileName: string,
      successMessage: string,
    ) => {
      try {
        const delivery = await offerCalendarInvite(events, fileName);
        if (delivery !== "cancelled") {
          toast.show({ message: successMessage });
        }
      } catch {
        showPage(CALENDAR_UNAVAILABLE);
      }
    },
    [showPage, toast],
  );

  const addCredentialToCalendar = useCallback(
    async (credential: Credential) => {
      await deliverCalendarInvite(
        [
          credentialDeadlineCalendarEvent(
            credential,
            normalizedCalendarLeadDays(workspace?.reminderPreferences.leadDays),
          ),
        ],
        `${credential.credentialName}-${credential.deadline}`,
        isCompliancePeriodCredential(credential)
          ? "Compliance date handed off to your calendar."
          : "Renewal date handed off to your calendar.",
      );
    },
    [deliverCalendarInvite, workspace],
  );

  const addReminderToCalendar = useCallback(
    async (reminder: Reminder) => {
      await deliverCalendarInvite(
        [
          reminderCalendarEvent(
            reminder,
            normalizedCalendarLeadDays(workspace?.reminderPreferences.leadDays),
          ),
        ],
        `${reminder.credentialName}-${reminder.eventDate}`,
        "Check-in handed off to your calendar.",
      );
    },
    [deliverCalendarInvite, workspace],
  );

  const addAllCheckInsToCalendar = useCallback(async () => {
    const events = allCheckInCalendarEvents(
      workspace?.credentials ?? [],
      normalizedCalendarLeadDays(workspace?.reminderPreferences.leadDays),
    );
    if (!events.length) {
      toast.show({ message: "There are no open check-ins to add yet." });
      return;
    }
    await deliverCalendarInvite(
      events,
      "itrack-check-ins",
      `${events.length} calendar ${
        events.length === 1 ? "check-in" : "check-ins"
      } handed off with your reminder schedule.`,
    );
  }, [deliverCalendarInvite, toast, workspace]);

  return { addCredentialToCalendar, addReminderToCalendar, addAllCheckInsToCalendar };
}
```

```ts
"use client";

import { useCallback, useState } from "react";
import type { DescribedError } from "../../lib/copy";

// The one error a modal renders (architecture-04 / app-ux-24): a store
// result is kept as it is; a sentence the modal produced itself (an
// allocator's arithmetic, a missing file) is copy already and becomes the
// summary's one entry under the modal's title; "" or null clears.
export function useModalError(
  title: string,
): [DescribedError | null, (value: string | DescribedError | null) => void] {
  const [error, setErrorState] = useState<DescribedError | null>(null);
  const setError = useCallback(
    (value: string | DescribedError | null) => {
      if (typeof value !== "string") {
        setErrorState(value);
        return;
      }
      setErrorState(
        value
          ? { what: title, next: value, recovery: "retry", code: null, detail: null }
          : null,
      );
    },
    [title],
  );
  return [error, setError];
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { Icon } from "../components/Icon";
import type { DescribedError } from "../lib/copy";

export function LoadingDashboard() {
  return (
    <div
      className="view-stack"
      role="status"
      aria-busy="true"
      aria-label="Loading iTrack"
    >
      <div className="loading-heading">
        <span />
        <strong />
        <small />
      </div>
      <div className="loading-hero">
        <span />
        <span />
        <span />
      </div>
      <div className="loading-grid">
        <span />
        <span />
        <span />
        <span />
      </div>
      <p className="sr-only">
        Loading your renewal workspace
      </p>

}

export function OfflineWorkspace() {
  return (
    <section className="offline-workspace" role="status">
      <span className="offline-workspace-mark">
        <Icon name="zap" size={26} />
      </span>
      <span className="section-kicker">Connection paused</span>
      <h1>Your cloud record is still protected.</h1>
      <p>
        iTrack could not load this device’s signed-in workspace while
        offline. Reconnect and it will retry automatically; no credential,
        certificate, or account data was cached here.
      </p>
    </section>
  );
}

export function WorkspaceLoadFailure({
  status,
  copy,
  onRetry,
}: {
  status: number | null;
  copy: DescribedError;
  onRetry: () => void;
}) {
  const authenticationFailure = status === 401 || status === 403;

  return (
    <section
      className="offline-workspace workspace-load-failure"
      role="alert"
    >
      <span className="offline-workspace-mark">
        <Icon name="alert" size={26} />
      </span>
      <span className="section-kicker">
        {authenticationFailure ? "Protected workspace" : "Connection interrupted"}
      </span>
      <h1>{copy.what}</h1>
      <p>{copy.next}</p>
      <button
        className="button button-primary"
        type="button"
        onClick={
          authenticationFailure
            ? () => window.location.reload()
            : onRetry
        }
      >
        {authenticationFailure ? "Reload and sign in" : "Try again"}
      </button>
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Icon } from "../../components/Icon";
import { TIME_ZONE_ACTION_KEY, zoneOfferStorageKey } from "../../lib/actionKeys";
import { deviceZoneSuggestion } from "../../lib/dates";
import { deviceTimeZone } from "../../lib/webPush";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../lib/workspaceStore";

export function Banners() {
  const { workspace, isOnline, error, pending, reload, actions } = useWorkspace();
  // The one-tap offer: only while the stored zone is the literal 'UTC' and
  // the device reports a real, different zone. Never evaluated during SSR
  // because `workspace` is fetched on the client.
  const [zoneOfferDismissed, setZoneOfferDismissed] = useState(false);
  const zoneSuggestion = workspace
    ? deviceZoneSuggestion(
        workspace.reminderPreferences.timeZone,
        deviceTimeZone(),
      )
    : null;
  // A "Not now" from an earlier visit on this device. Read at render time
  // rather than synced into state from an effect (react-hooks/
  // set-state-in-effect): the read is idempotent, keyed on the account, and
  // never runs during SSR because `workspace` is fetched on the client.
  const zoneOfferDismissedEarlier = useMemo(() => {
    const namespace = workspace?.user.draftStorageNamespace;
    if (!namespace) return false;
    try {
      return (
        window.localStorage.getItem(zoneOfferStorageKey(namespace)) ===
        deviceTimeZone()
      );
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }, [workspace?.user.draftStorageNamespace]);

  function dismissZoneOffer() {
    if (workspace) {
      try {
        window.localStorage.setItem(
          zoneOfferStorageKey(workspace.user.draftStorageNamespace),
          deviceTimeZone(),
        );
      } catch {
        // Private mode or a full store: the offer simply returns next load.
      }
    }
    setZoneOfferDismissed(true);
  }

  return (
    <>
      {!isOnline ? (
        <div className="offline-banner" role="status">
          <span>
            <Icon name="zap" size={18} />
          </span>
          <div>
            <strong>Offline — your cloud record is protected</strong>
            <small>
              Course text can remain in a browser-saved draft. Reconnect
              to save changes or upload proof.
            </small>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {error.page && workspace ? (
        <div className="error-banner" role="alert">
          <div>
            <strong>{error.page.what}</strong>
            {error.page.next ? <span>{error.page.next}</span> : null}
          </div>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => void reload()}>
            Reload workspace
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {workspace &&
      isOnline &&
      zoneSuggestion &&
      !zoneOfferDismissed &&
      !zoneOfferDismissedEarlier ? (
        <div className="zone-banner" role="status">
          <div>
            <strong>Your device is in {zoneSuggestion}</strong>
            <small>Reminders and default dates currently use UTC.</small>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={pending.isPending(TIME_ZONE_ACTION_KEY)}
            onClick={() => void actions.adoptDeviceTimeZone()}
          >
            Use {zoneSuggestion}
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="link-button"
            onClick={dismissZoneOffer}
          >
            Not now
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}
```

The four editor components keep `error` as a prop (their bodies move verbatim in Step 9), so their error state and the submit handlers that used to sit in the root (`updateActivityRecord :3558-3577`, `saveCredentialEdit :3631-3678`, `deleteCredentialRecord :3726-3752`, `savePersonalTask :3753-3774`, and the archive calls) live here. Create `app/screens/modals/ModalsHost.tsx`:

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { FORM_ACTION_KEY, credentialActionKey } from "../../lib/actionKeys";
import type { DescribedError } from "../../lib/copy";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../lib/workspaceStore";
import type {
  Activity,
  Credential,
  CredentialEditInput,
  RenewalTask,
} from "../../lib/workspaceTypes";
import { AcceptanceModal } from "./AcceptanceModal";
import { ActivityEditorModal } from "./ActivityEditorModal";
import { AllocationModal } from "./AllocationModal";
import { ClassificationModal } from "./ClassificationModal";
import { ConfirmDeleteCredentialModal } from "./ConfirmDeleteCredentialModal";
import { CredentialEditorModal } from "./CredentialEditorModal";
import { CredentialSetupModal } from "./CredentialSetupModal";
import { EvidenceModal } from "./EvidenceModal";
import { InstallHelpModal } from "./InstallHelpModal";
import { LogActivityModal } from "./LogActivityModal";
import { PersonalTaskEditorModal } from "./PersonalTaskEditorModal";
import { RemindersModal } from "./RemindersModal";
import { SubmissionModal } from "./SubmissionModal";

// The thirteen modal render sites (ITrackApp.tsx:4200-6376 at c6b1fe4), one
// component each, spelled `{cond ? (\n<…Modal` for the modal-site guard in
// tests/app-source-guards.test.mjs: eight gated on `workspace`, five whose
// slice setter handleSessionEnded calls. The four editors' bodies take
// `error` as a prop, so their error state and submit wiring live here until
// Tasks 7 and 10 restyle them.
export function ModalsHost() {
  const store = useWorkspace();
  const { workspace, modals, run, actions, isOnline } = store;
  const {
    activityOpen,
    activityPreselectId,
    credentialOpen,
    submissionCredentialId,
    acceptanceCredentialId,
    remindersOpen,
    installHelpOpen,
    editingActivity,
    credentialEditor,
    credentialDeletion,
    taskEditor,
    allocationActivity,
    classificationRepair,
    evidenceActivity,
  } = modals;
  const pending = store.pending.form;
  const [editError, setEditError] = useState<DescribedError | null>(null);
  const [credentialEditError, setCredentialEditError] =
    useState<DescribedError | null>(null);
  const [deleteError, setDeleteError] = useState<DescribedError | null>(null);
  const [taskError, setTaskError] = useState<DescribedError | null>(null);
  // The milestone sheets act on the credential that opened them
  // (architecture-05); the acceptance sheet only on a submitted cycle, as its
  // old condition `acceptanceOpen && selectedCredential?.status === "submitted"` did.
  const submissionCredential =
    workspace && submissionCredentialId
      ? (workspace.credentials.find(
          (credential) => credential.id === submissionCredentialId,
        ) ?? null)
      : null;
  const acceptanceCredential =
    workspace && acceptanceCredentialId
      ? (workspace.credentials.find(
          (credential) =>
            credential.id === acceptanceCredentialId &&
            credential.status === "submitted",
        ) ?? null)
      : null;

  async function updateActivityRecord(input: {
    title: string;
    provider: string;
    completionDate: string;
    totalUnits: number;
    acceptedEducationAttested?: boolean;
    crcApprovalAttested?: boolean;
  }) {
    if (!editingActivity) return;
    const result = await run(
      "updateActivity",
      {
        activityId: editingActivity.id,
        expectedRevision: editingActivity.revision,
        ...input,
      },
      { key: FORM_ACTION_KEY, success: "Learning record corrected." },
    );
    if (result.ok) {
      setEditError(null);
      modals.close("editActivity");
    } else {
      setEditError(result.copy);
    }
  }

  async function archiveActivityRecord(activity: Activity) {
    const result = await actions.archiveActivity(activity);
    if (!result.ok) setEditError(result.copy);
  }

  async function saveCredentialEdit(input: CredentialEditInput) {
    if (!credentialEditor) return;
    // A source-linked credential accepts only its display name, its cycle
    // dates and the attestations; the server refuses the template-owned keys
    // (400 template_field_locked) rather than ignoring them, so they are only
    // ever sent for a custom credential. The server also reads a frozen key's
    // presence, not its value: a submitted cycle refuses cycleStart/deadline
    // (and, for a custom plan, the requirement keys) even when they are
    // unchanged (409 cycle_closed). Only what differs from the stored
    // credential goes on the wire, so a rename alone is always a rename.
    const stored = credentialEditor;
    const custom = stored.ruleReviewStatus === "custom";
    const changed = (key: string, value: unknown, current: unknown) =>
      value !== current ? { [key]: value } : {};
    const result = await run(
      "updateCredential",
      {
        credentialId: stored.id,
        expectedRevision: stored.revision,
        credentialName: input.credentialName,
        ...changed("cycleStart", input.cycleStart, stored.cycleStart),
        ...changed("deadline", input.deadline, stored.deadline),
        ...(custom
          ? {
              ...changed("issuer", input.issuer, stored.issuer ?? ""),
              ...changed(
                "jurisdiction",
                input.jurisdiction,
                stored.jurisdiction,
              ),
              ...changed("profession", input.profession, stored.profession),
              ...changed(
                "totalRequired",
                input.totalRequired,
                stored.totalRequired,
              ),
              ...changed("unitLabel", input.unitLabel, stored.unitLabel),
            }
          : {}),
        ...(input.officialDatesAttested ? { officialDatesAttested: true } : {}),
        ...(input.templateEligibilityAttested
          ? { templateEligibilityAttested: true }
          : {}),
      },
      { key: FORM_ACTION_KEY, success: "Credential updated." },
    );
    if (result.ok) {
      setCredentialEditError(null);
      modals.close("editCredential");
    } else {
      setCredentialEditError(result.copy);
    }
  }

  async function deleteCredentialRecord(
    credential: Credential,
    confirmName: string,
    deleteOrphanedEvidence: boolean,
  ) {
    const result = await actions.deleteCredential(
      credential,
      confirmName,
      deleteOrphanedEvidence,
    );
    if (!result.ok) setDeleteError(result.copy);
  }

  async function savePersonalTask(input: { title: string; dueDate: string }) {
    if (!taskEditor) return;
    const { credential, task } = taskEditor;
    const result = await run(
      task ? "updatePersonalTask" : "createPersonalTask",
      task
        ? {
            taskId: task.id,
            expectedRevision: task.revision,
            ...input,
          }
        : {
            credentialId: credential.id,
            ...input,
          },
      {
        key: FORM_ACTION_KEY,
        success: task ? "Personal task updated." : "Personal task added.",
      },
    );
    if (result.ok) {
      setTaskError(null);
      modals.close("task");
    } else {
      setTaskError(result.copy);
    }
  }

  async function archivePersonalTask(task: RenewalTask) {
    const result = await actions.archivePersonalTask(task);
    if (!result.ok) setTaskError(result.copy);
  }

  return (
    <>
      {workspace && activityOpen ? (
        <LogActivityModal
          workspace={workspace}
          preselectCredentialId={activityPreselectId}
        />
      ) : null}

      {editingActivity ? (
        <ActivityEditorModal
          key={`${editingActivity.id}:${editingActivity.revision}`}
          activity={editingActivity}
          error={editError}
          pending={pending}
          isOnline={isOnline}
          onClose={() => {
            setEditError(null);
            modals.close("editActivity");
          }}
          onSave={(input) => void updateActivityRecord(input)}
          onArchive={() => void archiveActivityRecord(editingActivity)}
        />
      ) : null}

      {workspace && credentialEditor ? (
        <CredentialEditorModal
          key={`${credentialEditor.id}:${credentialEditor.revision}`}
          credential={credentialEditor}
          error={credentialEditError}
          pending={
            pending ||
            store.pending.isPending(credentialActionKey(credentialEditor.id))
          }
          onClose={() => {
            setCredentialEditError(null);
            modals.close("editCredential");
          }}
          onSave={(input) => void saveCredentialEdit(input)}
        />
      ) : null}

      {credentialDeletion ? (
        <ConfirmDeleteCredentialModal
          key={credentialDeletion.id}
          credential={credentialDeletion}
          error={deleteError}
          pending={
            pending ||
            store.pending.isPending(credentialActionKey(credentialDeletion.id))
          }
          onClose={() => {
            setDeleteError(null);
            modals.close("deleteCredential");
          }}
          onConfirm={(confirmName, deleteOrphanedEvidence) =>
            void deleteCredentialRecord(
              credentialDeletion,
              confirmName,
              deleteOrphanedEvidence,
            )
          }
        />
      ) : null}

      {taskEditor ? (
        <PersonalTaskEditorModal
          key={`${taskEditor.task?.id ?? "new"}:${
            taskEditor.task?.revision ?? 0
          }`}
          credential={taskEditor.credential}
          task={taskEditor.task}
          error={taskError}
          pending={pending}
          isOnline={isOnline}
          onClose={() => {
            setTaskError(null);
            modals.close("task");
          }}
          onSave={(input) => void savePersonalTask(input)}
          onArchive={
            taskEditor.task
              ? () => {
                  const task = taskEditor.task;
                  if (task) void archivePersonalTask(task);
                }
              : undefined
          }
        />
      ) : null}

      {workspace && credentialOpen ? (
        <CredentialSetupModal />
      ) : null}

      {workspace && submissionCredential ? (
        <SubmissionModal credential={submissionCredential} />
      ) : null}

      {workspace && acceptanceCredential ? (
        <AcceptanceModal workspace={workspace} credential={acceptanceCredential} />
      ) : null}

      {workspace && remindersOpen ? (

      {installHelpOpen ? (

      {workspace && allocationActivity ? (
        <AllocationModal workspace={workspace} activity={allocationActivity} />
      ) : null}

      {classificationRepair ? (
        <ClassificationModal repair={classificationRepair} />
      ) : null}

      {workspace && evidenceActivity ? (
        <EvidenceModal workspace={workspace} activity={evidenceActivity} />
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}
```

Write the generator. It copies every JSX body and every component from the working file by anchor, asserts each is byte-identical to the reference range the brief names, applies the count-asserted substitutions, and writes each file with the header below:

```bash
cat > "$SCRATCH/extract-store.py" <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Wave 4 Task 5 — move the thirteen modal bodies, the four editors, ProgressRow,
the four allocators and the three load states out of app/ITrackApp.tsx VERBATIM,
wrap each in its file, and rebuild ITrackApp.tsx as the composition root plus the
five legacy views.

Every moved range is located in the WORKING file by its anchor text and asserted
byte-identical to the reference copy (`git show c6b1fe4:app/ITrackApp.tsx`), whose
line numbers the plan cites. Task 1 touched none of these ranges; an assertion
failure means it did — stop and compare, fix nothing by hand.

Usage:  python3 extract-store.py <worktree-root> <reference-copy>
"""
import pathlib
import re
import sys

ROOT = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
REF = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).read_text().splitlines()
assert len(REF) == 10868, f"reference copy has {len(REF)} lines, expected 10868 (main @c6b1fe4)"
SRC = ROOT / "app" / "ITrackApp.tsx"
WORK = SRC.read_text().splitlines()


def ref(a, b):
    """Lines a..b of the reference copy, inclusive, 1-based, verbatim."""
    return REF[a - 1:b]


def find(text, start=0, what=None):
    for i in range(start, len(WORK)):
        if WORK[i] == text:
            return i
    raise SystemExit(f"extract-store: could not find {what or text!r} in app/ITrackApp.tsx")


def check(lines, a, b, what):
    if lines != ref(a, b):
        raise SystemExit(
            f"extract-store: {what} is not byte-identical to reference lines {a}-{b}; "
            "Task 1 was not supposed to touch it — stop and compare"
        )


def modal_body(site, ref_a, ref_b):
    """From the `        <Modal` after the site line to its `        </Modal>`."""
    s = find(site)
    a = find("        <Modal", s + 1, f"the <Modal after {site.strip()!r}")
    b = find("        </Modal>", a + 1, f"the </Modal> of {site.strip()!r}")
    lines = WORK[a:b + 1]
    check(lines, ref_a, ref_b, site.strip())
    return "\n".join(lines)


def top_level(start, ref_a, ref_b, with_comment=False):
    """A column-0 function from its opening line to its closing `}`."""
    a = find(start)
    b = find("}", a + 1, f"the closing brace of {start.strip()!r}")
    if with_comment:
        while WORK[a - 1].startswith(" *") or WORK[a - 1].startswith("/*"):
            a -= 1
    lines = WORK[a:b + 1]
    check(lines, ref_a, ref_b, start.strip())
    return "\n".join(lines)


def root_function(start, ref_a, ref_b):
    """A handler inside ITrackApp() (indent 2) to its closing `  }`."""
    a = find(start)
    b = find("  }", a + 1, f"the closing brace of {start.strip()!r}")
    lines = WORK[a:b + 1]
    check(lines, ref_a, ref_b, start.strip())
    return "\n".join(lines)


def sub(text, pattern, repl, count, what):
    new, n = re.subn(pattern, repl, text)
    if n != count:
        raise SystemExit(f"extract-store: {what}: expected {count} replacement(s), made {n}")
    return new


def write(rel, *parts):
    text = "\n".join(p.rstrip("\n") for p in parts) + "\n"
    path = ROOT / rel
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(text)
    print(f"wrote {rel}")


MODAL_ERROR = r'<ModalError\n(\s*)title=("[^"]+")\n\s*message=\{error\}\n\s*/>'
MODAL_ERROR_TO = (
    r'<ErrorSummary\n\1title=\2\n\1errors={[{ message: error.next }]}'
    r'\n\1detail={error.detail ?? undefined}\n\1/>'
)
SUMMARY_LINE = r'errors=\{error \? \[\{ message: error \}\] : \[\]\}\n(\s*)/>'
SUMMARY_LINE_TO = r'errors={error ? [{ message: error.next }] : []}\n\1detail={error?.detail ?? undefined}\n\1/>'
ERROR_PROP = r'(?m)^  error: string;$'
ERROR_PROP_TO = '  error: DescribedError | null;'


def close_pair(setter_call, kind):
    """`setX(…);\\n  setError("");` → `modals.close("<kind>");`"""
    return (re.escape(setter_call) + r';\n\s*setError\(""\);', f'modals.close("{kind}");')

            ? form.get("complianceAttested") === "on"

        lateReinstatementAttested:

            selectedCredential.deadline
            ? form.get("lateReinstatementAttested") === "on"
            : undefined,
      },
      {
        key: FORM_ACTION_KEY,
        success: isIsc2AutomaticRenewalCredential(selectedCredential)
          ? "ISC2 dashboard checkpoint saved. Confirm renewal only after the new dates appear."
          : isCompliancePeriodCredential(selectedCredential)
            ? "Compliance-period milestone saved. Confirm the next period from the official record."
            : isNremtCredential(selectedCredential)

              : isCrcCredential(selectedCredential)
                ? "CRC renewal logged. Keep the CRCCCONNECT confirmation with your program records."
                : "Submission logged. Keep the confirmation until your renewal is accepted.",
      },
    );
    if (result.ok) {

    } else {
      setError(result.copy);
    }
  }

'''

// The acceptance milestone sheet: body verbatim from ITrackApp.tsx 5476-5769
// at c6b1fe4. ModalsHost hands it a submitted credential only.
export function AcceptanceModal({
  workspace,
  credential,
}: {
  workspace: Workspace;
  credential: Credential;
}) {
  const store = useWorkspace();
  const { markSeriesClosed, modals, nav, run, today } = store;
  const pending = store.pending.form;
  const selectedCredential = credential;
  const [error, setError] = useModalError("This cycle was not closed");
  const selectedNremtNextRule = useMemo(
    () => currentNremtCatalogRule(workspace.catalog, selectedCredential),
    [selectedCredential, workspace.catalog],
  );

  async function handleAcceptance(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const form = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
    const result = await run(
      "markRenewalAccepted",
      {
        credentialId: selectedCredential.id,
        acceptedAt: String(form.get("acceptedAt") ?? ""),
        reference: String(form.get("reference") ?? ""),
        nextCycleStart: String(form.get("nextCycleStart") ?? ""),
        nextDeadline: String(form.get("nextDeadline") ?? ""),
        nextRuleSetId: requiresCurrentNextTemplate(selectedCredential)
          ? String(form.get("nextRuleSetId") ?? "")
          : isNremtCredential(selectedCredential)
            ? selectedNremtNextRule?.id
            : undefined,
        officialDatesAttested:
          requiresOfficialNextPeriodAttestation(selectedCredential)
            ? form.get("officialDatesAttested") === "on"
            : undefined,
        templateEligibilityAttested:
          isManagedPharmacistCredential(selectedCredential) ||
          isManagedNursingCredential(selectedCredential) ||
          isManagedDentalCredential(selectedCredential) ||
          isExpandedCertificationCredential(selectedCredential)
            ? form.get("templateEligibilityAttested") === "on"
            : undefined,
      },
      {
        key: FORM_ACTION_KEY,
        success: isCompliancePeriodCredential(selectedCredential)
          ? "Compliance period completed. Your next period is ready."
          : isNremtCredential(selectedCredential)
            ? "National Registry renewal confirmed. Your dashboard dates are preserved."
            : "Renewal accepted. Your next cycle is ready.",
      },
    );
    if (!result.ok) {
      setError(result.copy);
      return;
    }
    modals.close("acceptance");
    // The fold moment Task 8 mounts on Home reads which series just closed.
    markSeriesClosed(selectedCredential.seriesId ?? selectedCredential.id);
    if (result.id && nav.route.detail) {
      // Accepting a renewal ends the cycle the screen was opened on and
      // starts its successor. The detail screen is addressed by URL, so it
      // is re-pointed at the new cycle — replacing the entry, so Back does
      // not return to the finished one.
      nav.openCredential(result.id, { replace: true });
    }
  }

  return (
'''

// "Reuse completed learning": body verbatim from ITrackApp.tsx 5977-6106 at
// c6b1fe4 (Task 6 restyles it). The credential choice is local: it starts on
// the first eligible credential, as the old onAllocate closure seeded it.
export function AllocationModal({
  workspace,
  activity,
}: {
  workspace: Workspace;
  activity: Activity;
}) {
  const store = useWorkspace();
  const { modals, run } = store;
  const pending = store.pending.form;
  const allocationActivity = activity;
  const [error, setError] = useModalError("This activity was not applied");
  const [allocationCredentialId, setAllocationCredentialId] = useState("");
  const eligibleAllocationCredentials = useMemo(() => {
    const existingIds = new Set(
      allocationsFor(allocationActivity).map(
        (allocation) => allocation.credentialId,
      ),
    );
    return workspace.credentials.filter(
      (credential) =>
        isOpenCycle(credential) &&
        !existingIds.has(credential.id) &&
        activityDateFitsCredential(
          allocationActivity.completionDate,
          credential,
        ),
    );
  }, [allocationActivity, workspace]);
  const allocationCredential =
    eligibleAllocationCredentials.find(
      (credential) => credential.id === allocationCredentialId,
    ) ??
    eligibleAllocationCredentials[0] ??
    null;

  async function handleAllocation(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const form = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
    const allocatedUnits = Number(form.get("allocatedUnits"));
    let nremtMatches: RequirementMatchPayload[] | undefined;
    let crcMatches: RequirementMatchPayload[] | undefined;
    let crcApproval: CrcApprovalPayload | undefined;
    if (isNremtCredential(allocationCredential)) {
      try {
        nremtMatches = nremtRequirementMatchPayload(
          form,
          allocationCredential!,
          allocatedUnits,
        );
      } catch (matchError) {
        setError(
          matchError instanceof Error
            ? matchError.message
            : "Review the National Registry credit allocation.",
        );
        return;
      }
    } else if (isCrcCredential(allocationCredential)) {
      try {
        crcMatches = crcRequirementMatchPayload(
          form,
          allocationCredential!,
          allocatedUnits,
        );
        crcApproval = crcApprovalPayload(form);
      } catch (matchError) {
        setError(
          matchError instanceof Error
            ? matchError.message
            : "Review the CRC clock-hour allocation.",
        );
        return;
      }
    }
    const result = await run(
      "addActivityAllocation",
      {
        activityId: allocationActivity.id,
        credentialId: String(form.get("credentialId") ?? ""),
        ...(nremtMatches
          ? {
              requirementMatches: nremtMatches,
              acceptedEducationAttested: true,
            }
          : crcMatches && crcApproval
            ? {
                requirementMatches: crcMatches,
                ...crcApproval,
              }
            : {
                requirementIds: form
                  .getAll("requirementIds")
                  .map((value) => String(value))
                  .filter(Boolean),
              }),
        allocatedUnits,
        portalCarryoverAttested:
          form.get("portalCarryoverAttested") === "on",
      },
      {
        key: FORM_ACTION_KEY,
        success: "Activity applied to another credential.",
      },
    );
    if (result.ok) {
      modals.close("allocate");
    } else {
      setError(result.copy);
    }
  }

  return (
'''

allocation_body = modal_body("      {allocationActivity && workspace ? (", 5977, 6106)
allocation_body = sub(allocation_body, *close_pair("setAllocationActivity(null)", "allocate"), 2, "allocation close")
allocation_body = sub(allocation_body, r'onClick: \(\) => setAllocationActivity\(null\)', 'onClick: () => modals.close("allocate")', 1, "allocation empty-state close")
```
