EVIDENCE_HEADER = r'''"use client";

import { useEffect, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { ErrorSummary } from "../../components/Form";
import { Modal } from "../../components/Modal";
import { useToast } from "../../components/Toast";
import { activityIsMutable } from "../../lib/activityRules";
import {
  FALLBACK_ERROR,
  SESSION_ENDED_ERROR,
  describeApiError,
  type DescribedError,
} from "../../lib/copy";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/format";
import {
  deleteEvidenceFile,
  listEvidence,
  uploadEvidenceFile,
} from "../../lib/workspaceApi";
import { useWorkspace, type WorkspaceStore } from "../../lib/workspaceStore";
import type { Activity, EvidenceFile, Workspace } from "../../lib/workspaceTypes";
import { useModalError } from "./useModalError";

// uploadEvidence (ITrackApp.tsx:2960-2994 at c6b1fe4) on workspaceApi, shared
// with the Log sheet: the refetch happens here, the list update is the
// caller's.
export async function uploadEvidence(
  store: WorkspaceStore,
  activityId: string,
  file: File,
): Promise<
  { ok: true; evidence: EvidenceFile } | { ok: false; copy: DescribedError }
> {
  try {
    const { response, parsed } = await uploadEvidenceFile(activityId, file);
    if (parsed.kind === "session-ended") {
      store.sessionEnded();
      return {
        ok: false,
        copy: { ...SESSION_ENDED_ERROR, code: "authentication_required", detail: null },
      };
    }
    if (parsed.kind === "unexpected") {
      return { ok: false, copy: describeApiError(parsed) };
    }
    if (!response.ok || !parsed.data.evidence) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        copy: describeApiError({
          kind: "json",
          status: parsed.status,
          code: parsed.data.code,
          error: parsed.data.error,
        }),
      };
    }
    await store.reload();
    return { ok: true, evidence: parsed.data.evidence };
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, copy: { ...FALLBACK_ERROR, code: null, detail: null } };
  }
}

// "Proof and certificates": body verbatim from ITrackApp.tsx 6277-6375 at
// c6b1fe4 (Task 6 restyles it). The file list loads when the modal mounts,
// as openEvidence (:2996-3027) loaded it when the modal opened.
export function EvidenceModal({
  workspace,
  activity,
}: {
  workspace: Workspace;
  activity: Activity;
}) {
  const store = useWorkspace();
  const toast = useToast();
  const { reload, modals, sessionEnded } = store;
  const evidenceActivity = activity;
  const [error, setError] = useModalError("Proof could not be updated");
  const [evidenceFiles, setEvidenceFiles] = useState<EvidenceFile[]>([]);
  const [evidencePending, setEvidencePending] = useState(false);
  const evidenceIsFrozen = !activityIsMutable(
    evidenceActivity,
    workspace.credentials,
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    const timeout = window.setTimeout(() => {
      void (async () => {
        setEvidencePending(true);
        try {
          const parsed = await listEvidence(activity.id);
          if (cancelled) return;
          if (parsed.kind === "session-ended") {
            sessionEnded();
            return;
          }
          if (parsed.kind === "unexpected") {
            setError(describeApiError(parsed));
            return;
          }
          if (!parsed.ok) {
            setError(
              describeApiError({
                kind: "json",
                status: parsed.status,
                code: parsed.data.code,
                error: parsed.data.error,
              }),
            );
            return;
          }
          setEvidenceFiles(parsed.data.evidence ?? []);
        } catch {
          if (!cancelled) setError({ ...FALLBACK_ERROR, code: null, detail: null });
        } finally {
          if (!cancelled) setEvidencePending(false);
        }
      })();
    }, 0);
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      window.clearTimeout(timeout);
    };
  }, [activity.id, sessionEnded, setError]);

  async function handleEvidenceUpload(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const formElement = event.currentTarget;
    const form = new FormData(formElement);
    const file = form.get("file");
    if (!(file instanceof File) || file.size === 0) {
      setError("Choose a PDF or image to upload.");
      return;
    }
    setEvidencePending(true);
    setError(null);
    const uploaded = await uploadEvidence(store, evidenceActivity.id, file);
    setEvidencePending(false);
    if (!uploaded.ok) {
      setError(uploaded.copy);
      return;
    }
    setEvidenceFiles((current) => [uploaded.evidence, ...current]);
    formElement.reset();
    toast.show({ message: "Proof saved securely." });
  }

  async function deleteEvidence(evidence: EvidenceFile) {
    setEvidencePending(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const { response, parsed } = await deleteEvidenceFile(evidence.id);
      if (parsed.kind === "session-ended") {
        sessionEnded();
        return;
      }
      if (parsed.kind === "unexpected") {
        setError(describeApiError(parsed));
        return;
      }
      if (!response.ok) {
        if (parsed.data.code === "evidence_delete_retry") {
          setEvidenceFiles((current) =>
            current.map((item) =>
              item.id === evidence.id
                ? { ...item, deletionPending: true }
                : item,
            ),
          );
        }
        setError(
          describeApiError({
            kind: "json",
            status: parsed.status,
            code: parsed.data.code,
            error: parsed.data.error,
          }),
        );
        return;
      }
      setEvidenceFiles((current) =>
        current.filter((item) => item.id !== evidence.id),
      );
      await reload();
      toast.show({ message: "Proof removed." });
    } catch {
      setError({ ...FALLBACK_ERROR, code: null, detail: null });
    } finally {
      setEvidencePending(false);
    }
  }

  return (
'''

evidence_body = modal_body("      {evidenceActivity ? (", 6277, 6375)
evidence_body = sub(evidence_body, *close_pair("setEvidenceActivity(null)", "evidence"), 1, "evidence close")
evidence_body = sub(evidence_body, SUMMARY_LINE, SUMMARY_LINE_TO, 1, "evidence ErrorSummary")
write("app/screens/modals/EvidenceModal.tsx", EVIDENCE_HEADER, evidence_body, "  );\n}")

# ------------------------------------------------------------ the four editors
def editor(rel, header, start, ref_a, ref_b, summary_pattern, summary_repl):
    text = top_level(start, ref_a, ref_b)
    name = start[len("function "):start.index("(")]
    text = sub(text, r'(?m)^function ' + name + r'\(', 'export function ' + name + '(', 1, f"{name} export")
    text = sub(text, ERROR_PROP, ERROR_PROP_TO, 1, f"{name} error prop")
    text = sub(text, summary_pattern, summary_repl, 1, f"{name} ErrorSummary")
    write(rel, header, text)

ROOT_CODE = r'''export function ITrackApp() {
  const nav = useNavigation();
  return (
    <WorkspaceProvider nav={nav}>
      <Routed nav={nav} />
    </WorkspaceProvider>
  );
}

function Routed({ nav }: { nav: Navigation }) {
  const store = useWorkspace();
  const { highlightedReminderKey } = useReminderLaunch(store, nav);
  const { modals, workspace } = store;
  // The detail page is addressed by its URL (/credentials/<id>), not by an
  // app-wide selection, so a cold deep link, the browser's own Back and
  // Forward, and a tap all resolve the same way. Resolved from the open list
  // only: an archived id falls through to the provider's replace effect
  // (Task 7 gives the archived detail its own presentation).
  const detailId = nav.route.detail?.id ?? "";
  const detail = useMemo(
    () =>
      workspace?.credentials.find((credential) => credential.id === detailId) ??
      null,
    [detailId, workspace],
  );
  // What every PageHeader reads: the route it names the document after, the
  // credential a detail is showing, and how many navigations have happened
  // since mount (0 on first paint, so the skip link keeps the first Tab stop).
  const announcement = useMemo(
    () => ({
      route: nav.route,
      credentialName: detail?.credentialName ?? null,
      navigations: nav.navigations,
    }),
    [nav.route, nav.navigations, detail],
  );
  const openLog = useCallback(
    () => modals.open({ kind: "logActivity", preselectCredentialId: "" }),
    [modals],
  );

  return (
    <div className="app-root" data-app-root>
      <RouteAnnouncementContext value={announcement}>
        <AppShell
          activeTab={nav.route.tab}
          onNavigate={nav.setTab}
          onLogActivity={openLog}
        >
          <Banners />
          <ErrorBoundary resetKey={buildPath(nav.route)}>
            <Screen
              nav={nav}
              detail={detail}
              highlightedReminderKey={highlightedReminderKey}
            />
          </ErrorBoundary>
        </AppShell>
      </RouteAnnouncementContext>
      <ModalsHost />
    </div>
  );
}

function Screen({
  nav,
  detail,
  highlightedReminderKey,
}: {
  nav: Navigation;
  detail: Credential | null;
  highlightedReminderKey: string;
}) {
  const { workspace, status, reload } = useWorkspace();
  if (!workspace) {
    if (status.kind === "offline") return <OfflineWorkspace />;
    if (status.kind === "failed") {
      return (
        <WorkspaceLoadFailure
          status={status.httpStatus}
          copy={status.copy}
          onRetry={() => void reload()}
        />
      );
    }
    return <LoadingDashboard />;
  }
  if (nav.route.detail) {
    return detail ? (
      <DetailRoute workspace={workspace} credential={detail} />
    ) : null;
  }
  switch (nav.route.tab) {
    case "home":
      return (
        <HomeRoute
          workspace={workspace}
          highlightedReminderKey={highlightedReminderKey}
        />
      );
    case "credentials":
      return <CredentialsRoute workspace={workspace} />;
    case "history":
      return <HistoryRoute workspace={workspace} />;
    default:
      return <AccountRoute workspace={workspace} />;
  }
}

// The five route wrappers build the legacy views' props from the store; each
// leaves with its view when Tasks 7-11 and 16 extract them.
function HomeRoute({
  workspace,
  highlightedReminderKey,
}: {
  workspace: Workspace;
  highlightedReminderKey: string;
}) {
  const store = useWorkspace();
  const calendar = useCalendarActions(store);
  const { actions, isOnline, modals, nav, pending } = store;
  // Home is single-credential until Task 8's ledger: the cycle the server
  // names as active (the second half of the old selectedCredential memo,
  // ITrackApp.tsx:2111-2122 at c6b1fe4).
  const credential = useMemo(
    () =>
      workspace.credentials.find(
        (candidate) => candidate.id === workspace.activeCycleId,
      ) ?? null,
    [workspace],
  );
  return (
    <TodayView
      workspace={workspace}
      credential={credential}
      today={store.today()}
      isOnline={isOnline}
      highlightedReminderKey={highlightedReminderKey}
      onAddActivity={() =>
        modals.open({ kind: "logActivity", preselectCredentialId: "" })
      }
      onAddCredential={() => modals.open({ kind: "credentialSetup" })}
      onViewRecords={() => nav.setTab("history")}
      onOpenCredential={store.openCredentialDetail}
      onLogCreditsFor={(id) =>
        modals.open({ kind: "logActivity", preselectCredentialId: id })
      }
      onSubmit={() => {
        if (credential) {
          modals.open({ kind: "submission", credentialId: credential.id });
        }
      }}
      onAccept={() => {
        if (credential) {
          modals.open({ kind: "acceptance", credentialId: credential.id });
        }
      }}
      onReminders={() => modals.open({ kind: "reminders" })}
      onReminderState={(reminder, status) =>
        void actions.setReminderState(reminder, status)
      }
      onAddReminderToCalendar={(reminder) =>
        void calendar.addReminderToCalendar(reminder)
      }
      onToggleTask={(task) => void actions.toggleTask(task)}
      onAddPersonalTask={(target) =>
        modals.open({ kind: "task", credential: target, task: null })
      }
      onEditPersonalTask={(target, task) =>
        modals.open({ kind: "task", credential: target, task })
      }
      onRestorePersonalTask={(task) => void actions.restorePersonalTask(task)}
      taskActionsDisabled={!isOnline}
      pendingActionKeys={pending.keys}
      onClaimQuest={(quest) => void actions.claimWeeklyQuest(quest)}
      onRequirementApplicability={(requirement, status) =>
        credential
          ? void actions.setRequirementApplicability(
              credential.id,
              requirement,
              status,
            )
          : undefined
      }
      onDentalCheckpoint={(requirement, completed, evidenceNote) =>
        credential
          ? void actions.saveDentalCheckpoint(
              credential.id,
              requirement,
              completed,
              evidenceNote,
            )
          : undefined
      }
    />
  );
}

function CredentialsRoute({ workspace }: { workspace: Workspace }) {
  const { modals, openCredentialDetail } = useWorkspace();
  const selectedId =
    workspace.credentials.find(
      (candidate) => candidate.id === workspace.activeCycleId,
    )?.id ?? "";
  return (
    <CredentialsView
      credentials={workspace.credentials}
      selectedId={selectedId}
      onSelect={openCredentialDetail}
      onAdd={() => modals.open({ kind: "credentialSetup" })}
    />
  );
}

function DetailRoute({
  workspace,
  credential,
}: {
  workspace: Workspace;
  credential: Credential;
}) {
  const store = useWorkspace();
  const calendar = useCalendarActions(store);
  const { actions, isOnline, modals, nav, pending } = store;
  return (
    <CredentialDetailScreen
      credential={credential}
      onEdit={() => modals.open({ kind: "editCredential", credential })}
      onArchive={() => void actions.archiveCredential(credential)}
      onDelete={() => modals.open({ kind: "deleteCredential", credential })}
      activities={workspace.activities}
      isOnline={isOnline}
      onBreadcrumb={() => nav.setTab("credentials")}
      onSubmit={() =>
        modals.open({ kind: "submission", credentialId: credential.id })
      }
      onAccept={() =>
        modals.open({ kind: "acceptance", credentialId: credential.id })
      }
      onReminders={() => modals.open({ kind: "reminders" })}
      onAddToCalendar={(target) => void calendar.addCredentialToCalendar(target)}
      onRequirementApplicability={(credentialId, requirement, status) =>
        void actions.setRequirementApplicability(
          credentialId,
          requirement,
          status,
        )
      }
      onDentalCheckpoint={(credentialId, requirement, completed, evidenceNote) =>
        void actions.saveDentalCheckpoint(
          credentialId,
          requirement,
          completed,
          evidenceNote,
        )
      }
      actionsDisabled={!isOnline}
      pendingActionKeys={pending.keys}
    />
  );
}

function HistoryRoute({ workspace }: { workspace: Workspace }) {
  const { actions, isOnline, modals, pending } = useWorkspace();
  return (
    <RecordsView
      activities={workspace.activities}
      archivedActivities={workspace.archivedActivities}
      credentials={workspace.credentials}
      archivedCredentials={workspace.archivedCredentials}
      onAdd={() =>
        modals.open({ kind: "logActivity", preselectCredentialId: "" })
      }
      onEdit={(activity) => modals.open({ kind: "editActivity", activity })}
      onRestore={(activity) => void actions.restoreActivity(activity)}
      onRestoreCredential={(credential) =>
        void actions.restoreCredential(credential)
      }
      onDeleteCredential={(credential) =>
        modals.open({ kind: "deleteCredential", credential })
      }
      actionsDisabled={!isOnline}
      pendingActionKeys={pending.keys}
      onEvidence={(activity) => modals.open({ kind: "evidence", activity })}
      onAllocate={(activity) => modals.open({ kind: "allocate", activity })}
      onClassify={(activity, allocation) =>
        modals.open({ kind: "classify", activity, allocation })
      }
    />
  );
}

function AccountRoute({ workspace }: { workspace: Workspace }) {
  const store = useWorkspace();
  const push = usePushDevice(store);
  const calendar = useCalendarActions(store);
  const { actions, isOnline, modals, pending } = store;
  return (
    <AccountView
      workspace={workspace}
      onReminders={() => modals.open({ kind: "reminders" })}
      onWeeklyGoal={(weeklyGoal) => void actions.updateWeeklyGoal(weeklyGoal)}
      weeklyGoalPending={pending.isPending(WEEKLY_GOAL_ACTION_KEY)}
      isStandalone={push.isStandalone}
      installAvailable={push.installAvailable}
      onInstall={() => void push.install()}
      onAddAllCheckIns={() => void calendar.addAllCheckInsToCalendar()}
      pushDeviceState={push.pushDeviceState}
      pushPending={push.pushPending}
      isOnline={isOnline}
      onEnablePhoneAlerts={() => void push.enable()}
      onDisablePhoneAlerts={() => void push.disable()}
      onTestPhoneAlert={() => void push.test()}
      onRefreshPhoneAlerts={() => void push.refresh()}
    />
  );
}
'''

# The imports the root needs, merged into the working file's import block (Task
# 1's), from which every specifier the rebuilt file no longer references is
# dropped.
NEW_IMPORTS = [
    ("react", ["useCallback", "useMemo"]),
    ("./components/AppShell", ["AppShell"]),
    ("./components/ErrorBoundary", ["ErrorBoundary"]),
    ("./components/RouteAnnouncement", ["RouteAnnouncementContext"]),

    ("./lib/workspaceStore", ["WorkspaceProvider", "useWorkspace"]),
    ("./lib/workspaceTypes", ["type Credential", "type Workspace"]),

]
IMPORT_RE = re.compile(r'^import (type )?\{([^}]*)\} from "([^"]+)";\n?', re.M)


def local_name(spec):
    return spec.replace("type ", "").split(" as ")[-1].strip()


def used(name, body):
    # A bare reference or a spread (`...name(`), never a member access (`x.name`).
    return re.search(r"(?:(?<![\w.])|(?<=\.\.\.))" + re.escape(name) + r"\b", body) is not None


statements = []  # (type_only, module, [specifiers]) in source order
for m in IMPORT_RE.finditer(head_text):
    specs = [s.strip() for s in m.group(2).replace("\n", " ").split(",") if s.strip()]
    statements.append([m.group(1) or "", m.group(3), specs])
residue = IMPORT_RE.sub("", head_text)
assert residue.lstrip().startswith('"use client";'), "app/ITrackApp.tsx must start with \"use client\""
residue = residue.replace('"use client";', "", 1).strip("\n")
# The six catalog-category constants Task 1 kept in the root (decision 2:
# they import @/db/catalog/dental, so they never join build:lib-test) leave
# here for app/lib/catalogCategories.ts — verbatim, exported — for the setup
# modal and RequirementPicker. pushSubscriptionIdentity is dead in the root
# (usePushDevice.ts carries its own copy) and goes with them, so
# serializePushSubscription is not kept alive for an unused binding.
CATALOG_CONSTANTS = "\n".join(ref(132, 136)) + "\n\n" + "\n".join(ref(434, 458))
PUSH_IDENTITY = "\n".join(ref(460, 463))
for block, what in ((CATALOG_CONSTANTS, "the six catalog-category constants"), (PUSH_IDENTITY, "pushSubscriptionIdentity")):
    if residue.count(block) != 1:
        raise SystemExit(f"extract-store: {what} not found exactly once in the root's head — Task 1 changed it; stop and compare")
    residue = residue.replace(block, "", 1)
residue = re.sub(r"\n{3,}", "\n\n", residue).strip("\n")
write(
    "app/lib/catalogCategories.ts",
    '''import {
  DENTAL_AGGREGATE_PARENT_CATEGORY_IDS,
  DENTAL_LINKED_APPLICABILITY_CATEGORY_GROUPS,
  DENTAL_REQUIRED_SUBTYPE_CATEGORY_GROUPS,

// The catalog-category ids the setup modal and RequirementPicker branch on:
// verbatim from ITrackApp.tsx 132-136 and 434-458 at c6b1fe4, exported. Not a
// build:lib-test module — it imports the dental catalog (Task 1, decision 2).
''',
    re.sub(r"(?m)^const ", "export const ", CATALOG_CONSTANTS),
)
# Comments do not keep an import alive: the test runs over code only. The
# residue (what is left of the head — Task 1's six `…Now` wrappers) is scanned
# too: daysUntil, credentialCountdown, credentialInstrumentState,
# credentialRingState, cycleCountdownLabel and dayPart from ./lib/format are
# referenced by nothing else in the rebuilt root and must keep their
# specifiers, or the file is TS2304/TS2552 on every wrapper.
body_for_imports = "\n".join([residue, ROOT_CODE, views_text] + extras)
body_for_imports = re.sub(r"/\*[\s\S]*?\*/", "", body_for_imports)
body_for_imports = re.sub(r"(?m)^\s*//.*$", "", body_for_imports)
# A name Task 1's block already imports — from whichever module it chose — is
# not imported a second time; only names no statement carries are added.
already = {local_name(s) for _, _, specs in statements for s in specs}
for module, names in NEW_IMPORTS:
    missing = [n for n in names if local_name(n) not in already]
    if not missing:
        continue
    target = next((s for s in statements if s[0] == "" and s[1] == module), None)
    if target is None:
        statements.append(["", module, []])
        target = statements[-1]
    for name in missing:
        target[2].append(name)
        already.add(local_name(name))
lines = ['"use client";', ""]
for type_only, module, specs in statements:
    kept = [s for s in specs if used(local_name(s), body_for_imports)]
    # A `type X` beside a value import of X (Task 1's `type Credential` and the
    # root's) collapses to one specifier.
    seen = []
    for s in kept:
        if local_name(s) not in [local_name(k) for k in seen]:
            seen.append(s)
    if not seen:
        continue
    if len(seen) <= 3 and sum(len(s) for s in seen) < 60:
        lines.append(f'import {type_only}{{ {", ".join(seen)} }} from "{module}";')
    else:
        lines.append(f"import {type_only}{{")
        lines.extend(f"  {s}," for s in seen)
        lines.append(f'}} from "{module}";')
if residue:
    lines += ["", residue]
new_app = "\n".join(lines) + "\n\n" + ROOT_CODE.rstrip("\n") + "\n\n" + views_text + "\n"
if extras:
    new_app += "\n" + "\n\n".join(extras) + "\n"
SRC.write_text(new_app)
print(f"rewrote app/ITrackApp.tsx ({new_app.count(chr(10))} lines)")
EOF

### Task 6: Non-screen modals on the primitives (setup "Add a credential", "Record submission", acceptance, "Apply to another credential", "Categorize this activity", "Evidence", install help verbatim) + useDiscardGuard + modals.css; legacy modal-form CSS deleted

**Rationale:** spec §5.2 names the Modal/Form primitives every dialog is built on and spec §6 names the dialogs' words; after Task 5 the seven non-screen modals live in their own files (`app/screens/modals/*.tsx`) but still render the bodies of `app/ITrackApp.tsx@c6b1fe4:4773-5270, 5271-5473, 5474-5771, 5919-5975, 5976-6108, 6109-6275, 6276-6377` verbatim: `label.field` + bare `input`, `label.switch-row` attestation rows, `.button*` controls, `.mode-switch`/`.source-card`/`.condition-*`/`.cycle-rollover`/`.evidence-*`/`.celebration-panel`/`.advisory-note` blocks on the LEGACY ALIASES (`app/styles/log-activity.css:259-357, 632-949`), and the first-credential sheet still submits on native bubbles (app-ux-07: no inline feedback). Their error surface is now per-modal (Task 5 turned the seven `ModalError` sites into `ErrorSummary` on each modal's own `DescribedError`), but the sentence over it is the pre-redesign one ("This renewal plan was not created", "This record was not saved"). Two Wave 3 minors land here: Escape on a dirty sheet closes without a confirm (app-ux-23 kept the backdrop guard only — `app/components/Modal.tsx:198-209` calls `onCloseRef.current()` unconditionally, by design, because the same Escape must close a clean form and a nested prompt), so the confirm becomes a hook the owner routes Escape, the X and Cancel through; and the copy rules (one milestone verb "Record", "categorize" for "classify", "evidence" for "proof", no "Today", no "countable") reach these seven dialogs. `app/styles/modals.css` is born as a consumer on first-class tokens; the blocks in `log-activity.css` whose only consumers were these modals die with them; `legacy-shared.css:617-639` (`.install-help`, the install sheet's alone) and `history.css:188-190` (`.frozen-proof-advisory`, the evidence sheet's alone) go the same way; `--mark-tint-bright` is the one alias whose sole consumer was a deleted block and leaves `tokens.css`. Findings: app-ux-07, app-ux-23 (carried minor), app-ux-24, plus the §6 copy rows for `AllocationModal` 5978, `ClassificationModal` 6113-6138, `EvidenceModal` 6278, the install sheet 5919-5972 and the dialog names in section I of the copy table.

**Why the design holds (each point verified against the tree at c6b1fe4):** (1) `Modal.tsx:84-91` already serialises the dialog's first `<form>` through `FormData` for its backdrop guard; exporting that `serializeForm` gives the hook the same notion of "dirty" the backdrop uses, so the two never disagree. (2) A prompt rendered as a React child of the owner's `<Modal>` mounts a second dialog on the module-level stack (`app/lib/modalStack.ts`): it is top-most, so `Modal.tsx:206` (`if (!stack.isTop(id)) return;`) keeps the owner's Escape listener quiet, the owner's backdrop goes inert (`stack.sync`), and when both close in one commit the owner's opener is re-focused by the deferred-focus path at `Modal.tsx:219-232` — the nested-dialog case `tests/e2e/primitives.spec.ts:99-130` already proves. (3) `Modal.tsx:145-151` focuses `[data-autofocus]` when React's own `autoFocus` did not run, and `Button` spreads unknown props onto its `<button>` (`app/components/Button.tsx:33, 52`), so `data-autofocus` on "Keep editing" lands initial focus on the safe choice. (4) The `handleSessionEnded` guard (`tests/app-source-guards.test.mjs:63-98`) counts only `{cond ? (\n<…Modal` sites; the prompt is `open && (<Modal` and every other conditional in these files is followed by `<div`, `<form`, `<p` or `<Checkbox`, so the guard's counts are Task 5's, unchanged. (5) Every `name=` the FormData-reading payload builders read — `ruleSetId`, `credentialName`, `profession`, `jurisdiction`, `issuer`, `totalRequired`, `unitLabel`, `categoryName`, `categoryUnits`, `applicability:<id>`, `templateEligibilityAttested`, `officialDatesAttested`, `abveAnnualStartYear`, `cycleStart`, `deadline`, `submissionDate`, `confirmationNumber`, `complianceAttested`, `lateReinstatementAttested`, `acceptedAt`, `reference`, `nextRuleSetId`, `nextCycleStart`, `nextDeadline`, `credentialId`, `allocatedUnits`, `requirementIds`, `requirementMatch:<id>`, `acceptedEducationAttested`, `crcApprovalType`, `crcProgramReference`, `crcApprovalAttested`, `portalCarryoverAttested`, `file` — is kept on the primitive that replaces each legacy control (`TextInput`/`DateInput`/`Select`/`Checkbox` all forward `name`), so `tests/e2e/credentials.spec.ts`'s `input[name="…"]` locators and the three allocator components (`app/screens/parts/allocators/*`, untouched) keep working. (6) `Select` renders `<option value="">` for `placeholder` (`Form.tsx:208`) and a search input at ≥ 12 options (`Form.tsx:194`), so the 170-template chooser keeps `input[type="search"]` as its autofocus target (`primitives.spec.ts:55`) and the "required template" rule moves into the client validator. 3b. Create `app/components/useDiscardGuard.tsx`:

```tsx
"use client";

import {
  useCallback,
  useEffect,
  useRef,
  useState,
  type ReactNode,
  type RefObject,
} from "react";
import { DIALOG_NAMES } from "../lib/copy";
import { Button } from "./Button";
import { Modal, serializeForm } from "./Modal";

// The dirty-close confirm (spec §5.2; the Wave 3 minor "Escape on a dirty
// sheet closes without a confirm", app-ux-23's other half). A hook, not a
// Modal prop, on purpose: Modal's Escape stays unconditional — the same key
// has to close this prompt and a clean form — and each form modal decides
// what "dirty" means for it. The owner:
//   - passes `requestClose` as its Modal's onClose (Escape, the X button and
//     its own Cancel then all route here),
//   - renders `prompt` as the LAST child of its own Modal — a React child of
//     the sheet is a nested dialog on the modal stack (app/lib/modalStack.ts),
//     so it is top-most: Escape closes only the prompt, the sheet's backdrop
//     goes inert, and closing both in one commit still returns focus to the
//     sheet's opener (Modal.tsx's deferred-focus path),
//   - calls `snapshot()` once its form has mounted, deferred with
//     window.setTimeout(…, 0) so date defaults and autoFocus have settled, and
//     again whenever the set of fields changes (a mode switch) so that alone
//     is never a "change".
// Dirtiness is the FormData join Modal.tsx uses for its backdrop guard
// (serializeForm), or the owner's `isDirty` when its state lives outside the
// form. The backdrop keeps Modal's own snapshot behaviour (a dirty form
// ignores the press, app-ux-23). Refs are read only inside callbacks and
// effects (react-hooks/refs); the prompt is `open && (<Modal …>)`, never
// `? (`, so the handleSessionEnded guard does not count it as an app dialog.

export type DiscardGuardInput = {
  formRef: RefObject<HTMLFormElement | null>;
  onClose: () => void;
  title?: string;
  body?: string;
  keepLabel?: string;
  discardLabel?: string;
  isDirty?: () => boolean;
};

export type DiscardGuard = {
  requestClose: () => void;
  prompt: ReactNode;
  snapshot: () => void;
};

export function useDiscardGuard({
  formRef,
  onClose,
  title = DIALOG_NAMES.discardChanges,
  body = "Nothing has been saved yet.",
  keepLabel = "Keep editing",
  discardLabel = "Discard changes",
  isDirty,
}: DiscardGuardInput): DiscardGuard {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const baseline = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const onCloseRef = useRef(onClose);
  const isDirtyRef = useRef(isDirty);

  // The owner's closures change every render; the callbacks below read the
  // latest through refs (written only here, in an effect).
  useEffect(() => {
    onCloseRef.current = onClose;
    isDirtyRef.current = isDirty;
  });

  const snapshot = useCallback(() => {
    const form = formRef.current;
    baseline.current = form ? serializeForm(form) : null;
  }, [formRef]);

  const requestClose = useCallback(() => {
    const check = isDirtyRef.current;
    const form = formRef.current;
    const dirty = check
      ? check()
      : Boolean(
          form &&
            baseline.current !== null &&
            serializeForm(form) !== baseline.current,
        );
    if (dirty) {
      setOpen(true);
      return;
    }
    onCloseRef.current();
  }, [formRef]);

  const keep = () => setOpen(false);
  const discard = () => {
    setOpen(false);
    onCloseRef.current();
  };

  const prompt = open && (
    <Modal title={title} onClose={keep}>
      <p className="modal-prompt-body">{body}</p>
      <div className="form-actions">
        <Button variant="secondary" data-autofocus onClick={keep}>
          {keepLabel}
        </Button>
        <Button variant="destructive" onClick={discard}>
          {discardLabel}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );

  return { requestClose, prompt, snapshot };
}
```

`DIALOG_NAMES.discardChanges` is `"Discard your changes?"` (Task 2's `app/lib/copy.ts`). `data-autofocus` is a hyphenated attribute, so TSX accepts it on `Button` without a prop declaration and `Button` spreads it onto the `<button>` (`Button.tsx:33, 52`); `Modal.tsx:145-151` focuses it on mount.

4b. The sample component — insert immediately after the `BoundarySample` function (its closing `}` is line 98, followed by a blank line and `export function Styleguide() {`):

```tsx
// The discard guard (app/components/useDiscardGuard.tsx) where no real form
// is needed: a guarded memo. Escape, the X and Cancel on the untouched form
// close it; once the memo is typed they open "Discard your changes?" first,
// a nested dialog on the modal stack (tests/e2e/primitives.spec.ts).
function GuardedMemo({ onClose }: { onClose: () => void }) {
  const formRef = useRef<HTMLFormElement>(null);
  const { requestClose, prompt, snapshot } = useDiscardGuard({
    formRef,
    onClose,
  });
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = window.setTimeout(snapshot, 0);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [snapshot]);
  return (
    <Modal title="Guarded memo" eyebrow="Styleguide" onClose={requestClose}>
      <form
        ref={formRef}
        className="form-stack"
        noValidate
        onSubmit={(event) => event.preventDefault()}
      >
        <Field label="Memo">
          <TextInput name="memo" autoFocus />
        </Field>
        <div className="form-actions">
          <Button variant="quiet" onClick={requestClose}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button type="submit" variant="primary">
            Save
          </Button>
        </div>
      </form>
      {prompt}
    </Modal>
  );
}
```

 * Modals — the shared blocks the non-screen modals compose inside a Modal
 * body (app/screens/modals/*.tsx; Wave 4 Task 6). A consumer for
 * tools/contrast-audit.mjs: first-class tokens only, no literal, no legacy
 * alias, no transition or animation. Every ink-on-fill pair here is one
 * tokens.css claims: --ink and --ink-muted on --card / --paper / --paper-deep,
 * --ink-muted and --accent on --accent-soft, --ink-muted on every *-soft,
 * --state-due-soon on --state-due-soon-soft, --state-complete on
 * --state-complete-soft and on --card. Imported from app/globals.css after
 * log-activity.css, whose modal-form blocks this file replaces.
 */

/* The discard prompt's one sentence (app/components/useDiscardGuard.tsx). */
.modal-prompt-body {
  margin: 0 0 16px;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: var(--text-md);
  line-height: 1.5;
}

/* A grouped block under an eyebrow: the install steps, the current
   National Registry template. */
.modal-section {
  display: grid;
  gap: 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background: var(--paper);
  padding: 16px;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  line-height: 1.55;
}

.modal-section > p,
.modal-section > ol {
  margin: 0;
}

.modal-section > ol {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
  padding-left: 22px;
}

.modal-section-eyebrow {
  display: block;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-2xs);
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-eyebrow);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

/* A note under a form: the advisory sentence, a chosen template's source
   title, the frozen-evidence sentence. */
.modal-note {
  margin: 0;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: var(--paper-deep);
  padding: 12px 14px;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  line-height: 1.5;
}

/* The warning shade: muted ink on the due-soon fill, the state ink for the
   emphasis (both pairs claimed in tokens.css). */
.modal-note-warn {
  background: var(--state-due-soon-soft);
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.modal-note-warn strong {
  color: var(--state-due-soon);
}

/* The chosen template's card in the setup sheet. */
.source-card {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background: var(--card);
  padding: 16px;
}

.source-card-top {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px 12px;
}

.source-card-title {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: var(--text-lg);
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-display);
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.source-card-meta {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.source-card p {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.source-card a {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  min-height: var(--tap-min);
  color: var(--accent);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* Two Buttons in a row; the active mode is the primary one and carries
   aria-pressed. */
.mode-switch {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 8px;
}

/* The evidence list: line-separated rows, the meta line in mono. */
.evidence-list {
  display: grid;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.evidence-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 12px 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.evidence-row:first-child {
  border-top: 0;
  padding-top: 0;
}

.evidence-row strong {
  display: block;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
}

.evidence-row-meta {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 2px;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.evidence-row-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  gap: 6px;
}

.evidence-empty {
  margin: 0;
  border: 1px dashed var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 18px;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  text-align: center;
}

.evidence-empty strong {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
}

/* The Field-labelled file input beside its Upload button. */
.evidence-upload {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  align-items: end;
  gap: 12px;
}

.evidence-upload input[type="file"] {
  padding: 7px 12px;
}

.evidence-upload input[type="file"]::file-selector-button {
  min-height: var(--control-height-sm);
  margin-right: 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: var(--paper-deep);
  color: var(--ink);
  cursor: pointer;
  font: inherit;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 4px 10px;
}

/* The next cycle's dates in the acceptance sheet. */
.cycle-rollover {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background: var(--paper);
  padding: 16px;
}

.cycle-rollover > p {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
}

/* The chosen template's conditional rules: one Field per rule. */
.condition-list {
  display: grid;
  gap: 12px;
  margin: 0;
  border: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

.condition-list > legend {
  margin-bottom: 4px;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.condition-list > p {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.condition-row {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  padding-top: 12px;
}

/* The milestone sheets' opening panel: the complete state on its soft fill. */
.celebration-panel {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background: var(--state-complete-soft);
  padding: 16px;
}

.celebration-mark {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: var(--card);
  color: var(--state-complete);
}

.celebration-panel strong {
  display: block;
  color: var(--state-complete);
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: var(--text-lg);
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-display);
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.celebration-panel p {
  margin: 4px 0 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  line-height: 1.5;
}

@media (max-width: 540px) {
  .evidence-upload,
  .evidence-row {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }

  .evidence-row-actions {
    justify-content: flex-start;
  }
}
```

Every `font-size` is a `--text-*` token; every colour is a first-class token; there is no `transition`, no `animation`, no `env()` (none of the replaced blocks carried one), and the file's first rule is a class rule, so `tools/contrast-audit.mjs` reads it as a consumer.

6b. Import it after `log-activity.css` in `app/globals.css` (line 7):

```bash
grep -n '^@import "./styles/log-activity.css";$' app/globals.css
sed -i '' 's#^@import "./styles/log-activity.css";$#@import "./styles/log-activity.css";\
@import "./styles/modals.css";#' app/globals.css
sed -n 1,13p app/globals.css
```

Expected: the first grep prints `7:@import "./styles/log-activity.css";`; the print shows thirteen imports in the order tokens, fonts, legacy-shared, home, credentials, credential-detail, log-activity, modals, history, account, primitives, instruments, shell. `modals.css` sits before `primitives.css` on purpose: a `.form-actions` or `.field` rule from the primitives still wins at equal specificity, exactly as it does over the legacy files.

6c. The audit, build-free:

```bash
node tools/contrast-audit.mjs; echo "exit $?"
node --experimental-sqlite --test tests/contrast-audit.test.mjs tests/app-source-guards.test.mjs
```

Expected: a line `contrast-audit: app/styles/modals.css — 0 claims, 0 failing, 0 literals` among the per-file lines, the summary `contrast-audit: 19 stylesheets, 0 failing claims, 0 colour literals outside token blocks` (18 + the new file), `exit 0`; both test files PASS — "no new stylesheet references a legacy alias" now scans `modals.css` (it is not in `LEGACY_STYLESHEETS`) and finds none, the px font-size guard walks 14 stylesheets (13 today plus `modals.css`), and the modal-site guard's counts are Task 5's.

- [ ] **Step 7: `CredentialSetupModal` on the primitives — "Add a credential"**

Rewrite `app/screens/modals/CredentialSetupModal.tsx` whole (Task 5's file holds the body of `ITrackApp.tsx@c6b1fe4:4773-5270` plus `handleCredentialSubmit` 3088-3186 verbatim; every line below replaces it). The payload block is that handler's, with `catalog.customCredential` for `customCredential`, `catalog.catalogTemplates` for `catalogTemplates` and `run(...)` for `runAction(...)`; the field `name`s are unchanged.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { DENTAL_LINKED_APPLICABILITY_CATEGORY_GROUPS } from "@/db/catalog/dental";
import { Button } from "../../components/Button";
import {
  Checkbox,
  DateInput,
  ErrorSummary,
  Field,
  Select,
  TextInput,
  type ErrorSummaryEntry,
} from "../../components/Form";
import { Icon } from "../../components/Icon";
import { Modal } from "../../components/Modal";
import { StatusPill } from "../../components/instruments/StatusPill";
import { useDiscardGuard } from "../../components/useDiscardGuard";
import { DENTAL_LINKED_APPLICABILITY_CHILD_CATEGORY_IDS } from "../../lib/catalogCategories";
import { DIALOG_NAMES, type DescribedError } from "../../lib/copy";
import {
  defaultCatalogCycleStart,
  defaultCatalogDeadline,
  isAbveCatalogRule,
  isExpandedCertificationCatalogRule,
  isFloridaMentalHealthCatalogRule,
  isNremtCatalogRule,
  isRehabilitationCertificationCatalogRule,
  requiresOfficialCatalogDates,
  ruleReviewLabel,
  ruleReviewState,
} from "../../lib/credentialRules";
import { catalogCategorySummary, compactNumber, formatDate } from "../../lib/format";
import { useCatalog } from "../../lib/useCatalog";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../lib/workspaceStore";
import type { CatalogRule } from "../../lib/workspaceTypes";

// "Add a credential" (spec §6; app-ux-07): the template chooser and the
// custom plan on the Form primitives. One client-side validator, whose
// sentences render through `Field error=` and one ErrorSummary "Check the
// form" with field links (a11y-09) — never a native bubble, so the form is
// noValidate. A server refusal keeps its own state: the ErrorSummary titled
// "This credential wasn’t added" shows `copy.next` and folds the raw server
// sentence into its "Technical details" disclosure (app-ux-24). Escape, the
// X and Cancel go through useDiscardGuard: a typed name or a chosen template
// asks "Discard your changes?" first; a clean form — and a mode switch alone,
// which re-baselines the snapshot — closes at once. Every `name=` the
// createCredential payload reads is the one app/ITrackApp.tsx@c6b1fe4 used
// (4773-5270), so the FormData-built payload below is unchanged.

const IDS = {
  template: "credential-setup-template",
  profession: "credential-setup-profession",
  jurisdiction: "credential-setup-jurisdiction",
  name: "credential-setup-name",
  total: "credential-setup-total",
  abveYear: "credential-setup-abve-year",
  cycleStart: "credential-setup-cycle-start",
  deadline: "credential-setup-deadline",
} as const;

type SetupIssues = Partial<Record<keyof typeof IDS | "attestation", string>>;

const APPLICABILITY_OPTIONS = [
  { value: "applies", label: "Applies" },
  { value: "not_applicable", label: "Not this cycle" },
  { value: "needs_confirmation", label: "Not sure yet" },
];

const ABVE_YEAR_OPTIONS = [
  { value: "2025", label: "2025" },
  { value: "2026", label: "2026" },
  { value: "2027", label: "2027" },
];

function needsTemplateEligibility(rule: CatalogRule | null): boolean {
  return (
    rule !== null &&
    (rule.profession === "Pharmacy" ||
      rule.profession === "Nursing" ||
      rule.profession === "Dental" ||
      isExpandedCertificationCatalogRule(rule))
  );
}

// The `name`s of the attestation checkboxes the chosen template renders,
// refused unticked here before the server has to (its *_attestation_required
// codes map to the same sentence in app/lib/copy.ts).
function requiredAttestations(rule: CatalogRule | null, custom: boolean): string[] {
  if (custom || !rule) return [];
  const names: string[] = [];
  if (needsTemplateEligibility(rule)) names.push("templateEligibilityAttested");
  if (requiresOfficialCatalogDates(rule)) names.push("officialDatesAttested");
  return names;
}

function validateSetup(form: FormData, custom: boolean, rule: CatalogRule | null): SetupIssues {
  const text = (name: string) => String(form.get(name) ?? "").trim();
  const issues: SetupIssues = {};
  if (custom) {
    if (!text("credentialName")) issues.name = "Enter the credential name.";
    if (!text("profession")) issues.profession = "Enter the profession.";
    if (!text("jurisdiction")) issues.jurisdiction = "Enter the state or jurisdiction.";
    const total = Number(text("totalRequired"));
    if (text("totalRequired") === "" || !Number.isFinite(total) || total < 0) {
      issues.total = "Enter the total required.";
    }
  } else if (!text("ruleSetId")) {
    issues.template = "Choose a template.";
  }
  if (!custom && isAbveCatalogRule(rule) && !text("abveAnnualStartYear")) {
    issues.abveYear = "Choose 2025, 2026, or 2027.";
  }
  const cycleStart = text("cycleStart");
  const deadline = text("deadline");
  if (!cycleStart) issues.cycleStart = "Enter the cycle start date.";
  if (!deadline) issues.deadline = "Enter the renewal deadline.";
  else if (cycleStart && deadline < cycleStart) {
    issues.deadline = "Use a deadline on or after the cycle start.";
  }
  if (requiredAttestations(rule, custom).some((name) => form.get(name) !== "on")) {
    issues.attestation = "Confirm the statement on this form to continue.";
  }
  return issues;
}

function summaryOf(issues: SetupIssues): ErrorSummaryEntry[] {
  return (Object.keys(issues) as Array<keyof SetupIssues>).flatMap((key) => {
    const message = issues[key];
    if (!message) return [];
    return [{ fieldId: key === "attestation" ? undefined : IDS[key], message }];
  });
}

export function CredentialSetupModal() {
  const store = useWorkspace();
  const { modals, run, pending, today } = store;
  const catalog = useCatalog(store);
  const { load } = catalog;
  const [issues, setIssues] = useState<SetupIssues>({});
  const [failure, setFailure] = useState<DescribedError | null>(null);
  const formRef = useRef<HTMLFormElement>(null);
  const close = () => modals.close("credentialSetup");
  const { requestClose, prompt, snapshot } = useDiscardGuard({ formRef, onClose: close });

  // The catalog is fetched once per session (useCatalog guards repeats).
  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
  }, [load]);

  // The baseline is taken once the fields have mounted, and again when the
  // mode switches (its fields are different controls): choosing a mode is
  // not a change worth a prompt; a typed value or a chosen template is.
  const mode = catalog.customCredential;
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = window.setTimeout(snapshot, 0);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [snapshot, mode]);

  const rule = catalog.customCredential ? null : catalog.selectedRule;
  const conditionalCategories = (rule?.categories ?? []).filter(
    (category) =>
      category.applicability === "conditional" &&
      !DENTAL_LINKED_APPLICABILITY_CHILD_CATEGORY_IDS.has(category.id),
  );
  const summary = summaryOf(issues);

  function switchMode(custom: boolean) {
    setIssues({});
    setFailure(null);
    catalog.setCustomCredential(custom);
  }

  async function handleSubmit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (pending.form) return;
    const form = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
    const found = validateSetup(form, catalog.customCredential, rule);
    setIssues(found);
    setFailure(null);
    if (Object.keys(found).length > 0) return;

    const chosen = catalog.customCredential
      ? null
      : (catalog.catalogTemplates.find(
          (item) => item.id === String(form.get("ruleSetId") ?? ""),
        ) ?? null);
    const customCategoryUnits = Number(form.get("categoryUnits") ?? 0);
    const categories = catalog.customCredential
      ? customCategoryUnits > 0
        ? [
            {
              name: String(form.get("categoryName") ?? "General"),
              requiredUnits: customCategoryUnits,
            },
          ]
        : []
      : (chosen?.categories ?? []).map((category) => ({
          name: category.name,
          requiredUnits: category.requiredUnits,
        }));
    const totalRequired = catalog.customCredential
      ? Number(form.get("totalRequired") ?? 0)
      : (chosen?.totalUnits ?? 0);
    const applicabilityChoiceByCategoryId = new Map(
      (chosen?.categories ?? [])
        .filter((category) => category.applicability === "conditional")
        .map((category) => [
          category.id,
          String(form.get(`applicability:${category.id}`) ?? "needs_confirmation"),
        ]),
    );
    for (const categoryIds of DENTAL_LINKED_APPLICABILITY_CATEGORY_GROUPS) {
      const synchronizedStatus = applicabilityChoiceByCategoryId.get(categoryIds[0]);
      if (!synchronizedStatus) continue;
      for (const categoryId of categoryIds) {
        applicabilityChoiceByCategoryId.set(categoryId, synchronizedStatus);
      }
    }
    const applicabilityChoices = [...applicabilityChoiceByCategoryId].map(
      ([ruleCategoryId, status]) => ({ ruleCategoryId, status }),
    );

    const result = await run(
      "createCredential",
      {
        ruleSetId: chosen?.id ?? null,
        credentialName: catalog.customCredential
          ? String(form.get("credentialName") ?? "")
          : (chosen?.credentialName ?? ""),
        profession: catalog.customCredential
          ? String(form.get("profession") ?? "")
          : (chosen?.profession ?? ""),
        jurisdiction: catalog.customCredential
          ? String(form.get("jurisdiction") ?? "")
          : (chosen?.jurisdiction ?? ""),
        issuer: catalog.customCredential
          ? String(form.get("issuer") ?? "")
          : (chosen?.issuer ?? ""),
        cycleStart: String(form.get("cycleStart") ?? ""),
        deadline: String(form.get("deadline") ?? ""),
        templateEligibilityAttested: needsTemplateEligibility(chosen)
          ? form.get("templateEligibilityAttested") === "on"
          : undefined,
        totalRequired,
        unitLabel: catalog.customCredential
          ? String(form.get("unitLabel") ?? "hours")
          : (chosen?.unitLabel ?? "hours"),
        categories,
        applicabilityChoices,
        abveAnnualStartYear: isAbveCatalogRule(chosen)
          ? Number(form.get("abveAnnualStartYear"))
          : undefined,
        officialDatesAttested: requiresOfficialCatalogDates(chosen)
          ? form.get("officialDatesAttested") === "on"
          : undefined,
      },
      { success: "Credential added." },
    );
    if (!result.ok) {
      setFailure(result.copy);
      return;
    }
    catalog.setSelectedRuleId("");
    catalog.setCatalogQuery("");
    catalog.setCustomCredential(false);
    modals.close("credentialSetup");
  }

  const templateHint =
    catalog.catalogStatus === "loading"
      ? "Loading researched starting templates · custom plans are always available"
      : catalog.catalogStatus === "error"
        ? "Templates couldn’t be loaded · custom plans are always available"
        : `${catalog.catalogTemplates.length} researched starting templates · custom plans are always available`;

  return (
    <Modal title={DIALOG_NAMES.credentialSetup} onClose={requestClose}>
      <form ref={formRef} className="form-stack" noValidate onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
        <div className="mode-switch" role="group" aria-label="Credential setup mode">
          <Button
            variant={catalog.customCredential ? "secondary" : "primary"}
            aria-pressed={!catalog.customCredential}
            onClick={() => switchMode(false)}
          >
            Use a template
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant={catalog.customCredential ? "primary" : "secondary"}
            aria-pressed={catalog.customCredential}
            onClick={() => switchMode(true)}
          >
            Enter my own
          </Button>
        </div>

        {catalog.customCredential ? (
          <>
            <div className="form-grid">
              <Field id={IDS.profession} label="Profession" error={issues.profession}>
                <TextInput name="profession" required placeholder="Nurse" />
              </Field>
              <Field
                id={IDS.jurisdiction}
                label="State or jurisdiction"
                error={issues.jurisdiction}
              >
                <TextInput name="jurisdiction" required placeholder="PA" />
              </Field>
            </div>
            <Field
              id={IDS.name}
              label="License or professional certification"
              error={issues.name}
            >
              <TextInput
                autoFocus
                name="credentialName"
                required
                placeholder="Registered Nurse"
              />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Issuing organization" optional>
              <TextInput name="issuer" placeholder="Licensing board or certifying body" />
            </Field>
            <div className="form-grid form-grid-three">
              <Field id={IDS.total} label="Total required" error={issues.total}>
                <TextInput
                  name="totalRequired"
                  type="number"
                  min="0"
                  step="0.1"
                  inputMode="decimal"
                  required
                  className="field-control-mono"
                />
              </Field>
              <Field label="Unit label">
                <TextInput name="unitLabel" defaultValue="hours" required />
              </Field>
              <Field label="Special category">
                <TextInput name="categoryName" defaultValue="Ethics" />
              </Field>
            </div>
            <Field label="Special-category minimum">
              <TextInput
                name="categoryUnits"
                type="number"
                min="0"
                step="0.1"
                inputMode="decimal"
                defaultValue="0"
                className="field-control-mono"
              />
            </Field>
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            <Field
              id={IDS.template}
              label="Profession, credential, and state"
              hint={templateHint}
              error={issues.template}
            >
              <Select
                name="ruleSetId"
                value={catalog.selectedRuleId}
                onChange={(event) => {
                  const next = event.currentTarget.value;
                  catalog.setSelectedRuleId(next);
                  catalog.setCatalogQuery("");
                }}
                placeholder="Choose a rule template"
                searchable
                autoFocus
                searchLabel="Find a credential template"
                searchPlaceholder="Search profession, license, certification, or state"
                query={catalog.catalogQuery}
                onQueryChange={(query) => {
                  catalog.setCatalogQuery(query);
                  catalog.setSelectedRuleId("");
                }}
                options={catalog.catalogGroups.map((group) => ({
                  label: group.profession,
                  options: group.rules.map((item) => ({
                    value: item.id,
                    label: `${item.credentialName} · ${item.jurisdiction}`,
                    keywords: `${item.profession} ${item.credentialName} ${item.jurisdiction} ${item.issuer}`,
                  })),
                }))}
              />
            </Field>
            {catalog.catalogStatus === "error" ? (
              <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => void load()}>
                Templates didn’t load — try again
              </Button>
            ) : null}
            {catalog.catalogStatus !== "loading" && catalog.catalogMatches.length === 0 ? (
              <Button
                variant="secondary"
                onClick={() => {
                  catalog.setSelectedRuleId("");
                  catalog.setCatalogQuery("");
                  switchMode(true);
                }}
              >

"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { Button } from "../../components/Button";
import {
  Checkbox,
  DateInput,
  ErrorSummary,
  Field,
  TextInput,
} from "../../components/Form";
import { Icon } from "../../components/Icon";
import { Modal } from "../../components/Modal";
import { useDiscardGuard } from "../../components/useDiscardGuard";
import { DIALOG_NAMES, type DescribedError } from "../../lib/copy";
import {
  isCompliancePeriodCredential,
  isCrcCredential,
  isIsc2AutomaticRenewalCredential,
  isNremtCredential,
} from "../../lib/credentialRules";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../lib/workspaceStore";

// "Record submission" (spec §6: Record is the milestone verb) and its three
// issuer variants, on the Form primitives, with its own error state and the
// discard guard. The credential comes from the store's submissionCredentialId
// (architecture-05); every `name=` the markSubmitted payload reads is the
// one app/ITrackApp.tsx@c6b1fe4:5271-5473 used.

export function SubmissionModal() {
  const store = useWorkspace();
  const { workspace, modals, run, pending, today } = store;
  const credential =
    workspace?.credentials.find((item) => item.id === modals.submissionCredentialId) ?? null;
  const [nremtSubmissionDate, setNremtSubmissionDate] = useState(() => today());
  const [failure, setFailure] = useState<DescribedError | null>(null);
  const formRef = useRef<HTMLFormElement>(null);
  const close = () => modals.close("submission");
  const { requestClose, prompt, snapshot } = useDiscardGuard({ formRef, onClose: close });

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = window.setTimeout(snapshot, 0);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [snapshot]);

  if (!credential) return null;

  const isc2 = isIsc2AutomaticRenewalCredential(credential);
  const compliance = isCompliancePeriodCredential(credential);
  const nremt = isNremtCredential(credential);
  const crc = isCrcCredential(credential);

  async function handleSubmit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!credential || pending.form) return;
    const form = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
    setFailure(null);
    const result = await run(
      "markSubmitted",
      {
        credentialId: credential.id,
        submissionDate: String(form.get("submissionDate") ?? ""),
        confirmationNumber: String(form.get("confirmationNumber") ?? ""),
        complianceAttested:
          isc2 || compliance || nremt || crc
            ? form.get("complianceAttested") === "on"
            : undefined,
        lateReinstatementAttested:
          nremt && String(form.get("submissionDate") ?? "") > credential.deadline
            ? form.get("lateReinstatementAttested") === "on"
            : undefined,
      },
      {
        success: isc2
          ? "ISC2 dashboard checkpoint saved. Confirm renewal only after the new dates appear."
          : compliance
            ? "Compliance-period milestone saved. Confirm the next period from the official record."
            : nremt
              ? "National Registry application logged. Keep the dashboard approval with your record."
              : crc
                ? "CRC renewal logged. Keep the CRCCCONNECT confirmation with your program records."
                : "Submission logged. Keep the confirmation until your renewal is accepted.",
      },
    );
    if (!result.ok) {
      setFailure(result.copy);
      return;
    }
    modals.close("submission");
  }

  return (
    <Modal
      title={
        isc2
          ? "Save an ISC2 dashboard checkpoint"
          : compliance
            ? "Record compliance"
            : nremt
              ? "Save the National Registry application"
              : DIALOG_NAMES.submission
      }
      eyebrow={
        isc2
          ? "Automatic-renewal milestone"
          : compliance
            ? "Compliance-period milestone"
            : nremt
              ? "National Registry milestone"
              : "Renewal milestone"
      }
      onClose={requestClose}
    >
      <form ref={formRef} className="form-stack" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
        <div className="celebration-panel">
          <span className="celebration-mark">
            <Icon name="check" size={20} />
          </span>
          <div>
            <strong>
              {isc2
                ? "Record what the ISC2 dashboard shows"
                : compliance
                  ? "Save the official compliance milestone"
                  : nremt
                    ? "Save the National Registry application record"
                    : crc
                      ? "Confirm the accepted CRCCCONNECT totals"
                      : "One last record for your future self"}
            </strong>
            <p>
              {isc2
                ? "This checkpoint records your attestation that required CPEs and annual maintenance fees are satisfied. It does not mean ISC2 has renewed the certification."
                : compliance
                  ? "Record when the official record shows this period’s education requirement is complete."
                  : nremt
                    ? "Confirm the assigned NCCP model and every component in the National Registry dashboard before recording the application."
                    : crc
                      ? "Confirm every program is accepted once and the exact credit-type amounts satisfy the total that counts, the ethics minimum, and the Professional Development cap shown for this cycle."
                      : "Logging the date and confirmation keeps “credits earned” separate from “renewal submitted.”"}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Field
          label={
            isc2
              ? "Dashboard checked"
              : compliance
                ? "Compliance confirmed"
                : nremt
                  ? "Application submitted"
                  : "Submission date"
          }
        >
          {nremt ? (
            <DateInput
              autoFocus
              name="submissionDate"
              required
              value={nremtSubmissionDate}
              onValueChange={setNremtSubmissionDate}
            />
          ) : (
            <DateInput autoFocus name="submissionDate" required defaultValue={today()} />
          )}
        </Field>
        <Field
          label={
            isc2
              ? "Dashboard or payment reference"
              : compliance
                ? "Official record reference"
                : nremt
                  ? "Dashboard or application reference"
                  : "Confirmation or receipt number"
          }
          optional
        >
          <TextInput
            name="confirmationNumber"
            placeholder={
              isc2
                ? "e.g., dashboard receipt ID"
                : compliance
                  ? "e.g., portal or employer record ID"
                  : nremt
                    ? "e.g., National Registry application ID"
                    : "e.g., RNL-2048-194"
            }
          />
        </Field>
        {isc2 || compliance || nremt || crc ? (
          <Checkbox
            name="complianceAttested"
            required
            label={
              isc2
                ? "I checked the ISC2 Dashboard"
                : compliance
                  ? "I checked the official compliance record"
                  : nremt
                    ? "I checked the National Registry dashboard"
                    : "I checked CRCCCONNECT"
            }
            description={
              isc2
                ? "It shows this cycle’s required CPEs and annual maintenance fees as satisfied."
                : compliance
                  ? "It shows this period’s education requirement as complete."
                  : nremt
                    ? "It shows the assigned model, component totals, National topics, and pediatric content as satisfied."
                    : "It shows each program accepted under the recorded credit type and the total that counts, the ethics minimum, and the Professional Development cap shown for this cycle as satisfied."
            }
          />
        ) : null}
        {nremt && nremtSubmissionDate > credential.deadline ? (
          <Checkbox
            name="lateReinstatementAttested"
            required
            label="I am using the late reinstatement path"
            description="All continuing education was completed by the credential’s expiration cutoff. Education completed during reinstatement is not accepted, and late acceptance is not guaranteed."
          />
        ) : null}
        <p className="modal-note">
          {isc2
            ? "ISC2 performs automatic recertification at the end of the three-year cycle when its requirements are met. Close this cycle only after the dashboard displays renewed certification dates."
            : compliance
              ? "This records an education-compliance milestone, not a license-renewal filing. Close the period only after confirming the next official compliance dates."
              : nremt
                ? "For Active status, EMR and EMT skills are verified by a Training Officer; AEMT and Paramedic skills are verified by a Medical Director. Inactive status still requires the full continuing-education or RBE pathway. If expired, follow the dashboard’s current reinstatement process."
                : crc
                  ? "Post-approved programs must have CRCC’s accepted decision and supporting evidence on file. The same program may be submitted only once, and excess hours do not carry forward."
                  : "This records what you submitted. Mark the cycle renewed only after the issuing organization confirms acceptance."}
        </p>
        <ErrorSummary
          title="This milestone wasn’t saved"
          errors={failure ? [{ message: failure.next }] : []}
          detail={failure?.detail ?? undefined}
        />
        <div className="form-actions">
          <Button variant="quiet" onClick={requestClose}>
            Not yet
          </Button>
          <Button type="submit" variant="primary" pending={pending.form} pendingLabel="Saving…">
            {isc2 ? "Save dashboard checkpoint" : compliance ? "Mark compliant" : "Mark submitted"}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </form>
      {prompt}
    </Modal>
  );
}

The successor re-point (`nav.openCredential(result.id, { replace: true })` when the detail is routed) moves in verbatim; the old `setSelectedCredentialId(result.id)` has no equivalent (architecture-05) and `markSeriesClosed` is what Task 8's fold reads.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { Button } from "../../components/Button";
import {
  Checkbox,
  DateInput,
  ErrorSummary,
  Field,
  Select,
  TextInput,
} from "../../components/Form";
import { Icon } from "../../components/Icon";
import { Modal } from "../../components/Modal";
import { useDiscardGuard } from "../../components/useDiscardGuard";
import { type DescribedError } from "../../lib/copy";
import {
  currentNremtCatalogRule,
  isCompliancePeriodCredential,
  isExpandedCertificationCredential,
  isFloridaInsuranceComplianceCredential,
  isFloridaMentalHealthPhaseCredential,
  isIsc2AutomaticRenewalCredential,
  isManagedDentalCredential,
  isManagedNursingCredential,
  isManagedPharmacistCredential,
  isNremtCredential,
  requiresCurrentNextTemplate,
  requiresNonOverlappingNextPeriod,
  requiresOfficialNextPeriodAttestation,
} from "../../lib/credentialRules";
import { seriesKey } from "../../lib/cycles";
import { addDaysIso, addMonthsIso } from "../../lib/dates";
import { oppositeFloridaMentalHealthRuleSetId } from "../../lib/floridaMentalHealth";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../lib/workspaceStore";

// "Close this renewal cycle" and its three issuer variants (titles unchanged,
// spec §6 section I) on the Form primitives: the next cycle's dates in a
// .cycle-rollover block, the current National Registry template in a
// .modal-section, attestations as Checkbox rows, its own error state and the
// discard guard. On success the store learns the series closed (Task 8's
// fold reads recentlyClosedSeriesId) and a routed detail is re-pointed at the
// successor with a replaced history entry, exactly as before.

export function AcceptanceModal() {
  const store = useWorkspace();
  const { workspace, modals, run, pending, today, nav, markSeriesClosed } = store;
  const credential =
    workspace?.credentials.find((item) => item.id === modals.acceptanceCredentialId) ?? null;
  const nremtNextRule = useMemo(
    () => currentNremtCatalogRule(workspace?.catalog ?? [], credential),
    [workspace, credential],
  );
  const [failure, setFailure] = useState<DescribedError | null>(null);
  const formRef = useRef<HTMLFormElement>(null);
  const close = () => modals.close("acceptance");
  const { requestClose, prompt, snapshot } = useDiscardGuard({ formRef, onClose: close });

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = window.setTimeout(snapshot, 0);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [snapshot]);

  if (!credential || credential.status !== "submitted") return null;

  const isc2 = isIsc2AutomaticRenewalCredential(credential);
  const compliance = isCompliancePeriodCredential(credential);
  const nremt = isNremtCredential(credential);
  const floridaPhase = isFloridaMentalHealthPhaseCredential(credential);
  const expanded = isExpandedCertificationCredential(credential);
  const nextTemplateOptions = (workspace?.catalog ?? [])
    .filter((item) =>
      floridaPhase
        ? item.id === oppositeFloridaMentalHealthRuleSetId(credential.ruleSetId)
        : item.id.startsWith("fl-insurance-producer-"),
    )
    .map((item) => ({ value: item.id, label: item.credentialName }));
  const needsTemplateEligibility =
    isManagedPharmacistCredential(credential) ||
    isManagedNursingCredential(credential) ||
    isManagedDentalCredential(credential) ||
    expanded;

  async function handleSubmit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!credential || pending.form) return;
    const form = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
    setFailure(null);
    const result = await run(
      "markRenewalAccepted",
      {
        credentialId: credential.id,
        acceptedAt: String(form.get("acceptedAt") ?? ""),
        reference: String(form.get("reference") ?? ""),
        nextCycleStart: String(form.get("nextCycleStart") ?? ""),
        nextDeadline: String(form.get("nextDeadline") ?? ""),
        nextRuleSetId: requiresCurrentNextTemplate(credential)
          ? String(form.get("nextRuleSetId") ?? "")
          : nremt
            ? nremtNextRule?.id
            : undefined,
        officialDatesAttested: requiresOfficialNextPeriodAttestation(credential)
          ? form.get("officialDatesAttested") === "on"
          : undefined,
        templateEligibilityAttested: needsTemplateEligibility
          ? form.get("templateEligibilityAttested") === "on"
          : undefined,
      },
      {
        success: compliance
          ? "Compliance period completed. Your next period is ready."
          : nremt
            ? "National Registry renewal confirmed. Your dashboard dates are preserved."
            : "Renewal accepted. Your next cycle is ready.",
      },
    );
    if (!result.ok) {
      setFailure(result.copy);
      return;
    }
    modals.close("acceptance");
    markSeriesClosed(seriesKey(credential));
    // Accepting a renewal ends the cycle the screen was opened on and starts
    // its successor. The detail screen is addressed by URL, so it is
    // re-pointed at the new cycle — replacing the entry, so Back does not
    // return to the finished one.
    if (nav.route.detail) {
      nav.openCredential(result.id, { replace: true });
    }
  }

  return (
    <Modal
      title={
        isc2
          ? "Confirm the renewed ISC2 cycle"
          : compliance
            ? "Start the next compliance period"
            : nremt
              ? "Confirm the renewed National Registry cycle"
              : "Close this renewal cycle"
      }
      eyebrow={
        isc2
          ? "Dashboard renewed"
          : compliance
            ? "Official record updated"
            : nremt
              ? "Dashboard renewal approved"
              : "Acceptance received"
      }
      onClose={requestClose}
    >
      <form ref={formRef} className="form-stack" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
        <div className="celebration-panel">
          <span className="celebration-mark">
            <Icon name="check" size={20} />
          </span>
          <div>
            <strong>
              {isc2
                ? "Your renewed certification starts a clean cycle"
                : compliance
                  ? "Your next compliance period starts clean"
                  : "Your renewed credential starts a clean cycle"}
            </strong>
            <p>
              The completed cycle stays in history. Credits, checked tasks, and
              submission records will not be copied forward.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="form-grid">

              name="acceptedAt"
              required

        {nremt ? (
          <div className="modal-section">
