            <p className="source-card-title">
              {nremtNextRule?.credentialName ?? credential.credentialName}
            </p>
            <p>
              The next cycle must stay on this current same-level catalog
              template. Enter the cycle start and fixed expiration exactly as
              displayed in the National Registry dashboard.
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : null}
        {requiresCurrentNextTemplate(credential) ? (
          <Field
            label={
              floridaPhase
                ? "Next renewal’s Florida phase"
                : "Next period’s official Florida template"
            }
            hint={
              floridaPhase
                ? "Florida alternates Ethics and Boundaries with Telehealth each biennium. Confirm the displayed opposite phase against CE Broker; the new cycle will reset every third-biennium and supervisor condition for review."
                : "Reconfirm both license line and tenure tier. iTrack will seed the new period from this current official template."
            }
          >
            <Select
              name="nextRuleSetId"
              defaultValue=""
              required
              placeholder={
                floridaPhase
                  ? "Choose the phase shown by CE Broker"
                  : "Choose the variant shown by MyProfile"
              }
              options={nextTemplateOptions}
            />
          </Field>
        ) : null}
        <div className="cycle-rollover">
          <span className="modal-section-eyebrow">
            {compliance ? "Next compliance period" : "Next renewal cycle"}
          </span>
          <p>Confirm the dates shown by your issuing organization.</p>
          <div className="form-grid">
            <Field label={nremt ? "Dashboard cycle start" : "New cycle starts"}>
              <DateInput
                name="nextCycleStart"
                required
                defaultValue={nremt || expanded ? undefined : addDaysIso(credential.deadline, 1)}
                min={
                  requiresNonOverlappingNextPeriod(credential)
                    ? addDaysIso(credential.deadline, 1)
                    : undefined
                }
              />
            </Field>
            <Field
              label={
                compliance
                  ? "Next compliance deadline"
                  : nremt
                    ? "Dashboard fixed expiration"
                    : "Next renewal deadline"
              }
            >
              <DateInput
                name="nextDeadline"
                required
                defaultValue={
                  nremt || expanded
                    ? undefined
                    : addMonthsIso(credential.deadline, credential.cycleMonths || 12)
                }
              />
            </Field>
          </div>
        </div>
        {requiresOfficialNextPeriodAttestation(credential) ? (
          <Checkbox
            name="officialDatesAttested"
            required
            label={
              nremt
                ? "I verified the current-template dashboard dates"
                : "I verified the official next-period record"
            }
            description={
              nremt
                ? "The same-level template, cycle start, and fixed expiration above match the National Registry dashboard."
                : "The confirmation and next cycle dates above match the issuer, authority, or employer record."
            }
          />
        ) : null}
        {needsTemplateEligibility ? (
          <Checkbox
            name="templateEligibilityAttested"
            required
            label={`I confirmed the next period is a standard full-cycle${
              expanded
                ? " credential or license maintenance path"
                : isManagedNursingCredential(credential) || isManagedDentalCredential(credential)
                  ? " renewal or registration"
                  : " renewal"
            }`}
            description={
              expanded
                ? "The official account confirms the same credential and path. No initial, shortened, waiver, inactive, retired, reinstatement, synchronized or multi-credential, exam-alternative, or other adjusted variant applies."
                : credential.ruleSetId === "tx-rn-2026-v1" || credential.ruleSetId === "tx-lvn-2026-v1"
                  ? "I am using the 20-hour CNE path rather than the certification alternative, and no initial, shortened, inactive, exempt, or other adjusted-status variant applies."
                  : isManagedDentalCredential(credential)
                    ? "No initial, shortened, inactive, retired, prorated, exempt, or other adjusted-status variant applies to the next period."
                    : "No shortened, inactive, prorated, exempt, or other adjusted-status variant applies to the next period."
            }
          />
        ) : null}
        <p className="modal-note">
          {isFloridaInsuranceComplianceCredential(credential)
            ? "The next period will use the selected current template and will reset every conditional rule for confirmation."
            : floridaPhase
              ? "The next renewal will use the CE Broker-confirmed phase and reset every third-biennium and supervisor condition for review."
              : nremt
                ? "Do not infer the new cycle start from the old expiration. National Registry can assign an early rolling start while retaining the fixed expiration; the dashboard dates control."
                : isManagedPharmacistCredential(credential)
                  ? "The next renewal will use the latest current version of this state pharmacist template and reset every conditional authorization for review."
                  : isManagedNursingCredential(credential)
                    ? "The next period will use the latest current version of this nursing template and reset every conditional training rule for review."
                    : isManagedDentalCredential(credential)
                      ? "The next period will use the latest current version of this dental template and reset every conditional permit, training, and cadence rule for review."
                      : expanded
                        ? "The next period will use the latest current version of the same credential template and reset every conditional rule for confirmation."
                        : "Requirements are copied as a starting snapshot. Review the current official rules before relying on the new plan."}
        </p>
        <ErrorSummary
          title="This cycle wasn’t closed"
          errors={failure ? [{ message: failure.next }] : []}
          detail={failure?.detail ?? undefined}
        />
        <div className="form-actions">
          <Button variant="quiet" onClick={requestClose}>
            Not yet
          </Button>
          <Button
            type="submit"
            variant="primary"
            pending={pending.form}
            pendingLabel="Creating next cycle…"
          >
            {isc2
              ? "Confirm renewal and continue"
              : compliance
                ? "Start next period"
                : "Mark accepted and continue"}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </form>
      {prompt}
    </Modal>
  );
}

Rewrite `app/screens/modals/AllocationModal.tsx` whole (Task 5's file: `ITrackApp.tsx@c6b1fe4:5976-6108` + `handleAllocation` 3370-3441 + `eligibleAllocationCredentials` 2214-2230 + `allocationCredentialId` as local state). The three allocator components keep their props; the local allocator errors (the sentences `nremtRequirementMatchPayload` / `crcRequirementMatchPayload` / `crcApprovalPayload` throw) render under "Check the form", a server refusal under "This activity wasn’t applied".

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { Button } from "../../components/Button";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/EmptyState";
import {
  Checkbox,
  ErrorSummary,
  Field,
  Select,
  TextInput,
} from "../../components/Form";
import { Icon } from "../../components/Icon";
import { Modal } from "../../components/Modal";
import { useDiscardGuard } from "../../components/useDiscardGuard";
import {
  activityDateFitsCredential,
  allocationsFor,
  isPriorPeriodCarryoverEntry,
} from "../../lib/activityRules";
import {
  crcApprovalPayload,
  crcRequirementMatchPayload,
  nremtRequirementMatchPayload,
} from "../../lib/allocation";
import { DIALOG_NAMES, type DescribedError } from "../../lib/copy";
import { isCrcCredential, isNremtCredential } from "../../lib/credentialRules";
import { isOpenCycle } from "../../lib/cycles";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../lib/workspaceStore";
import type { CrcApprovalPayload, RequirementMatchPayload } from "../../lib/workspaceTypes";
import { CrcRequirementAllocator } from "../parts/allocators/CrcRequirementAllocator";
import { NremtRequirementAllocator } from "../parts/allocators/NremtRequirementAllocator";
import { RequirementPicker } from "../parts/allocators/RequirementPicker";

// "Apply to another credential" (spec §6; was "Reuse completed learning"):
// the credential picker and the credit amount on the Form primitives, the
// allocators untouched (their `requirementMatch:<id>` / `requirementIds` /
// CRCC field names are what addActivityAllocation reads), the carryover
// attestation as a Checkbox, its own error state and the discard guard.

export function AllocationModal() {
  const store = useWorkspace();
  const { workspace, modals, run, pending } = store;
  const activity = modals.allocationActivity;
  const [credentialId, setCredentialId] = useState("");
  const [failure, setFailure] = useState<DescribedError | null>(null);
  const [issue, setIssue] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const formRef = useRef<HTMLFormElement>(null);
  const close = () => modals.close("allocate");
  const { requestClose, prompt, snapshot } = useDiscardGuard({ formRef, onClose: close });

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = window.setTimeout(snapshot, 0);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [snapshot]);

  // Open cycles the activity is not applied to yet whose window holds its
  // completion date (the memo at app/ITrackApp.tsx@c6b1fe4:2214-2230).
  const eligible = useMemo(() => {
    if (!workspace || !activity) return [];
    const existingIds = new Set(
      allocationsFor(activity).map((allocation) => allocation.credentialId),
    );
    return workspace.credentials.filter(
      (item) =>
        isOpenCycle(item) &&
        !existingIds.has(item.id) &&
        activityDateFitsCredential(activity.completionDate, item),
    );
  }, [activity, workspace]);
  const credential = eligible.find((item) => item.id === credentialId) ?? eligible[0] ?? null;

  if (!activity) return null;

  async function handleSubmit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!activity || pending.form) return;
    const form = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
    const allocatedUnits = Number(form.get("allocatedUnits"));
    let nremtMatches: RequirementMatchPayload[] | undefined;
    let crcMatches: RequirementMatchPayload[] | undefined;
    let crcApproval: CrcApprovalPayload | undefined;
    setIssue(null);
    setFailure(null);
    if (credential && isNremtCredential(credential)) {
      try {
        nremtMatches = nremtRequirementMatchPayload(form, credential, allocatedUnits);
      } catch (matchError) {
        setIssue(
          matchError instanceof Error
            ? matchError.message
            : "Review the National Registry credit allocation.",
        );
        return;
      }
    } else if (credential && isCrcCredential(credential)) {
      try {
        crcMatches = crcRequirementMatchPayload(form, credential, allocatedUnits);
        crcApproval = crcApprovalPayload(form);
      } catch (matchError) {
        setIssue(
          matchError instanceof Error
            ? matchError.message
            : "Review the CRC clock-hour allocation.",
        );
        return;
      }
    }
    const result = await run(
      "addActivityAllocation",
      {
        activityId: activity.id,
        credentialId: String(form.get("credentialId") ?? ""),
        ...(nremtMatches
          ? { requirementMatches: nremtMatches, acceptedEducationAttested: true }
          : crcMatches && crcApproval
            ? { requirementMatches: crcMatches, ...crcApproval }
            : {
                requirementIds: form
                  .getAll("requirementIds")
                  .map((value) => String(value))
                  .filter(Boolean),
              }),
        allocatedUnits,
        portalCarryoverAttested: form.get("portalCarryoverAttested") === "on",
      },
      { success: "Activity applied to another credential." },
    );
    if (!result.ok) {
      setFailure(result.copy);
      return;
    }
    modals.close("allocate");
  }

  return (
    <Modal title={DIALOG_NAMES.allocate} eyebrow={activity.title} onClose={requestClose}>
      {eligible.length ? (
        <form ref={formRef} className="form-stack" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
          <p className="modal-note">
            One course may count toward more than one credential. Confirm
            eligibility with each issuing organization.
          </p>
          <Field label="Also apply to">
            <Select
              name="credentialId"
              value={credential?.id ?? ""}
              onChange={(event) => {
                const next = event.currentTarget.value;
                setCredentialId(next);
              }}
              required
              options={eligible.map((item) => ({
                value: item.id,
                label: `${item.credentialName} · ${item.jurisdiction}`,
              }))}
            />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Credits to apply">
            <TextInput
              name="allocatedUnits"
              type="number"
              inputMode="decimal"
              min={isCrcCredential(credential) ? 0.01 : 0.1}
              max={activity.totalUnits}
              step={isCrcCredential(credential) ? 0.01 : 0.1}
              defaultValue={activity.totalUnits}
              required
              className="field-control-mono"
            />
          </Field>
          {credential && isNremtCredential(credential) ? (
            <NremtRequirementAllocator
              key={credential.id}
              credential={credential}
              availableUnits={activity.totalUnits}
            />
          ) : credential && isCrcCredential(credential) ? (
            <CrcRequirementAllocator
              key={credential.id}
              credential={credential}
              availableUnits={activity.totalUnits}
              initialProgramReference={
                allocationsFor(activity).some((allocation) =>
                  allocation.credentialRuleSetId?.startsWith("crcc-"),
                )
                  ? (activity.evidenceReference ?? "")
                  : ""
              }
            />
          ) : (
            <RequirementPicker key={credential?.id} credential={credential} />
          )}
          {isPriorPeriodCarryoverEntry(activity.completionDate, credential) ? (
            <Checkbox
              name="portalCarryoverAttested"
              required
              label="The issuing authority permits this carryover"
              description="Apply this prior-period record to the evidence-backed carryover source plus only compatible classifiers, and retain the issuer’s supporting record."
            />
          ) : null}
          <ErrorSummary
            title={failure ? "This activity wasn’t applied" : "Check the form"}
            errors={failure ? [{ message: failure.next }] : issue ? [{ message: issue }] : []}
            detail={failure?.detail ?? undefined}
          />
          <div className="form-actions">
            <Button variant="quiet" onClick={requestClose}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="submit"
              variant="primary"
              pending={pending.form}
              pendingLabel="Applying…"
            >
              Apply to credential
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      ) : (
        <EmptyState
          compact
          title="No other eligible credential"
          body="Add another active credential, or this activity is already applied everywhere it can be."
          action={{ label: "Close", onClick: close }}
          icon={<Icon name="plus" size={22} />}
        />
      )}
      {prompt}
    </Modal>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { Button } from "../../components/Button";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/EmptyState";
import { Checkbox, ErrorSummary, Field, TextInput } from "../../components/Form";
import { Icon } from "../../components/Icon";
import { Modal } from "../../components/Modal";
import { useDiscardGuard } from "../../components/useDiscardGuard";
import { isPriorPeriodCarryoverEntry } from "../../lib/activityRules";
import { crcRequirementMatchPayload, nremtRequirementMatchPayload } from "../../lib/allocation";
import { DIALOG_NAMES, type DescribedError } from "../../lib/copy";
import { isCrcCredential, isNremtCredential } from "../../lib/credentialRules";
import { compactNumber } from "../../lib/format";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../lib/workspaceStore";
import type { RequirementMatchPayload } from "../../lib/workspaceTypes";
import { CrcRequirementAllocator } from "../parts/allocators/CrcRequirementAllocator";
import { NremtRequirementAllocator } from "../parts/allocators/NremtRequirementAllocator";
import { RequirementPicker } from "../parts/allocators/RequirementPicker";

// "Categorize this activity" (an allocation that still needs a requirement)
// or "Edit requirement tags" (one that has them), spec §6: "categorize"
// replaces "classify" and "evidence" replaces "proof" in every sentence; the
// allocators and their field names are unchanged, the carryover attestation
// is a Checkbox, the error state is the modal's own.

export function ClassificationModal() {
  const store = useWorkspace();
  const { workspace, modals, run, pending } = store;
  const repair = modals.classificationRepair;
  const credential =
    workspace?.credentials.find((item) => item.id === repair?.allocation.credentialId) ?? null;
  const [failure, setFailure] = useState<DescribedError | null>(null);
  const [issue, setIssue] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const formRef = useRef<HTMLFormElement>(null);
  const close = () => modals.close("classify");
  const { requestClose, prompt, snapshot } = useDiscardGuard({ formRef, onClose: close });

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = window.setTimeout(snapshot, 0);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [snapshot]);

  if (!repair) return null;
  const { activity, allocation } = repair;
  const needsCategory = allocation.classificationStatus === "needs_classification";
  const groups = allocation.unresolvedExclusiveGroups?.join(" and ") ?? "";

  async function handleSubmit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!repair || pending.form) return;
    const form = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
    let nremtMatches: RequirementMatchPayload[] | undefined;
    let crcMatches: RequirementMatchPayload[] | undefined;
    setIssue(null);
    setFailure(null);
    if (credential && isNremtCredential(credential)) {
      try {
        nremtMatches = nremtRequirementMatchPayload(form, credential, allocation.allocatedUnits);
      } catch (matchError) {
        setIssue(
          matchError instanceof Error
            ? matchError.message
            : "Review the National Registry credit allocation.",
        );
        return;
      }
    } else if (credential && isCrcCredential(credential)) {
      try {
        crcMatches = crcRequirementMatchPayload(form, credential, allocation.allocatedUnits);
      } catch (matchError) {
        setIssue(
          matchError instanceof Error
            ? matchError.message
            : "Review the CRC clock-hour allocation.",
        );
        return;
      }
    }
    const result = await run(
      "updateActivityAllocationRequirements",
      {
        allocationId: allocation.id,
        ...(nremtMatches
          ? { requirementMatches: nremtMatches, acceptedEducationAttested: true }
          : crcMatches
            ? {
                requirementMatches: crcMatches,
                crcApprovalAttested: form.get("crcApprovalAttested") === "on",
              }
            : {
                requirementIds: form
                  .getAll("requirementIds")
                  .map((value) => String(value))
                  .filter(Boolean),
                allocatedUnits: Number(form.get("allocatedUnits")),
              }),
        portalCarryoverAttested: form.get("portalCarryoverAttested") === "on",
      },
      { success: "Requirement tags updated." },
    );
    if (!result.ok) {
      setFailure(result.copy);
      return;
    }
    modals.close("classify");
  }

  return (
    <Modal
      title={needsCategory ? DIALOG_NAMES.categorize : DIALOG_NAMES.editTags}
      eyebrow={activity.title}
      onClose={requestClose}
    >
      {credential ? (
        <form ref={formRef} className="form-stack" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
          {needsCategory ? (
            <p className="modal-note">
              Choose the requirement this activity counts toward before it counts.
              {groups ? ` Choose exactly one option for ${groups}.` : ""}
            </p>
          ) : (
            <p className="modal-note">
              Update which requirements this preserved activity satisfies
              {isNremtCredential(credential)
                ? ". Its National Registry amount stays exact."
                : isCrcCredential(credential)
                  ? ". Its CRC-applied amount and existing CRCC approval record stay exact."
                  : ", and correct how much of the full learning record counts here."}{" "}
              Its date and evidence will not change.
            </p>
          )}
          {isNremtCredential(credential) ? (
            <NremtRequirementAllocator
              key={allocation.id}
              credential={credential}
              availableUnits={allocation.allocatedUnits}
              initialMatches={allocation.requirementMatches}
            />
          ) : isCrcCredential(credential) ? (
            <CrcRequirementAllocator
              key={allocation.id}
              credential={credential}
              availableUnits={allocation.allocatedUnits}
              initialMatches={allocation.requirementMatches}
              includeApprovalFields={false}
            />
          ) : (
            <>
              <Field
                label="Credits to apply to this credential"
                hint={`The full learning record remains ${compactNumber(
                  activity.totalUnits,
                )} credits; change only the amount this credential may count.`}
              >
                <TextInput
                  name="allocatedUnits"
                  type="number"
                  min="0.01"
                  max={activity.totalUnits}
                  step="0.01"
                  inputMode="decimal"
                  defaultValue={allocation.allocatedUnits}
                  required
                  className="field-control-mono"
                />
              </Field>
              <RequirementPicker
                key={allocation.id}
                credential={credential}
                initialRequirementIds={allocation.requirementIds}
              />
            </>
          )}
          {isPriorPeriodCarryoverEntry(activity.completionDate, credential) ? (
            <Checkbox
              name="portalCarryoverAttested"
              required
              label="The issuing authority permits this carryover"
              description="Keep this prior-period activity tagged to the evidence-backed carryover source plus only compatible classifiers, and retain the official supporting record."
            />
          ) : null}
          <ErrorSummary
            title={failure ? "These tags weren’t saved" : "Check the form"}
            errors={failure ? [{ message: failure.next }] : issue ? [{ message: issue }] : []}
            detail={failure?.detail ?? undefined}
          />
          <div className="form-actions">
            <Button variant="quiet" onClick={requestClose}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="submit"
              variant="primary"
              pending={pending.form}
              pendingLabel="Updating…"
            >
              Update allocation
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      ) : (
        <EmptyState
          compact
          title="Credential unavailable"
          body="This activity’s credential could not be opened."
          action={{ label: "Close", onClick: close }}
          icon={<Icon name="plus" size={22} />}
        />
      )}
      {prompt}
    </Modal>
  );
}
```

Rewrite `app/screens/modals/EvidenceModal.tsx` whole (Task 5's file: `ITrackApp.tsx@c6b1fe4:6276-6377` + `evidenceFiles`/`evidencePending` 1367-1368 + `openEvidence` 2996-3027, `handleEvidenceUpload` 3028-3044, `deleteEvidence` 3045-3087 wired through `workspaceApi`). Every API answer goes through `describeApiError`; nothing here switches on a code: after a refused removal the list is simply re-read (the server marks an interrupted removal `deletionPending`, which is what the old code set by hand from `evidence_delete_retry`).

```tsx
"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { Button } from "../../components/Button";
import { ErrorSummary, Field, TextInput } from "../../components/Form";
import { Modal } from "../../components/Modal";
import { useToast } from "../../components/Toast";
import { useDiscardGuard } from "../../components/useDiscardGuard";
import { activityIsMutable } from "../../lib/activityRules";
import type { ApiResult } from "../../lib/apiResponse";
import { buttonClassName } from "../../lib/buttonClass";
import { DIALOG_NAMES, describeApiError, type DescribedError } from "../../lib/copy";
import { formatDate, formatFileSize } from "../../lib/format";
import { deleteEvidenceFile, listEvidence, uploadEvidenceFile } from "../../lib/workspaceApi";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../lib/workspaceStore";
import type { EvidenceFile } from "../../lib/workspaceTypes";

// "Evidence" (spec §6: evidence replaces proof): the Field-labelled file
// input, the line-separated list with its mono meta, Download as a dressed
// link and Remove as a pending Button, the frozen note for a closed cycle,
// and one error surface fed only by describeApiError. A lapsed session is
// handed to store.reload(), whose own 401 path drops the workspace and
// unmounts this modal (its site is gated on `workspace`).

function describe(parsed: ApiResult<{ error?: string; code?: string }>): DescribedError {
  if (parsed.kind === "json") {
    return describeApiError({
      kind: "json",
      status: parsed.status,
      code: parsed.data.code,
      error: parsed.data.error,
    });
  }
  if (parsed.kind === "unexpected") {
    return describeApiError({ kind: "unexpected", status: parsed.status, text: parsed.text });
  }
  return describeApiError({ kind: "session-ended" });
}

export function EvidenceModal() {
  const store = useWorkspace();
  const { workspace, modals, reload } = store;
  const toast = useToast();
  const activity = modals.evidenceActivity;
  const activityId = activity?.id ?? null;
  const frozen = Boolean(
    activity && workspace && !activityIsMutable(activity, workspace.credentials),
  );
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<EvidenceFile[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [removingId, setRemovingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [failure, setFailure] = useState<DescribedError | null>(null);
  const [fileError, setFileError] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined);
  const formRef = useRef<HTMLFormElement>(null);
  const close = () => modals.close("evidence");
  const { requestClose, prompt, snapshot } = useDiscardGuard({ formRef, onClose: close });

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = window.setTimeout(snapshot, 0);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [snapshot]);

  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!activityId) return;
    const parsed = await listEvidence(activityId);
    if (parsed.kind === "json" && parsed.ok) {
      setFiles(parsed.data.evidence ?? []);
    } else {
      setFailure(describe(parsed));
      if (parsed.kind === "session-ended") void reload();
    }
    setLoading(false);
  }, [activityId, reload]);

  // The list is read once the modal has mounted (deferred, so no state is
  // set synchronously inside the effect — react-hooks/set-state-in-effect).
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      void refresh();
    }, 0);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [refresh]);

  if (!activity) return null;

  async function handleUpload(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!activity || uploading) return;
    const formElement = event.currentTarget;
    const file = new FormData(formElement).get("file");
    if (!(file instanceof File) || file.size === 0) {
      setFileError("Choose a PDF or image to upload.");
      return;
    }
    setFileError(undefined);
    setFailure(null);
    setUploading(true);
    try {
      const { parsed } = await uploadEvidenceFile(activity.id, file);
      if (parsed.kind === "json" && parsed.ok && parsed.data.evidence) {
        const uploaded = parsed.data.evidence;
        setFiles((current) => [uploaded, ...current]);
        formElement.reset();
        await reload();
        toast.show({ message: "Evidence saved." });
        return;
      }
      setFailure(describe(parsed));
      if (parsed.kind === "session-ended") void reload();
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
    }
  }

  async function remove(evidence: EvidenceFile) {
    if (removingId) return;
    setFailure(null);
    setRemovingId(evidence.id);
    try {
      const { parsed } = await deleteEvidenceFile(evidence.id);
      if (parsed.kind === "json" && parsed.ok) {
        setFiles((current) => current.filter((item) => item.id !== evidence.id));
        await reload();
        toast.show({ message: "Evidence removed." });
        return;
      }
      setFailure(describe(parsed));
      if (parsed.kind === "session-ended") {
        void reload();
        return;
      }
      // A refused removal may have left the file marked for retry on the
      // server; the list is the source of truth for that flag.
      await refresh();
    } finally {
      setRemovingId(null);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Modal title={DIALOG_NAMES.evidence} eyebrow={activity.title} onClose={requestClose}>
      <div className="form-stack">
        <ErrorSummary
          title="Evidence wasn’t updated"
          errors={failure ? [{ message: failure.next }] : []}
          detail={failure?.detail ?? undefined}
        />
        {frozen ? (
          <p className="modal-note">
            This activity belongs to a closed cycle; its evidence is read-only.
          </p>
        ) : (
          <form ref={formRef} className="evidence-upload" noValidate onSubmit={handleUpload}>
            <Field
              id="evidence-file"
              label="Add an evidence file"
              hint="Private to your account · PDF, JPEG, PNG, or WebP · up to 10 MB"
              error={fileError}
            >
              <TextInput
                name="file"
                type="file"
                accept=".pdf,image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp"
                required
              />
            </Field>
            <Button type="submit" variant="primary" pending={uploading} pendingLabel="Saving…">
              Upload evidence
            </Button>
          </form>
        )}
        <div aria-live="polite">
          {loading && files.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="evidence-empty">Loading evidence…</p>
          ) : files.length ? (
            <ul className="evidence-list">
              {files.map((evidence) => (
                <li className="evidence-row" key={evidence.id}>
                  <div>
                    <strong>{evidence.fileName}</strong>
                    <span className="evidence-row-meta">
                      {formatFileSize(evidence.sizeBytes)} · saved{" "}
                      {formatDate(evidence.createdAt)}
                      {evidence.deletionPending ? " · removal interrupted" : ""}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="evidence-row-actions">
                    {!evidence.deletionPending ? (
                      <a className={buttonClassName("secondary", "sm")} href={evidence.downloadUrl}>
                        Download
                      </a>
                    ) : null}
                    {evidence.deletionPending || !frozen ? (
                      <Button
                        variant="quiet"
                        size="sm"
                        pending={removingId === evidence.id}
                        disabled={removingId !== null && removingId !== evidence.id}
                        onClick={() => void remove(evidence)}
                      >
                        {evidence.deletionPending ? "Retry removal" : "Remove"}
                      </Button>
                    ) : null}
                  </div>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          ) : failure ? null : (
            <p className="evidence-empty">
              <strong>No evidence uploaded yet</strong>
              {frozen
                ? "No evidence was saved before this cycle closed."
                : "Add the completion certificate, receipt, or attendance record above."}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      {prompt}
    </Modal>
  );
}
```

The upload form is `noValidate` so an empty pick reaches the "Choose a PDF or image to upload." sentence through `Field error=` (the old `required` bubble never let it show). `Button pending` marks the row being removed (`aria-busy`, focus kept) while the other rows' Remove buttons are natively `disabled` — one write at a time, as before. `serializeForm` counts a picked file by name (`Modal.tsx:82-91`), so a chosen-but-not-uploaded file makes the guard ask.

In `app/screens/modals/ModalsHost.tsx` the site Task 5 wrote for this modal passes `workspace=` and `activity=` props the component no longer takes. Spell the site exactly — the `{cond ? (\n<…Modal` shape the modal-site guard counts, gated on the activity slice it already reads:

```tsx

        <EvidenceModal />
      ) : null}
```

(the modal reads `modals.evidenceActivity` itself.)

"use client";

import { Button } from "../../components/Button";
import { Modal } from "../../components/Modal";
import { DIALOG_NAMES } from "../../lib/copy";
import { isIosLike } from "../../lib/webPush";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../lib/workspaceStore";

// The install-help sheet (keep-list: content verbatim but for the copy
// table's two word swaps; the accessible name is pinned by
// tests/e2e/primitives.spec.ts:20-28). Opened by usePushDevice.install() when
// the browser offers no install prompt, and by enable() on an iOS browser
// that is not yet standalone.

export function InstallHelpModal() {
  const { modals } = useWorkspace();
  const close = () => modals.close("installHelp");
  return (
    <Modal title={DIALOG_NAMES.installHelp} eyebrow="Install" onClose={close}>
      <div className="form-stack">
        <div className="modal-section">
          {isIosLike() ? (
            <>
              <p>
                Apple enables web alerts only after iTrack is opened from your
                Home Screen.
              </p>
              <ol>
                <li>Open iTrack in Safari.</li>
                <li>
                  Tap the Share button, then choose <strong>Add to Home Screen</strong>.
                </li>
                <li>
                  Open the new iTrack icon and return to Account to turn on
                  phone alerts.
                </li>
              </ol>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <p>
                Open your browser menu and choose <strong>Install app</strong>{" "}
                or <strong>Add to Home Screen</strong>.
              </p>
              <p>
                Then open iTrack from its new icon for a focused, full-screen
                workspace.
              </p>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
        <p className="modal-note">
          Installing does not turn on alerts. iTrack asks for notification
          permission only after you tap the separate phone-alert button.
        </p>
        <div className="form-actions">
          <Button variant="primary" onClick={close}>
            Got it
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
}

**Gotchas for this task:**
- The prompt must be the LAST child of the owner's `<Modal>`, never a sibling of it: as a React child it is a nested dialog on the modal stack (top-most answers Escape, the owner's backdrop goes inert, focus walks back through the owner to the opener). Rendered outside, it would be a second top-level dialog whose Escape closes the owner too.
- Call `snapshot()` only from a deferred effect (`window.setTimeout(…, 0)`). Taking it synchronously in the mount effect records the form before a `DateInput`'s `defaultValue` and React's `autoFocus` have settled on some browsers, and the untouched form then reads as dirty.
- `serializeForm` sees only named controls: the template chooser's `<input type="search">` has no `name`, so typing a query alone never makes "Add a credential" dirty — choosing a template (`ruleSetId`) does. The setup sheet re-baselines on a mode switch (the `[snapshot, mode]` effect); a modal whose state lives outside its form passes `isDirty` instead (Task 10's edit sheet).
- Modal's backdrop guard keeps its own snapshot, taken once at mount: after a mode switch the backdrop may read the untouched custom form as dirty and ignore the press. That is app-ux-23's contract (ignore, never discard) and is left as it is.
- `Button pending` is for a write on the wire (focus stays, `aria-busy`); native `disabled` is for a control that cannot act — the other Remove buttons while one removal is in flight, and nothing else here. Never `disabled={pending.form}` on a submit.
- The setup sheet is `noValidate` and the evidence form is `noValidate`; the milestone, allocation and categorize forms keep native `required` (their fields arrive prefilled; an unticked attestation is what the browser refuses, and the server's `*_attestation_required` codes map to the same sentence). Adding a11y-09 validators there needs copy-table sentences this task does not have.
- `describeApiError` takes `ApiFailure`, not `ApiResult`: map `kind: "json"` with `parsed.data.code` / `parsed.data.error` and `kind: "unexpected"` with `parsed.text` (the `describe` helper in `EvidenceModal`). Never read `parsed.data.error` into the UI directly and never branch on `parsed.data.code` — after a refused removal the list is re-read instead of setting `deletionPending` by hand.
- A lapsed session inside the evidence modal is handed to `store.reload()`: its own 401 path drops the workspace, and the modal's site (`{workspace && evidenceActivity ? (`) unmounts it. Do not call `handleSessionEnded` from a modal — it is not on the store's surface.
- `useCatalog(store).load()` is guarded against repeats (the old `catalogRequest` ref); calling it from the mount effect is the old `openCredentialSetup` behaviour. Do not call it in render.
- The conditional rules are one native `Select` per rule (values `applies` / `not_applicable` / `needs_confirmation`, default `needs_confirmation`, `name` = `applicability:<id>`), not three visually hidden radios: the FormData the submit reads is identical, the control is a single focus stop, and no forced-colours rule is needed. The dead `.condition-options` selectors in `legacy-shared.css`'s forced-colours block (1204-1239) go with that file in Task 18.
- The old source card's `verified-chip` becomes a `StatusPill` on `ruleReviewState()`; the chip's rules stay in `legacy-shared.css` for `CredentialDetailScreen` until Task 7 — do not delete them here.
- `.advisory-note`, `.read-only-status` and `.archive-zone*` stay in `log-activity.css` on purpose: three modals this task does not touch still wear them. `.verified-chip` and `.section-kicker` likewise stay in `legacy-shared.css`.
- Only `--mark-tint-bright` leaves the alias block. `--ink-coral-faint` looks orphaned by the evidence/celebration cuts but its two readers are the `.archive-zone` paragraphs that stay; prune only after the `grep -rl` loop in 14d prints `0` for a name.
- `AcceptanceModal` renders nothing unless the addressed credential is `submitted` (the old site's condition); the ABVE refusal lives with the opener (Task 7), not here. After success it calls `markSeriesClosed(seriesKey(credential))` — Task 8's fold reads it — and re-points a routed detail at `result.id` with `replace: true`, exactly as `handleAcceptance` did.
- Every string this task renders is in the "Copy this task writes" list at the top; the copy-rule swaps inside kept sentences are exactly three — "appears on Today" → "appears on Home", "countable total" → "total that counts" (twice, the CRC milestone), "supporting proof" / "date and proof" → evidence — plus the categorize EmptyState body. Nothing else in the seven bodies changes a word.
- `tests/e2e/credentials.spec.ts:69` already expects "Credential added." — the store's success toast now says exactly that, so the pin is untouched, not re-pointed.
- `--list` before the dev-server run: the new primitives case makes it `Total: 56 tests in 1 file`; a different total means the test was appended inside another `test(...)` body.

### Task 7: Credential detail: six sections (Plan, Activities, Checklist moved from Home, Submission & acceptance, History, Manage), "Log activity for this credential", archived read-only state, categories editor, three editor modals on the primitives, credentialFilters.ts, credential-detail.css rewritten

**Rationale:** spec §6 "Credential detail" names the six sections the screen is made of — Plan (the requirement bars with their rule answers), Activities ("the activities logged against this credential" — today `CredentialDetailScreen` computes `credentialActivities` at `app/ITrackApp.tsx:7708-7712` and never lists them: finding app-ux-10), Checklist (today the renewal checklist is Home's card at `:7201-7395`, three taps away from the credential it belongs to), Submission & acceptance, History and Edit/Archive/Delete, plus a "Log activity for this credential" action the detail has never had. Spec §4 fixes edit / delete / archive: archiving keeps every record and is restorable, delete is name-confirmed, and a custom credential's requirements are editable — `updateCredential` (`app/api/workspace/route.ts:6629-7090`) has accepted a `categories` replace-set since Wave 2 (`credentialCategoryDraftsFromPayload` `:6497-6584`, the total rule `assertCategoryTotalWithinCredential` `:6611-6631`, 409 `requirement_in_use` `:6884`) and no editor has ever sent it — the Wave 3 reviewer's "categories editor over updateCredential's live but unused categories contract" minor. The other carried minor, "archived credentials not fully frozen", has two halves: the server half (Task 3 closes the task- and activity-side writes with 409 `credential_archived`) and the client half — today the detail resolves only from `workspace.credentials` (`:2128-2135`), so the moment a credential is archived the dead-URL effect (`:2153-2161`) bounces the user to `/credentials` and there is no archived presentation at all; `tests/e2e/credential-edit-archive-delete.spec.ts:23-30` pins that bounce. Finding app-ux-03 (edit/delete/archive reachable from the detail) is closed by the header and the Manage section; app-ux-25 (the four "handed off to your calendar" toasts that describe a hand-off the browser did not perform) is closed by the calendar copy of table D. Copy table section D is the only source of strings here; section I fixes the three dialog names this task keeps ("Edit credential", "Delete {name}?", "Add a personal task" / "Edit personal task"). The stylesheet `app/styles/credential-detail.css` (325 lines) is a verbatim Wave 3 move on fourteen legacy aliases (`--font-ui`, `--ink-surface`, `--on-dark`, `--on-dark-faint`, `--veil-rgb`, `--chip`, `--wash`, `--ink-tint`, `--edge-tint`, `--wash-tint`, `--edge-amber-soft`, `--wash-amber`, `--ink-tint-deep`, `--tint-bright`) and is rewritten whole on first-class tokens; the screen also leans on `legacy-shared.css`'s `.progress-row`/`.requirement-condition`/`.dental-checkpoint*`/`.verified-chip` and on home.css's checklist rules, none of which it uses afterwards. `app/lib/credentialFilters.ts` is born here because the detail's History needs the one series a credential belongs to (`seriesFor`) and Task 9's list needs the same grouping with a query and a state filter (`filterCredentials`) — one pure module, tested once.

**Decisions.** (1) **Header actions:** primary "Log activity for this credential" (`store.modals.open({ kind: "logActivity", preselectCredentialId: credential.id })`, native `disabled` when frozen) and secondary "Edit credential" (`disabled` offline or on a closed cycle); on an archived credential the secondary is "Restore" (`pending` on `credentialActionKey`). Archive and Delete live in section 6 "Manage credential" with their consequences spelled out — a destructive fill on every visit and a four-button phone app bar are worse than one extra scroll. (2) **The archived detail stays on its URL.** This task widens Task 5's `Routed` lookup — open list only, by Task 5 decision 5 — to `workspace.archivedCredentials` (Step 16) and the provider's dead-detail `detailResolves` the same way (Step 8e), so `store.actions.archiveCredential` (which never navigated — the bounce was the dead-URL effect) now leaves the user on a read-only record: the note "Archived {Mon D, YYYY}. Restore it to log activity or change its plan.", a `StatusPill state="none"` reading "Archived", "Restore" in the header, and every write control `disabled` (native — it cannot act); Restore and Delete stay live. `frozen = archived || !isOpenCycle(credential) || !isOnline` is the single client-side freeze; `pending` (aria-disabled) is only ever an in-flight write. (3) **The checklist arrives here now;** Home drops its card in Task 8. For the commits in between both render it (Home's legacy `.task-row .custom-check` rows and the detail's native `Checkbox` rows) — acceptable on the feature branch, and it is why home.css's checklist rules (463-597, 928-950) and legacy-shared.css's `.custom-check` forced-colours block (1194-1240) are NOT deleted in this task: `tests/e2e/forced-colors.spec.ts:16` still reads `.task-row .custom-check` on Home until Task 8. Likewise `ProgressRow.tsx` (Task 5's `app/screens/parts/`) and the legacy-shared.css blocks it wears (135-360, 389-418) stay for Home's Requirements card; the detail's `RequirementRow` is its own copy of ProgressRow's third branch (`app/ITrackApp.tsx:10024-10102`) on `CreditBar` and `StatusPill`. (4) **Categories editor scope: names and minimums only.** Every other field of an existing row is echoed untouched (`requirementId, kind, relation, parentRequirementId, applicability, applicabilityStatus, conditionNote, exclusiveGroup` — the server resets an absent enum to its default and inserts a row without a `requirementId`), a new row is `kind: "minimum", relation: "independent", applicability: "always"`; `categories` travels only when a row was added, removed, renamed or re-valued; the editor shows only for `custom && credential.status === "active"` (a submitted cycle refuses the key's presence with 409 `cycle_closed` — it renders the frozen note instead, and hides the dates and the template-locked fields the same server rule freezes). Client rule before save: the sum of active, independent, top-level minimums ≤ totalRequired + 0.001 — the server's `assertCategoryTotalWithinCredential` rule — else the copy-table error on the Total field and in the ErrorSummary; names non-empty and minimums > 0 at a 0.25 step are the inputs' native `required`/`min`/`step` (the existing editor validates natively too, and the copy table carries no sentence for them); duplicate names are not refused — the server keys rows by id, not name, and accepts them. Server refusals (`requirement_in_use`, `activities_outside_cycle`, the category-total 400 = `invalid_request`) render through `describeApiError` as `copy.next` with the raw sentence in the "Technical details" disclosure. (5) **The three modals read the store themselves.** `CredentialEditorModal({ credential, onClose })`, `ConfirmDeleteCredentialModal({ credential, onClose })` and `PersonalTaskEditorModal({ credential, task, onClose })` own their `error: DescribedError | null`, read `pending` from `store.pending`, and call the two store actions this task adds (`saveCredentialEdit`, `savePersonalTask`) plus the existing `deleteCredential` / `archivePersonalTask` — Task 5's `error`/`pending`/`onSave` props and any ModalsHost-local handler go. Their three ModalsHost sites keep the guard's spelling (`{workspace && credentialEditor ? (`, `{credentialDeletion ? (`, `{taskEditor ? (`). (6) **Search fields for the list helper:** name, issuer, profession and jurisdiction — users search by state. (7) `credentialFilters.ts` is born here; Task 9 consumes `filterCredentials`, `CREDENTIAL_FILTER_OPTIONS`, `CredentialFilterState`, `CredentialFilter`. (8) `shell.spec.ts:337-338`: the detail's bar (two-line title plus its wrapped actions) and the log's bar (wrapped action) are each taller than Home's one-line bar; the order between the two is no longer pinned. (9) `packet.spec.ts:11`: the link is "Renewal packet" (the label is the detail's; Task 17 rewrites the rest of that spec). (10) **CSS deletions are grep-gated.** After the rewrite the only alias with no consumer left is `--edge-amber-soft` (verified below); everything else the old file used is still consumed by home/account/history/log-activity/legacy-shared. `.verified-chip`'s three modifier rules and its share of the `.verified-chip, .demo-label` selector go only if `grep -rn 'verified-chip' app/` finds no consumer (Task 6 restyled the setup sheet, which was the other one); the two detail selectors in legacy-shared.css's TABULAR FIGURES list and the one in LEGACY DISPLAY FACE go unconditionally (they name classes that no longer exist). (11) **Clock reads:** one `useMemo` keyed on the `credential` prop (a new object after every refetch) calls `store.nowMs()` once and derives the countdown, the pill/ring states and the set of overdue task ids — never `Date.now()` in render. (12) **The Checklist section is the `#checklist` landmark** (`tabIndex={-1}`); it focuses itself when `store.focusRequest === "checklist"` (Task 8's "Open checklist" row action) and clears the request, deferred through `window.setTimeout(…, 0)`; the store's `restorePersonalTask` stops reaching for `#renewal-checklist` by id and asks for the same focus through `requestFocus("checklist")`. (13) The phone keeps the 72 px ring (`RING_SIZES` is fixed at mount; scaling it by CSS is a documented deviation the plan does not take): at ≤ 820 px the countdown moves under the facts instead. (14) An informational requirement that is neither conditional nor a dental checkpoint has no bar and no answer to give; it is listed in "Rule answers" as "Applies this cycle" with its note, so nothing the catalog defines disappears from the screen.

// `app/lib/credentialFilters.ts` is the search-and-filter vocabulary of the
// Credentials list (Task 9) and the series lookup the credential detail's
// History section uses (`seriesFor`). Pure, so it is tested here against the
// ESM that `npm run build:lib-test` emits, exactly like tests/cycles.test.mjs.
// The clock is always a parameter: `TODAY` is a fixed date, `NOW` a fixed
// local instant, and the due-soon boundary dates are found with
// `daysUntilDate` (tests/instruments.test.mjs's convention) so the cases hold
// in whatever zone the runner starts.
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import { addDaysIso } from "../.test-build/dates.js";
import { DUE_SOON_DAYS } from "../.test-build/instruments.js";
import { daysUntilDate } from "../.test-build/readiness.js";
import {
  CREDENTIAL_FILTER_OPTIONS,

const TODAY = "2026-09-15";
const NOW = Date.parse("2026-09-15T09:00:00");

// The calendar date whose `daysUntilDate` from NOW is exactly `days`, found
// by walking a small window instead of assuming a zone.
function deadlineAtDays(days) {
  for (let offset = days - 2; offset <= days + 2; offset += 1) {
    const candidate = addDaysIso(TODAY, offset);
    if (daysUntilDate(candidate, NOW) === days) return candidate;
  }
  throw new Error(`no calendar date reads ${days} days from NOW`);
}

function credential(overrides = {}) {
  counter += 1;
  return {
    id: `c${counter}`,
    status: "active",
    cycleStart: "2026-01-01",
    deadline: "2027-12-31",

    issuer: "E2E board",

  };
}

const clock = { today: TODAY, nowMs: NOW };

  const alpha = credential({
    credentialName: "Alpha counseling",

    profession: "Nursing",
    jurisdiction: "New Jersey",
  });

  assert.equal(credentialMatchesQuery(alpha, []), true);
  assert.equal(credentialMatchesQuery(alpha, ["island", "alpha"]), true);

  assert.deepEqual(by("due-soon"), ["Due soon"]);

  assert.deepEqual(by("submitted"), ["Submitted"]);

    credentialName: "Renewed only",

  const later = credential({ credentialName: "Later", deadline: addDaysIso(TODAY, 400) });

  assert.equal(listing.series[2].current, null);
  assert.equal(seriesState(listing.series[2], NOW), "none");
  assert.deepEqual(
    names(filterCredentials(list, { query: "", state: "no-cycle" }, clock)),
    ["Renewed only"],
  );
});

  });
  const b = credential({
    credentialName: "Two cycles",
    seriesId: "s",
    cycleStart: "2026-06-01",
    deadline: addDaysIso(TODAY, 300),
    isCurrentCycle: true,
  });
  const listing = filterCredentials([a, b], all(), clock);
  assert.equal(listing.series.length, 1);
  assert.equal(listing.series[0].current?.id, b.id);
});

test("seriesFor returns the one series containing the credential, with the current cycle to link forward to", () => {
  const source = credential({
    credentialName: "E2E custom credential",
    status: "renewed",
    cycleStart: "2026-01-01",
    deadline: "2027-12-31",
    seriesId: "root",
    acceptedAt: "2026-06-15",
  });
  const successor = credential({
    credentialName: "E2E custom credential",
    cycleStart: "2028-01-01",
    deadline: "2029-12-31",
    seriesId: "root",
  });
  const other = credential({ credentialName: "Other" });
  const series = seriesFor([other, source, successor], source, TODAY);
  assert.equal(series.seriesId, "root");
  assert.equal(series.current?.id, successor.id);
  assert.deepEqual(series.previous.map((entry) => entry.id), [source.id]);
  assert.deepEqual(
    series.members.map((entry) => entry.id).sort(),
    [source.id, successor.id].sort(),
  );
  // a credential absent from the list is a series of itself
  const lone = seriesFor([other], source, TODAY);
  assert.equal(lone.current, null);
  assert.deepEqual(lone.previous.map((entry) => entry.id), [source.id]);
});

- [ ] **Step 3: Create `app/lib/credentialFilters.ts` and register it with the test build**

Create `app/lib/credentialFilters.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The credential list vocabulary shared by the Credentials list (Task 9's
 * search box and seven-state filter) and the credential detail's History
 * section (one series per credential, `seriesFor`). Pure on purpose: `today`
 * (YYYY-MM-DD, the store's todayLocal(dateZone)) and `nowMs` are parameters,
 * never read here, and nothing under React or the DOM is imported, so
 * `npm run build:lib-test` compiles it for tests/credential-filters.test.mjs
 * (hence the `.js` suffixes on the sibling imports).
 */
import {
  groupCycles,
  seriesKey,
  type CycleLike,
  type CycleSeries,
} from "./cycles.js";
import { stateOf, type InstrumentState } from "./instruments.js";

export type CredentialFilterState =
  | "all"
  | "overdue"
  | "due-soon"
  | "on-track"
  | "submitted"
  | "no-cycle"
  | "archived";

export const CREDENTIAL_FILTER_OPTIONS: ReadonlyArray<{
  value: CredentialFilterState;
  label: string;
}> = [
  { value: "all", label: "All" },
  { value: "overdue", label: "Overdue" },
  { value: "due-soon", label: "Due soon" },
  { value: "on-track", label: "On track" },
  { value: "submitted", label: "Submitted" },
  { value: "no-cycle", label: "No cycle" },
  { value: "archived", label: "Archived" },
];

export type FilterableCredential = CycleLike & {
  credentialName: string;
  issuer?: string | null;
  profession: string;
  jurisdiction: string;
  archivedAt?: string | null;
  isCurrentCycle?: boolean;
};

export type CredentialFilter = { query: string; state: CredentialFilterState };

export type CredentialListing<T extends FilterableCredential> = {
  series: CycleSeries<T>[];
  total: number;
  archivedShown: boolean;
};

/** Lower-cased, whitespace-split search words; "" and blanks give []. */
export function queryTokens(query: string): string[] {
  return query.trim().toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
}

/**
 * Every token must appear (case-insensitive substring) somewhere in the
 * name, issuer, profession or jurisdiction — users search by state as often
 * as by name. No tokens match everything.
 */
export function credentialMatchesQuery(
  credential: FilterableCredential,
  tokens: readonly string[],
): boolean {
  if (tokens.length === 0) return true;
  const haystack = [
    credential.credentialName,
    credential.issuer ?? "",
    credential.profession,
    credential.jurisdiction,
  ]
    .join(" ")
    .toLowerCase();
  return tokens.every((token) => haystack.includes(token));
}

/** The member a series is listed and searched by: its open cycle, else its newest ended one. */
export function leadMember<T extends FilterableCredential>(
  series: CycleSeries<T>,
): T {
  return series.current ?? series.previous[0] ?? series.members[0];
}

/** The state a series filters under: its open cycle's, or "none" when every cycle is renewed. */
export function seriesState<T extends FilterableCredential>(
  series: CycleSeries<T>,
  nowMs: number,
): InstrumentState {
  return series.current ? stateOf(series.current, nowMs) : "none";
}

/** The server archives a series as one, so the lead member's archivedAt speaks for the series. */
export function isArchivedSeries<T extends FilterableCredential>(
  series: CycleSeries<T>,
): boolean {
  return Boolean(leadMember(series).archivedAt);
}

// groupCycles picks the current cycle by date; when the payload says which
// member is current (`isCurrentCycle`, computed in the stored reminder zone)
// that wins, so the list agrees with Home across a midnight the device and
// stored zones straddle — the same override CredentialsView applies today.
function groupWithServerCurrent<T extends FilterableCredential>(
  list: readonly T[],
  today: string,
): CycleSeries<T>[] {
  return groupCycles(list, today).map((entry) => ({
    ...entry,
    current:
      entry.members.find((member) => member.isCurrentCycle) ?? entry.current,
  }));
}

/**
 * `list` is workspace.credentials + workspace.archivedCredentials. "all" and
 * every cycle state hide archived series (spec §4: archived credentials leave
 * Credentials); "archived" shows only them. "no-cycle" is a series with no
 * open cycle; the other states are the open cycle's `stateOf`. `total` counts
 * the partition (archived or not) before the query and state narrow it.
 */
export function filterCredentials<T extends FilterableCredential>(
  list: readonly T[],
  filter: CredentialFilter,
  clock: { today: string; nowMs: number },
): CredentialListing<T> {
  const archivedShown = filter.state === "archived";
  const partition = groupWithServerCurrent(list, clock.today).filter(
    (entry) => isArchivedSeries(entry) === archivedShown,
  );
  const tokens = queryTokens(filter.query);
  const series = partition.filter((entry) => {
    if (filter.state === "no-cycle" && entry.current !== null) return false;
    if (
      filter.state !== "all" &&
      filter.state !== "archived" &&
      filter.state !== "no-cycle" &&
      seriesState(entry, clock.nowMs) !== filter.state
    ) {
      return false;
    }
    return credentialMatchesQuery(leadMember(entry), tokens);
  });
  return { series, total: partition.length, archivedShown };
}

/**
 * The one series a credential belongs to (by `seriesKey`), for the detail's
 * History: `current` is the open cycle to link forward to from a closed one,
 * `previous` the renewed cycles newest first. A credential absent from `list`
 * is a series of itself.
 */
export function seriesFor<T extends FilterableCredential>(
  list: readonly T[],
  credential: T,
  today: string,
): CycleSeries<T> {
  const key = seriesKey(credential);
  const members = list.filter((entry) => seriesKey(entry) === key);
  return groupWithServerCurrent(members.length ? members : [credential], today)[0];
}
```

```ts
import type { Page } from "@playwright/test";
import { expect, freshIdentity, test } from "./fixtures";

// The credential detail is a routed screen (spec §5.1 Layout): opening one
// pushes an ordinary history entry for /credentials/:id, its header is a
// PageHeader whose eyebrow is a breadcrumb link naming the URL parent
// ("Credentials" — never the tab it was opened from), and Back and Forward
// are the browser's own. Every navigation lands focus on the new screen's H1
// (a11y-03, a11y-M-02). Spec §6: the screen is six named regions — Plan,
// Activities, Checklist, Submission & acceptance, History, Manage credential
// — and carries "Log activity for this credential".
//
// Every test seeds its own credential under one throwaway identity per file:
// the demo workspace on the shared dev D1 is never the fixture for a screen
// that carries writes (edit / archive / delete live in a sibling spec).
test.use({ identity: freshIdentity() });

const SECTIONS = [
  "Plan",
  "Activities",
  "Checklist",
  "Submission & acceptance",
  "History",
  "Manage credential",
] as const;

const uniqueName = (label: string) =>
  `${label} ${Date.now().toString(36)}${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 5)}`;

// The rail sits outside <main>, so "the H1 in main" is the screen's own.
const detailHeading = (page: Page, name: string) =>
  page.getByRole("main").getByRole("heading", { level: 1, name, exact: true });

const breadcrumb = (page: Page) =>
  page.getByRole("main").getByRole("link", { name: "Credentials", exact: true });

const region = (page: Page, name: (typeof SECTIONS)[number]) =>
  page.getByRole("main").getByRole("region", { name, exact: true });

test("a list row opens the detail; the browser back button returns to the list", async ({ page, app }) => {
  const name = uniqueName("E2E detail");
  await app.seedCredential({ credentialName: name });
  await app.goto("/credentials");
  await page
    .getByRole("region", { name: "Your credentials" })
    .getByRole("button", { name })
    .click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/credentials\/[^/]+$/);
  await expect(detailHeading(page, name)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(detailHeading(page, name)).toBeFocused();
  await expect(page).toHaveTitle(`${name} · iTrack`);
  // The breadcrumb names the URL parent; the rail's own Credentials link is
  // outside the main landmark, so this is the only one in it.
  await expect(breadcrumb(page)).toBeVisible();
  await page.goBack();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/credentials$/);
  await expect(
    page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Every renewal, one clear place." }),
  ).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page).toHaveTitle("Credentials · iTrack");
  await expect(page.getByRole("main").getByRole("heading", { level: 1 })).toBeFocused();
  app.expectNoErrors();
});

  const name = uniqueName("E2E deep link");
  const { id } = await app.seedCredential({ credentialName: name });
  await app.goto(`/credentials/${id}`);
  await expect(detailHeading(page, name)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page).toHaveTitle(`${name} · iTrack`);
  // Adopting the URL on mount is not a navigation: the skip link stays the
  // first Tab stop.
  expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.activeElement === document.body)).toBe(true);
  app.expectNoErrors();
});

test("an unknown id falls back to the list and replaces its own entry, so Back leaves the app", async ({ page, app }) => {
  await app.goto("/credentials/nope");
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/credentials$/);
  await expect(
    page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Every renewal, one clear place." }),
  ).toBeVisible();
  // The dead URL was REPLACED, not pushed over: the list is the first entry
  // the app owns, and Back leaves iTrack instead of bouncing again.
  await page.goBack();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL("about:blank");
  app.expectNoErrors();
});

test("Add renewal date to calendar hands off an .ics file and says what was downloaded (app-ux-25)", async ({ page, app }) => {
  const name = uniqueName("E2E calendar");
  const { id } = await app.seedCredential({ credentialName: name });
  await app.goto(`/credentials/${id}`);
  // A headless browser exposes no navigator.share, so
  // app/lib/calendarInvite.ts falls through to the anchor download.
  const download = page.waitForEvent("download");
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Add renewal date to calendar" }).click();
  expect((await download).suggestedFilename()).toMatch(/\.ics$/);
  await expect(
    page
      .getByRole("status")
      .filter({ hasText: "Calendar file downloaded — open it to add the renewal date." }),
  ).toBeVisible();
  app.expectNoErrors();
});

test("switching tabs from a detail is ordinary routing: Back returns to the detail", async ({ page, app }) => {
  const name = uniqueName("E2E tab switch");
  await app.seedCredential({ credentialName: name });
  await app.goto("/credentials");
  await page
    .getByRole("region", { name: "Your credentials" })
    .getByRole("button", { name })
    .click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/credentials\/[^/]+$/);
  await expect(detailHeading(page, name)).toBeVisible();
  await app.tab("Home").click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/^https?:\/\/[^/]+\/$/);
  await expect(page).toHaveTitle("Home · iTrack");
  await expect(app.tab("Home")).toHaveAttribute("aria-current", "page");
  await expect(detailHeading(page, name)).toHaveCount(0);
  // Nothing was unwound: the detail is the previous entry, so Back returns
  // to it, with focus on its heading.
  await page.goBack();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/credentials\/[^/]+$/);
  await expect(detailHeading(page, name)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(detailHeading(page, name)).toBeFocused();
  app.expectNoErrors();
});

test("re-tapping Credentials from a detail returns to the list, and Back returns to the detail", async ({ page, app }) => {
  const name = uniqueName("E2E re-tap");
  await app.seedCredential({ credentialName: name });
  await app.goto("/credentials");
  await page
    .getByRole("region", { name: "Your credentials" })
    .getByRole("button", { name })
    .click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/credentials\/[^/]+$/);
  await expect(detailHeading(page, name)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(app.tab("Credentials")).toHaveAttribute("aria-current", "page");
  await app.tab("Credentials").click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/credentials$/);
  await expect(page).toHaveTitle("Credentials · iTrack");
  await expect(detailHeading(page, name)).toHaveCount(0);
  await expect(
    page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Every renewal, one clear place." }),
  ).toBeVisible();
  // /credentials was pushed over the detail (ordinary routing), so Back
  // returns to the detail rather than leaving the app.
  await page.goBack();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/credentials\/[^/]+$/);
  app.expectNoErrors();
});

test("Record submission opens the submission sheet", async ({ page, app }) => {
  const name = uniqueName("E2E submission");

    .getByRole("region", { name: "Your credentials" })

    .getByRole("button", { name: "Record submission", exact: true })
    .click();
  await expect(app.dialog("Record submission")).toBeVisible();
  app.expectNoErrors();
});

test("the detail is six named regions in order, and Plan carries the requirement bars", async ({ page, app }) => {
  const name = uniqueName("E2E sections");
  const { id } = await app.seedCredential({ credentialName: name });
  // One logged activity so the Activities section lists a row: an empty
  // section renders an EmptyState whose own h2 would join the heading order
  // asserted below.
  await app.seedActivity(id, { title: "E2E sections course" });
  await app.goto(`/credentials/${id}`);
  const main = page.getByRole("main");
  for (const section of SECTIONS) {
    await expect(region(page, section)).toBeVisible();
  }
  expect(await main.getByRole("heading", { level: 2 }).allTextContents()).toEqual([...SECTIONS]);
  // The custom seed's one "General" category is a bar inside Plan.
  await expect(region(page, "Plan").getByRole("progressbar", { name: /General/ })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(region(page, "Activities").getByText("E2E sections course")).toBeVisible();
  await expect(region(page, "Activities")).toContainText("1 logged");
  app.expectNoErrors();
});

test("Log activity for this credential pre-selects it, and Escape returns focus to the button", async ({ page, app }) => {
  const name = uniqueName("E2E preselect");
  const { id } = await app.seedCredential({ credentialName: name });
  await app.seedActivity(id, { title: "E2E detail course" });
  await app.goto(`/credentials/${id}`);
  const activities = region(page, "Activities");
  await expect(activities.getByText("E2E detail course")).toBeVisible();
  // A seeded activity carries no evidence: the row's pill says so in words.
  await expect(activities.locator(".status-pill", { hasText: "Evidence needed" })).toHaveCount(1);
  const opener = page.getByRole("button", { name: "Log activity for this credential" });
  await opener.click();
  // Task 10 renames the sheet; until then the moved body keeps its name.
  const sheet = app.dialog("Log completed learning");
  await expect(sheet).toBeVisible();
  await expect(sheet.locator('select[name="credentialId"]')).toHaveValue(id);
  await page.keyboard.press("Escape");
  await expect(sheet).toHaveCount(0);
  await expect(opener).toBeFocused();
  app.expectNoErrors();
});

test("the checklist adds a personal task and checks it off with Undo", async ({ page, app }) => {
  const name = uniqueName("E2E checklist");
  const { id } = await app.seedCredential({ credentialName: name });
  await app.goto(`/credentials/${id}`);
  const checklist = region(page, "Checklist");
  // A custom credential ships no managed tasks.
  await expect(checklist).toContainText("0 of 0 done");
  await checklist.getByRole("button", { name: "Add task", exact: true }).click();
  const sheet = app.dialog("Add a personal task");
  await expect(sheet).toBeVisible();
  await sheet.locator('input[name="title"]').fill("E2E step");
  await sheet.locator('input[name="dueDate"]').fill("2027-06-30");
  await sheet.getByRole("button", { name: "Add task", exact: true }).click();
  await expect(sheet).toHaveCount(0);
  const step = checklist.getByRole("checkbox", { name: /E2E step/ });
  await expect(step).toBeVisible();
  await expect(step).not.toBeChecked();
  await expect(checklist).toContainText("0 of 1 done");
  // click, not check(): the input is controlled by the refetched workspace,
  // so its state follows the round trip rather than the click.
  await step.click();
  await expect(step).toBeChecked();
  await expect(checklist).toContainText("1 of 1 done");
  const toast = page.getByRole("status").filter({ hasText: "Task checked off." });
  await expect(toast).toBeVisible();
  await toast.getByRole("button", { name: "Undo" }).click();
  await expect(step).not.toBeChecked();
  await expect(page.getByRole("status").filter({ hasText: "Change undone." })).toBeVisible();
  app.expectNoErrors();
});

test("History reads No previous cycles for a fresh credential", async ({ page, app }) => {
  const { id } = await app.seedCredential({ credentialName: uniqueName("E2E history") });
  await app.goto(`/credentials/${id}`);
  await expect(region(page, "History")).toContainText("No previous cycles.");
  app.expectNoErrors();
});

  // replace-set (app/api/workspace/route.ts credentialCategoryDraftsFromPayload):
  // present only when a row was added, removed, renamed or re-valued.
  categories?: CategoryDraftInput[];
};

// One row of updateCredential's `categories` replace-set. A `requirementId`
// updates the existing requirement in place; a row without one is inserted
// (and the requirement it replaced is deleted — 409 requirement_in_use when
// credits are logged against it). Absent enum fields reset to the server's
// defaults, so an editor echoes every field of an untouched row.
export type CategoryDraftInput = {
  requirementId?: string;
  name: string;
  requiredUnits: number;
  kind: "minimum" | "maximum" | "informational";
  relation: "independent" | "nested" | "overlapping";
  parentRequirementId?: string;
  applicability: "always" | "conditional" | "optional";
  applicabilityStatus?: "applies" | "not_applicable" | "needs_confirmation";
  conditionNote?: string;
  exclusiveGroup?: string;
};
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { Button } from "../../components/Button";
import { CreditBar } from "../../components/instruments/CreditBar";
import { StatusPill } from "../../components/instruments/StatusPill";
import { requirementRawEarned } from "../../lib/activityRules";
import { compactNumber } from "../../lib/format";
import type { InstrumentState } from "../../lib/instruments";
import { requirementKind } from "../../lib/readiness";
import type { Requirement } from "../../lib/workspaceTypes";

export type RequirementRowProps = {
  name: string;
  earned: number;
  required: number;
  unit: string;
  state: InstrumentState;
  requirement?: Requirement;
  // The quiet "Doesn’t apply this cycle?" link a conditional rule that applies
  // carries; absent when the detail is frozen or the rule is unconditional.
  onNotApplicable?: () => void;
};

/*
 * One requirement bar: a minimum row fills toward its required units and reads
 * "Minimum met" once counted reaches required (CreditBar decides that itself for
 * an uncapped bar); a maximum row keeps the neutral state its cap implies and
 * reads "Within limit" or "{n} over limit" from the server's excess figure.
 */
export function RequirementRow({
  name,
  earned,
  required,
  unit,
  state,
  requirement,
  onNotApplicable,
}: RequirementRowProps) {
  const kind = requirement ? requirementKind(requirement) : "minimum";
  const rawEarned = requirement ? requirementRawEarned(requirement) : earned;
  const excess = requirement
    ? Number(
        requirement.excessUnits ??
          (kind === "maximum" ? Math.max(0, rawEarned - required) : 0),
      )
    : 0;
  const nested = requirement?.relation === "nested";
  const met = kind === "maximum" ? excess === 0 : earned >= required;
  return (
    <div className="progress-row" data-nested={nested || undefined} data-kind={kind}>
      <div className="progress-label">
        <span>
          <strong>{name}</strong>
          {kind === "maximum" ? (
            excess > 0 ? (
              <StatusPill state="overdue">{compactNumber(excess)} over limit</StatusPill>
            ) : (
              <StatusPill state="none">Within limit</StatusPill>
            )
          ) : met ? (
            <StatusPill state="complete">Minimum met</StatusPill>
          ) : null}
        </span>
        <span className="progress-figure">
          <strong>
            {kind === "maximum"
              ? `${compactNumber(rawEarned)} of ${compactNumber(required)} max`
              : `${compactNumber(earned)} / ${compactNumber(required)}`}
          </strong>{" "}
          {unit}
        </span>
      </div>
      <CreditBar
        counted={rawEarned}
        required={required}
        cap={kind === "maximum" ? required : undefined}
        state={kind === "maximum" ? "none" : state}
        label={`${name}: ${compactNumber(rawEarned)} of ${compactNumber(required)} ${unit}${
          kind === "maximum" ? " maximum" : ""
        }`}
      />
      {kind === "maximum" && excess > 0 ? (
        <p className="plan-note plan-note-excess">
          {compactNumber(earned)} {unit} count toward this limit;{" "}
          {compactNumber(excess)} are preserved but excluded.
        </p>
      ) : onNotApplicable ? (
        <Button
          variant="quiet"
          size="sm"
          className="progress-row-condition"
          onClick={onNotApplicable}
        >
          Doesn’t apply this cycle?
        </Button>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```
