```tsx
"use client";

import type { FormEvent } from "react";
import { Button } from "../../components/Button";
import { Field, TextInput } from "../../components/Form";
import type { Requirement } from "../../lib/workspaceTypes";

export function DentalCheckpointForm({
  requirement,
  disabled,
  pending,
  onSave,
  onReopen,
}: {
  requirement: Requirement;
  disabled: boolean;
  pending: boolean;
  onSave: (evidenceNote: string) => void;
  onReopen: () => void;
}) {
  const completed = requirement.checkpointStatus === "completed";
  const handleSubmit = (event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    // Button expresses pending as aria-disabled, which does not stop Enter in
    // the text field from submitting; the guard lives here.
    if (pending || disabled) return;
    const form = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
    onSave(String(form.get("checkpointEvidenceNote") ?? "").trim());
  };
  return (
    <form className="checkpoint-form" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
      <Field label="Evidence or official-record reference">
        <TextInput
          key={`${requirement.id}:${requirement.checkpointRevision ?? 0}`}
          name="checkpointEvidenceNote"
          maxLength={500}
          required
          defaultValue={requirement.checkpointEvidenceNote ?? ""}
          placeholder="Certificate, CPR card, portal, or assessment reference"
          disabled={disabled}
        />
      </Field>
      <div className="plan-answer-actions">
        <Button
          type="submit"
          size="sm"
          variant="primary"
          disabled={disabled}
          pending={pending}
          pendingLabel="Saving…"
        >
          {completed ? "Update reference" : "Mark complete"}
        </Button>
        {completed ? (
          <Button size="sm" variant="quiet" disabled={disabled} pending={pending} onClick={onReopen}>
            Reopen
          </Button>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
```

Names and minimums only (decision 4). Each row keeps every stored field it does not show; the minimum is held as the text the number input types (a controlled number input cannot hold "0." as a number), and the modal converts it on save.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useRef } from "react";
import { Button } from "../../components/Button";
import { Field, TextInput } from "../../components/Form";
import type { CategoryDraftInput } from "../../lib/workspaceTypes";

// One editor row: the draft the server takes plus what the editor needs — a
// stable React key, the credits already logged against the requirement (a row
// with credits cannot be removed: the server answers 409 requirement_in_use),
// and the minimum as the text the input holds while it is typed.
export type CategoryRow = Omit<CategoryDraftInput, "requiredUnits"> & {
  key: string;
  earned: number;
  units: string;
};

// credentialCategoryDraftsFromPayload: "categories must be an array of up to 30 items".
export const CATEGORY_ROW_LIMIT = 30;

export function CategoriesEditor({
  rows,
  unitLabel,
  disabled,
  onChange,
}: {
  rows: CategoryRow[];
  unitLabel: string;
  disabled: boolean;
  onChange: (rows: CategoryRow[]) => void;
}) {
  const added = useRef(0);
  const update = (key: string, patch: Partial<CategoryRow>) =>
    onChange(rows.map((row) => (row.key === key ? { ...row, ...patch } : row)));
  return (
    <fieldset className="category-editor" disabled={disabled}>
      <legend>Requirements</legend>
      {rows.map((row) => (
        <div className="category-editor-row" key={row.key}>
          <Field label="Requirement name">
            <TextInput
              name={`category-${row.key}-name`}
              value={row.name}
              maxLength={100}
              required
              onChange={(event) => {
                const name = event.currentTarget.value;
                update(row.key, { name });
              }}
            />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Minimum" hint={unitLabel}>
            <TextInput
              name={`category-${row.key}-units`}
              type="number"
              inputMode="decimal"
              min="0.25"
              step="0.25"
              required
              className="field-control-mono"
              value={row.units}
              onChange={(event) => {
                const units = event.currentTarget.value;
                update(row.key, { units });
              }}
            />
          </Field>
          <div className="category-editor-remove">
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="quiet"
              aria-label={`Remove ${row.name}`}
              disabled={row.earned > 0}
              onClick={() => onChange(rows.filter((entry) => entry.key !== row.key))}
            >
              Remove
            </Button>
            {row.earned > 0 ? <small className="field-hint">Has logged credits</small> : null}
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
      <Button
        size="sm"
        disabled={rows.length >= CATEGORY_ROW_LIMIT}
        onClick={() => {
          added.current += 1;
          onChange([
            ...rows,
            {
              key: `new-${added.current}`,
              name: "",
              units: "",
              kind: "minimum",
              relation: "independent",
              applicability: "always",
              earned: 0,
            },
          ]);
        }}
      >
        Add requirement
      </Button>
    </fieldset>
  );
}
```

Create the screen. Everything it needs comes from `useWorkspace()`; the only prop is the credential the root resolved (from `credentials` or `archivedCredentials`).

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useId, useMemo, useRef, type MouseEvent } from "react";
import { Button } from "../components/Button";
import { EmptyState } from "../components/EmptyState";
import { Checkbox } from "../components/Form";
import { Icon } from "../components/Icon";
import { CycleRing } from "../components/instruments/CycleRing";
import { StatusPill } from "../components/instruments/StatusPill";
import { isPlainLeftClick } from "../components/NavItem";
import { PageHeader } from "../components/PageHeader";
import {
  credentialActionKey,
  requirementActionKey,
  taskActionKey,
} from "../lib/actionKeys";
import { allocationsFor } from "../lib/activityRules";
import { seriesFor } from "../lib/credentialFilters";
import {
  isCompliancePeriodCredential,
  isIsc2AutomaticRenewalCredential,
  isNremtCredential,
  ruleReviewLabel,
  ruleReviewState,
} from "../lib/credentialRules";
import { isClosedCycle, isOpenCycle } from "../lib/cycles";
import {
  compactNumber,
  credentialCountdown,
  credentialRingState,
  formatDate,
} from "../lib/format";
import { STATE_LABELS, ringValueOf, stateOf } from "../lib/instruments";
import {
  credentialProgress,
  daysUntilDate,
  requirementEarned,
  requirementKind,
  requirementStatus,
} from "../lib/readiness";
import { useWorkspace } from "../lib/workspaceStore";
import type {
  Activity,
  ActivityAllocation,
  Credential,
  Requirement,
} from "../lib/workspaceTypes";
import { DentalCheckpointForm } from "./credentialDetail/DentalCheckpointForm";
import { RequirementRow } from "./credentialDetail/RequirementRow";
import { useCalendarActions } from "./hooks/useCalendarActions";

type ActivityRow = { activity: Activity; allocation: ActivityAllocation };

// A conditional rule, a dental checkpoint or an informational requirement is
// answered in the "Rule answers" list rather than drawn as a bar.
function isAnswerable(requirement: Requirement): boolean {
  return (
    (requirement.applicability ?? "always") !== "always" ||
    requirement.isDentalCheckpoint === true ||
    requirementKind(requirement) === "informational"
  );
}

function answerWord(requirement: Requirement): string {
  const status = requirementStatus(requirement);
  const word =
    status === "applies"
      ? "Applies this cycle"
      : status === "not_applicable"
        ? "Not this cycle"
        : "Needs your answer";
  if (!requirement.isDentalCheckpoint) return word;
  return `${word} · ${
    requirement.checkpointStatus === "completed"
      ? "completion documented"
      : "completion required"
  }`;
}

function compareNewestFirst(a: ActivityRow, b: ActivityRow): number {
  const left = a.activity.completionDate;
  const right = b.activity.completionDate;
  return left < right ? 1 : left > right ? -1 : 0;
}

const EVIDENCE_PILL = {
  attached: { state: "complete", word: "Evidence attached" },
  missing: { state: "due-soon", word: "Evidence needed" },
  not_required: { state: "none", word: "No evidence needed" },
} as const;

/*
 * Spec §6 "Credential detail": six named regions in this order — Plan,
 * Activities, Checklist, Submission & acceptance, History, Manage credential.
 * The one client-side freeze is `frozen`: archived, closed or offline, every
 * write control is natively disabled (it cannot act); `pending` is only ever
 * an in-flight write. An archived credential stays on its URL as a read-only
 * record with Restore in the header (decision 2).
 */
export function CredentialDetail({ credential }: { credential: Credential }) {
  const store = useWorkspace();
  const calendar = useCalendarActions(store);
  const ids = useId();
  const checklistRef = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const { workspace, focusRequest, requestFocus, nowMs: readNowMs } = store;
  const today = store.today();

  // One clock read per workspace change, outside render (react-hooks/purity):
  // the countdown, the pill and ring states and the overdue task marks all
  // derive from it. `credential` is a new object after every refetch.
  const clock = useMemo(() => {
    const nowMs = readNowMs();
    return {
      countdown: credentialCountdown(credential, nowMs),
      state: stateOf(credential, nowMs),
      ringState: credentialRingState(credential, nowMs),
      overdueTaskIds: new Set(
        credential.tasks
          .filter(
            (task) =>
              task.status !== "completed" &&
              typeof task.dueDate === "string" &&
              task.dueDate !== "" &&
              daysUntilDate(task.dueDate, nowMs) < 0,
          )
          .map((task) => task.id),
      ),
    };
  }, [credential, readNowMs]);

  // Every activity allocated to this credential, newest first (app-ux-10).
  const activityList = workspace?.activities;
  const rows = useMemo<ActivityRow[]>(
    () =>
      (activityList ?? [])
        .flatMap((activity) =>
          allocationsFor(activity)
            .filter((allocation) => allocation.credentialId === credential.id)
            .map((allocation) => ({ activity, allocation })),
        )
        .sort(compareNewestFirst),
    [activityList, credential.id],
  );

  // The series this cycle belongs to, across live and archived credentials.
  const credentialList = workspace?.credentials;
  const archivedList = workspace?.archivedCredentials;
  const series = useMemo(
    () =>
      seriesFor(
        [...(credentialList ?? []), ...(archivedList ?? [])],
        credential,
        today,
      ),
    [archivedList, credential, credentialList, today],
  );

  // Home's "Open checklist" lands here: the section takes focus once and the
  // request is cleared, deferred so no state is set inside the effect itself.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (focusRequest !== "checklist") return;
    const id = window.setTimeout(() => {
      checklistRef.current?.focus();
      requestFocus(null);
    }, 0);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(id);
  }, [focusRequest, requestFocus]);

  if (!workspace) return null;

  const archived = Boolean(credential.archivedAt);
  const open = isOpenCycle(credential);
  const closed = isClosedCycle(credential);
  const isOnline = store.isOnline;
  const frozen = archived || !open || !isOnline;
  const busy = store.pending.isPending(credentialActionKey(credential.id));
  const compliance = isCompliancePeriodCredential(credential);
  const isc2 = isIsc2AutomaticRenewalCredential(credential);
  const dateWord = compliance ? "compliance" : "renewal";
  const ring = ringValueOf(credential);
  const remaining = Math.max(0, credential.totalRequired - credential.totalEarned);
  const requirementRows = credential.requirements.filter(
    (requirement) =>
      requirementStatus(requirement) === "applies" &&
      requirementKind(requirement) !== "informational",
  );
  const answerable = credential.requirements.filter(isAnswerable);
  const evidenceNeeded = rows.filter(
    ({ activity }) =>
      activity.evidenceStatus === "missing" ||
      Number(activity.evidenceDeletionPendingCount ?? 0) > 0,
  ).length;
  const requirementsShort = Math.max(
    Number(credential.totalRemaining ?? 0) > 0 ? 1 : 0,
    credential.requirements.filter(
      (requirement) =>
        requirementStatus(requirement) === "needs_confirmation" ||
        (requirement.isActive !== false &&
          requirementKind(requirement) === "minimum" &&
          requirementStatus(requirement) !== "not_applicable" &&
          Math.max(0, requirement.requiredUnits - requirementEarned(requirement)) > 0),
    ).length,
  );
  const toCategorize = credential.classificationIssues?.length ?? 0;
  const openTasks = credential.tasks.filter((task) => task.status !== "completed").length;
  const done = credential.tasks.length - openTasks;
  const previous = series.previous.filter((cycle) => cycle.id !== credential.id);

  // A real link the client router intercepts (isPlainLeftClick → useNavigation),
  // exactly like NavItem's tabs; a modified click is the browser's.
  const openDetailLink =
    (id: string) => (event: MouseEvent<HTMLAnchorElement>) => {
      if (!isPlainLeftClick(event)) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      store.openCredentialDetail(id);
    };

  return (
    <div className="credential-detail" data-archived={archived || undefined}>
      <PageHeader
        eyebrow={
          // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-html-link-for-pages -- client-side navigation is already provided by useNavigation
          <a
            href="/credentials"
            onClick={(event) => {
              if (!isPlainLeftClick(event)) return;
              event.preventDefault();
              store.nav.setTab("credentials");
            }}
          >
            Credentials
          </a>
        }
        title={credential.credentialName}
        lede={`${credential.jurisdiction}${credential.issuer ? ` · ${credential.issuer}` : ""}`}
        actions={
          <>
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              icon={<Icon name="plus" size={16} />}
              disabled={frozen}
              onClick={() =>
                store.modals.open({ kind: "logActivity", preselectCredentialId: credential.id })
              }
            >
              Log activity for this credential
            </Button>
            {archived ? (
              <Button
                variant="secondary"
                disabled={!isOnline}
                pending={busy}
                onClick={() => void store.actions.restoreCredential(credential)}
              >
                Restore
              </Button>
            ) : (
              <Button
                variant="secondary"
                icon={<Icon name="edit" size={16} />}
                disabled={!isOnline || !open}
                onClick={() => store.modals.open({ kind: "editCredential", credential })}
              >
                Edit credential
              </Button>
            )}
          </>
        }
      />
      {archived ? (
        <p className="detail-archived-note" role="status">
          Archived {formatDate(credential.archivedAt)}. Restore it to log activity or change its
          plan.
        </p>
      ) : null}

      {/* 1 · Plan */}
      <section className="detail-section" aria-labelledby={`${ids}-plan`}>
        <div className="detail-section-heading">
          <h2 id={`${ids}-plan`}>Plan</h2>
          {credential.sourceUrl ? (
            <a
              className="btn btn-quiet"
              href={credential.sourceUrl}
              target="_blank"
              rel="noreferrer"
            >
              Open official guidance
              <Icon name="arrowUpRight" size={15} />
              <span className="sr-only"> (opens in a new tab)</span>
            </a>
          ) : null}
        </div>
        <div className="plan-summary">
          <CycleRing
            key={credential.id}
            size={72}
            fraction={ring.fraction}
            percent={ring.percent}
            state={clock.ringState}
            label={
              ring.basis === "credits"
                ? `${credential.credentialName}: ${compactNumber(credential.totalEarned)} of ${compactNumber(credential.totalRequired)} ${credential.unitLabel} counted`
                : `${credential.credentialName}: ${ring.percent}% ready`
            }
            valueText={`${ring.percent}%, ${STATE_LABELS[clock.state].toLowerCase()}`}
          />
          <dl className="plan-summary-facts">
            <div>
              <dt>Status</dt>
              <dd>
                {archived ? (
                  <StatusPill state="none">Archived</StatusPill>
                ) : (
                  <StatusPill state={clock.state} />
                )}
              </dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt>{compliance ? "Complete by" : "Renew by"}</dt>
              <dd>
                <strong>{formatDate(credential.deadline)}</strong>
              </dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt>Credits</dt>
              <dd>
                {credential.totalRequired > 0 ? (
                  <>
                    <strong>
                      {compactNumber(credential.totalEarned)} of{" "}
                      {compactNumber(credential.totalRequired)} {credential.unitLabel}
                    </strong>
                    {remaining > 0 ? <span> · {compactNumber(remaining)} still needed</span> : null}
                  </>
                ) : (
                  "No credit total"
                )}
              </dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt>Rules</dt>
              <dd>
                {credential.ruleReviewStatus === "custom" ? (
                  "Custom requirements · entered manually"
                ) : (
                  <StatusPill state={ruleReviewState(credential.ruleReviewStatus)}>
                    {ruleReviewLabel(credential.ruleReviewStatus)}
                  </StatusPill>
                )}
                {credential.sourceTitle ? <small>{credential.sourceTitle}</small> : null}
              </dd>
            </div>
          </dl>
          <div className="plan-countdown">
            {clock.countdown.kind === "closed" ? (
              <>
                <small className="eyebrow">Cycle ended</small>
                <strong className="plan-countdown-date">{formatDate(credential.deadline)}</strong>
                <span>Renewed {formatDate(clock.countdown.acceptedAt)}</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <strong>{Math.abs(clock.countdown.days)}</strong>
                <small className="eyebrow">
                  {clock.countdown.kind === "overdue"
                    ? Math.abs(clock.countdown.days) === 1
                      ? "day overdue"
                      : "days overdue"
                    : clock.countdown.days === 1
                      ? "day left"
                      : "days left"}
                </small>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
        {open && !archived ? (
          <div className="plan-actions">
            <Button
              variant="quiet"
              icon={<Icon name="clock" size={15} />}
              onClick={() => {
                store.nav.setTab("profile");
                store.requestFocus("reminders");
              }}
            >
              Check-in settings
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="quiet"
              icon={<Icon name="plus" size={15} />}
              onClick={() => void calendar.addCredentialToCalendar(credential)}
            >
              Add {dateWord} date to calendar
            </Button>
          </div>
        ) : null}
        <div className="plan-requirements">
          {credential.totalRequired > 0 ? (
            <RequirementRow
              name="Overall"
              earned={credential.totalEarned}
              required={credential.totalRequired}
              unit={credential.unitLabel}
              state={clock.state}
            />
          ) : (
            <p className="plan-note">
              No general credit total: complete the training conditions and the checklist from
              the official record.
            </p>
          )}
          {Number(credential.totalExcessUnits ?? 0) > 0 ? (
            <p className="plan-note plan-note-excess">
              {compactNumber(credential.totalRawEarned ?? 0)} {credential.unitLabel} are
              documented; {compactNumber(credential.totalExcessUnits ?? 0)} exceed a category
              limit.
            </p>
          ) : null}
          {Number(credential.unclassifiedUnits ?? 0) > 0 ? (
            <p className="plan-note plan-note-excess">
              {compactNumber(credential.unclassifiedUnits ?? 0)} {credential.unitLabel} are kept
              but not counted until their activity type is categorized.
            </p>
          ) : null}
          {requirementRows.map((requirement) => (
            <RequirementRow
              key={requirement.id}
              name={requirement.name}
              earned={requirementEarned(requirement)}
              required={requirement.requiredUnits}
              unit={credential.unitLabel}
              state={clock.state}
              requirement={requirement}
              onNotApplicable={
                requirement.applicability === "conditional" && !frozen
                  ? () =>
                      void store.actions.setRequirementApplicability(
                        credential.id,
                        requirement,
                        "not_applicable",
                      )
                  : undefined
              }
            />
          ))}
        </div>
        {answerable.length ? (
          <>
            <h3 id={`${ids}-answers`}>Rule answers</h3>
            <dl className="plan-answers" aria-labelledby={`${ids}-answers`}>
              {answerable.map((requirement) => {
                const status = requirementStatus(requirement);
                const saving = store.pending.isPending(requirementActionKey(requirement.id));
                const conditional = requirement.applicability === "conditional";
                const dental = requirement.isDentalCheckpoint === true;
                const checkpointEditable = dental && status === "applies" && open && !archived;
                return (
                  <div key={requirement.id} data-answer={status} aria-busy={saving || undefined}>
                    <dt>{requirement.name}</dt>
                    <dd>
                      <span className="plan-answer-state">{answerWord(requirement)}</span>
                      {requirement.conditionNote ? (
                        <span className="plan-answer-note">{requirement.conditionNote}</span>
                      ) : null}
                      {dental && !checkpointEditable && requirement.checkpointEvidenceNote ? (
                        <span className="plan-answer-note">
                          Reference: {requirement.checkpointEvidenceNote}
                        </span>
                      ) : null}
                      {dental && !checkpointEditable && requirement.checkpointCompletedAt ? (
                        <span className="plan-answer-note">
                          Completed {formatDate(requirement.checkpointCompletedAt)}
                        </span>
                      ) : null}
                      {conditional || checkpointEditable ? (
                        <div className="plan-answer-actions">
                          {conditional && status !== "applies" ? (
                            <Button
                              size="sm"
                              disabled={frozen}
                              pending={saving}
                              pendingLabel="Saving…"
                              onClick={() =>
                                void store.actions.setRequirementApplicability(
                                  credential.id,
                                  requirement,
                                  "applies",
                                )
                              }
                            >
                              {status === "not_applicable" ? "Add to plan" : "Applies"}
                            </Button>
                          ) : null}
                          {conditional && status !== "not_applicable" ? (
                            <Button
                              size="sm"
                              variant="quiet"
                              disabled={frozen}
                              pending={saving}
                              pendingLabel="Saving…"
                              onClick={() =>
                                void store.actions.setRequirementApplicability(
                                  credential.id,
                                  requirement,
                                  "not_applicable",
                                )
                              }
                            >
                              Not this cycle
                            </Button>
                          ) : null}
                          {checkpointEditable ? (
                            <DentalCheckpointForm
                              requirement={requirement}
                              disabled={frozen}
                              pending={saving}
                              onSave={(evidenceNote) =>
                                void store.actions.saveDentalCheckpoint(
                                  credential.id,
                                  requirement,
                                  true,
                                  evidenceNote,
                                )
                              }
                              onReopen={() =>
                                void store.actions.saveDentalCheckpoint(
                                  credential.id,
                                  requirement,
                                  false,
                                  requirement.checkpointEvidenceNote ?? "",
                                )
                              }
                            />
                          ) : null}
                        </div>
                      ) : null}
                    </dd>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </dl>
          </>
        ) : null}
      </section>

      {/* 2 · Activities (app-ux-10) */}
      <section className="detail-section" aria-labelledby={`${ids}-activities`}>
        <div className="detail-section-heading">
          <h2 id={`${ids}-activities`}>Activities</h2>
          <span className="detail-section-count">{rows.length} logged</span>
        </div>
        {rows.length ? (
          <ul className="activity-list">
            {rows.map(({ activity, allocation }) => {
              const categories = allocation.categoryNames?.length
                ? allocation.categoryNames.join(" · ")
                : (allocation.categoryName ?? "");
              const evidence = EVIDENCE_PILL[activity.evidenceStatus];
              return (
                <li className="activity-row" key={`${activity.id}:${allocation.id}`}>
                  <div className="activity-row-text">
                    <strong>{activity.title}</strong>
                    <span>
                      <time dateTime={activity.completionDate}>
                        {formatDate(activity.completionDate)}
                      </time>{" "}
                      ·{" "}
                      <span className="activity-row-units">
                        {compactNumber(allocation.allocatedUnits)} {credential.unitLabel}
                      </span>
                      {categories ? ` · ${categories}` : ""}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="activity-row-actions">
                    <StatusPill state={evidence.state}>{evidence.word}</StatusPill>
                    {allocation.classificationStatus === "needs_classification" ? (
                      <Button
                        size="sm"
                        disabled={frozen}
                        onClick={() => store.modals.open({ kind: "classify", activity, allocation })}
                      >
                        Categorize
                      </Button>
                    ) : null}
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      variant="quiet"
                      aria-label={`Edit ${activity.title}`}
                      disabled={!isOnline}
                      onClick={() => store.modals.open({ kind: "editActivity", activity })}
                    >
                      Edit
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
        ) : (
          <EmptyState
            compact
            title="Nothing logged for this credential yet"
            body="Activities you log for it appear here with their evidence status."
            action={
              frozen
                ? undefined
                : {
                    label: "Log activity",
                    onClick: () =>
                      store.modals.open({
                        kind: "logActivity",
                        preselectCredentialId: credential.id,
                      }),
                  }
            }
          />
        )}
      </section>

      {/* 3 · Checklist (from Home's card) */}
      <section
        className="detail-section"
        id="checklist"
        tabIndex={-1}
        ref={checklistRef}
        aria-labelledby={`${ids}-checklist`}
      >
        <div className="detail-section-heading">
          <h2 id={`${ids}-checklist`}>Checklist</h2>
          <span className="detail-section-count">
            {done} of {credential.tasks.length} done
          </span>
          {open && !archived ? (
            <Button
              size="sm"
              icon={<Icon name="plus" size={15} />}
              disabled={!isOnline}
              onClick={() => store.modals.open({ kind: "task", credential, task: null })}
            >
              Add task
            </Button>
          ) : null}
        </div>
        {isNremtCredential(credential) ? (
          <div className="plan-note">
            <strong>Confirm the status pathway shown in your dashboard</strong>
            <p>
              Active EMR/EMT status uses Training Officer skills verification; Active
              AEMT/Paramedic status uses Medical Director verification. Inactive status still
              requires all CE or RBE requirements. After expiration, use the dashboard’s current
              late reinstatement path and cutoff dates.
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : null}
        <ul className="task-list">
          {credential.tasks.map((task) => {
            const saving = store.pending.isPending(taskActionKey(task.id));
            const overdue = clock.overdueTaskIds.has(task.id);
            return (
              <li
                className="task-row"
                key={task.id}
                data-done={task.status === "completed" || undefined}
                data-overdue={overdue || undefined}
                aria-busy={saving || undefined}
              >
                <Checkbox
                  label={task.title}
                  checked={task.status === "completed"}
                  disabled={frozen || saving}
                  onChange={() => void store.actions.toggleTask(task)}
                  description={
                    task.kind === "evidence"
                      ? `${evidenceNeeded} activities still need evidence`
                      : task.dueDate
                        ? `${overdue ? "Overdue · " : ""}Due ${formatDate(task.dueDate)}`
                        : task.isPersonal
                          ? "Personal task · no due date"
                          : undefined
                  }
                />
                {task.isPersonal && open && !archived ? (
                  <Button
                    size="sm"
                    variant="quiet"
                    aria-label={`Edit ${task.title}`}
                    disabled={!isOnline || saving}
                    onClick={() => store.modals.open({ kind: "task", credential, task })}
                  >
                    Edit
                  </Button>
                ) : null}
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
        {(credential.archivedTasks ?? []).length ? (
          <details className="detail-disclosure">
            <summary id="archived-tasks-summary">
              Archived personal tasks <small>{credential.archivedTasks.length}</small>
              <Icon name="chevronDown" size={16} />
            </summary>
            <ul>
              {credential.archivedTasks.map((task) => (
                <li key={task.id}>
                  <div>
                    <strong>{task.title}</strong>
                    <small>{task.dueDate ? `Due ${formatDate(task.dueDate)}` : "No due date"}</small>
                  </div>
                  <Button
                    size="sm"
                    variant="secondary"
                    aria-label={`Restore ${task.title}`}
                    disabled={frozen}
                    pending={store.pending.isPending(taskActionKey(task.id))}
                    pendingLabel="Restoring…"
                    onClick={() => void store.actions.restorePersonalTask(task)}
                  >
                    Restore
                  </Button>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </details>
        ) : null}
      </section>

      {/* 4 · Submission & acceptance */}
      <section className="detail-section" aria-labelledby={`${ids}-submission`}>
        <h2 id={`${ids}-submission`}>Submission &amp; acceptance</h2>
        <div className="submission-panel" data-status={credential.status}>
          {credential.status === "active" ? (
            <>
              <div>
                <strong>Not submitted yet.</strong>
                <p>
                  Record the submission separately from your activities; the packet below is what
                  you send.
                </p>
              </div>
              <Button
                variant="primary"
                disabled={frozen}
                onClick={() =>
                  store.modals.open({ kind: "submission", credentialId: credential.id })
                }
              >
                {isc2
                  ? "Save dashboard checkpoint"
                  : compliance
                    ? "Record compliance"
                    : "Record submission"}
              </Button>
            </>
          ) : credential.status === "submitted" ? (
            <>
              <div>
                <strong>Submitted {formatDate(credential.submittedAt)}</strong>
                <p>
                  {credential.confirmationNumber
                    ? `Confirmation ${credential.confirmationNumber}`
                    : "No confirmation number recorded."}
                </p>
              </div>
              <Button
                variant="primary"
                disabled={frozen}
                onClick={() =>
                  store.modals.open({ kind: "acceptance", credentialId: credential.id })
                }
              >
                {isc2
                  ? "Confirm renewed cycle"
                  : compliance
                    ? "Start next period"
                    : "Record acceptance"}
              </Button>
            </>
          ) : (
            <div>
              <strong>Renewed {formatDate(credential.acceptedAt)}</strong>
              <p>
                {credential.acceptanceReference
                  ? `Reference ${credential.acceptanceReference}`
                  : "This cycle is closed and its record is kept."}
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="packet-row">
          <div>
            <strong>Renewal packet</strong>
            <p>
              A private, print-ready summary of this cycle. Evidence files stay separate and need
              your sign-in.
            </p>
            <p className="packet-gaps">
              {requirementsShort} requirements short · {evidenceNeeded} activities need evidence ·{" "}
              {toCategorize} activities to categorize · {openTasks} checklist steps open
            </p>
          </div>
          {isOnline ? (
            <a
              className="btn btn-secondary"
              href={`/api/export/packet?credentialId=${encodeURIComponent(credential.id)}`}
              target="_blank"
              rel="noopener noreferrer"
            >
              Renewal packet
              <Icon name="arrowUpRight" size={15} />
              <span className="sr-only"> (opens in a new tab)</span>
            </a>
          ) : (
            <Button disabled>Reconnect to open the renewal packet</Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* 5 · History */}
      <section className="detail-section" aria-labelledby={`${ids}-history`}>
        <h2 id={`${ids}-history`}>History</h2>
        {closed && series.current ? (
          <p className="plan-note">
            This cycle is closed and its record is frozen.{" "}
            <a href={`/credentials/${series.current.id}`} onClick={openDetailLink(series.current.id)}>
              Open the current cycle
            </a>
          </p>
        ) : null}
        {previous.length ? (
          <ul className="history-list">
            {previous.map((cycle) => (
              <li key={cycle.id}>
                <a href={`/credentials/${cycle.id}`} onClick={openDetailLink(cycle.id)}>
                  <strong>Renewed {formatDate(cycle.acceptedAt)}</strong>
                  <span>
                    {formatDate(cycle.cycleStart)} – {formatDate(cycle.deadline)} ·{" "}
                    {credentialProgress(cycle)}%
                  </span>
                </a>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        ) : (
          <p className="plan-note">No previous cycles.</p>
        )}
      </section>

      {/* 6 · Manage credential */}
      <section className="detail-section" aria-labelledby={`${ids}-manage`}>
        <h2 id={`${ids}-manage`}>Manage credential</h2>
        <p className="plan-note">
          {archived
            ? "Restoring puts it back on Home and Credentials with every record intact."
            : "Archiving hides this credential from Home and Credentials and keeps every record; restore it any time."}{" "}
          Deleting removes its cycles, checklist and check-ins permanently — the activities you
          logged stay in your Activity log.
        </p>
        <div className="manage-actions">
          {archived ? (
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              disabled={!isOnline}
              pending={busy}
              onClick={() => void store.actions.restoreCredential(credential)}
            >
              Restore credential
            </Button>
          ) : (
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              disabled={!isOnline}
              pending={busy}
              onClick={() => void store.actions.archiveCredential(credential)}
            >
              Archive credential
            </Button>
          )}
          <Button
            variant="destructive"
            disabled={!isOnline}
            onClick={() => store.modals.open({ kind: "deleteCredential", credential })}
          >
            Delete credential…
          </Button>
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { Button } from "../../components/Button";
import {
  Checkbox,
  DateInput,
  ErrorSummary,
  Field,
  TextInput,
  type ErrorSummaryEntry,
} from "../../components/Form";
import { Modal } from "../../components/Modal";
import { useDiscardGuard } from "../../components/useDiscardGuard";
import { credentialActionKey } from "../../lib/actionKeys";
import type { DescribedError } from "../../lib/copy";
import {
  isAbveCredential,
  isCrcCredential,
  isExpandedCertificationCredential,
  isFloridaMentalHealthPhaseCredential,
  isManagedDentalCredential,
  isManagedNursingCredential,
  isManagedPharmacistCredential,
  isNremtCredential,
} from "../../lib/credentialRules";
import { compactNumber } from "../../lib/format";
import { requirementEarned } from "../../lib/readiness";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../lib/workspaceStore";
import type {
  CategoryDraftInput,
  Credential,
  CredentialEditInput,
} from "../../lib/workspaceTypes";
import { CategoriesEditor, type CategoryRow } from "../credentialDetail/CategoriesEditor";

const TOTAL_FIELD_ID = "credential-total-required";

// Every stored field is echoed back: `categories` is a replace-set whose absent
// enum fields reset to their defaults and whose missing requirementId inserts
// a new row (credentialCategoryDraftsFromPayload), so an untouched row travels
// whole.
function seedRows(credential: Credential): CategoryRow[] {
  return credential.requirements.map((requirement) => ({
    key: requirement.id,
    requirementId: requirement.id,
    name: requirement.name,
    units: String(requirement.requiredUnits),
    kind: requirement.kind ?? "minimum",
    relation: requirement.relation ?? "independent",
    parentRequirementId: requirement.parentRequirementId ?? undefined,
    applicability: requirement.applicability ?? "always",
    applicabilityStatus: requirement.applicabilityStatus,
    conditionNote: requirement.conditionNote ?? undefined,
    exclusiveGroup: requirement.exclusiveGroup ?? undefined,
    earned: requirementEarned(requirement),
  }));
}

function toDraft(row: CategoryRow): CategoryDraftInput {
  return {
    ...(row.requirementId ? { requirementId: row.requirementId } : {}),
    name: row.name.trim(),
    requiredUnits: Number(row.units),
    kind: row.kind,
    relation: row.relation,
    ...(row.parentRequirementId ? { parentRequirementId: row.parentRequirementId } : {}),
    applicability: row.applicability,
    ...(row.applicabilityStatus ? { applicabilityStatus: row.applicabilityStatus } : {}),
    ...(row.conditionNote ? { conditionNote: row.conditionNote } : {}),
    ...(row.exclusiveGroup ? { exclusiveGroup: row.exclusiveGroup } : {}),
  };
}

// The server counts active, independent, top-level minimums against the total
// (assertCategoryTotalWithinCredential); the client applies the same rule
// before the request leaves.
function countsTowardTotal(row: CategoryRow): boolean {
  return (
    row.kind === "minimum" &&
    row.relation === "independent" &&
    !row.parentRequirementId &&
    (row.applicabilityStatus ?? "applies") === "applies"
  );
}

function rowsChanged(rows: CategoryRow[], seed: CategoryRow[]): boolean {
  if (rows.length !== seed.length) return true;
  return rows.some((row, index) => {
    const before = seed[index];
    return (
      row.key !== before.key ||
      row.name.trim() !== before.name ||
      Number(row.units) !== Number(before.units)
    );
  });
}

export function CredentialEditorModal({
  credential,
  onClose,
}: {
  credential: Credential;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const store = useWorkspace();
  const custom = credential.ruleReviewStatus === "custom";
  const submitted = credential.status === "submitted";
  // A submitted cycle refuses the presence of every frozen key (dates, the
  // template-locked fields and `categories`) with 409 cycle_closed: only the
  // name and, for a custom plan, the issuer are offered then.
  const editsCategories = custom && credential.status === "active";
  const pending =
    store.pending.form || store.pending.isPending(credentialActionKey(credential.id));
  const [cycleStart, setCycleStart] = useState(credential.cycleStart);
  const [deadline, setDeadline] = useState(credential.deadline);
  const [seed] = useState(() => seedRows(credential));
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<CategoryRow[]>(seed);
  const [totalError, setTotalError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<DescribedError | null>(null);
  const formRef = useRef<HTMLFormElement>(null);
  const { requestClose, prompt, snapshot } = useDiscardGuard({ formRef, onClose });
  useEffect(() => {
    const id = window.setTimeout(snapshot, 0);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(id);
  }, [snapshot]);

  const datesChanged =
    cycleStart !== credential.cycleStart || deadline !== credential.deadline;
  // The setup sheet's attestations, asked the same way and only once a
  // source-linked credential's dates actually change — the server re-runs the
  // template date rules only then.
  const asksOfficialDates =
    !custom &&
    datesChanged &&
    (isNremtCredential(credential) ||
      isFloridaMentalHealthPhaseCredential(credential) ||
      isCrcCredential(credential) ||
      isAbveCredential(credential) ||
      isExpandedCertificationCredential(credential));
  const asksTemplateEligibility =
    !custom &&
    datesChanged &&
    (isManagedPharmacistCredential(credential) ||
      isManagedNursingCredential(credential) ||
      isManagedDentalCredential(credential) ||
      isExpandedCertificationCredential(credential));

  const handleSubmit = async (event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (pending) return;
    const form = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
    const text = (key: string) => String(form.get(key) ?? "").trim();
    const editsPlan = custom && !submitted;
    const totalRequired = editsPlan ? Number(form.get("totalRequired")) : credential.totalRequired;
    const unitLabel = (editsPlan ? text("unitLabel") : "") || credential.unitLabel;
    let categories: CategoryDraftInput[] | undefined;
    if (editsCategories) {
      const sum = rows
        .filter(countsTowardTotal)
        .reduce((total, row) => total + (Number(row.units) || 0), 0);
      if (sum > totalRequired + 0.001) {
        setTotalError(
          `Requirement minimums add up to ${compactNumber(sum)} ${unitLabel}, more than the ${compactNumber(totalRequired)} total.`,
        );
        return;
      }
      if (rowsChanged(rows, seed)) categories = rows.map(toDraft);
    }
    setTotalError(null);
    const input: CredentialEditInput = {
      credentialName: text("credentialName"),
      // A disabled input is absent from FormData; carry the stored issuer so
      // the shape stays whole (saveCredentialEdit drops it for templates).
      issuer: custom ? text("issuer") : (credential.issuer ?? ""),
      cycleStart: submitted ? credential.cycleStart : text("cycleStart"),
      deadline: submitted ? credential.deadline : text("deadline"),
      ...(editsPlan
        ? {
            jurisdiction: text("jurisdiction"),
            profession: text("profession"),
            totalRequired,
            unitLabel: text("unitLabel"),
          }
        : {}),
      officialDatesAttested: form.get("officialDatesAttested") === "on" ? true : undefined,
      templateEligibilityAttested:
        form.get("templateEligibilityAttested") === "on" ? true : undefined,
      ...(categories ? { categories } : {}),
    };
    const result = await store.actions.saveCredentialEdit(credential, input);
    if (result.ok) onClose();
    else setError(result.copy);
  };

  const summary: ErrorSummaryEntry[] = [
    ...(error ? [{ message: error.next }] : []),
    ...(totalError ? [{ fieldId: TOTAL_FIELD_ID, message: totalError }] : []),
  ];

  return (
    <Modal title="Edit credential" onClose={requestClose}>
      <form ref={formRef} className="form-stack" onSubmit={(event) => void handleSubmit(event)}>
        <ErrorSummary
          title={error ? "These changes weren’t saved" : undefined}
          errors={summary}
          detail={error?.detail ?? undefined}
        />
        <Field label="License or professional certification">
          <TextInput
            autoFocus
            name="credentialName"
            defaultValue={credential.credentialName}
            maxLength={180}
            required
          />
        </Field>
        <Field
          label="Issuing organization"
          hint={custom ? undefined : "Source-linked credentials take their issuer from the template."}
        >
          <TextInput
            name="issuer"
            defaultValue={credential.issuer ?? ""}
            maxLength={180}
            disabled={!custom}
          />
        </Field>
        {submitted ? (
          <p className="modal-note">
            This cycle has a logged submission; its dates and requirements are frozen.
          </p>
        ) : (
          <>
            {custom ? (
              <>
                <div className="form-grid">
                  <Field label="Profession">
                    <TextInput
                      name="profession"
                      defaultValue={credential.profession}
                      maxLength={120}
                      required
                    />
                  </Field>
                  <Field label="State or jurisdiction">
                    <TextInput
                      name="jurisdiction"
                      defaultValue={credential.jurisdiction}
                      maxLength={120}
                      required
                    />
                  </Field>
                </div>
                <div className="form-grid">
                  <Field id={TOTAL_FIELD_ID} label="Total required" error={totalError ?? undefined}>
                    <TextInput
                      name="totalRequired"
                      type="number"
                      inputMode="decimal"
                      min="0.25"
                      step="0.25"
                      defaultValue={credential.totalRequired}
                      required
                      className="field-control-mono"
                    />
                  </Field>
                  <Field label="Unit label">
                    <TextInput
                      name="unitLabel"
                      defaultValue={credential.unitLabel}
                      maxLength={40}
                      required
                    />
                  </Field>
                </div>
              </>
            ) : null}
            {asksTemplateEligibility ? (
              <Checkbox
                name="templateEligibilityAttested"
                required
                label={
                  <strong>
                    I confirmed this is a standard full-cycle{" "}
                    {isExpandedCertificationCredential(credential)
                      ? "credential or license maintenance path"
                      : isManagedNursingCredential(credential) ||
                          isManagedDentalCredential(credential)
                        ? "renewal or registration"
                        : "renewal"}
                  </strong>
                }
                description={
                  isExpandedCertificationCredential(credential)
                    ? "The official issuer or regulator record matches this exact credential, status, maintenance path, and the dates below. No initial, shortened, waiver, inactive, retired, reinstatement, synchronized or multi-credential, exam-alternative, or other adjusted variant applies."
                    : credential.ruleSetId === "tx-rn-2026-v1" ||
                        credential.ruleSetId === "tx-lvn-2026-v1"
                      ? "The regulator record matches the dates below, I am using the 20-hour CNE path rather than the certification alternative, and no initial, shortened, inactive, exempt, or other adjusted-status variant applies."
                      : isManagedDentalCredential(credential)
                        ? "The regulator record matches the dates below, and no initial, shortened, inactive, retired, prorated, exempt, or other adjusted-status variant applies."
                        : "The official issuer or regulator record matches the dates below, and no initial, shortened, inactive, prorated, exempt, or other adjusted-status variant applies."
                }
              />
            ) : null}
            <div className="form-grid">
              <Field label="Cycle started">
                <DateInput name="cycleStart" value={cycleStart} onValueChange={setCycleStart} required />
              </Field>
              <Field label="Renewal deadline">
                <DateInput name="deadline" value={deadline} onValueChange={setDeadline} required />
              </Field>
            </div>
            {asksOfficialDates ? (
              <Checkbox
                name="officialDatesAttested"
                required
                label={
                  <strong>
                    {isNremtCredential(credential)
                      ? "I checked my National Registry dashboard"
                      : isFloridaMentalHealthPhaseCredential(credential)
                        ? "I checked my CE Broker period and phase"
                        : isAbveCredential(credential)
                          ? "I checked my ABVE member record"
                          : isCrcCredential(credential)
                            ? "I checked CRCCCONNECT"
                            : "I checked the official credential record"}
                  </strong>
                }
                description={
                  isNremtCredential(credential)
                    ? "It assigns this 2025 NCCP level template, and the cycle start and fixed expiration entered above match the dashboard exactly."
                    : isFloridaMentalHealthPhaseCredential(credential)
                      ? "CE Broker shows this Ethics and Boundaries or Telehealth phase, beginning April 1 of an odd year and ending March 31 two years later."
                      : isAbveCredential(credential)
                        ? "It shows the selected Fellow or Diplomate credential, the year first held in this cycle, and the fixed January 1, 2025 through December 31, 2027 recertification cycle."
                        : isCrcCredential(credential)
                          ? "It shows the CRC certification-period start and valid-through date entered above."
                          : "The issuer, regulator, or official account shows this exact credential or license path, current status, cycle start, and deadline."
                }
              />
            ) : null}
            {editsCategories ? (
              <CategoriesEditor
                rows={rows}
                unitLabel={credential.unitLabel}
                disabled={pending}
                onChange={setRows}
              />
            ) : null}
          </>
        )}
        <div className="form-actions">
          <Button variant="quiet" onClick={requestClose} disabled={pending}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button type="submit" variant="primary" pending={pending} pendingLabel="Saving…">
            Save changes
          </Button>
        </div>
      </form>
      {prompt}
    </Modal>
  );
}
```

Replace `app/screens/modals/ConfirmDeleteCredentialModal.tsx` whole (from `:9086-9172`; the two bullets and "Delete permanently" are verbatim, the eyebrow goes, the switch row becomes a `Checkbox`):

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { Button } from "../../components/Button";
import { Checkbox, ErrorSummary, Field, TextInput } from "../../components/Form";
import { Modal } from "../../components/Modal";
import { credentialActionKey } from "../../lib/actionKeys";
import type { DescribedError } from "../../lib/copy";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../lib/workspaceStore";
import type { Credential } from "../../lib/workspaceTypes";

export function ConfirmDeleteCredentialModal({
  credential,
  onClose,
}: {
  credential: Credential;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const store = useWorkspace();
  const pending =
    store.pending.form || store.pending.isPending(credentialActionKey(credential.id));
  const [value, setValue] = useState("");
  // Checked by default (spec §4: evidence linked only to this credential is
  // deleted); unticking sends deleteOrphanedEvidence: false, the opt-out.
  const [orphans, setOrphans] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<DescribedError | null>(null);
  const matches = value.trim() === credential.credentialName;

  // On success the store navigates to /credentials and closes this site.
  const handleSubmit = async (event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!matches || pending) return;
    const result = await store.actions.deleteCredential(credential, value.trim(), orphans);
    if (!result.ok) setError(result.copy);
  };

  return (
    <Modal title={`Delete ${credential.credentialName}?`} onClose={onClose}>
      <form className="form-stack" onSubmit={(event) => void handleSubmit(event)}>
        <ErrorSummary
          title={`Delete ${credential.credentialName}?`}
          errors={error ? [{ message: error.next }] : []}
          detail={error?.detail ?? undefined}
        />
        <div className="modal-note">
          <p>Removes this credential, every past cycle, its checklist and check-ins.</p>
          <p>Keeps your learning records in the activity log.</p>
        </div>
        <Field label="Type the credential name to confirm">
          <TextInput
            name="confirmName"
            autoComplete="off"
            autoFocus
            value={value}
            onChange={(event) => {
              const next = event.currentTarget.value;
              setValue(next);
            }}
          />
        </Field>
        <Checkbox
          name="deleteOrphanedEvidence"
          checked={orphans}
          onChange={(event) => {
            const checked = event.currentTarget.checked;
            setOrphans(checked);
          }}
          label="Also delete evidence files that belong only to this credential"
        />
        <div className="form-actions">
          <Button variant="quiet" onClick={onClose} disabled={pending}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button type="submit" variant="destructive" pending={pending} disabled={!matches}>
            Delete permanently
          </Button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
}
```

Replace `app/screens/modals/PersonalTaskEditorModal.tsx` whole (from `:9173-9340`; already on the primitives — the three "Packet readiness" strings and the "Today" hint change per copy table D, the legacy `.advisory-note` / `.archive-zone` markup moves to `modals.css` classes and Buttons, and the saves go through the store):

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { Button } from "../../components/Button";
import {
  DateInput,
  ErrorSummary,
  Field,
  TextInput,
  type ErrorSummaryEntry,
} from "../../components/Form";
import { Modal } from "../../components/Modal";
import type { DescribedError } from "../../lib/copy";
import { ISO_DATE_PATTERN } from "../../lib/dates";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../lib/workspaceStore";
import type { Credential, RenewalTask } from "../../lib/workspaceTypes";

export function PersonalTaskEditorModal({
  credential,
  task,
  onClose,
}: {
  credential: Credential;
  task: RenewalTask | null;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const store = useWorkspace();
  const pending = store.pending.form;
  const isOnline = store.isOnline;
  const [confirmingArchive, setConfirmingArchive] = useState(false);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<{ title?: string; dueDate?: string }>({});
  const [error, setError] = useState<DescribedError | null>(null);
  const editing = Boolean(task);

  // Validated here, not by the browser: `noValidate` turns the native bubble
  // off, each problem is written under its field and listed in a focused
  // summary (a11y-09). The due date stays optional — the server accepts an
  // empty one — so its message fires only for a value that is not a
  // calendar date. `pending` is guarded here because Button expresses it as
  // aria-disabled, which does not stop Enter in a text field from submitting.
  const handleSubmit = async (event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (pending) return;
    const form = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
    const title = String(form.get("title") ?? "").trim();
    const dueDate = String(form.get("dueDate") ?? "");
    const next: { title?: string; dueDate?: string } = {};
    if (!title) next.title = "Enter a task name";
    if (dueDate && !ISO_DATE_PATTERN.test(dueDate)) next.dueDate = "Enter a due date";
    setFieldErrors(next);
    if (next.title || next.dueDate) return;
    const result = await store.actions.savePersonalTask(credential, task, { title, dueDate });
    if (result.ok) onClose();
    else setError(result.copy);
  };

  const summary: ErrorSummaryEntry[] = [
    ...(error ? [{ message: error.next }] : []),
    ...(fieldErrors.title ? [{ fieldId: "personal-task-title", message: fieldErrors.title }] : []),
    ...(fieldErrors.dueDate ? [{ fieldId: "personal-task-due", message: fieldErrors.dueDate }] : []),
  ];

  return (
    <Modal
      title={editing ? "Edit personal task" : "Add a personal task"}
      eyebrow={credential.credentialName}
      onClose={onClose}
    >
      <div className="form-stack">
        <p className="modal-note">
          Personal tasks count toward the checklist. Complete or archive them before
          submission. They do not earn XP.
        </p>
        <form className="form-stack" noValidate onSubmit={(event) => void handleSubmit(event)}>
          <Field id="personal-task-title" label="Task" error={fieldErrors.title}>
            <TextInput
              autoFocus
              name="title"
              defaultValue={task?.title ?? ""}
              maxLength={160}
              placeholder="e.g., Request transcript from provider"
              required
            />
          </Field>
          <Field
            id="personal-task-due"
            label="Due date"
            optional
            hint="Due dates appear in Home check-ins when reminders are on."
            error={fieldErrors.dueDate}
          >
            <DateInput name="dueDate" defaultValue={task?.dueDate ?? ""} />
          </Field>
          <ErrorSummary
            title={error ? "This task did not save" : undefined}
            errors={summary}
            detail={error?.detail ?? undefined}
          />
          <div className="form-actions">
            <Button variant="quiet" onClick={onClose}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="submit"
              variant="primary"
              pending={pending}
              pendingLabel="Saving…"
              disabled={!isOnline}
            >
              {!isOnline ? "Reconnect to save" : editing ? "Save changes" : "Add task"}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
        {task?.isPersonal ? (
          <section className="modal-section" aria-labelledby="archive-task-title">
            <div>
              <strong id="archive-task-title">Archive this task</strong>
              <p>Remove it from the checklist and reminders without deleting its history.</p>
            </div>
            {!confirmingArchive ? (
              <Button
                variant="secondary"
                disabled={pending || !isOnline}
                onClick={() => setConfirmingArchive(true)}
              >
                Archive task
              </Button>
            ) : (
              <div className="modal-note-warn" role="alert">
                <p>
                  <strong>Archive this personal task?</strong> This removes it from the checklist
                  and reminders. You can restore it later.
                </p>
                <div className="form-actions">
                  <Button
                    variant="secondary"
                    disabled={pending}
                    onClick={() => setConfirmingArchive(false)}
                  >
                    Keep task
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    autoFocus
                    variant="destructive"
                    pending={pending}
                    pendingLabel="Archiving…"
                    disabled={!isOnline}
                    onClick={() => void store.actions.archivePersonalTask(task)}
                  >
                    Archive task
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </section>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 15: `app/styles/credential-detail.css` — replaced whole, first-class tokens only**

Every colour is a first-class token; no `px` font-size; no transition or animation (the chevron rotates instantly); every ink-on-fill pairing is one tokens.css already claims (`--ink`/`--ink-muted` on `--card`/`--paper`; `--state-overdue` on `--state-overdue-soft`; `--accent` on `--card`). No claim-shaped comment (`N:1 on …`) may appear in a consumer file — the audit must report `0 claims`.

```css
/* Credential detail — app/screens/CredentialDetail.tsx and its parts
 * (credentialDetail/RequirementRow, DentalCheckpointForm, CategoriesEditor).
 * The page header is the PageHeader primitive (shell.css); buttons, fields,
 * checkboxes and the error summary are primitives.css; the pill, ring and bar
 * are instruments.css. First-class tokens only; nothing here moves — no
 * duration of any kind (spec §5.1 Motion). Rewritten in Wave 4 Task 7 on the six-section
 * layout of spec §6 "Credential detail". */

.credential-detail {
  display: grid;
  gap: 22px;
}

.detail-archived-note {
  margin: 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: var(--paper);

  font-size: var(--text-sm);
}

  gap: 16px;

  border-radius: var(--radius-md);

}

.detail-section h2 {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: var(--font-display);

}

/* ===== PLAN ===== */

}

.plan-actions,
.plan-answer-actions,
.manage-actions,
.activity-row-actions {
  display: flex;

}

.plan-requirements {

}

.progress-row {

}

.progress-row[data-nested="true"] {
  margin-left: 16px;
  border-left: 2px solid var(--line);
  padding-left: 12px;
}

.progress-label {
  display: flex;

  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
  color: var(--ink-muted);

}

.progress-label > span:first-child {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;

}

.progress-label strong {
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
}

.progress-figure {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.progress-row-condition {
  justify-self: start;
}

.plan-note {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.plan-note strong {
  color: var(--ink);
}

.plan-note p {
  margin: 4px 0 0;
}

.plan-note a {
  color: var(--accent);
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* The overdue ink on its soft fill — the pair the overdue pill already carries. */
.plan-note-excess {
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: var(--state-overdue-soft);
  color: var(--state-overdue);
  padding: 8px 10px;
}

.plan-answers {
  display: grid;
  gap: 12px;
  margin: 0;
}

.plan-answers > div {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: var(--paper);
  padding: 12px;
}

/* Decorative edge (the mockup's due-soon row edge); the state word carries the meaning. */
.plan-answers > div[data-answer="needs_confirmation"] {
  border-color: var(--edge-due-soon);
}

.plan-answers dt {
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.plan-answers dd {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
}

.plan-answer-state {
  color: var(--ink);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.checkpoint-form {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  width: 100%;
}

/* ===== ACTIVITIES ===== */

.activity-list,
.task-list,
.history-list {
  display: grid;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.activity-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 12px 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.activity-row-text {
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.activity-row-text strong {
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.activity-row-text > span {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
}

.activity-row time,
.activity-row-units {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

/* ===== CHECKLIST ===== */

.task-list {
  gap: 4px;
}

.task-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: 50px;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
}

.task-row .checkbox {
  min-height: var(--tap-min);
}

.task-row[data-done="true"] .checkbox-label {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  text-decoration: line-through;
}

.task-row[data-overdue="true"] .checkbox-description {
  color: var(--state-overdue);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.detail-disclosure > summary {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  min-height: var(--tap-min);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.detail-disclosure > summary small {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: 400;
}

.detail-disclosure[open] > summary .icon {
  transform: rotate(180deg);
}

.detail-disclosure ul {
  display: grid;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.detail-disclosure li {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 8px 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.detail-disclosure li strong,
.detail-disclosure li small {
  display: block;
}

.detail-disclosure li small {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
}

/* ===== SUBMISSION & ACCEPTANCE ===== */

.submission-panel {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  gap: 16px;
  align-items: center;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: var(--paper);
  padding: 16px;
}

.submission-panel strong,
.packet-row strong {
  display: block;
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
}

.submission-panel p,
.packet-row p {
  margin: 2px 0 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
}

.packet-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  gap: 16px;
  align-items: center;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  padding-top: 16px;
}

.packet-gaps {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

/* ===== HISTORY ===== */

.history-list a {
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
  min-height: var(--tap-min);
  padding: 10px 0;
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.history-list a strong {
  color: var(--accent);
}

.history-list a:hover strong {
  text-decoration: underline;
}

.history-list a span {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
}

/* ===== CATEGORIES EDITOR (CredentialEditorModal) ===== */

.category-editor {
  display: grid;
  gap: 12px;
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0;
  border: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

.category-editor > legend {
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.category-editor-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 120px auto;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: end;
}

.category-editor-remove {
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
  justify-items: start;
  padding-bottom: 6px;
}

/* ===== PHONE ===== */

@media (max-width: 820px) {
  .plan-summary {
    grid-template-columns: 72px minmax(0, 1fr);
  }

  .plan-countdown {
    grid-column: 2;
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 8px;
    text-align: left;
  }

  .plan-countdown .eyebrow {
    margin-top: 0;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 540px) {
  .detail-section {
    padding: 18px 16px;
  }

  .activity-row,
  .submission-panel,
  .packet-row,
  .category-editor-row {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .progress-label {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 3px;
  }
}
```

**Gotchas for this task:**
- `Routed.detail` searches `archivedCredentials` from Step 16 on (Task 5 resolved from the open list only — its decision 5); do not add a second resolver inside the screen. The archived presentation is driven by `credential.archivedAt` alone, and the provider's dead-detail effect still replaces an unknown id with `/credentials` (credential-detail.spec's "an unknown id falls back…" pins it).
- The Task 3 server gates are what make the stale-tab test pass: a `toggleTask` against an archived credential answers 409 `credential_archived`, which `run()`'s conflict branch turns into the one error toast and a reload. If that test shows a page banner instead, the code reached `error.page` — the conflict branch must return before it.
- `useMemo` deps must be exact: list the destructured `readNowMs`/`activityList`/`credentialList`/`archivedList`, never the whole `store` beside them, or eslint's exhaustive-deps warns "unnecessary dependency". The clock memo is keyed on the `credential` prop on purpose — a refetch hands the screen a new object, so the countdown and the overdue marks follow every write.
- `Checkbox` rows are controlled by the refetched workspace: an e2e clicks and then `expect(step).toBeChecked()`; `check()` would race the round trip.
- `ErrorSummary` focuses itself when its messages change; the categories total error lands in it with a `fieldId` link to the Total field (`credential-total-required` is an explicit id on the `Field`, forwarded to its input — never an id on the control itself).
- In the delete confirm, `disabled={!matches}` is native (the button cannot act until the name matches) while `pending` stays aria-disabled — the two meanings the design system separates.
- `@next/next/no-html-link-for-pages` fires on a literal `href="/credentials"` (the breadcrumb carries the disable comment the legacy screen had); if `npm run lint` also flags the History links' template hrefs, put the same `{/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-html-link-for-pages -- client-side navigation is already provided by useNavigation */}` line above each `<a` — the links are real and the client router intercepts them.
- Legacy `.progress-row` / `.progress-label` rules still exist in `legacy-shared.css` for Home's ProgressRow; the new file redefines the same two class names with identical declarations and is imported later, so both screens render the same until Task 8 deletes the legacy copy. `.met-label` / `.limit-label` are not reused — the new row speaks through `StatusPill`.
- `getByRole("group", { name: "Requirements" })` resolves the `fieldset` by its `legend`; a `Field` label "Minimum" is unique in the editor, so `getByLabel("Minimum")` never catches "Total required".
- The seeded custom credential (10 hours, one "General" category) is why the e2e edits General to 6 and adds Ethics at 4: the server refuses minimums over the total with the same rule the client applies first, so a sum of 13 would never reach the bars.
- `tests/e2e/forced-colors.spec.ts` reads Home's `.task-row .custom-check` until Task 8 — that is the reason home.css's checklist rules and the `.custom-check` forced-colours block survive this task.
