### Task 8: Home as the binding ledger: ledger.ts, Home.tsx with LedgerRow/AttentionRow, timeline label lanes, Needs attention with Undo, Best next action, first-run card, the fold moment on --duration-fold, home.css rewritten; gamification and checklist leave Home; home.spec rewritten

**Rationale:** spec §6 Home — "Your renewals": all credentials as ledger rows sorted by urgency (overdue, due within 90 days, on track, no cycle), each with `CycleRing`, days to deadline, credits counted/required and one next action; right column `DeadlineTimeline` + "Needs attention" check-ins (with Undo on snooze/dismiss, app-ux-08) + "Best next action"; gamification leaves Home for Account (app-ux-13); a first-run "Add your first credential" card — plus §5.1 Layout ("a two-column ledger on Home: credentials column, timeline + next actions column") and §5.1 Motion's third moment ("closing a cycle: card folds to the ledger row"), which `tokens.css:195` already reserves as `--duration-fold: 360ms` (zeroed under reduced motion at `:295-301`). Mockup A is binding for Home: `docs/design/2026-09-10-mockup-a/home-desktop.html:62` (the grid `minmax(0, 1fr) 380px`, 28px gap), `:19` (a row is `72px minmax(0, 1fr) 132px 200px`, 20px gaps, 18px 20px padding, 12px radius; `:68` the due-soon row edge `#E5C98A` = `--edge-due-soon`), `:74-93` (ring · name + pill · issuer line · 6px bar + mono "5 of 40 credits count · 20 clinical minimum · 5 ethics" · countdown numeral + "days left" eyebrow + mono date · one action + one-line hint), `:126-151` (the submitted row: "Sent" + "13 days ago", "Record acceptance" / "Next cycle opens when accepted"), `:153-155` (the footer "Add a credential · Archived (1)"), `:159-223` (the aside: "Next twelve months" card, "Needs attention" with "Reminder settings" and Snooze / Done, an inline 'Snoozed "…" for 7 days.' + Undo strip, the inverse "Best next action" card with a paper-filled button); `home-phone.html:35-104` (order: Best next action, the credential cards with 56px rings and no per-row button, Needs attention; `:18` the phone card `56px minmax(0,1fr) auto`, 14px). Findings closed here: app-ux-04 (Home never shows a closed cycle with a countdown — a series whose every cycle is renewed is a "no cycle" row with "—", and `ledgerEntries` never picks a renewed cycle as `current`), app-ux-05 (Home is a multi-credential ledger, one row per series), app-ux-08 (Snooze and Done get an Undo toast that restores the check-in through Task 3's `status: "active"`), app-ux-12 (the header's desktop action group carries exactly the rail's labels — "Log activity" — so the side-by-side mismatch is gone; every log entry point on Home says "Log activity"), app-ux-13 (the momentum card `app/ITrackApp.tsx:7024-7198` — "Professional momentum", Level/XP orb, weekly quests, `.momentum-note` — leaves Home with `TodayView`), app-ux-21 (a check-in row is one open button + Snooze + Done, the title clamped to two lines; "Log credits" and "Add to calendar" leave the row — the ledger row logs, calendar stays on the detail and Account), and the Wave 3 reviewer minor "timeline marker-vs-marker label collisions" (`app/lib/instruments.ts:327-381` lays every label at the same y; two deadlines within a label's width overprint — this task adds a second label lane). At main @ `c6b1fe4` Home is `TodayView` (`app/ITrackApp.tsx:6381-7502`, 24 props, mounted at `:4063-4120`), a single-credential dashboard bound to `selectedCredential`: the onboarding hero `:6452-6514`, the greeting header `:6602-6619` (`Good ${dayPart()}, ${first}.` + a `button.desktop-only` "Log completed learning"), the `.renewal-hero` `:6622-6775`, the timeline card `:6777-6798`, the reminder inbox `:6800-6905` (h2 "N timely check-ins", four buttons per row), the next-action card `:6908-6924`, then the `.dashboard-grid` `:6927-7501` (requirements with `ProgressRow`, the momentum card, the checklist, "Recent learning"). Its stylesheet `app/styles/home.css` (1,209 lines) is wholly on legacy aliases (`--ink-surface`, `--on-dark*`, `--wash-amber`, `--font-ui`, `--edge-amber-*` …) and re-scopes the inverse-family aliases on `.renewal-hero` (`:1164-1183`). The footer's "Archived ({n})" → `store.nav.setTab("credentials"); store.requestFocus("archived-filter")` (Task 9 honours it); the footer's "Add a credential" opens the setup dialog.
12. Timeline lanes fix the collision minor in `timelineLayout` (the x maths untouched): markers are walked in date order and a marker whose x is closer to the previous lane-0 marker than that marker's estimated label width (`label.length * 6.2 + 8` plot units) plus an 8-unit gap goes to lane 1. Lane-1 labels are drawn BELOW the tick-label row — name at y 100, date at y 112, the plot 116px tall instead of 92 — not at y 76 as the brief first sketched: y 76 is the quarter tick labels' own baseline (`DeadlineTimeline.tsx:126-133`), so a lane-1 label there would overprint "Dec" / "Mar" / "Jun". The marker circle and its 44px hit stay on the axis in both lanes (a hit moved off the axis would misplace the deadline); the `li` and the SVG label group carry `data-lane`, the plot carries `data-lanes`.
13. `rowAction` is one function: the row's button and the "Best next action" card's button call it for the same credential, so the two never disagree (the e2e asserts they are equal).

The inverse card's paper-filled button (`background: var(--on-inverse); color: var(--inverse-surface)`, hover `--on-inverse-muted`) is a new ink-on-fill pairing; the symmetric claims are added to `tokens.css` in both blocks before the stylesheet uses them (15.5:1 / 9.8:1 light, 14.2:1 / 5.6:1 dark — the same numbers as the existing `--on-inverse` claims, mirrored).
15. In the e2e, a seeded due-soon custom credential first has its overdue managed tasks checked off through `toggleTask` (a custom credential is created with three managed tasks due 120 and 30 days before the deadline and on it — `route.ts:2159-2175` — so a cycle 20 days out already has two overdue steps and `bestNextAction` would point the row at its checklist); that keeps the row's next action the credits it still needs, which is what the pre-selection assertion proves.

//   needing = open rows in state overdue | due-soon with 0 < totalRequired and totalEarned < totalRequired; overdue = rows in state overdue;
//   soonestMonth = formatMonth(<the earliest needing row's deadline>) or null

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing unit test for the ledger module**

Create `tests/ledger.test.mjs` (the `tests/instruments.test.mjs` conventions: `NOW` is a fixed local instant, the 90/91-day boundary is located through `daysUntilDate` so the suite holds in any zone; it imports only `.test-build/`):

```js
// `app/lib/ledger.ts` orders Home's rows (spec §6: overdue, due within 90
// days, on track, then a submitted cycle waiting on its board, then a series
// with no open cycle) and derives the header's lede input. Pure, so it is
// tested against the ESM `npm run build:lib-test` emits, like
// tests/instruments.test.mjs; the clock and today are parameters.
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import { addDaysIso } from "../.test-build/dates.js";
import { DUE_SOON_DAYS } from "../.test-build/instruments.js";
import { daysUntilDate } from "../.test-build/readiness.js";
import {
  URGENCY_ORDER,
  ledgerEntries,
  ledgerLedeInput,
  sortByUrgency,
  urgencyRank,
} from "../.test-build/ledger.js";

// 09:00 local on 2026-09-15 (the instruments suite's instant).
const NOW = Date.parse("2026-09-15T09:00:00");
const TODAY = "2026-09-15";

// The calendar date whose daysUntilDate from NOW is exactly `days` (zone-proof).
function deadlineAtDays(days) {
  for (let offset = days - 2; offset <= days + 2; offset += 1) {
    const candidate = addDaysIso(TODAY, offset);
    if (daysUntilDate(candidate, NOW) === days) return candidate;
  }
  assert.fail(`no calendar date reads ${days} days from NOW`);
}

function cycle(id, status, deadline, extra = {}) {
  return { id, status, cycleStart: "2025-01-01", deadline, ...extra };
}

const MONTHS = [
  "January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June",
  "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December",
];
const monthOf = (iso) => MONTHS[Number(iso.slice(5, 7)) - 1];

test("URGENCY_ORDER ranks overdue, due soon, on track, submitted, complete, none", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(URGENCY_ORDER, ["overdue", "due-soon", "on-track", "submitted", "complete", "none"]);
  assert.equal(urgencyRank("overdue"), 0);
  assert.equal(urgencyRank("none"), 5);
});

test("sortByUrgency orders by state regardless of input order; a submitted cycle with a past deadline ranks submitted, not overdue", () => {
  const onTrack = cycle("on-track", "active", "2028-03-31");
  const submittedPast = cycle("submitted", "submitted", "2026-09-01");
  const overdue = cycle("overdue", "active", "2026-09-01");
  const dueSoon = cycle("due-soon", "active", "2026-11-30");
  const sorted = sortByUrgency([onTrack, submittedPast, overdue, dueSoon], NOW);
  assert.deepEqual(sorted.map((item) => item.id), ["overdue", "due-soon", "on-track", "submitted"]);
});

test("within one state the soonest deadline comes first, ties by cycleStart then id", () => {
  const later = cycle("b", "active", "2026-12-15");
  const sooner = cycle("a", "active", "2026-11-30");
  const sameDeadlineOlderStart = cycle("z", "active", "2026-12-15", { cycleStart: "2024-06-01" });
  const sameEverything = cycle("c", "active", "2026-12-15");
  const sorted = sortByUrgency([later, sameEverything, sooner, sameDeadlineOlderStart], NOW);
  assert.deepEqual(sorted.map((item) => item.id), ["a", "z", "b", "c"]);
});

test("the due-soon boundary is the instruments rule: today and +90 are due soon, +91 is on track", () => {
  assert.equal(daysUntilDate(TODAY, NOW), 1);
  const today = cycle("today", "active", TODAY);
  const at90 = cycle("at90", "active", deadlineAtDays(DUE_SOON_DAYS));
  const at91 = cycle("at91", "active", deadlineAtDays(DUE_SOON_DAYS + 1));
  const sorted = sortByUrgency([at91, at90, today], NOW);
  assert.deepEqual(sorted.map((item) => item.id), ["today", "at90", "at91"]);
  const entries = ledgerEntries([at91, at90, today], TODAY, NOW);
  assert.deepEqual(entries.map((entry) => entry.state), ["due-soon", "due-soon", "on-track"]);
});

test("ledgerEntries: every open row first, then one none-row per series with no open cycle, latest = its newest-ended cycle", () => {
  const open = cycle("open", "active", "2027-06-30", { seriesId: "s-open" });
  const renewedOld = cycle("r1", "renewed", "2024-12-31", { seriesId: "s-history", acceptedAt: "2025-01-10" });
  const renewedNew = cycle("r2", "renewed", "2025-12-31", { seriesId: "s-history", acceptedAt: "2026-01-05" });
  const entries = ledgerEntries([renewedOld, open, renewedNew], TODAY, NOW);
  assert.deepEqual(
    entries.map(({ seriesId, current, latest, state }) => ({ seriesId, current: current?.id ?? null, latest: latest.id, state })),
    [
      { seriesId: "s-open", current: "open", latest: "open", state: "on-track" },
      { seriesId: "s-history", current: null, latest: "r2", state: "none" },
    ],
  );
});

test("ledgerEntries: a renewed cycle with an open successor yields only the successor", () => {
  const renewed = cycle("old", "renewed", "2025-12-31", { seriesId: "s", acceptedAt: "2026-01-05" });
  const successor = cycle("new", "active", "2027-12-31", { seriesId: "s", cycleStart: "2026-01-01" });
  const entries = ledgerEntries([renewed, successor], TODAY, NOW);
  assert.deepEqual(entries.map((entry) => [entry.seriesId, entry.current?.id, entry.latest.id, entry.state]), [
    ["s", "new", "new", "on-track"],
  ]);
});

test("sorting is pure and stable: the input is untouched and a second pass is the same order", () => {

  assert.deepEqual(once.map((item) => item.id), twice.map((item) => item.id));

});

- [ ] **Step 3: Create `app/lib/ledger.ts` and add it to `build:lib-test`**

Create `app/lib/ledger.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Home's ledger order and the header's lede input (spec §6 Home: "all
 * credentials as ledger rows sorted by urgency — overdue, due within 90 days,
 * on track, no cycle"). One entry per credential series (app/lib/cycles.ts
 * groupCycles): the open cycle where there is one, else the series' newest
 * ended cycle as a "no cycle" row. A submitted cycle sorts after the open
 * ones — it waits on a board and nothing can be earned for it — and before
 * the history rows.
 *
 * Pure: `today` (YYYY-MM-DD in the reminder zone) and `nowMs` are
 * parameters, never read here. Imports carry the `.js` suffix for
 * `npm run build:lib-test` (tsc --module nodenext) and tests/ledger.test.mjs.
 */
import { compareCycleUrgency, groupCycles, type CycleLike } from "./cycles.js";
import { stateOf, type InstrumentState } from "./instruments.js";

/** The row order: the pill states in the order a reader wants them. */
export const URGENCY_ORDER: readonly InstrumentState[] = [
  "overdue",
  "due-soon",
  "on-track",
  "submitted",
  "complete",
  "none",
];

export function urgencyRank(state: InstrumentState): number {
  const rank = URGENCY_ORDER.indexOf(state);
  return rank === -1 ? URGENCY_ORDER.length : rank;
}

/** State rank first, then the cycles.ts tie-break (deadline, cycleStart, id). Returns a new array. */
export function sortByUrgency<T extends CycleLike>(
  cycles: readonly T[],
  nowMs: number,
): T[] {
  return [...cycles].sort(
    (a, b) =>
      urgencyRank(stateOf(a, nowMs)) - urgencyRank(stateOf(b, nowMs)) ||
      compareCycleUrgency(a, b),
  );
}

export type LedgerEntry<T extends CycleLike> = {
  seriesId: string;
  /** The open cycle the row counts down, or null for a series whose every cycle is renewed. */
  current: T | null;
  /** The cycle the row describes: `current`, else the newest-ended one. */
  latest: T;
  state: InstrumentState;
};

/**
 * Open cycles sorted by urgency, then every series without an open cycle as
 * a "none" row (its newest-ended cycle as `latest`) in groupCycles order,
 * which is newest ended first.
 */
export function ledgerEntries<T extends CycleLike>(
  credentials: readonly T[],
  today: string,
  nowMs: number,
): LedgerEntry<T>[] {
  const series = groupCycles(credentials, today);
  const open = series.flatMap((entry) =>
    entry.current ? [{ seriesId: entry.seriesId, current: entry.current }] : [],
  );
  open.sort(
    (a, b) =>
      urgencyRank(stateOf(a.current, nowMs)) -
        urgencyRank(stateOf(b.current, nowMs)) ||
      compareCycleUrgency(a.current, b.current),
  );
  const rows: LedgerEntry<T>[] = open.map(({ seriesId, current }) => ({
    seriesId,
    current,
    latest: current,
    state: stateOf(current, nowMs),
  }));
  for (const entry of series) {
    if (entry.current) continue;
    const latest = entry.previous[0] ?? entry.members[0];
    if (!latest) continue;
    rows.push({ seriesId: entry.seriesId, current: null, latest, state: "none" });
  }
  return rows;
}

export type LedgerCredits = { totalEarned: number; totalRequired: number };

export type LedgerLedeInput = {
  rows: number;
  /** Open rows that are overdue or due soon and still short of their total. */
  needing: number;
  overdue: number;
  /** The earliest needing row's deadline month, through the caller's formatter. */
  soonestMonth: string | null;
};

export function ledgerLedeInput<T extends CycleLike>(
  entries: readonly LedgerEntry<T>[],
  credentialsById: ReadonlyMap<string, LedgerCredits>,
  formatMonth: (iso: string) => string,
): LedgerLedeInput {
  let needing = 0;
  let overdue = 0;
  let soonest: string | null = null;
  for (const entry of entries) {
    if (entry.state === "overdue") overdue += 1;
    if (!entry.current) continue;
    if (entry.state !== "overdue" && entry.state !== "due-soon") continue;
    const credits = credentialsById.get(entry.current.id);
    if (!credits || credits.totalRequired <= 0) continue;
    if (credits.totalEarned >= credits.totalRequired) continue;
    needing += 1;
    if (soonest === null || entry.current.deadline < soonest) {
      soonest = entry.current.deadline;
    }
  }
  return {
    rows: entries.length,
    needing,
    overdue,
    soonestMonth: soonest === null ? null : formatMonth(soonest),
  };
}
```

  const sorted = [...deadlines].sort(compareDates);
  const markers: TimelineLayout["markers"] = [];
  let laneZero: { x: number; label: string } | null = null;
  for (const deadline of sorted) {
    if (deadline.date >= end) continue;
    const markerX = x(deadline.date);
    const lane: 0 | 1 =
      laneZero !== null &&
      markerX - laneZero.x < estimatedLabelWidth(laneZero.label) + LANE_GAP
        ? 1
        : 0;
    if (lane === 0) laneZero = { x: markerX, label: deadline.label };
    markers.push({
      ...deadline,
      x: markerX,
      r: markerRadius(deadline.state),
      lane,
    });
  }
  return {
    start,
    end,
    span,
    axis,
    ticks,
    todayX: x(today),
    markers,
    lanes: markers.some((marker) => marker.lane === 1) ? 2 : 1,
    beyond: sorted.filter((deadline) => deadline.date >= end),
  };
}

It closes over the provider's `run`, `toast` (the provider's `useToast()` handle, which Task 5's success path already uses), `today` and `requestFocus`; add `import { reminderActionKey } from "./actionKeys";` and `import { addDaysIso } from "./dates";` to the store's imports if they are not already there (`grep -n 'reminderActionKey\|addDaysIso' app/lib/workspaceStore.tsx`):

```ts
  // Snooze / Done on a Home check-in (app-ux-08). `run` shows the plain
  // success toast on its own; the Undo toast posted right after carries the
  // same sentence, so the Toast queue REPLACES the plain one (a plain toast
  // yields to the next `show`) and the reader sees one message with an Undo.
  // Undo restores by deleting the reminder_states row (Task 3's `active`):
  // the row comes back in its server-sorted place, and Home focuses it
  // through the focus request. `reminder.title` is the DISPLAY title — Home
  // passes the derived check-in title, so the toast names what was on screen.
  const setReminderState = useCallback(
    async (
      reminder: Reminder,
      status: "dismissed" | "snoozed",
    ): Promise<ActionResult> => {
      const key = reminderActionKey(reminder.key);
      const message =
        status === "snoozed"
          ? `Snoozed “${reminder.title}” for 7 days.`
          : `Marked “${reminder.title}” done.`;
      const result = await run(
        "setReminderState",
        {
          reminderKey: reminder.key,
          credentialId: reminder.credentialId,
          status,
          snoozedUntil: status === "snoozed" ? addDaysIso(today(), 7) : null,
        },
        { key, success: message },
      );
      if (!result.ok) return result;
      toast.show({
        message,
        action: {
          label: "Undo",
          onClick: () => {
            void run(
              "setReminderState",
              {
                reminderKey: reminder.key,
                credentialId: reminder.credentialId,
                status: "active",
                snoozedUntil: null,
              },
              { key, success: "Check-in restored." },
            ).then((restored) => {
              if (restored.ok) requestFocus(`reminder:${reminder.key}`);
            });
          },
        },
      });
      return result;
    },
    [run, toast, today, requestFocus],
  );
```

```ts
import type { Page } from "@playwright/test";
import { expect, freshIdentity, test, type AppFixture } from "./fixtures";

// Home is the ledger (spec §6 Home; mockup A home-desktop.html /
// home-phone.html, binding): one row per credential series sorted by urgency
// — a ring, the credits that count, a countdown and one next action — beside
// the twelve-month timeline, the "Needs attention" check-ins (Snooze / Done
// with Undo, app-ux-08) and the "Best next action" card. The demo identity
// (one NJ LCSW due 2026-11-30, 5 of 40 credits, three tasks — two still open,
// due 2026-10-31 and 2026-11-30) is read-only; every describe that writes
// takes its own fresh identity, so one test's rows never fill another's
// check-in list. Runs in all four projects; the phone assertions are the
// `isPhone()` branches, not skips.

const isPhone = () => test.info().project.name.startsWith("phone");

// Dates in the runner's LOCAL calendar (en-CA formats YYYY-MM-DD). The app's
// today is todayLocal(dateZone), and a fresh identity's stored zone is the UTC
// fallback, so it reads the device zone — this machine's. A UTC slice
// (`new Date().toISOString()`) is a day ahead every evening, which would put
// "13 days ago" one day out.
const localIso = (date: Date) =>
  new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", { year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit" }).format(date);
const isoDaysFromToday = (days: number) => localIso(new Date(Date.now() + days * 86_400_000));

// A custom credential is created with three managed checklist tasks due 120
// and 30 days before its deadline and on it (route.ts renewalTaskSpecs). For
// a cycle 20 days out the first two are already overdue, and bestNextAction
// ranks an overdue step above the credits still needed — so the seeds that
// must show "Log activity" check those steps off first (Task 8 decision 15).
async function completeOverdueTasks(app: AppFixture, credentialId: string) {
  const today = isoDaysFromToday(0);
  const credential = (await app.workspace()).credentials.find((item) => item.id === credentialId);
  for (const task of credential?.tasks ?? []) {
    if (task.status !== "completed" && task.dueDate && task.dueDate < today) {
      await app.act("toggleTask", { taskId: task.id, completed: true, expectedRevision: task.revision });
    }
  }
}

test("Home is the ledger: the demo credential is one due-soon row with a ring, a countdown and one action beside the three aside cards", async ({ page, app }) => {
  await app.goto("/");
  await expect(app.tab("Home")).toHaveAttribute("aria-current", "page");
  await expect(app.tab("Credentials")).not.toHaveAttribute("aria-current", "page");
  await expect(page).toHaveTitle("Home · iTrack");
  const main = page.getByRole("main");
  await expect(main.getByRole("heading", { level: 1, name: "Your renewals" })).toBeVisible();
  // The eyebrow is the date — long on the desktop, short on the phone.
  if (isPhone()) {
    await expect(main.locator(".ledger-date-short")).toBeVisible();
    await expect(main.locator(".ledger-date-short")).toHaveText(/^[A-Z][a-z]{2}, [A-Z][a-z]{2} \d{1,2}$/);
    await expect(main.locator(".ledger-date-long")).toBeHidden();
  } else {
    await expect(main.locator(".ledger-date-long")).toBeVisible();
    await expect(main.locator(".ledger-date-long")).toHaveText(/^[A-Z][a-z]+day, [A-Z][a-z]+ \d{1,2}, \d{4}$/);
    await expect(main.locator(".ledger-date-short")).toBeHidden();
  }

  // One row, due soon (Nov 30 is inside the 90-day window from mid-September).
  const rows = main.locator(".ledger-row");
  await expect(rows).toHaveCount(1);
  const row = rows.first();
  await expect(row).toHaveAttribute("data-state", "due-soon");
  await expect(row.getByRole("heading", { level: 2, name: "Licensed Clinical Social Worker" })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(row.locator(".status-pill")).toHaveText("Due soon");
  // The ring counts credits; its value text speaks the cycle's word.
  const ring = row.getByRole("progressbar", { name: "Licensed Clinical Social Worker: 5 of 40 credits counted" });
  await expect(ring).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuenow", "13");
  await expect(ring).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuetext", "13%, due soon");
  for (const bar of await page.getByRole("progressbar").all()) {
    await expect(bar).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuenow", /^\d+(\.\d+)?$/);
  }
  await expect(row.locator(".ledger-row-credits-text")).toContainText("5 of 40");
  // The countdown: a numeral, the "days left" eyebrow and the mono date.
  await expect(row.locator(".ledger-row-days")).toHaveText(/^\d+$/);
  await expect(row.locator(".ledger-row-countdown")).toContainText("days left");
  await expect(row.locator(".ledger-row-date")).toHaveText("Nov 30, 2026");
  // One action: the credits still needed (5 of 40 — the demo's open tasks
  // are not overdue until 2026-10-31, so bestNextAction is "learning").
  const action = row.getByRole("button", { name: "Log activity", exact: true });
  await expect(action).toBeVisible();
  await expect(row.locator(".ledger-row-hint")).toHaveText("35 credits still needed");

  // The timeline lists the demo deadline as a real button in lane 0; the
  // demo deadline sits in the axis's first third, so its label hangs from
  // the marker's right and stays inside the plot.
  const timeline = page.getByRole("list", { name: "Deadlines in the next twelve months" });
  await expect(timeline.getByRole("button", { name: /Licensed Clinical Social Worker, Nov 30, 2026/ })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.locator('.deadline-timeline-list > li[data-edge="start"]')).toHaveCount(1);
  await expect(page.locator('.deadline-timeline-list > li[data-lane="0"]')).toHaveCount(1);
  await expect(page.locator('.deadline-timeline-plot[data-lanes="1"]')).toHaveCount(1);
  const markerName = page.locator(".deadline-timeline-marker-name", { hasText: "Licensed Clinical Social Worker" });
  await expect(markerName).toHaveAttribute("text-anchor", "start");
  const plotBox = await page.locator(".deadline-timeline-plot svg").boundingBox();
  const nameBox = await markerName.boundingBox();
  expect(nameBox?.x).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(plotBox?.x ?? Infinity);
  expect((nameBox?.x ?? Infinity) + (nameBox?.width ?? 0)).toBeLessThanOrEqual((plotBox?.x ?? 0) + (plotBox?.width ?? 0));

  // Needs attention: the demo's open tasks and its deadline are within the
  // 90-day lead, every one "Due soon" (until 2026-10-31, when the first task
  // turns overdue — the pill still reads "Due soon" on the others).
  await expect(main.getByRole("heading", { level: 2, name: "Needs attention" })).toBeVisible();
  const checkIns = main.locator(".attention-row");
  await expect(checkIns.first()).toBeVisible();
  await expect(main.locator(".attention-row .status-pill", { hasText: "Due soon" }).first()).toBeVisible();
  await expect(main.getByRole("button", { name: "Reminder settings" })).toBeVisible();

  // Best next action names the most urgent open row's own action.
  const next = main.getByRole("region", { name: "Best next action" });
  await expect(next).toBeVisible();
  await expect(next.getByRole("button")).toHaveText(await action.innerText());

  // Header actions: the mockup's two on the desktop (the rail's labels), none
  // on the phone (shell.css hides a lone desktop-only group).
  const headerActions = main.locator(".page-header-actions");
  if (isPhone()) {
    await expect(headerActions).toBeHidden();
    // One column; Best next action first; the 72px ring scaled to 56px.
    const tracks = await main.locator(".ledger").evaluate((node) => getComputedStyle(node).gridTemplateColumns.trim().split(/\s+/).length);
    expect(tracks).toBe(1);
    const nextBox = await next.boundingBox();
    const rowBox = await row.boundingBox();
    expect(nextBox?.y ?? Infinity).toBeLessThan(rowBox?.y ?? -Infinity);
    const ringBox = await row.locator(".cycle-ring").boundingBox();
    expect(Math.round(ringBox?.width ?? 0)).toBe(56);
    expect(Math.round(ringBox?.height ?? 0)).toBe(56);
  } else {
    await expect(headerActions.getByRole("link", { name: "Renewal packet for Licensed Clinical Social Worker" })).toHaveAttribute("href", /^\/api\/export\/packet\?credentialId=/);
    await expect(headerActions.getByRole("button", { name: "Log activity", exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    // Two tracks, the second the 380px aside (mockup: minmax(0, 1fr) 380px).
    const tracks = await main.locator(".ledger").evaluate((node) => getComputedStyle(node).gridTemplateColumns.trim().split(/\s+/));
    expect(tracks).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(tracks[1]).toBe("380px");
  }
  app.expectNoErrors();
});

test.describe("urgency order", () => {
  test.use({ identity: freshIdentity() });

  test("rows sort overdue, due soon, on track, submitted, each with its own action; a row's Log activity pre-selects its credential", async ({ page, app }) => {
    // Seeded out of order on purpose: C, D, A, B.
    const c = await app.seedCredential({ credentialName: "E2E on track", cycleStart: isoDaysFromToday(-165), deadline: isoDaysFromToday(200) });
    const d = await app.seedCredential({ credentialName: "E2E submitted", cycleStart: isoDaysFromToday(-215), deadline: isoDaysFromToday(150) });
    await app.act("markSubmitted", { credentialId: d.id, submissionDate: isoDaysFromToday(-13), confirmationNumber: "CONF-1" });
    const a = await app.seedCredential({ credentialName: "E2E overdue", cycleStart: isoDaysFromToday(-400), deadline: isoDaysFromToday(-3) });
    await app.seedActivity(a.id, { totalUnits: 12, allocatedUnits: 12, completionDate: isoDaysFromToday(-30) });
    const b = await app.seedCredential({ credentialName: "E2E due soon", cycleStart: isoDaysFromToday(-345), deadline: isoDaysFromToday(20) });
    await completeOverdueTasks(app, b.id);

    await app.goto("/");
    const rows = page.locator(".ledger-row");
    await expect(rows).toHaveCount(4);
    expect(await rows.evaluateAll((nodes) => nodes.map((node) => node.getAttribute("data-credential-id")))).toEqual([a.id, b.id, c.id, d.id]);
    expect(await rows.evaluateAll((nodes) => nodes.map((node) => node.getAttribute("data-state")))).toEqual(["overdue", "due-soon", "on-track", "submitted"]);

    // A: credits complete on an overdue cycle — a complete ring with its
    // check whose value text speaks for the CYCLE (never "100%, renewed" —
    // WCAG 4.1.2), and its first overdue checklist step as the action.
    const ringA = page.getByRole("progressbar", { name: "E2E overdue: 12 of 10 hours counted" });
    await expect(ringA).toHaveAttribute("data-state", "complete");
    await expect(ringA).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuenow", "100");
    await expect(ringA).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuetext", "100%, overdue");
    await expect(ringA.locator(".cycle-ring-check")).toHaveCount(1);
    await expect(rows.nth(0).locator(".ledger-row-countdown")).toContainText("days overdue");
    await expect(rows.nth(0).getByRole("button", { name: "Open checklist" })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(rows.nth(0).locator(".ledger-row-hint")).toHaveText(/^Step due /);
    // B: nothing counted, 20 days out — the credits it still needs.
    const rowB = rows.nth(1);
    await expect(rowB.getByRole("button", { name: "Log activity", exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(rowB.locator(".ledger-row-hint")).toHaveText("10 hours still needed");
    // C: on track — the same action, quiet.
    await expect(rows.nth(2).getByRole("button", { name: "Log activity", exact: true })).toHaveClass(/btn-quiet/);
    // D: sent 13 days ago, waiting on its board.
    const rowD = rows.nth(3);
    await expect(rowD.locator(".ledger-row-sent")).toHaveText("Sent");
    await expect(rowD.locator(".ledger-row-countdown")).toContainText("13 days ago");
    await expect(rowD.locator(".ledger-row-issuer")).toContainText("awaiting acceptance");
    await expect(rowD.getByRole("button", { name: "Record acceptance" })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(rowD.locator(".ledger-row-hint")).toHaveText("Next cycle opens when accepted");
    // The lede: one overdue row wins the sentence (Task 2 ledgerLede).
    await expect(page.getByRole("main").locator(".page-lede")).toHaveText("Four credentials on the record. One past its deadline.");

    // The row's own action hands its credential to the Log sheet.
    await rowB.getByRole("button", { name: "Log activity", exact: true }).click();
    const sheet = app.dialog("Log completed learning");
    await expect(sheet).toBeVisible();
    await expect(sheet.locator('select[name="credentialId"]')).toHaveValue(b.id);
    app.expectNoErrors();
  });
});

test.describe("snooze, done and undo", () => {
  test.use({ identity: freshIdentity() });

  test("Snooze and Done leave an Undo toast; Undo brings the check-in back in its place and focuses it", async ({ page, app }) => {
    // 20 days out: inside the 30-day lead, so Home shows a deadline
    // check-in (app/lib/reminders.ts reminderActivationDate). Its two overdue
    // managed tasks are check-ins too and sort first; the deadline row is
    // found by its derived title.
    await app.seedCredential({ credentialName: "E2E deadline credential", cycleStart: isoDaysFromToday(-345), deadline: isoDaysFromToday(20) });
    await app.goto("/");
    const row = page.locator(".attention-row", { has: page.locator(".attention-title", { hasText: /^Renewal due / }) });
    await expect(row).toHaveCount(1);
    await expect(row.locator(".status-pill")).toHaveText("Due soon");
    const key = await row.getAttribute("data-reminder-key");
    expect(key).toMatch(/^deadline:/);
    const inWorkspace = async () => ((await app.workspace()).reminders ?? []).some((reminder) => reminder.key === key);

    await row.getByRole("button", { name: /^Snooze Renewal due .* for 7 days$/ }).click();
    await expect(toastStatus(page)).toContainText(/^Snoozed “Renewal due [^”]+” for 7 days\.$/);
    await expect(row).toHaveCount(0);
    expect(await inWorkspace()).toBe(false);
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Undo" }).click();
    await expect(row).toHaveCount(1);
    await expect(toastStatus(page)).toContainText("Check-in restored.");
    expect(await inWorkspace()).toBe(true);
    // Keyboard users land on what they restored.
    await expect(row.locator(".attention-open")).toBeFocused();

    await row.getByRole("button", { name: /^Mark Renewal due .* done for this cycle$/ }).click();
    await expect(toastStatus(page)).toContainText(/^Marked “Renewal due [^”]+” done\.$/);
    await expect(row).toHaveCount(0);
    expect(await inWorkspace()).toBe(false);
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Undo" }).click();
    await expect(row).toHaveCount(1);
    await expect(toastStatus(page)).toContainText("Check-in restored.");
    await expect(row.locator(".attention-open")).toBeFocused();
    app.expectNoErrors();
  });
});

test.describe("pending", () => {
  test.use({ identity: freshIdentity() });

  test("a snooze in flight keeps its button busy and focused; nothing is optimistic", async ({ page, app }) => {
    await app.seedCredential({ credentialName: "E2E pending credential", cycleStart: isoDaysFromToday(-345), deadline: isoDaysFromToday(20) });
    await app.goto("/");
    await page.route((url) => url.pathname === "/api/workspace", async (route) => {
      if (route.request().method() === "POST") {
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1500));
      }
      await route.continue();
    });
    const row = page.locator(".attention-row").first();
    const snooze = row.getByRole("button", { name: /^Snooze / });
    await snooze.click();
    // Pending = aria-disabled + aria-busy with focus kept (Button primitive);
    // the row is still there because the workspace is only trusted after the
    // write and the refetch land.
    await expect(snooze).toHaveAttribute("aria-busy", "true");
    await expect(snooze).toBeFocused();
    await expect(row).toHaveCount(1);
    await expect(toastStatus(page)).toContainText("for 7 days.", { timeout: 10_000 });
    app.expectNoErrors();
  });
});

test.describe("the fold moment", () => {
  test.use({ identity: freshIdentity() });

  test("recording an acceptance folds the successor row in on the next visit to Home, once", async ({ page, app }) => {
    const { id } = await app.seedCredential();
    await app.act("markSubmitted", { credentialId: id, submissionDate: "2026-06-01", confirmationNumber: "CONF-1" });
    await app.goto(`/credentials/${id}`);
    // Hold the moment open: the row drops data-motion on animationend, which
    // this duration postpones for the length of the test. Under the token
    // (360ms, 0ms with reduced motion) the assertion below would be a race.
    await page.addStyleTag({ content: '.ledger-row[data-motion="fold"] { animation-duration: 60s !important; }' });
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Record acceptance" }).click();
    const dialog = app.dialog("Close this renewal cycle");
    await expect(dialog).toBeVisible();
    await dialog.locator('input[name="acceptedAt"]').fill("2026-06-15");
    await dialog.locator('input[name="reference"]').fill("REF-1");
    await dialog.locator('input[name="nextCycleStart"]').fill("2028-01-01");
    await dialog.locator('input[name="nextDeadline"]').fill("2029-12-31");
    await dialog.locator('button[type="submit"]').click();
    await expect(dialog).toHaveCount(0);
    // The detail re-points at the successor (replace), then Home mounts its row folding.
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/credentials\/[^/]+$/);
    const successorId = (await app.workspace()).activeCycleId ?? "";
    expect(successorId).not.toBe(id);
    await app.tab("Home").click();
    await expect(page).toHaveTitle("Home · iTrack");
    const row = page.locator(".ledger-row").first();
    await expect(row).toHaveAttribute("data-credential-id", successorId);
    await expect(row).toHaveAttribute("data-motion", "fold");
    expect(await row.evaluate((node) => getComputedStyle(node).animationName)).toBe("ledger-fold");
    // Once: the marker lives in memory — a cold load carries no fold.
    await page.reload();
    await expect(page.locator(LOADING)).toHaveCount(0, { timeout: 30_000 });
    expect(await page.locator(".ledger-row").first().getAttribute("data-motion")).toBeNull();
    app.expectNoErrors();
  });
});

```tsx
"use client";

import { useId, type AnimationEvent, type MouseEvent, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { Button } from "../../components/Button";
import { isPlainLeftClick } from "../../components/NavItem";
import { CreditBar } from "../../components/instruments/CreditBar";
import { CycleRing } from "../../components/instruments/CycleRing";
import { StatusPill } from "../../components/instruments/StatusPill";
import { allocationsFor } from "../../lib/activityRules";
import { cycleCountdown } from "../../lib/cycles";
import { compactNumber, formatDate } from "../../lib/format";
import {
  STATE_LABELS,
  daysBetweenIso,
  ringStateOf,
  ringValueOf,
  stateOf,
  type InstrumentState,
} from "../../lib/instruments";
import type { LedgerEntry } from "../../lib/ledger";
import { buildPath } from "../../lib/navigation";
import { bestNextAction } from "../../lib/nextAction";
import { activeMinimums, requirementEarned } from "../../lib/readiness";
import { useWorkspace, type WorkspaceStore } from "../../lib/workspaceStore";
import type { Activity, Credential, GuidedAction } from "../../lib/workspaceTypes";

export type RowAction = {
  label: string;
  variant: "secondary" | "quiet";
  hint: string;
  run: () => void;
};

const EMPTY_ACTIVITIES: readonly Activity[] = [];

/** Activities allocated to this credential whose evidence is still missing — the count bestNextAction ranks. */
export function missingEvidenceFor(
  credential: Credential,
  activities: readonly Activity[],
): number {
  return activities.filter(
    (activity) =>
      activity.evidenceStatus === "missing" &&
      allocationsFor(activity).some(
        (allocation) => allocation.credentialId === credential.id,
      ),
  ).length;
}

/**
 * The credits still needed: the overall shortfall, or — once the total is
 * met while a category minimum is short (the branch bestNextAction words
 * "Complete N more <category> …") — the largest category shortfall.
 */
function creditsStillNeeded(credential: Credential): number {
  const overall = Math.max(0, credential.totalRequired - credential.totalEarned);
  if (overall > 0) return overall;
  return activeMinimums(credential).reduce(
    (largest, requirement) =>
      Math.max(largest, requirement.requiredUnits - requirementEarned(requirement)),
    0,
  );
}

/**
 * One next action per row (spec §6): the label and hint are the copy table's,
 * the handler the store's. The "Best next action" card calls this for the
 * most urgent open row, so its button and that row's never disagree.
 */
export function rowAction(
  guided: GuidedAction,
  credential: Credential,
  state: InstrumentState,
  missingEvidence: number,
  store: WorkspaceStore,
): RowAction {
  const openDetail = () => store.openCredentialDetail(credential.id);
  const toLog = () => store.nav.setTab("history");
  switch (guided.kind) {
    case "learning":
      return {
        label: "Log activity",
        variant: state === "on-track" ? "quiet" : "secondary",
        hint: `${compactNumber(creditsStillNeeded(credential))} ${credential.unitLabel} still needed`,
        run: () =>
          store.modals.open({
            kind: "logActivity",
            preselectCredentialId: credential.id,
          }),
      };
    case "acceptance":
      return {
        label: "Record acceptance",
        variant: "secondary",
        hint: "Next cycle opens when accepted",
        run: () =>
          store.modals.open({ kind: "acceptance", credentialId: credential.id }),
      };
    case "submission":
      return {
        label: "Record submission",
        variant: "secondary",
        hint: "Credits complete · ready to submit",
        run: () =>
          store.modals.open({ kind: "submission", credentialId: credential.id }),
      };
    case "checklist":
      return {
        label: "Open checklist",
        variant: "quiet",
        hint: guided.dueDate
          ? `Step due ${formatDate(guided.dueDate)}`
          : "One checklist step left",
        run: () => {
          openDetail();
          store.requestFocus("checklist");
        },
      };
    case "conditions":
      return {
        label: "Review conditions",
        variant: "quiet",
        hint: "One rule needs an answer",
        run: openDetail,
      };
    case "records": {
      const issues = credential.classificationIssues?.length ?? 0;
      if (issues > 0) {
        const n = guided.count ?? issues;
        return {
          label: "Categorize activities",
          variant: "quiet",
          hint: `${compactNumber(n)} ${n === 1 ? "activity" : "activities"} to categorize`,
          run: toLog,
        };
      }
      const n = guided.count ?? missingEvidence;
      return {
        label: "Attach evidence",
        variant: "quiet",
        hint:
          n === 1
            ? "1 activity needs evidence"
            : `${compactNumber(n)} activities need evidence`,
        run: toLog,
      };
    }
    case "history":
    default:
      return {
        label: "View history",
        variant: "quiet",
        hint: `Renewed ${formatDate(credential.acceptedAt)}`,
        run: openDetail,
      };
  }
}

export function LedgerRow({
  entry,
  today,
  nowMs,
  folding,
}: {
  entry: LedgerEntry<Credential>;
  today: string;
  nowMs: number;
  folding: boolean;
}) {
  const store = useWorkspace();
  const nameId = useId();
  const credential = entry.current ?? entry.latest;
  const name = credential.credentialName;
  const activities = store.workspace?.activities ?? EMPTY_ACTIVITIES;
  const open = entry.current !== null;
  // The pill and the value text speak the CYCLE's word (stateOf); the ring's
  // own state is credits-based (ringStateOf) — a fully counted overdue
  // credential says "100%, overdue", never "100%, renewed" (WCAG 4.1.2).
  const cycleWord = STATE_LABELS[open ? stateOf(credential, nowMs) : "none"].toLowerCase();
  const ringValue = ringValueOf(credential);
  const ringState: InstrumentState = open ? ringStateOf(credential, nowMs) : "none";
  const ringLabel = !open
    ? `${name}: no open cycle`
    : ringValue.basis === "credits"
      ? `${name}: ${compactNumber(credential.totalEarned)} of ${compactNumber(credential.totalRequired)} ${credential.unitLabel} counted`
      : `${name}: ${ringValue.percent}% ready`;
  const missingEvidence = open ? missingEvidenceFor(credential, activities) : 0;
  const action: RowAction = open
    ? rowAction(
        bestNextAction(credential, missingEvidence, today),
        credential,
        entry.state,
        missingEvidence,
        store,
      )
    : {
        label: "View history",
        variant: "quiet",
        hint: `Renewed ${formatDate(credential.acceptedAt)}`,
        run: () => store.openCredentialDetail(credential.id),
      };
  const href = buildPath({
    tab: "credentials",
    detail: { kind: "credential", id: credential.id },
  });
  // A minimum equal to the total IS the total (the CreditBar drops such a
  // marker too), so only the minimums inside the bar are named.
  const minimums = activeMinimums(credential).filter(
    (requirement) => requirement.requiredUnits < credential.totalRequired,
  );
  const largestMinimum = Math.max(0, ...minimums.map((item) => item.requiredUnits));

  const issuerLine = !open
    ? `${credential.jurisdiction} · renewed ${formatDate(credential.acceptedAt)}`
    : entry.state === "submitted"
      ? `${credential.issuer ?? credential.jurisdiction} · sent ${formatDate(
          (credential.submittedAt ?? today).slice(0, 10),
          { year: undefined },
        )}, awaiting acceptance`
      : credential.issuer
        ? `${credential.jurisdiction} · ${credential.issuer}`
        : credential.jurisdiction;

  let countdown: ReactNode;
  if (!open) {
    countdown = (
      <>
        <span className="ledger-row-days">—</span>
        <span className="eyebrow">no cycle</span>
      </>
    );
  } else if (entry.state === "submitted") {
    const sent = (credential.submittedAt ?? today).slice(0, 10);
    const ago = daysBetweenIso(sent, today);
    countdown = (
      <>
        <span className="ledger-row-sent">Sent</span>
        <span className="eyebrow">{ago === 1 ? "1 day ago" : `${ago} days ago`}</span>
        <span className="ledger-row-date">{formatDate(sent)}</span>
      </>
    );
  } else {
    const remaining = cycleCountdown(credential, nowMs);
    const days = remaining.kind === "closed" ? 0 : Math.abs(remaining.days);
    const overdue = remaining.kind === "overdue";
    countdown = (
      <>
        <span className="ledger-row-days">{days}</span>
        <span className="eyebrow">
          {overdue
            ? days === 1
              ? "day overdue"
              : "days overdue"
            : days === 1
              ? "day left"
              : "days left"}
        </span>
        <span className="ledger-row-date">{formatDate(credential.deadline)}</span>
      </>
    );
  }

  const openCredential = (event: MouseEvent<HTMLAnchorElement>) => {
    if (!isPlainLeftClick(event)) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    store.openCredentialDetail(credential.id);
  };
  // The fold is cleared by its own animationend only — a ring's check-draw
  // inside the row bubbles an animationend of its own.
  const clearFold = (event: AnimationEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
    if (folding && event.animationName === "ledger-fold") store.markSeriesClosed("");
  };

  return (
    <article
      className="ledger-row"
      data-state={entry.state}
      data-credential-id={credential.id}
      aria-labelledby={nameId}
      data-motion={folding ? "fold" : undefined}
      onAnimationEnd={clearFold}
    >
      {/* Keyed on the credential: the ring's completion moment compares one instance's successive fractions. */}
      <CycleRing
        key={credential.id}
        size={72}
        fraction={open ? ringValue.fraction : 0}
        percent={open ? ringValue.percent : 0}
        state={ringState}
        label={ringLabel}
        valueText={`${open ? ringValue.percent : 0}%, ${cycleWord}`}
        showNumeral={open}
      />
      <div className="ledger-row-main">
        <div className="ledger-row-title">
          <h2 id={nameId} className="ledger-row-name">
            <a href={href} onClick={openCredential}>
              {name}
            </a>
          </h2>
          <StatusPill state={entry.state} />
        </div>
        <p className="ledger-row-issuer">{issuerLine}</p>
        {credential.totalRequired > 0 ? (
          <div className="ledger-row-credits">
            <CreditBar
              counted={credential.totalEarned}
              required={credential.totalRequired}
              minimum={largestMinimum || undefined}
              state={ringState}
              label={`${name}: ${compactNumber(credential.totalEarned)} of ${compactNumber(credential.totalRequired)} ${credential.unitLabel}`}
            />
            <p className="ledger-row-credits-text">
              <strong>
                {compactNumber(credential.totalEarned)} of {compactNumber(credential.totalRequired)}
              </strong>{" "}
              {credential.unitLabel} count
              {minimums
                .map(
                  (requirement) =>
                    ` · ${compactNumber(requirement.requiredUnits)} ${requirement.name} minimum${
                      requirementEarned(requirement) >= requirement.requiredUnits ? " met" : ""
                    }`,
                )
                .join("")}
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <p className="ledger-row-credits-text">No credit total · checklist only</p>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="ledger-row-countdown">{countdown}</div>
      <div className="ledger-row-action">
        <Button variant={action.variant} onClick={action.run}>
          {action.label}
        </Button>
        <p className="ledger-row-hint">{action.hint}</p>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}
```

Create `app/screens/home/AttentionRow.tsx` (mockup `home-desktop.html:196-211`: pill · title + sub · Snooze / Done; the pill words are the Wave 3 ones; the two aria-labels are copy-table B's; the DISPLAY title is what the store puts in its toast):

```tsx
"use client";

import { useLayoutEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { Button } from "../../components/Button";
import { StatusPill } from "../../components/instruments/StatusPill";
import { reminderActionKey } from "../../lib/actionKeys";
import { checkInBody, checkInTitle, type CheckInTask } from "../../lib/copy";
import { isCompliancePeriodCredential } from "../../lib/credentialRules";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/format";
import { STATE_LABELS, reminderState } from "../../lib/instruments";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../lib/workspaceStore";
import type { Reminder } from "../../lib/workspaceTypes";

const shortDate = (iso: string) => formatDate(iso, { year: undefined });
const longDate = (iso: string) => formatDate(iso);

export function AttentionRow({
  reminder,
  task,
  highlighted,
}: {
  reminder: Reminder;
  task: CheckInTask;
  highlighted: boolean;
}) {
  const store = useWorkspace();
  const { focusRequest, requestFocus } = store;
  const openRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const credential = store.workspace?.credentials.find(
    (item) => item.id === reminder.credentialId,
  );
  const state = reminderState(reminder);
  const title = checkInTitle(
    { ...reminder, compliance: isCompliancePeriodCredential(credential) },
    task,
    shortDate,
  );
  const body = checkInBody(reminder, task, longDate);
  const busy = store.pending.isPending(reminderActionKey(reminder.key));
  const focusTarget = `reminder:${reminder.key}`;

  // Undo restores the check-in and asks for focus on it (the store's
  // requestFocus after the refetch); the row answers once it is mounted.
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (focusRequest !== focusTarget) return;
    openRef.current?.focus();
    requestFocus(null);
  }, [focusRequest, focusTarget, requestFocus]);

  const setState = (status: "snoozed" | "dismissed") => {
    // The display title rides in `title` so the toast names what was on screen.
    void store.actions.setReminderState({ ...reminder, title }, status);
  };

  return (
    <li
      className="attention-row"
      data-reminder-key={reminder.key}
      data-state={state}
      data-highlighted={highlighted ? "true" : undefined}
      tabIndex={-1}
    >
      <StatusPill state={state}>
        {reminder.urgency === "overdue"
          ? "Overdue"
          : reminder.urgency === "today"
            ? "Due today"
            : STATE_LABELS[state]}
      </StatusPill>
      <button
        ref={openRef}
        type="button"
        className="attention-open"
        onClick={() => store.openCredentialDetail(reminder.credentialId)}
      >
        <strong className="attention-title">{title}</strong>
        <small>{body}</small>
      </button>
      <div className="attention-actions">
        <Button
          variant="quiet"
          size="sm"
          pending={busy}
          aria-label={`Snooze ${title} for 7 days`}
          onClick={() => setState("snoozed")}
        >
          Snooze
        </Button>
        <Button
          variant="quiet"
          size="sm"
          pending={busy}
          aria-label={`Mark ${title} done for this cycle`}
          onClick={() => setState("dismissed")}
        >
          Done
        </Button>
      </div>
    </li>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useId, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "../components/Button";
import { EmptyState } from "../components/EmptyState";
import { Icon } from "../components/Icon";
import { isPlainLeftClick } from "../components/NavItem";
import { PageHeader } from "../components/PageHeader";
import { DeadlineTimeline } from "../components/instruments/DeadlineTimeline";
import { buttonClassName } from "../lib/buttonClass";
import { ledgerLede, type CheckInTask } from "../lib/copy";
import { formatDate } from "../lib/format";
import type { TimelineDeadline } from "../lib/instruments";
import { ledgerEntries, ledgerLedeInput, type LedgerCredits } from "../lib/ledger";
import { bestNextAction } from "../lib/nextAction";
import { useWorkspace } from "../lib/workspaceStore";
import type { Credential, Reminder } from "../lib/workspaceTypes";
import { AttentionRow } from "./home/AttentionRow";
import { LedgerRow, missingEvidenceFor, rowAction } from "./home/LedgerRow";

const EMPTY_CREDENTIALS: readonly Credential[] = [];
const EMPTY_REMINDERS: readonly Reminder[] = [];
const SHOWN_CHECK_INS = 3;

// A task check-in's key is `task:<taskId>:<dueDate>` (app/lib/reminders.ts);
// the task itself is on its credential, so the title can be derived from its
// kind on the client (decision 6) — no server change, push and ICS untouched.
function checkInTaskFor(
  reminder: Reminder,
  credentials: readonly Credential[],
): CheckInTask {
  if (reminder.kind !== "task") return null;
  const taskId = reminder.key.split(":")[1] ?? "";
  for (const credential of credentials) {
    const task = credential.tasks.find((candidate) => candidate.id === taskId);
    if (task) {
      return { kind: task.kind, isPersonal: Boolean(task.isPersonal), title: task.title };
    }
  }
  return null;
}

const monthName = (iso: string) =>
  formatDate(iso, { day: undefined, month: "long", year: undefined });

/**
 * Home (spec §6): the ledger — one row per credential series sorted by
 * urgency — beside the timeline, the check-ins and the best next action.
 * Everything comes from the store; the clock is read once per workspace
 * through store.nowMs() inside a memo, never in the render body.
 */
export function Home({ highlightedReminderKey }: { highlightedReminderKey: string }) {
  const store = useWorkspace();
  const workspace = store.workspace;
  const today = store.today();
  const nowMs = useMemo(() => store.nowMs(), [store]);
  const credentials = workspace?.credentials ?? EMPTY_CREDENTIALS;
  const reminders = workspace?.reminders ?? EMPTY_REMINDERS;
  const archived = workspace?.archivedCredentials.length ?? 0;
  const [showAll, setShowAll] = useState(false);
  const timelineId = useId();
  const attentionId = useId();
  const nextId = useId();

  const entries = useMemo(
    () => ledgerEntries(credentials, today, nowMs),
    [credentials, today, nowMs],
  );
  const creditsById = useMemo(
    () =>
      new Map<string, LedgerCredits>(
        credentials.map((credential) => [
          credential.id,
          { totalEarned: credential.totalEarned, totalRequired: credential.totalRequired },
        ]),
      ),
    [credentials],
  );

  if (!workspace) return null;

  const firstOpen = entries.find((entry) => entry.current !== null) ?? null;
  const first = firstOpen?.current ?? null;
  const lede = entries.length
    ? ledgerLede(ledgerLedeInput(entries, creditsById, monthName))
    : "Add your first credential to start your ledger.";
  const timelineDeadlines: TimelineDeadline[] = entries.flatMap((entry) =>
    entry.current
      ? [
          {
            id: entry.current.id,
            label: entry.current.credentialName,
            date: entry.current.deadline,
            state: entry.state,
          },
        ]
      : [],
  );
  // A push deep link's check-in is listed first (useReminderLaunch highlights it).
  const highlightedReminder = reminders.find((reminder) => reminder.key === highlightedReminderKey);
  const visible = highlightedReminder
    ? [highlightedReminder, ...reminders.filter((reminder) => reminder.key !== highlightedReminder.key)]
    : reminders;
  const shown = showAll ? visible : visible.slice(0, SHOWN_CHECK_INS);
  const guided = first ? bestNextAction(first, missingEvidenceFor(first, workspace.activities), today) : null;
  const next =
    first && firstOpen && guided
      ? rowAction(guided, first, firstOpen.state, missingEvidenceFor(first, workspace.activities), store)
      : null;
  const openSetup = () => store.modals.open({ kind: "credentialSetup" });

  return (
    <div className="ledger-page">
      <PageHeader
        eyebrow={
          <>
            <span className="ledger-date ledger-date-long">
              {formatDate(today, { weekday: "long", month: "long", day: "numeric", year: "numeric" })}
            </span>
            <span className="ledger-date ledger-date-short">
              {formatDate(today, { weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric", year: undefined })}
            </span>
          </>
        }
        title="Your renewals"
        lede={lede}
        actions={
          <div className="desktop-only ledger-header-actions">
            {first ? (
              <a
                className={buttonClassName("secondary")}
                href={`/api/export/packet?credentialId=${encodeURIComponent(first.id)}`}
                target="_blank"
                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                aria-label={`Renewal packet for ${first.credentialName}`}
              >
                Renewal packet
                <Icon name="arrowUpRight" size={15} />
              </a>
            ) : null}
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              icon={<Icon name="plus" size={16} />}
              onClick={() => store.modals.open({ kind: "logActivity", preselectCredentialId: "" })}
            >
              Log activity
            </Button>
          </div>
        }
      />
      {credentials.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="ledger-empty">
          <EmptyState
            title={archived ? "No active credentials" : "Add your first credential"}
            body={
              archived
                ? "Restore one from Credentials or add a new one."
                : "Pick your board’s template or set up a custom credential. Your deadlines, credits and check-ins start here."
            }
            action={{ label: "Add credential", onClick: openSetup }}
          />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="ledger">
          <section className="ledger-rows" aria-label="Your renewals">
            {entries.map((entry) => (
              <LedgerRow
                key={entry.latest.id}
                entry={entry}
                today={today}
                nowMs={nowMs}
                folding={entry.current !== null && entry.seriesId === store.recentlyClosedSeriesId}
              />
            ))}
            <p className="ledger-footer">
              <a
                href="/credentials"
                onClick={(event) => {
                  if (!isPlainLeftClick(event)) return;
                  event.preventDefault();
                  openSetup();
                }}
              >
                Add a credential
              </a>
              {archived ? (
                <>
                  <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
                  <a
                    href="/credentials"
                    onClick={(event) => {
                      if (!isPlainLeftClick(event)) return;
                      event.preventDefault();
                      store.nav.setTab("credentials");
                      store.requestFocus("archived-filter");
                    }}
                  >
                    Archived ({archived})
                  </a>
                </>
              ) : null}
            </p>
          </section>
          <aside className="ledger-aside">
            <section className="ledger-card ledger-timeline" aria-labelledby={timelineId}>
              <div className="ledger-card-heading">
                <h2 id={timelineId} className="eyebrow">
                  Next twelve months
                </h2>
              </div>
              <DeadlineTimeline
                today={today}
                deadlines={timelineDeadlines}
                formatDate={(iso) => formatDate(iso)}
                formatShortDate={(iso) => formatDate(iso, { year: undefined })}
                formatMonth={(iso) => formatDate(iso, { day: undefined, month: "short", year: "numeric" })}
                onSelect={store.openCredentialDetail}
              />
            </section>
            <section className="ledger-card ledger-attention" aria-labelledby={attentionId}>
              <div className="ledger-card-heading">
                <h2 id={attentionId} className="eyebrow">
                  Needs attention
                </h2>
                <Button
                  variant="quiet"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => {
                    store.nav.setTab("profile");
                    store.requestFocus("reminders");
                  }}
                >
                  Reminder settings
                </Button>
              </div>
              {visible.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="ledger-attention-empty">Nothing needs attention right now.</p>
              ) : (
                <ul className="attention-list" id="attention-list">
                  {shown.map((reminder) => (
                    <AttentionRow
                      key={reminder.key}
                      reminder={reminder}
                      task={checkInTaskFor(reminder, credentials)}
                      highlighted={reminder.key === highlightedReminderKey}
                    />
                  ))}
                </ul>
              )}
              {visible.length > SHOWN_CHECK_INS ? (
                <Button
                  variant="quiet"
                  size="sm"
                  aria-controls="attention-list"
                  aria-expanded={showAll}
                  onClick={() => setShowAll((current) => !current)}
                >
                  {showAll ? "Show the first 3 check-ins" : `View all ${visible.length} check-ins`}
                </Button>
              ) : null}
            </section>
            {guided && next ? (
              <section className="ledger-card ledger-next-action" aria-labelledby={nextId}>
                <h2 id={nextId} className="eyebrow">
                  Best next action
                </h2>
                <p className="ledger-next-action-title">{guided.title}</p>
                <p className="ledger-next-action-body">{guided.body}</p>
                <Button variant="primary" onClick={next.run}>
                  {next.label}
                </Button>
              </section>
            ) : null}
          </aside>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

Notes on the shape (react-hooks 7 at error): every hook runs before the `if (!workspace) return null;` early return; `store.nowMs()` is read inside `useMemo` keyed on the store value (Task 5 rebuilds it on every workspace change, so the clock is re-read per load and never in a render body — `purity`); no component is defined inside another (`static-components`); no state is set in render or in an effect body (the only effect, `AttentionRow`'s, calls the store's `requestFocus`, not a local setter); `openRef.current` is read in a layout effect only (`refs`). `<Banners />` is NOT rendered here — Task 18 inserts it after `<PageHeader …/>`. The `.eyebrow` class on the three `h2`s is `shell.css:167-173` (the same uppercase 0.75rem 700 style the page header's eyebrow wears).

```css
/*
 * Home — the ledger (app/screens/Home.tsx, home/LedgerRow.tsx,
 * home/AttentionRow.tsx). Mockup A: home-desktop.html — the page a 28px
 * stack, the ledger `minmax(0, 1fr) 380px` with 28px gaps, a row
 * `72px minmax(0, 1fr) 132px 200px` with 20px gaps and 18px 20px padding, the
 * aside a 16px stack of 20px-padded cards, the inverse "Best next action"
 * card; home-phone.html — one column, Best next action first, 56px rings,
 * 14px cards, no per-row button row until the action row folds under the
 * card. A consumer stylesheet: first-class tokens only. The one animation is
 * the third spec moment — the fold — on --duration-fold (0ms under reduced
 * motion through tokens.css).
 */
.ledger-page {
  display: grid;
  gap: 28px;
}

.ledger-header-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
}

.ledger-date-short {
  display: none;
}

.ledger {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) var(--ledger-aside-width);
  gap: 28px;
  align-items: start;
}

.ledger-rows {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.ledger-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 72px minmax(0, 1fr) 132px 200px;
  gap: 20px;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 18px 20px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background: var(--card);
}

/* The row edge is decorative — the pill carries the word (a11y-11). */
.ledger-row[data-state="due-soon"] {
  border-color: var(--edge-due-soon);
}

.ledger-row[data-state="overdue"] {
  border-color: var(--state-overdue);
}

.ledger-row-main {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.ledger-row-title {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;

}

.ledger-row-name {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: var(--text-lg);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.2;
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-display);
}

.ledger-row-name a {
  color: var(--ink);
  text-decoration: none;
}

.ledger-row-name a:hover {

}

.ledger-row-credits-text {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--text-2xs);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

  font-weight: 500;
}

.ledger-row-countdown {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-end;
  text-align: right;
}

/* The mockup's 40px numeral on the rem scale: --text-3xl (36px) at 800. */
.ledger-row-days {
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: var(--text-3xl);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-display);

}

.ledger-row-sent {

  font-size: var(--text-xl);
  font-weight: 700;

  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-display);
}

.ledger-row-countdown .eyebrow {
  margin-top: 4px;
}

.ledger-row-date {
  margin-top: 2px;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--text-2xs);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.ledger-row-action {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: stretch;
  gap: 8px;
}

.ledger-row-hint {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-2xs);
  text-align: center;
}

.ledger-footer {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 6px 4px 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
}

.ledger-footer a {
  color: var(--accent);
  text-decoration: none;
}

.ledger-footer a:hover {
  color: var(--accent-hover);
  text-decoration: underline;
}

.ledger-aside {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.ledger-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 20px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background: var(--card);
}

.ledger-card-heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
}

.ledger-card h2 {
  margin: 0;
}

.ledger-attention-empty {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
}

.attention-list {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.attention-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: start;
  padding: 12px 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.attention-row:first-child {
  border-top: 0;
  padding-top: 0;
}

/* A push deep link's check-in, and the row an Undo just restored. */
.attention-row[data-highlighted="true"] {
  box-shadow: inset 4px 0 var(--accent);
}

.attention-row .status-pill {
  margin-top: 2px;
}

.attention-open {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: var(--tap-min);
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: inherit;
  font: inherit;
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* Two lines at most: a personal task's title is the user's own words (decision 6). */
.attention-title {
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
  overflow: hidden;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.attention-open small {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 2px;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-2xs);
}

.attention-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 6px;
}

/*
 * BEST NEXT ACTION — the inverse card (mockup: ink surface, paper text,
 * muted paper eyebrow and body, a paper-filled button). The button's ink on
 * the on-inverse fill is claimed in tokens.css (--inverse-surface on
 * --on-inverse / --on-inverse-muted); the focus ring token has no claim on
 * the inverse surface, so the ring here is --accent-on-inverse.
 */
.ledger-next-action {
  gap: 10px;
  border-color: transparent;
  background: var(--inverse-surface);
  color: var(--on-inverse);
}

.ledger-next-action .eyebrow,
.ledger-next-action-body {
  color: var(--on-inverse-muted);
}

.ledger-next-action-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: var(--text-xl);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.15;
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-display);
  text-wrap: balance;
}

.ledger-next-action-body {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
}

.ledger-next-action .btn-primary {
  align-self: flex-start;
  margin-top: 4px;
  border-color: transparent;
  background: var(--on-inverse);
  color: var(--inverse-surface);
}

.ledger-next-action .btn-primary:hover,
.ledger-next-action .btn-primary:active {
  background: var(--on-inverse-muted);
}

.ledger-next-action .btn-primary:focus-visible {
  outline-color: var(--accent-on-inverse);
}

.ledger-empty {
  max-width: 560px;
}

/*
 * THE FOLD (spec §5.1 Motion, the third moment): the successor row folds in
 * once when a cycle closes — data-motion="fold" is set by Home from the
 * store's marker and cleared on animationend. `both` keeps the rested state;
 * --duration-fold is 0ms under prefers-reduced-motion, so nothing plays.
 */
@keyframes ledger-fold {
  from {
    transform: translateY(-8px) scaleY(1.08);
    opacity: 0.4;
  }

  to {
    transform: none;
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

.ledger-row[data-motion="fold"] {
  transform-origin: top center;
  animation: ledger-fold var(--duration-fold) var(--ease-out) both;
}

@media (max-width: 1040px) {
  .ledger-row {
    grid-template-columns: 72px minmax(0, 1fr) 110px 170px;
    gap: 16px;
  }
}

/*
 * PHONE (home-phone.html): one column in the artboard's order — Best next
 * action, the rows, Needs attention, then the timeline (kept last, decision
 * 5). A row is the 56px card: ring · name + pill · countdown, the action
 * row folded under it. The 72px ring mount scales to 56px through its
 * viewBox (decision 3).
 */
@media (max-width: 820px) {
  .ledger-page {
    gap: 16px;
  }

  .ledger-date-long {
    display: none;
  }

  .ledger-date-short {
    display: inline;
  }

  .ledger {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 12px;
  }

  .ledger-aside {
    display: contents;
  }

  .ledger-next-action {
    order: -1;
    padding: 16px;
  }

  .ledger-rows {
    order: 0;
  }

  .ledger-attention {
    order: 1;
  }

  .ledger-timeline {
    order: 2;
  }

  .ledger-next-action-title {
    font-size: var(--text-lg);
  }

  .ledger-row {
    grid-template-columns: 56px minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    grid-template-areas:
      "ring main count"
      "action action action";
    gap: 12px 14px;
    padding: 14px;
  }

  .ledger-row .cycle-ring[data-size="72"] {
    grid-area: ring;
    width: 3.5rem;
    height: 3.5rem;
  }

  .ledger-row-main {
    grid-area: main;
    gap: 4px;
  }

  .ledger-row-title {
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .ledger-row-name {
    font-size: var(--text-md);
  }

  .ledger-row-issuer,
  .ledger-row-credits .credit-bar {
    display: none;
  }

  .ledger-row-countdown {
    grid-area: count;
  }

  .ledger-row-days {
    font-size: var(--text-2xl);
  }

  .ledger-row-date {
    display: none;
  }

  .ledger-row-action {
    grid-area: action;
    flex-direction: row;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 10px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
    padding-top: 10px;
  }

  .ledger-row-hint {
    text-align: left;
  }

  .ledger-card {
    padding: 14px;
  }

  .attention-row {
    gap: 10px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 540px) {
  .ledger-row-action .btn {
    flex: 1 0 auto;
  }

Gotchas for the executor: `CycleRing`'s completion moment is per instance — every row ring carries `key={credential.id}`, and its `valueText` speaks the CYCLE word (`stateOf`), never `ringStateOf`'s "renewed" on an open cycle (`instruments.spec.ts` pins `100%, overdue`). `.section-kicker`, `.card`, `.card-heading`, `.view-stack`, `.button*` and `.desktop-only` stay in `legacy-shared.css`/`shell.css` — Credentials, the Activity log and Account still render them until Tasks 9, 11 and 16; Home just stops using them. `formatDate` returns "Not set" for `null`: the mono date cell only ever receives `credential.deadline` or a `submittedAt` that `markSubmitted` always sets (the `?? today` guards are for the type, not for data). Lead days `[90, 30, 7, 1]` mean any deadline ≤ 90 days out yields a deadline check-in, and a custom credential's managed tasks yield task check-ins the moment their own lead window opens — the seeded due-soon credential in `home.spec.ts` therefore shows three check-ins, its overdue task rows first. The demo identity is read-only; every seeded describe uses `freshIdentity()` in its own describe (a file-level identity would let one test's overdue rows fill the next test's three visible check-ins). `tests/e2e/home.spec.ts`'s demo assertions are date-bound like every demo pin: the row's action reads "Log activity" while the demo's open tasks are not overdue (until 2026-10-31) and its pill "Due soon" while the deadline is inside 90 days (until 2026-11-30). The `page.route` delay in the pending case slows only `POST /api/workspace`; the `GET` refetch is untouched, so the toast still lands within the assertion's 10 s. `onAnimationEnd` bubbles: the `animationName === "ledger-fold"` guard is what keeps a row's `CycleRing` check-draw (`cycle-ring-check-draw`) from clearing the fold marker.
