### Task 9: Credentials list: search (name/issuer/profession/jurisdiction) + seven-state filter over filterCredentials, link rows with 40px ring, folded past cycles, functional H1, credentials.css rewritten, credentials.spec rewritten

**Rationale:** spec §6 — "**Credentials**: list with search and state filter" — and the §6 copy rules ("functional screens have functional H1s"; "credits that count"). app-ux-18 (P3, carry into redesign): "Renewed cycles pile into the Credentials list as near-duplicates with only a bare percentage … No due date, days left or next step on any row; 'history' is the only marker for the closed cycle" — recommendation "group cycles under one credential row (active cycle up front, '2 past cycles' disclosure), and show due date + days left + credits on the row". app-ux-11 (P2): "Page H1s are taglines rather than screen names" — `app/ITrackApp.tsx:7566` is `title="Every renewal, one clear place."` with the eyebrow "Credentials" above it; "screen H1 = screen name". Today the list is `CredentialsView` (`app/ITrackApp.tsx:7531-7662` at main `c6b1fe4`): a `<section className="credential-picker credential-list" aria-label="Your credentials">` of `<button>` rows (`:7577-7642`) whose small print reads `{jurisdiction} · {cycleStatusLabel} · Due {date} · {n} days left` and whose only figure is a bare `${credentialProgress(lead)}%` (`:7602-7606`); the past cycles fold under an `archived-items previous-cycles` disclosure of `button.archived-item`s (`:7609-7635`); an `add-picker` "Add another credential" duplicates the header action (`:7641-7644`); there is no search and no state filter, and `workspace.archivedCredentials` never reaches the screen (`:4122-4127` passes `workspace.credentials` only). `app/styles/credentials.css` (123 lines) is the verbatim Wave 3 move on five legacy aliases (`--edge-accent-soft`, `--white`, `--ink-tint-quiet`, `--ink-soft`, `--line-soft`) plus the hover box-shadow rule at `:92-96`. This task moves the screen to `app/screens/Credentials.tsx` on the primitives and the instruments, gives it the search and the seven-state filter over Task 7's `filterCredentials`, makes every row a real link with a 40 px `CycleRing`, a `StatusPill`, a `CreditBar` and a countdown, folds the past cycles as links under the row, renames the H1 to "Credentials", rewrites the stylesheet on first-class tokens and rewrites `tests/e2e/credentials.spec.ts` to prove search, every filter state including Archived, and both empty states in all four projects.

**Decisions this task fixes (each has a test below):** (1) The state filter is a plain native `Select` — seven options is under `SEARCHABLE_OPTION_COUNT` (12), so no search box grows in front of it; it is one focus stop and forced-colours-safe by construction; no segmented control exists in the system and seven segments do not fit 390 px. (2) "Archived" is an option on this list (Home's "Archived (n)" footer lands here, Task 8 decision 11) AND the Activity log keeps its archived-credentials section (spec §6) — both read the same server split (`workspace.archivedCredentials`). (3) Search covers name, issuer, profession and jurisdiction (users search by state); every whitespace-separated token must match, case-insensitively (Task 7's `credentialMatchesQuery`). (4) Rows are links: `isPlainLeftClick` → `event.preventDefault(); store.openCredentialDetail(id)`; a modified click or a middle click falls through to the browser with the real `href`. (5) The query and the state are React state (`useState`), never the URL; they reset when the screen unmounts (the URL contract is unchanged; history is written only by `useNavigation`). (6) `today` is `store.today()`; the clock (`store.nowMs()`) is read once inside the listing memo — never in render (`react-hooks/purity`) — so every row keys its state on one instant. (7) The ring column is `2.5rem` wide, not the mockup's `40px`: `instruments.css` sizes `.cycle-ring[data-size="40"]` at `2.5rem` so it follows the root font size, and a fixed 40 px column would clip it under a larger browser font. (8) The two "Add credential" buttons on the empty page (the header's and the `EmptyState`'s) are deliberate — the header action is constant across every state of the screen — so every locator on that button is scoped (`main`, `.empty-state`); `primitives.spec.ts:55` already uses `.first()`.

```ts
import type { Page } from "@playwright/test";
import { expect, freshIdentity, test } from "./fixtures";

// The Credentials list (spec §6 "Credentials: list with search and state
// filter"; app-ux-11, app-ux-18): one link row per credential — its open
// cycle, or the newest renewed one — with a 40 px ring, the state pill, the
// credits bar and a countdown, the past cycles folded under the row as links
// of their own; a search box over name, issuer, profession and jurisdiction;
// a native select over the seven states; the functional H1 "Credentials".
// The demo workspace is read-only; every describe that writes seeds its own
// identity — one describe per identity, so rows never leak between tests.
// Four projects.

const isoDaysFromToday = (days: number) =>
  new Date(Date.now() + days * 86_400_000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);

const list = (page: Page) => page.getByRole("list", { name: "Your credentials" });
// The count line is the screen's own role="status"; the toast region and the
// zone banner carry that role too, so it is located by its class.
const count = (page: Page) => page.locator("p.credentials-count");
const stateFilter = (page: Page) => page.getByRole("combobox", { name: "Show" });
const search = (page: Page) => page.getByRole("searchbox", { name: "Search" });
// The header's "Add credential" is constant; the empty page adds a second one
// inside the EmptyState, so both are always scoped.
const addCredential = (page: Page) =>
  page.getByRole("main").getByRole("button", { name: "Add credential", exact: true });

test("the list is one link row per credential with a ring, a pill, the credits and a countdown; Add credential opens the setup sheet", async ({ page, app }) => {
  await app.goto("/credentials");
  await expect(page).toHaveTitle("Credentials · iTrack");
  await expect(app.tab("Credentials")).toHaveAttribute("aria-current", "page");
  // A functional H1 (app-ux-11): the screen's name.
  await expect(
    page.getByRole("main").getByRole("heading", { level: 1, name: "Credentials", exact: true }),
  ).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole("search", { name: "Filter credentials" })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(count(page)).toHaveAttribute("role", "status");
  await expect(count(page)).toHaveText("1 credential");
  const row = list(page).getByRole("link", { name: /Licensed Clinical Social Worker/ });
  await expect(row).toHaveCount(1);
  await expect(row).toHaveAttribute("href", /^\/credentials\/[^/]+$/);
  // The demo LCSW is due 2026-11-30, inside DUE_SOON_DAYS: the pill says so
  // and the row wears the decorative due-soon edge.
  await expect(row.locator(".status-pill")).toHaveText("Due soon");
  await expect(list(page).locator("li.credential-row")).toHaveAttribute("data-state", "due-soon");
  // The ring is a progressbar with a numeric value (5 of 40 credits → 13);
  // the bar beside it counts the credits; the text says it in words.
  await expect(
    row.getByRole("progressbar", { name: "Licensed Clinical Social Worker: 13% of credits counted" }),
  ).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuenow", "13");
  await expect(
    row.getByRole("progressbar", { name: "Licensed Clinical Social Worker: 5 of 40 credits" }),
  ).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuenow", "5");
  await expect(row.locator(".credential-row-credits")).toHaveText("5 of 40 credits count");
  await expect(row.locator(".credential-row-meta")).toHaveText(
    "New Jersey · New Jersey State Board of Social Work Examiners",
  );
  await expect(row.locator(".credential-row-countdown strong")).toHaveText(/^\d+$/);
  await expect(row.locator(".credential-row-countdown")).toContainText("days left");
  await expect(row.locator(".credential-row-countdown")).toContainText("Due Nov 30, 2026");
  // No past cycles on the demo credential: nothing folds under the row.
  await expect(list(page).locator("details")).toHaveCount(0);
  await addCredential(page).click();
  await expect(app.dialog("Add a credential")).toBeVisible();
  app.expectNoErrors();
});

test("the template chooser groups templates by profession and a miss offers the custom path", async ({ page, app }) => {
  await app.goto("/credentials");
  await addCredential(page).click();
  const sheet = app.dialog("Add a credential");
  const templates = sheet.getByRole("combobox", { name: "Profession, credential, and state" });
  // The catalog is fetched when the sheet opens; the first optgroup is the
  // proof it arrived and is grouped by profession.
  await expect(templates.locator("optgroup").first()).toBeAttached({ timeout: 15_000 });
  await templates.selectOption({ index: 1 });
  await expect(templates).not.toHaveValue("");
  // Typing a new search drops the template that was chosen: the search and
  // the choice are one control, never two disagreeing ones.
  const templateSearch = sheet.getByPlaceholder("Search profession, license, certification, or state");
  await templateSearch.fill("zzzz");
  await expect(templates).toHaveValue("");
  await expect(templates.locator("optgroup")).toHaveCount(0);
  await expect(sheet.getByText("0 matches")).toBeVisible();
  await sheet
    .getByRole("button", { name: "No exact match — enter my own requirements" })
    .click();
  await expect(sheet.locator('input[name="credentialName"]')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(sheet.locator('input[name="totalRequired"]')).toBeVisible();
  app.expectNoErrors();
});

test.describe("state filter", () => {
  test.use({ identity: freshIdentity() });

  test("narrows by cycle state, and Archived lists only archived credentials", async ({ page, app }) => {
    // Two far deadlines (on track — date-relative, so the test never drifts
    // into "due soon" as the calendar advances); later one inside the 90-day window.
    const alpha = await app.seedCredential({
      credentialName: "E2E Alpha counseling",
      issuer: "Alpha board",
      deadline: isoDaysFromToday(500),
    });
    await app.seedCredential({
      credentialName: "E2E Beta nursing",
      profession: "Nursing",
      issuer: "Beta board",
      deadline: isoDaysFromToday(400),
    });
    await app.goto("/credentials");
    await expect(stateFilter(page)).toHaveValue("all");
    // The seven options, in the copy table's order.
    await expect(stateFilter(page).locator("option")).toHaveText([
      "All",
      "Overdue",
      "Due soon",
      "On track",
      "Submitted",
      "No cycle",
      "Archived",
    ]);
    await stateFilter(page).selectOption("due-soon");
    await expect(list(page)).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(
      page.locator(".empty-state.empty-state-compact").getByRole("heading", { level: 2, name: "No credentials match" }),
    ).toBeVisible();
    await expect(count(page)).toHaveText("0 of 2 credentials");
    await stateFilter(page).selectOption("on-track");
    await expect(list(page).getByRole("link")).toHaveCount(2);
    await expect(count(page)).toHaveText("2 of 2 credentials");

    // A third credential due in 20 days is the only due-soon row. The filter
    // is React state: a reload starts on "All" again.
    await app.seedCredential({ credentialName: "E2E Soon", deadline: isoDaysFromToday(20) });
    await app.goto("/credentials");
    await expect(stateFilter(page)).toHaveValue("all");
    await expect(count(page)).toHaveText("3 credentials");
    await stateFilter(page).selectOption("due-soon");
    const soon = list(page).getByRole("link", { name: /E2E Soon/ });
    await expect(soon).toHaveCount(1);
    await expect(list(page).getByRole("link")).toHaveCount(1);
    await expect(soon.locator(".status-pill")).toHaveText("Due soon");
    await expect(count(page)).toHaveText("1 of 3 credentials");

    // Archive Alpha behind the page's back: "All" and every cycle state hide
    // it; "Archived" shows only it, with its own pill and count.
    const revision =
      (await app.workspace()).credentials.find((credential) => credential.id === alpha.id)?.revision ?? 1;
    await app.act("archiveCredential", { credentialId: alpha.id, expectedRevision: revision });
    await app.goto("/credentials");
    await expect(list(page).getByRole("link")).toHaveCount(2);
    await expect(list(page).getByRole("link", { name: /E2E Alpha counseling/ })).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(count(page)).toHaveText("2 credentials");
    await stateFilter(page).selectOption("archived");
    const archivedRow = list(page).getByRole("link", { name: /E2E Alpha counseling/ });
    await expect(archivedRow).toHaveCount(1);
    await expect(list(page).getByRole("link")).toHaveCount(1);
    await expect(archivedRow.locator(".status-pill")).toHaveText("Archived");
    await expect(list(page).locator("li.credential-row")).toHaveAttribute("data-archived", "true");
    await expect(count(page)).toHaveText("1 archived");
    // The search still applies inside the archived partition.
    await search(page).fill("beta");
    await expect(list(page)).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(count(page)).toHaveText("0 archived");
    app.expectNoErrors();
  });
});

});
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Create `app/screens/credentials/CredentialRow.tsx`**

The row is one `<li>` wrapping one link — the whole row is the link, with a real `href` so a modified click, a bookmark or a copy works without the client router — followed by the folded past cycles. It renders nothing that `CredentialsView` (`app/ITrackApp.tsx:7587-7638`) rendered: the `button`, the `credential-picker` classes, the bare `picker-progress` percentage, `cycleStatusLabel`/`cycleCountdownLabel` (`:7504-7530`, now in `app/lib/format.ts` and unused by this screen) and the `archived-items previous-cycles` disclosure are all replaced. Block content inside the link is `div`/`p` (an `a` is transparent, so flow content is legal in it; a `div` inside a `span` is not), which also keeps the instruments' own `div` roots valid.

```tsx
"use client";

import type { MouseEvent } from "react";
import { Icon } from "../../components/Icon";
import { isPlainLeftClick } from "../../components/NavItem";
import { CreditBar } from "../../components/instruments/CreditBar";
import { CycleRing } from "../../components/instruments/CycleRing";
import { StatusPill } from "../../components/instruments/StatusPill";
import { cycleCountdown, type CycleSeries } from "../../lib/cycles";
import { compactNumber, formatDate } from "../../lib/format";
import {
  ringStateOf,
  ringValueOf,
  stateOf,
  type InstrumentState,
} from "../../lib/instruments";
import { credentialProgress, readinessScore } from "../../lib/readiness";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../lib/workspaceStore";
import type { Credential } from "../../lib/workspaceTypes";

/*
 * One row of the Credentials list (spec §6; app-ux-18): a credential's open
 * cycle — or, when every cycle is renewed, the newest of them — as a link to
 * /credentials/:id, with its past cycles folded underneath as links of their
 * own. The whole row is the link (a real href: a modified click is the
 * browser's); the ring, the pill, the bar and the countdown are its content,
 * so its accessible name is the row's text and a substring match on the
 * credential name finds it. `nowMs` is read once by the screen, never here
 * (react-hooks/purity), so every row keys its state on the same instant.
 */
export function CredentialRow({
  series,
  nowMs,
}: {
  series: CycleSeries<Credential>;
  nowMs: number;
}) {
  const store = useWorkspace();
  const lead: Credential | undefined = series.current ?? series.previous[0];
  if (!lead) return null;
  // The pill and the row edge speak the CYCLE word; the ring and the bar
  // speak credits (a credits-complete ring on an open cycle reads complete
  // while its pill still says the cycle's state — instruments.ts ringStateOf).
  const state: InstrumentState = series.current
    ? stateOf(series.current, nowMs)
    : "none";
  const ringState: InstrumentState = series.current
    ? ringStateOf(series.current, nowMs)
    : "none";
  const archived = Boolean(lead.archivedAt);
  const ring = ringValueOf(lead);
  const countdown = cycleCountdown(lead, nowMs);
  const pastCycles = series.previous.filter((previous) => previous.id !== lead.id);
  const name = lead.credentialName;

  const open = (id: string) => (event: MouseEvent<HTMLAnchorElement>) => {
    if (!isPlainLeftClick(event)) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    store.openCredentialDetail(id);
  };

  return (
    <li
      className="credential-row"
      data-state={state}
      data-archived={archived || undefined}
    >
      <a
        className="credential-row-link"
        href={`/credentials/${lead.id}`}
        onClick={open(lead.id)}
      >
        <CycleRing
          key={lead.id}
          size={40}
          fraction={ring.fraction}
          percent={ring.percent}
          state={ringState}
          label={`${name}: ${ring.percent}% ${
            ring.basis === "credits" ? "of credits counted" : "ready"
          }`}
        />
        <div className="credential-row-text">
          <div className="credential-row-title">
            <strong>{name}</strong>
            {archived ? (
              <StatusPill state="none">Archived</StatusPill>
            ) : (
              <StatusPill state={state} />
            )}
          </div>
          <p className="credential-row-meta">
            {lead.jurisdiction}
            {lead.issuer ? ` · ${lead.issuer}` : ""}
          </p>
          {lead.totalRequired > 0 ? (
            <>
              <CreditBar
                counted={lead.totalEarned}
                required={lead.totalRequired}
                state={state}
                label={`${name}: ${compactNumber(lead.totalEarned)} of ${compactNumber(
                  lead.totalRequired,
                )} ${lead.unitLabel}`}
              />
              <p className="credential-row-credits">
                <strong>
                  {compactNumber(lead.totalEarned)} of {compactNumber(lead.totalRequired)}
                </strong>{" "}
                {lead.unitLabel} count
              </p>
            </>
          ) : (
            <p className="credential-row-credits">
              <strong>{readinessScore(lead)}%</strong> ready · no credit total
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="credential-row-countdown">
          {countdown.kind === "closed" ? (
            <>
              <small>Renewed</small>
              <span>{formatDate(countdown.acceptedAt)}</span>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <strong>{Math.abs(countdown.days)}</strong>
              <small>{countdown.kind === "overdue" ? "days overdue" : "days left"}</small>
              <span>Due {formatDate(lead.deadline)}</span>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </a>
      {pastCycles.length ? (
        <details className="credential-row-history">
          <summary>
            {pastCycles.length} previous {pastCycles.length === 1 ? "cycle" : "cycles"}
            <Icon name="chevronDown" size={16} />
          </summary>
          <ul>
            {pastCycles.map((previous) => (
              <li key={previous.id}>
                <a href={`/credentials/${previous.id}`} onClick={open(previous.id)}>
                  <strong>Renewed {formatDate(previous.acceptedAt)}</strong>
                  <span>
                    {formatDate(previous.cycleStart)} – {formatDate(previous.deadline)} ·{" "}
                    {credentialProgress(previous)}%
                  </span>
                </a>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </details>
      ) : null}
    </li>
  );
}
```

Why these exact expressions: `series.current ?? series.previous[0]` and `pastCycles` are `CredentialsView`'s own (`:7583-7586`); `groupCycles` guarantees a series with any open cycle has `current` set (`app/lib/cycles.ts:83-93` rule 2 picks an open cycle before any renewed one), so the `if (!lead) return null` guard only covers a shape the server never sends. `ringValueOf` is the list's own rule moved to `app/lib/instruments.ts:188-199` in Wave 3 ("the Credentials list's rule"). The bar's `state` is the cycle word so a due-soon row's bar reads due-soon; `CreditBar` turns complete on its own once counted reaches required (`CreditBar.tsx:17-25`). `formatDate(countdown.acceptedAt)` never receives `null` on a closed cycle (`markRenewalAccepted` always sets `acceptedAt`); "Due {date}" keeps the substring `renewed-cycle-home.spec.ts` checks. The `key={lead.id}` on the ring is `CycleRing.tsx:42-47`'s rule: an accepted renewal replaces the row's lead in place, and a different credential must be a fresh mount, never a completion.

- [ ] **Step 6: Create `app/screens/Credentials.tsx`**

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "../components/Button";
import { EmptyState } from "../components/EmptyState";
import { Field, Select, TextInput } from "../components/Form";
import { Icon } from "../components/Icon";
import { PageHeader } from "../components/PageHeader";
import {
  CREDENTIAL_FILTER_OPTIONS,
  filterCredentials,
  type CredentialFilter,
  type CredentialFilterState,
} from "../lib/credentialFilters";
import type { SelectOption } from "../lib/selectFilter";
import { useWorkspace } from "../lib/workspaceStore";
import type { Credential } from "../lib/workspaceTypes";
import { CredentialRow } from "./credentials/CredentialRow";

/*
 * The Credentials screen (spec §6 "Credentials: list with search and state
 * filter"; app-ux-11, app-ux-18). One link row per credential over
 * app/lib/credentialFilters.ts; a search box over name, issuer, profession
 * and jurisdiction; a native select over the seven states — seven options is
 * under the Select primitive's search threshold, so it stays one focus stop
 * and forced colours draw it by construction. The query and the state are
 * React state: they reset when the screen unmounts and never touch the URL.
 * The clock is read inside the listing memo, never in render
 * (react-hooks/purity), so every row keys its state on one instant.
 */

// The Select primitive takes a mutable SelectOption[]; the options constant is
// readonly.
const FILTER_OPTIONS: SelectOption[] = CREDENTIAL_FILTER_OPTIONS.map((option) => ({
  value: option.value,
  label: option.label,
}));

const NO_CREDENTIALS: readonly Credential[] = [];

// Home's ledger footer asks for the Archived filter under this name
// (app/screens/Home.tsx: store.requestFocus("archived-filter")).
const ARCHIVED_FILTER_FOCUS = "archived-filter";

// The count line (copy table C): the plain count, "n of total" once the query
// or the state has narrowed the active credentials, or the archived count.
function countCopy(shown: number, unfiltered: number, filter: CredentialFilter): string {
  if (filter.state === "archived") return `${shown} archived`;
  if (filter.query.trim() !== "" || filter.state !== "all") {
    return `${shown} of ${unfiltered} credentials`;
  }
  return shown === 1 ? "1 credential" : `${shown} credentials`;
}

export function Credentials() {
  const store = useWorkspace();
  const { workspace, focusRequest, requestFocus } = store;
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [state, setState] = useState<CredentialFilterState>("all");
  const stateFieldRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const today = store.today();

  const credentials = workspace?.credentials ?? NO_CREDENTIALS;
  const archivedCredentials = workspace?.archivedCredentials ?? NO_CREDENTIALS;
  const all = useMemo(
    () => [...credentials, ...archivedCredentials],
    [credentials, archivedCredentials],
  );

  // One clock read per listing — the rows and the filter agree on the
  // instant, and nothing reads Date.now() in render. `unfiltered` is the
  // active pool the count line's "n of total" names, computed from the same
  // clock rather than trusted from the listing's own `total`.
  const { listing, unfiltered, nowMs } = useMemo(() => {
    const now = store.nowMs();
    const clock = { today, nowMs: now };
    return {
      nowMs: now,
      listing: filterCredentials(all, { query, state }, clock),
      unfiltered: filterCredentials(all, { query: "", state: "all" }, clock).series.length,
    };
  }, [all, query, state, today, store]);

  // Home's "Archived (n)" footer (Task 8): the filter flips to Archived and
  // the select takes focus — deferred, as every state-setting effect is, so
  // it lands after the screen has painted (and after PageHeader's own heading
  // focus, which runs first as a child effect) — then the request is consumed
  // so a later visit starts on "All".
  useEffect(() => {
    if (focusRequest !== ARCHIVED_FILTER_FOCUS) return;
    const handle = window.setTimeout(() => {
      setState("archived");
      stateFieldRef.current?.querySelector("select")?.focus();
      requestFocus(null);
    }, 0);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(handle);
  }, [focusRequest, requestFocus]);

  if (!workspace) return null;

  const openSetup = () => store.modals.open({ kind: "credentialSetup" });
  const clear = () => {
    setQuery("");
    setState("all");
  };
  const empty = credentials.length + archivedCredentials.length === 0;

  return (
    <div className="screen credentials-screen">
      <PageHeader
        title="Credentials"
        lede="Every credential you track, with its current cycle."
        actions={
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            icon={<Icon name="plus" size={16} />}
            onClick={openSetup}
          >
            Add credential
          </Button>
        }
      />
      {empty ? (
        <EmptyState
          title="Add your first credential"
          body="Choose a source-linked rule template or make a custom plan from your credential information."
          action={{ label: "Add credential", onClick: openSetup }}
        />
      ) : (
        <>
          <div
            className="credentials-toolbar"
            role="search"
            aria-label="Filter credentials"
          >
            <Field label="Search">
              <TextInput
                type="search"
                name="credentialSearch"
                value={query}
                placeholder="Name, issuer, profession, or state"
                autoComplete="off"
                onChange={(event) => {
                  const next = event.currentTarget.value;
                  setQuery(next);
                }}
              />
            </Field>
            <div ref={stateFieldRef}>
              <Field label="Show">
                <Select
                  name="credentialState"
                  value={state}
                  options={FILTER_OPTIONS}
                  onChange={(event) => {
                    const next = event.currentTarget.value as CredentialFilterState;
                    setState(next);
                  }}
                />
              </Field>
            </div>
          </div>
          <p className="credentials-count" role="status">
            {countCopy(listing.series.length, unfiltered, { query, state })}
          </p>
          {listing.series.length ? (
            <ul className="credential-list" aria-label="Your credentials">
              {listing.series.map((series) => (
                <CredentialRow key={series.seriesId} series={series} nowMs={nowMs} />
              ))}
            </ul>
          ) : (
            <EmptyState
              compact
              title="No credentials match"
              body="Try another name, or clear the filter."
              action={{ label: "Clear filters", onClick: clear }}
            />
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

Notes on what the lint rules see here: every hook runs before the `if (!workspace) return null` (rules-of-hooks); the two `onChange` handlers read `event.currentTarget.value` into a local before the plain `setX(next)` call — never inside a functional updater (the `no state updater reads event.currentTarget` guard); `stateFieldRef.current` is read only inside the timeout (react-hooks/refs); the effect's only state write sits inside `window.setTimeout(…, 0)` (react-hooks/set-state-in-effect, the house pattern); the memo's dependency list names everything its body reads and nothing else (exhaustive-deps flags an unused declared dependency on `useMemo`, so the clock is read inside the memo rather than memoised separately against `workspace`). The `Select` gets no `ref` — `SelectProps` is `ComponentPropsWithoutRef<"select">` — so the one `querySelector("select")` inside the wrapper the screen owns is the focus path; no DOM id crosses a file boundary (architecture-14). The search input is never `autoFocus`ed: `PageHeader` owns the focus target on route entry, and `primitives.spec.ts:55` still expects `input[type="search"]` to be the setup dialog's autofocus field (the template chooser's search), not this one.

- [ ] **Step 7: Replace the whole of `app/styles/credentials.css`**

Every colour is a first-class token with a claim in `tokens.css` for the pairing it is used in — `--ink`/`--ink-muted` on `--card` (17.1:1 / 6.8:1), `--accent` on `--card` (8.0:1), `--focus-ring` on `--card` (mark); `--edge-due-soon` and `--line` are decorative edges; the state colours come from the instruments' own classes. Every `font-size` is a `var(--text-*)`; no transition (the chevron rotates instantly; rows never react to hover beyond the title underline — the design system reserves hover tints for controls). The mockup's row anatomy (ring · text · countdown) is kept at the 40 px scale.

```css
/* Credentials — app/screens/Credentials.tsx (Wave 4 Task 9): the searchable,
 * filterable list of link rows with a credential's past cycles folded under
 * its row. First-class tokens only; no colour literal, no px font-size, no
 * transition. The due-soon row edge is decorative — the pill carries the word. */

.credentials-screen {
  display: grid;
  gap: 22px;
}

/* The toolbar: the search grows, the state select keeps a fixed width; both
   sit on their baseline so the two labels line up. */
.credentials-toolbar {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 220px;
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: end;
}

.credentials-count {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
}

.credential-list {
  display: grid;
  gap: 12px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.credential-row {
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background: var(--card);
}

.credential-row[data-state="due-soon"] {
  border-color: var(--edge-due-soon);
}

/* An archived row keeps the neutral hairline whatever its cycle state was. */
.credential-row[data-archived="true"] {
  border-color: var(--line);
}

/* The whole row is one link: ring · text · countdown. The ring column is the
   instrument's own width (2.5rem — instruments.css .cycle-ring[data-size="40"]),
   so it follows the root font size instead of clipping at a fixed 40px. */
.credential-row-link {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 2.5rem minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  gap: 16px;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: var(--tap-comfortable);
  padding: 16px 20px;
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.credential-row-link:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring);
  outline-offset: 2px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
}

.credential-row-link:hover .credential-row-title strong {
  text-decoration: underline;
}

.credential-row-text {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.credential-row-title {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

.credential-row-title strong {
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: var(--text-lg);
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-display);
  line-height: 1.2;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.credential-row-meta {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
}

.credential-row-credits {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.credential-row-credits strong {
  color: var(--ink);
  font-weight: 500;
}

/* The countdown: a display numeral, an eyebrow-styled word, a mono date. */
.credential-row-countdown {
  display: grid;
  justify-items: end;
  text-align: right;
}

.credential-row-countdown strong {
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: var(--text-2xl);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-display);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.credential-row-countdown small {
  margin-top: 4px;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-2xs);
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-eyebrow);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.credential-row-countdown span {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

/* Past cycles fold under the row: a disclosure whose summary is a 44px
   control, then one link per cycle, line-separated. The chevron rotates
   instantly — no transition. */
.credential-row-history {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.credential-row-history > summary {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  min-height: var(--tap-min);
  padding: 8px 20px;
  color: var(--accent);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: 700;
  list-style: none;
}

.credential-row-history > summary::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}

.credential-row-history[open] > summary .icon {
  transform: rotate(180deg);
}

.credential-row-history ul {
  display: grid;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.credential-row-history a {
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
  min-height: var(--tap-min);
  padding: 10px 20px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.credential-row-history li:last-child a {
  border-bottom: 0;
}

.credential-row-history a strong {
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
}

.credential-row-history a:hover strong {
  text-decoration: underline;
}

.credential-row-history a span {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

/* Phone: the toolbar stacks; the countdown drops under the text as one
   baseline-aligned line; the row keeps its ring column. */
@media (max-width: 820px) {
  .credentials-toolbar {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .credential-row-link {
    grid-template-columns: 2.5rem minmax(0, 1fr);
    padding: 14px 16px;
  }

  .credential-row-countdown {
    grid-column: 2;
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 4px 8px;
    justify-items: start;
    text-align: left;
  }

  .credential-row-countdown small {
    margin-top: 0;
  }

  .credential-row-history > summary,
  .credential-row-history a {
    padding-left: 16px;
    padding-right: 16px;
  }
}
```

**Gotchas for the implementer:**
- A link's accessible name is its whole content, the ring's and the bar's `aria-label`s included (both roles are excluded from name-from-content only as embedded controls in a label, which these are not), so a row's name reads "Licensed Clinical Social Worker: 13% of credits counted Licensed Clinical Social Worker Due soon New Jersey · … 5 of 40 credits count 75 days left Due Nov 30, 2026". Every row locator therefore uses a regex or an un-`exact` string (a substring match on the credential name) — never `exact: true` on a row link.
- `groupCycles`/`filterCredentials` are the only sanctioned current-cycle logic: the screen never writes `!== "renewed"` or compares `status` (`tests/app-source-guards.test.mjs` bans it outside `app/lib/cycles.ts`); `stateOf`/`ringStateOf` take the series' `current`, and a series with no open cycle is `"none"` — the pill reads "No cycle" and the countdown "Renewed {date}".
- The `data-state` on the `li` is the cycle word even on an archived row (the filter partitions by `archivedAt`, not by state); the stylesheet's `[data-archived="true"]` rule restores the neutral hairline so a due-soon edge never decorates an archived row, and the pill says "Archived" whatever the state.
- The `Select` primitive renders the search input only at ≥ 12 options; the seven-option filter is a bare `<select>` (role `combobox`, `selectOption` by value) — an e2e that reaches for `input[type="search"]` on this page finds the header sheet's chooser, not the filter.
- `tests/contrast-audit.test.mjs`'s alias test scans `credentials.css` from this commit: one `var(--white)`, `var(--line-soft)` or `var(--edge-accent-soft)` left in the rewritten file fails the build by name. The `.archived-items` family, `.disclosure-chevron` and `.view-stack` stay in `legacy-shared.css` for the Activity log and Account until Tasks 11/16/18 — this screen stops using them and must not delete them; `.picker-progress` at `legacy-shared.css:684` is one selector of a grouped rule and goes with the file in Task 18.
- The `from Home` test needs Task 8's ledger footer (`Archived (n)` → `requestFocus("archived-filter")`); the screen's effect is harmless without it (the request never arrives). `PageHeader` focuses its `h1` on every navigation in a child effect; the screen's own effect runs after it and defers through `window.setTimeout(…, 0)`, which is why the select — not the heading — ends up focused.
- `docs/DESIGN-SYSTEM.md` still names `credentials.css` among the seven alias-allowed files; Task 19 rewrites that paragraph with the rest of the docs — do not edit it here.

**Rationale:** spec §6 "Log activity" is the only screen bullet that prescribes a shape: "two steps. Essentials (title, completion date defaulting to local today, credits, credentials/requirements, evidence drop zone) then optional details (provider, format, notes, allocator for NREMT/CRC). Save is always visible (sticky footer). Certificate OCR becomes a secondary 'Scan a certificate' action that states the 4.5 MB one-time download (perf-07, app-ux-20)." Today (main @c6b1fe4, moved verbatim by Task 5 into `app/screens/modals/LogActivityModal.tsx`) the sheet is one flat `form.form-stack` of 19 controls (25+ for NREMT/CRC) whose Cancel/Save row sits below the fold on a 900 px desktop (app-ux-06, `app/ITrackApp.tsx:4221-4684`), led by a `section.certificate-capture` whose two file inputs auto-run OCR the moment a photo is chosen (`handleActivityEvidenceSelection` `:2674-2836`), pulling ≈ 4.45 MB from `/ocr/` on first use with no disclosure (perf-07) and reading only conventionally labelled certificates (app-ux-20); it validates with native bubbles and `required` alone (a11y-09 — one `aria-invalid` at `:4507` in the whole client), it renders the global `error` string through `ModalError` while the page banner shows the same sentence (app-ux-24, `:4649-4654`), its title "Log completed learning" is one of seven labels for the same verb (app-ux-12), the sentence at `:4538-4541` names the retired "Today" tab (app-ux-14), and Escape on a dirty sheet closes it without a confirm — the Wave 3 reviewer minor: `Modal.tsx`'s `onEscape` (`app/components/Modal.tsx:198-209`) calls `onCloseRef.current()` unconditionally, the dirty check (`:236-244`) runs for backdrop presses only. The edit variant `ActivityEditorModal` (`:8569-8844`, "Edit learning record") still reads `label.field`/`.switch-row` markup and says "proof" and "History". This task rewrites the sheet on the primitives as one `<form>` with an Essentials step and a Details disclosure under a footer whose primary is the one verb, moves the OCR behind an explicit button and a nested notice that names the download, gives the sheet one validation pattern (`app/lib/logActivityForm.ts`), a discard prompt that fires only for input the browser draft cannot keep, and its own error state; restyles the three allocators and the picker on `Checkbox`/`TextInput`; renames and rebuilds the editor as `EditActivityModal` ("Edit activity"); and replaces `app/styles/log-activity.css` whole on first-class tokens (its `transition: width 180ms ease` at `:614` — the fifth legacy duration literal — dies with it).

**Decisions:** (1) Step 2 is a DISCLOSURE inside one `<form>`, not a wizard: Save from step 1 alone is a spec requirement; `Modal.tsx` takes its FormData dirty snapshot of the dialog's first `<form>` at mount (`:152-153`) and its Tab trap cycles one dialog (`:155-195`); the three payload builders (`crcRequirementMatchPayload`, `crcApprovalPayload`, `nremtRequirementMatchPayload` in Task 1's `app/lib/allocation.ts`) read `FormData` and are called unchanged. Every Details control is mounted from the start and the section is hidden with the `hidden` attribute — never `disabled` (which drops fields from FormData and from submit), never unmounted (which would make the snapshot read dirty on open). For NREMT/CRC credentials Details is forced open and the toggle renders `disabled` with the "Required for …" tag. (2) The primary is "Log activity" (new) and "Save changes" (edit): copy table E. (3) The sheet owns its credential locally — `useState` seeded from `store.modals.activityPreselectId`, else the restored draft's credential, else `workspace.activeCycleId` when it is an open cycle, else the first open cycle; nothing app-wide moves while the sheet is open (architecture-05, closed in Task 5). (4) The discard confirm fires only for unrecoverable input (`hasUnrecoverableInput`: a file, allocator amounts, requirement tags, format, notes, a CRC reference) — title/date/credits/credential/provider persist in the browser draft, so `tests/e2e/primitives.spec.ts:30-47` (Escape closes a title-dirty sheet) stays true and is not edited. The prompt is spelled `{discardPrompt && (<Modal` — the nested-dialog form the modal-site guard does not count. (5) The OCR notice decides by the service-worker cache (`ocrBundleCached()` → `caches.match("/ocr/lang/eng.traineddata.gz")`, the largest of the runtime-cached paths at `public/sw.js:13-19`): no new storage key, and "once" is true by construction; a private-mode browser without CacheStorage sees the notice every time (accepted). Selecting a file never scans; the button scans. (6) `/ocr/*` headers and the two unused core variants are NOT touched this wave (Task 19 records the deferral). (7) Format and Notes ship — Task 4 gave `addActivity` the `format`/`notes` contract. (8) "evidence" is the word everywhere in this sheet and the editor. (9) The edit variant's archive stays a two-step in-modal confirm ("Archive activity" → alert "Archive this activity?" → "Keep activity" / "Archive activity"); Task 11 gives the log's rows a direct Archive with Undo. (10) `log-activity.css` is the sheet's file, rewritten first-class and removed from `LEGACY_STYLESHEETS`; the blocks the other modals consumed died in Task 6, and the three the editor still wore (`.archive-zone*`, `.read-only-status`, `.advisory-note`) die here. (11) `LogActivityModal` takes no props and reads `useWorkspace()`; its hooks live in a module-level `LogActivitySheet` so the `workspace` null-guard is a plain early return above every hook (`react-hooks/rules-of-hooks`). (12) `EditActivityModal` keeps the old prop names; `error` is the `DescribedError | null` the host keeps for each modal since Task 5 — the raw server sentence sits under "Technical details" through `ErrorSummary`'s `detail` (Task 2).

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing node:test suite `tests/log-activity-form.test.mjs`**

Every validation message once, the payload shape for the three families, and the discard-prompt predicate. `FormData` is a Node 22 global, so `hasUnrecoverableInput` is exercised exactly as the sheet calls it. The window message is asserted through `formatDate` from Task 1's pure module rather than a literal, so a change to the date format cannot fail this suite for the wrong reason.

```js
// One validation pattern for the Log activity sheet (a11y-09): every field
// message and the ErrorSummary entries come from validateLogActivity, the
// addActivity payload from activityPayload, and the discard prompt's trigger
// from hasUnrecoverableInput. Pure — `npm run build:lib-test` compiles
// app/lib/logActivityForm.ts into .test-build/ and this suite imports the
// emitted ESM. FormData is a Node 22 global, so the predicate is driven the
// way the sheet drives it. The e2e proof that the sheet renders these
// messages inline is tests/e2e/log-activity.spec.ts.
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import { formatDate } from "../.test-build/format.js";
import {
  ACTIVITY_FORMAT_OPTIONS,
  NOTES_MAX_LENGTH,
  activityPayload,
  hasUnrecoverableInput,
  validateLogActivity,
} from "../.test-build/logActivityForm.js";

const IDS = {
  title: "f-title",
  completionDate: "f-date",
  totalUnits: "f-units",
  allocatedUnits: "f-allocated",
  credentialId: "f-credential",
  provider: "f-provider",
  carryover: "f-carryover",
  format: "f-format",
  notes: "f-notes",
};
const WINDOW = { start: "2026-01-01", end: "2027-12-31" };
const VALID = {
  title: "Ethics in clinical practice",
  completionDate: "2026-06-02",
  totalUnits: "2",
  allocatedUnits: "2",
  credentialId: "cred-1",
  provider: "",
  format: "",
  notes: "",
  isNremt: false,
  window: WINDOW,
  isCarryover: false,
  carryoverAttested: false,
};

const messagesOf = (input) => validateLogActivity(input, IDS).summary.map((entry) => entry.message);

test("a valid input has no field errors and an empty summary", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(validateLogActivity(VALID, IDS), { fields: {}, summary: [] });
  // The window is optional (no credential chosen yet): only the calendar is checked.
  assert.deepEqual(validateLogActivity({ ...VALID, window: null }, IDS).fields.completionDate, undefined);
});

test("title: empty and over 180 characters", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(validateLogActivity({ ...VALID, title: "   " }, IDS).summary, [
    { fieldId: "f-title", message: "Enter what you completed." },
  ]);
  assert.deepEqual(messagesOf({ ...VALID, title: "x".repeat(181) }), ["Keep the title to 180 characters."]);
  assert.deepEqual(messagesOf({ ...VALID, title: "x".repeat(180) }), []);
});

test("completion date: missing, not a calendar date, outside the window, and the carryover variant", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(messagesOf({ ...VALID, completionDate: "" }), ["Enter the completion date."]);
  assert.deepEqual(messagesOf({ ...VALID, completionDate: "2026-02-30" }), ["Enter the completion date."]);
  assert.deepEqual(messagesOf({ ...VALID, completionDate: "2025-12-31" }), [
    `Use a date between ${formatDate("2026-01-01")} and ${formatDate("2027-12-31")}.`,
  ]);
  assert.deepEqual(messagesOf({ ...VALID, completionDate: "2028-01-01" }), [
    `Use a date between ${formatDate("2026-01-01")} and ${formatDate("2027-12-31")}.`,
  ]);
  // A prior-period date on a credential with a confirmed-carryover window
  // (window.start already moved back) that still falls before the window.
  assert.deepEqual(
    messagesOf({ ...VALID, completionDate: "2023-01-01", isCarryover: true, carryoverAttested: true, window: { start: "2024-01-01", end: "2027-12-31" } }),
    ["Use a date in this cycle, or the actual prior-cycle date for confirmed carryover."],
  );
  assert.equal(validateLogActivity({ ...VALID, completionDate: "2025-12-31" }, IDS).fields.completionDate, `Use a date between ${formatDate("2026-01-01")} and ${formatDate("2027-12-31")}.`);
});

test("credits earned: empty, zero, text, over 10,000; credits that count above the total", () => {
  for (const totalUnits of ["", "0", "abc", "-1"]) {
    assert.deepEqual(messagesOf({ ...VALID, totalUnits, allocatedUnits: "" }), ["Enter the credits earned."], totalUnits);
  }
  assert.deepEqual(messagesOf({ ...VALID, totalUnits: "10001", allocatedUnits: "" }), ["Credits can’t exceed 10,000."]);
  assert.deepEqual(messagesOf({ ...VALID, totalUnits: "10000", allocatedUnits: "" }), []);
  assert.deepEqual(messagesOf({ ...VALID, allocatedUnits: "3" }), ["Credits that count can’t exceed the credits earned."]);
  assert.equal(validateLogActivity({ ...VALID, allocatedUnits: "3" }, IDS).fields.allocatedUnits, "Credits that count can’t exceed the credits earned.");
  // Empty "credits that count" falls back to the total in the payload; it is not an error.
  assert.deepEqual(messagesOf({ ...VALID, allocatedUnits: "" }), []);
});
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Create `app/lib/logActivityForm.ts` and register it in `build:lib-test`**

`app/lib/logActivityForm.ts` (whole file; pure — no React, DOM or D1 import; `.js` suffixes for the `nodenext` emit):

```ts
// One validation pattern for the Log activity sheet (a11y-09, spec §6). The
// sheet calls validateLogActivity on submit, renders each field's message
// through Field's `error` (aria-invalid + aria-describedby) and the same list
// through ErrorSummary, so the two never disagree; activityPayload builds
// the addActivity body in exactly the shape the old handleActivitySubmit
// (app/ITrackApp.tsx:2895-2931 at c6b1fe4) built, with Task 4's format and
// notes appended; hasUnrecoverableInput decides whether closing the sheet
// asks first — the browser draft keeps title, date, credits, credential and
// provider (app/lib/activityDraft.ts), and nothing else. Pure, so
// tests/log-activity-form.test.mjs drives it through build:lib-test.
import {
  ACTIVITY_DRAFT_MAX_UNITS,
  ACTIVITY_DRAFT_TITLE_MAX_LENGTH,
} from "./activityDraft.js";
import { formatDate } from "./format.js";
import type {
  CrcApprovalPayload,
  RequirementMatchPayload,
} from "./workspaceTypes.js";

export type LogActivityField =
  | "title"
  | "completionDate"
  | "totalUnits"
  | "allocatedUnits"
  | "credentialId"
  | "provider"
  | "carryover"
  | "format"
  | "notes";

export type LogActivityInput = {
  title: string;
  completionDate: string;
  totalUnits: string;
  allocatedUnits: string;
  credentialId: string;
  provider: string;
  format: string;
  notes: string;
  isNremt: boolean;
  // [confirmedCarryoverWindowStart ?? cycleStart, deadline]; null until a
  // credential is chosen (then only the calendar is checked).
  window: { start: string; end: string } | null;
  // A prior-period date on a credential with a confirmed-carryover rule.
  isCarryover: boolean;
  carryoverAttested: boolean;
};

export type LogActivityValidation = {
  fields: Partial<Record<LogActivityField, string>>;
  summary: Array<{ fieldId?: string; message: string }>;
};

export type ActivityFormat =
  | "live_course"
  | "live_webinar"
  | "self_study"
  | "conference"
  | "other";

// The five formats addActivity accepts (Task 4, 400 invalid_format otherwise).
export const ACTIVITY_FORMAT_OPTIONS: ReadonlyArray<{
  value: ActivityFormat;
  label: string;
}> = [
  { value: "live_course", label: "Live course" },
  { value: "live_webinar", label: "Live webinar" },
  { value: "self_study", label: "On-demand or self-study" },
  { value: "conference", label: "Conference" },
  { value: "other", label: "Other" },
];

export const NOTES_MAX_LENGTH = 2000;

const ISO_DATE = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;

function isCalendarDate(value: string): boolean {
  if (!ISO_DATE.test(value)) return false;
  const [year, month, day] = value.split("-").map(Number);
  const date = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day));
  return (
    date.getUTCFullYear() === year &&
    date.getUTCMonth() === month - 1 &&
    date.getUTCDate() === day
  );
}

function isFormat(value: string): value is ActivityFormat {
  return ACTIVITY_FORMAT_OPTIONS.some((option) => option.value === value);
}

// The credits that count: the entered value when it is a positive number,
// else the credits earned (the field mirrors the total until edited).
function allocatedOf(input: Pick<LogActivityInput, "totalUnits" | "allocatedUnits">): number {
  const allocated = Number(input.allocatedUnits);
  return input.allocatedUnits.trim() !== "" && Number.isFinite(allocated) && allocated > 0
    ? allocated
    : Number(input.totalUnits);
}

export function validateLogActivity(
  input: LogActivityInput,
  ids: Record<LogActivityField, string>,
): LogActivityValidation {
  const fields: Partial<Record<LogActivityField, string>> = {};
  const fail = (field: LogActivityField, message: string) => {
    if (!fields[field]) fields[field] = message;
  };

  const title = input.title.trim();
  if (!title) fail("title", "Enter what you completed.");
  else if (title.length > ACTIVITY_DRAFT_TITLE_MAX_LENGTH) {
    fail("title", "Keep the title to 180 characters.");
  }

  if (!isCalendarDate(input.completionDate)) {
    fail("completionDate", "Enter the completion date.");
  } else if (
    input.window &&
    (input.completionDate < input.window.start ||
      input.completionDate > input.window.end)
  ) {
    fail(
      "completionDate",
      input.isCarryover
        ? "Use a date in this cycle, or the actual prior-cycle date for confirmed carryover."
        : `Use a date between ${formatDate(input.window.start)} and ${formatDate(input.window.end)}.`,
    );
  }

  const totalUnits = Number(input.totalUnits);
  if (input.totalUnits.trim() === "" || !Number.isFinite(totalUnits) || totalUnits <= 0) {
    fail("totalUnits", "Enter the credits earned.");
  } else if (totalUnits > ACTIVITY_DRAFT_MAX_UNITS) {
    fail("totalUnits", "Credits can’t exceed 10,000.");
  } else if (input.allocatedUnits.trim() !== "") {
    const allocated = Number(input.allocatedUnits);
    if (Number.isFinite(allocated) && allocated > totalUnits + 0.0001) {
      fail("allocatedUnits", "Credits that count can’t exceed the credits earned.");
    }
  }

  if (!input.credentialId) fail("credentialId", "Choose a credential.");
  if (input.isNremt && !input.provider.trim()) {
    fail("provider", "Enter the provider for National Registry credit.");
  }
  if (input.isCarryover && !input.carryoverAttested) {
    fail("carryover", "Confirm the issuing authority permits this carryover.");
  }
  if (input.format && !isFormat(input.format)) {
    fail("format", "Choose a format from the list.");
  }
  if (input.notes.length > NOTES_MAX_LENGTH) {
    fail("notes", "Keep notes to 2,000 characters.");
  }

  const order: LogActivityField[] = [
    "title",
    "completionDate",
    "totalUnits",
    "allocatedUnits",
    "credentialId",
    "provider",
    "carryover",
    "format",
    "notes",
  ];
  const summary = order.flatMap((field) => {
    const message = fields[field];
    return message ? [{ fieldId: ids[field], message }] : [];
  });
  return { fields, summary };
}

export function activityPayload(
  input: LogActivityInput & {
    requirementIds?: string[];
    requirementMatches?: RequirementMatchPayload[];
    acceptedEducationAttested?: boolean;
    crc?: CrcApprovalPayload | null;
    evidenceStatus: "missing" | "not_required";
  },
): Record<string, unknown> {
  const totalUnits = Number(input.totalUnits);
  const allocatedUnits = allocatedOf(input);
  return {
    title: input.title,
    provider: input.provider,
    completionDate: input.completionDate,
    totalUnits,
    credentialId: input.credentialId,
    ...(input.requirementMatches && input.crc
      ? { requirementMatches: input.requirementMatches, ...input.crc }
      : input.requirementMatches
        ? {
            requirementMatches: input.requirementMatches,
            acceptedEducationAttested: true,
          }
        : { requirementIds: input.requirementIds ?? [] }),
    allocatedUnits,
    evidenceStatus: input.evidenceStatus,
    portalCarryoverAttested: input.carryoverAttested,
    format: input.format || null,
    notes: input.notes.trim() || null,
  };
}

// True when closing the sheet would lose something the browser draft does
// not keep: an attached file, an allocator amount, a requirement tag, a
// format, notes or a CRCC reference. Allocator inputs default to "0", so an
// amount counts only when it is positive.
export function hasUnrecoverableInput(form: FormData, hasFile: boolean): boolean {
  if (hasFile) return true;
  for (const [name, value] of form.entries()) {
    if (typeof value !== "string") continue;
    if (name.startsWith("requirementMatch:") && Number(value) > 0) return true;
    if (name === "requirementIds" && value) return true;
    if (
      (name === "format" || name === "notes" || name === "crcProgramReference") &&
      value.trim()
    ) {
      return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}
```

```css
/*
 * A sticky footer for a sheet whose primary action must stay in view (spec
 * §6 Log activity: "Save is always visible"). The card is the scroll
 * container, so the footer sticks to its bottom edge as the header sticks to
 * its top; the card's scroll-padding-bottom above clears the height
 * Modal.tsx publishes, so a control Tab lands on never sits under it. It
 * wraps: a full-width status line (the sheet's offline note) sits above the
 * button row.
 */
.modal-footer {
  position: sticky;
  bottom: 0;
  z-index: 2;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 12px 24px calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: var(--card);
}
```

```ts

// True once this browser holds the English model — the largest of the three
// files the first scan fetches, runtime-cached by the service worker
// (public/sw.js RUNTIME_STATIC_PATHS). The sheet asks before the first
// download and never again: the cache is the record, so no storage key is
// written. False wherever CacheStorage is missing or refuses (a private
// window, an insecure origin), so those browsers see the notice each time.
// Never called during render — an event handler awaits it.
export async function ocrBundleCached(): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    if (typeof caches === "undefined") return false;
    return Boolean(await caches.match("/ocr/lang/eng.traineddata.gz"));
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}
```

```ts
// The Log activity sheet (spec §6): one form in two steps — Essentials, then
// a Details disclosure — under a sticky footer whose primary is the one verb;
// the browser draft; one validation pattern (a11y-09); a discard prompt only
// for what the draft cannot keep; the certificate reader as an opt-in action
// behind a notice that names its 4.5 MB download (perf-07, app-ux-20); the
// record-saved-then-evidence-uploaded order. The typing regression moved here
// verbatim from Wave 2 (app-ux-01 / architecture-M-01) and keeps its shape.
// The demo identity is read-only: the local-date and typing cases never
// submit; everything that writes takes a fresh identity. Runs in all four
// projects (the phone projects render the same dialog as a bottom sheet).
import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import type { Page } from "@playwright/test";
import { expect, freshIdentity, LOG_SHEET_NAME, test } from "./fixtures";

const toast = (page: Page) => page.locator('.toast-region [role="status"] .toast');
const detailsToggle = (sheet: ReturnType<Page["locator"]>) =>
  sheet.getByRole("button", { name: /^Details/ });

test.describe("local date", () => {
  test.use({ timezoneId: "America/New_York" });

  test("the completion date defaults to the local date under a fixed clock", async ({ page, app }) => {
    // 02:30Z on 10 September is 22:30 on the 9th in New York: the sheet's
    // default is the day the user is standing in (critic-01), not the UTC day.
    await page.clock.setFixedTime(new Date("2026-09-10T02:30:00Z"));
    await app.goto("/");
    expect((await app.workspace()).user.isDemo).toBe(true);
    const sheet = await app.openLog();
    await expect(app.dialog(LOG_SHEET_NAME)).toBeVisible();
    await expect(sheet.locator('input[name="completionDate"]')).toHaveValue("2026-09-09");
    await page.keyboard.press("Escape");
    await expect(sheet).toBeHidden();
    app.expectNoErrors();
  });
});

// app-ux-01 / architecture-M-01: the second keystroke in any log-activity
// field used to throw inside a deferred state updater and unmount the app.
// Typing two characters into each field, slowly enough for the draft-persist
// effect to schedule its timeouts between keys, is the exact reproduction.
// Provider and "credits that count" now sit in the Details step, so it is
// opened first; the fields keep their names.
test("typing two characters into every log-activity field does not crash the app", async ({ app, page }) => {
  await app.goto("/");
  expect((await app.workspace()).user.isDemo).toBe(true);
  const sheet = await app.openLog();

  const title = sheet.locator('input[name="title"]');
  await title.click();
  await title.pressSequentially("Et", { delay: 300 });
  app.expectNoErrors();
  await expect(title).toHaveValue("Et");

  const units = sheet.locator('input[name="totalUnits"]');
  await units.click();
  await units.pressSequentially("12", { delay: 300 });
  app.expectNoErrors();
  await expect(units).toHaveValue("12");

  await detailsToggle(sheet).click();
  await expect(detailsToggle(sheet)).toHaveAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");

  const allocated = sheet.locator('input[name="allocatedUnits"]');
  await allocated.click();
  await allocated.fill("");
  await allocated.pressSequentially("11", { delay: 300 });
  app.expectNoErrors();
  await expect(allocated).toHaveValue("11");

  const provider = sheet.locator('input[name="provider"]');
  await provider.click();
  await provider.pressSequentially("NB", { delay: 300 });
  app.expectNoErrors();
  await expect(provider).toHaveValue("NB");

  // A date input takes whole values; two fills 300 ms apart hit the same
  // pending-lane path a second keystroke does.
  const completion = sheet.locator('input[name="completionDate"]');
  await completion.fill("2026-01-05");
  await page.waitForTimeout(300);
  await completion.fill("2026-01-06");
  app.expectNoErrors();
  await expect(completion).toHaveValue("2026-01-06");

  await expect(sheet).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.locator("#main-content")).toBeVisible();
  app.expectNoErrors();
});

  test("the certificate reader is opt-in behind a notice that names its download, and evidence uploads only once the activity is logged", async ({ page, app, context }) => {
    // The on-device reader loads its worker, core and English model from
    // /ocr/ on first use, so this test runs longer than a plain save.
    test.slow();
    await app.seedCredential();
    await app.goto("/");
    const sheet = await app.openLog();
    const photo = await readFile(new URL("../../public/icon-192.png", import.meta.url));
    await sheet.locator('input[name="evidenceFile"]').setInputFiles({ name: "certificate.png", mimeType: "image/png", buffer: photo });
    await expect(sheet.getByText("certificate.png")).toBeVisible();
    // Attaching a file scans nothing.
    await expect(sheet.locator(".log-scan-status")).toHaveCount(0);

    const fetched: string[] = [];
    const recordFetch = (request: { url(): string }) => fetched.push(request.url());
    page.on("request", recordFetch);
    const ocrRequests = () => fetched.filter((url) => new URL(url).pathname.startsWith("/ocr/"));

    const scan = sheet.getByRole("button", { name: "Scan a certificate" });
    await scan.click();
    const notice = app.dialog("Download the certificate reader?");
    await expect(notice).toBeVisible();
    await expect(notice).toContainText("about 4.5 MB");
    await expect(notice.getByRole("button", { name: "Download and scan" })).toBeFocused();
    expect(ocrRequests()).toEqual([]);
    await notice.getByRole("button", { name: "Not now" }).click();
    await expect(notice).toHaveCount(0);
    expect(ocrRequests()).toEqual([]);

    await scan.click();
    await expect(notice).toBeVisible();
    await notice.getByRole("button", { name: "Download and scan" }).click();
    await expect(notice).toHaveCount(0);
    const status = sheet.locator(".log-scan-status");
    await expect(status).toBeVisible();
    // The reader ran, not failed to start: the scan ends in a read phase
    // within the budget, and the photo is still attached.
    await expect(status).toHaveAttribute("data-phase", /^(manual|success)$/, { timeout: 90_000 });
    page.off("request", recordFetch);
    await expect(sheet.getByText("certificate.png")).toBeVisible();
    // On-device, as the notice promises: the worker, a core and the English
    // model came from iTrack itself, and nothing left the origin meanwhile.
    const origin = new URL(page.url()).origin;
    expect(fetched.filter((url) => !url.startsWith(`${origin}/`))).toEqual([]);
    const paths = fetched.map((url) => new URL(url).pathname);
    expect(paths).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(["/ocr/worker.min.js", "/ocr/lang/eng.traineddata.gz"]));
    expect(paths.some((path) => /^\/ocr\/core\/tesseract-core-.*\.wasm\.js$/.test(path))).toBe(true);

    await sheet.locator('input[name="title"]').fill("Scanned course");
    await sheet.locator('input[name="totalUnits"]').fill("2");
    await sheet.locator('input[name="completionDate"]').fill("2026-06-02");
    // Evidence is expected unless the box says otherwise (it sits in Details, unchecked).
    await expect(sheet.locator('input[name="evidenceNotRequired"]')).not.toBeChecked();

    // The order the sheet promises: the activity is logged first, and the
    // file is uploaded against the id that save returns.
    const writes: string[] = [];
    page.on("request", (request) => {
      if (request.method() !== "POST") return;
      const path = new URL(request.url()).pathname;
      if (path === "/api/workspace") writes.push(String(request.postDataJSON()?.action));
      else if (path === "/api/evidence") writes.push("evidence");
    });
    await sheet.getByRole("button", { name: "Log activity" }).click();
    await expect(sheet).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(toast(page)).toContainText("2 credits and evidence saved.");
    expect(writes).toEqual(["addActivity", "evidence"]);

    const saved = (await app.workspace()).activities.find((activity) => activity.title === "Scanned course");
    expect(saved?.evidenceStatus).toBe("attached");
    expect(saved?.evidenceCount).toBe(1);
    const listed = await context.request.get(`/api/evidence?activityId=${encodeURIComponent(saved!.id)}`, { headers: { accept: "application/json" } });
    expect(listed.ok()).toBe(true);
    const { evidence } = (await listed.json()) as { evidence: Array<{ fileName: string; contentType: string; sizeBytes: number }> };
    expect(evidence).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(evidence[0]).toMatchObject({ fileName: "certificate.png", contentType: "image/png", sizeBytes: photo.byteLength });

    // The Activity log shows the evidence on file for the new record (the
    // legacy RecordsView until Task 11, which re-points this).
    await app.goto("/history");
    const records = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Completed activities" });
    await expect(records.getByText("Scanned course")).toBeVisible();
    await expect(records.getByText("1 on file")).toBeVisible();
    app.expectNoErrors();
  });
});
```

`tests/e2e/forced-colors.spec.ts:75-108` (from the comment `// The Log sheet's requirement rows open unchecked…` through the closing `  }` of the `if ((await rows.count()) > 0) {` block; `grep -n "The Log sheet's requirement rows" tests/e2e/forced-colors.spec.ts` prints its first line) is replaced by the native-checkbox assertion — the picker rows are now the `Checkbox` primitive, which needs no forced-colours rule (DESIGN-SYSTEM.md "Forced colors"):

```ts
  // The Log sheet's requirement rows are native checkboxes now (the Checkbox
  // primitive): the platform draws their state, so nothing here opts out of
  // the forced palette and no glyph has to be hidden. Clicking one row's
  // label checks only that row. Guarded: a seed without taggable
  // requirements must not fail this for the wrong reason.
  const sheet = await app.openLog();
  const boxes = sheet.locator('input[name="requirementIds"]');
  if ((await boxes.count()) > 0) {
    await sheet.locator("label.requirement-choice").first().click();
    const choices = await boxes.evaluateAll((elements) =>
      elements.map((element) => {
        const computed = getComputedStyle(element);
        const box = element.getBoundingClientRect();
        return {
          checked: (element as HTMLInputElement).checked,
          visible: computed.opacity === "1" && computed.visibility !== "hidden" && box.width >= 20 && box.height >= 20,
          adjust: computed.getPropertyValue("forced-color-adjust"),
        };
      }),
    );
    expect(choices[0].checked, "the clicked row is checked").toBe(true);
    for (const row of choices.slice(1)) {
      expect(row.checked, "no other row is checked").toBe(false);
    }
    for (const row of choices) {
      expect(row.visible, "a visible native input, not an opacity-0 proxy").toBe(true);
      expect(row.adjust, "the platform draws the box").not.toBe("none");
    }
  }
```

- `:309-373` (the walk; `grep -n "the sheet's sticky header never covers" tests/e2e/primitives.spec.ts`): the header comment gains one sentence and the test gains the footer. Replace the test body from `  await app.goto("/");` to the closing `});` with:

```ts
  await app.goto("/");
  const sheet = await app.openLog();
  // Both steps on screen: Details opened, so the walk crosses every field
  // the sheet holds and the card has the most to scroll.
  await sheet.getByRole("button", { name: /^Details/ }).click();
  const card = page.locator(".modal-card");
  const geometry = await card.evaluate((element) => {
    const header = element.querySelector(".modal-header");
    const footer = element.querySelector(".modal-footer");
    if (!header || !footer) throw new Error("the sheet did not render its header and footer");
    return {
      scrolls: element.scrollHeight > element.clientHeight,
      headerHeight: header.getBoundingClientRect().height,
      headerPosition: getComputedStyle(header).position,
      footerHeight: footer.getBoundingClientRect().height,
      footerPosition: getComputedStyle(footer).position,
      paddingTop: parseFloat(getComputedStyle(element).scrollPaddingTop),
      paddingBottom: parseFloat(getComputedStyle(element).scrollPaddingBottom),
      // Modal.tsx's own tab order: what keepFocusInside cycles through.
      controls: element.querySelectorAll(
        "a[href],button:not([disabled]),input:not([disabled]):not([type='hidden']),select:not([disabled]),textarea:not([disabled]),[tabindex]:not([tabindex='-1'])",
      ).length,
    };
  });
  expect(geometry.scrolls, "the Log sheet scrolls inside its card at this viewport").toBe(true);
  expect(geometry.headerPosition).toBe("sticky");
  expect(geometry.footerPosition).toBe("sticky");
  expect(geometry.paddingTop, "the card clears the header plus 12px of air").toBeCloseTo(geometry.headerHeight + 12, 1);
  expect(geometry.paddingBottom, "the card clears the footer plus 12px of air").toBeCloseTo(geometry.footerHeight + 12, 1);
  expect(geometry.controls).toBeGreaterThan(10);

  const focusedAgainstBars = () =>
    page.evaluate(() => {
      const active = document.activeElement;
      const header = document.querySelector(".modal-header");
      const footer = document.querySelector(".modal-footer");
      if (!(active instanceof HTMLElement) || !header || !footer) return null;
      const rect = active.getBoundingClientRect();
      const covers = (bar: Element) => {
        const box = bar.getBoundingClientRect();
        return rect.top < box.bottom && rect.bottom > box.top && rect.left < box.right && rect.right > box.left;
      };
      const name = active.getAttribute("name") ?? active.getAttribute("aria-label") ?? active.textContent ?? "";
      return {
        control: `${active.tagName.toLowerCase()} "${name.trim().slice(0, 40)}"`,
        inBody: active.closest(".modal-body") !== null,
        underHeader: covers(header),
        underFooter: covers(footer),
        rect: { top: rect.top, bottom: rect.bottom },
      };
    });
  const walk = async (key: "Tab" | "Shift+Tab") => {
    let visited = 0;
    for (let step = 1; step < geometry.controls; step += 1) {
      await page.keyboard.press(key);
      const focused = await focusedAgainstBars();
      if (!focused || !focused.inBody) continue;
      visited += 1;
      expect(focused.underHeader, `${key} ${step}: ${focused.control} at ${JSON.stringify(focused.rect)} is behind the header`).toBe(false);
      expect(focused.underFooter, `${key} ${step}: ${focused.control} at ${JSON.stringify(focused.rect)} is behind the footer`).toBe(false);
    }
    return visited;
  };
  // From the header's close button — the first control — to the last (the
  // footer's primary), and back: the card scrolls to its bottom and returns.
  await sheet.getByRole("button", { name: "Close dialog" }).focus();
  expect(await walk("Tab"), "the forward walk visited the body's fields").toBeGreaterThan(10);
  expect(await card.evaluate((element) => element.scrollTop), "the walk scrolled the card").toBeGreaterThan(0);
  expect(await walk("Shift+Tab"), "the backward walk visited the body's fields").toBeGreaterThan(10);
  // Read-only against the demo workspace: closed, never saved.
  await page.keyboard.press("Escape");
  await expect(sheet).toHaveCount(0);
  app.expectNoErrors();
});
```
