```tsx
"use client";

import { useId, useState, type ChangeEvent, type DragEvent } from "react";
import { Button } from "../../components/Button";
import { FieldError } from "../../components/Form";
import { Icon } from "../../components/Icon";
import { buttonClassName } from "../../lib/buttonClass";
import { formatFileSize } from "../../lib/format";

// The evidence drop zone (spec §6 Log activity, Essentials). A file is
// attached here and uploaded only after the activity is logged
// (handleActivitySubmit's order, kept); attaching never scans — the reader
// is the separate "Scan a certificate" action (ScanCertificate.tsx). The
// file input is visually hidden inside a label dressed as a secondary
// button, so keyboard and pointer both reach the platform picker; the input
// keeps its name so a FormData snapshot sees it, and its value is cleared
// after each pick so the File lives in React state alone (the sheet's dirty
// check adds `Boolean(file)` for that reason). The limits mirror the
// evidence API (app/api/evidence/_shared.ts MAX_EVIDENCE_BYTES, the four
// accepted types) so a refusal happens before any upload.

export const EVIDENCE_MAX_BYTES = 10 * 1_048_576;

export type EvidenceFileType =
  | "application/pdf"
  | "image/jpeg"
  | "image/png"
  | "image/webp";

// The MIME type from the file, else from its extension (a phone camera roll
// hands over image/jpg, a renamed download an empty type); null when it is
// none of the four the evidence API accepts.
export function evidenceFileType(file: File): EvidenceFileType | null {
  const lowerName = file.name.toLowerCase();
  if (file.type === "application/pdf" || lowerName.endsWith(".pdf")) {
    return "application/pdf";
  }
  if (["image/jpeg", "image/png", "image/webp"].includes(file.type)) {
    return file.type as EvidenceFileType;
  }
  if (lowerName.endsWith(".jpg") || lowerName.endsWith(".jpeg")) return "image/jpeg";
  if (lowerName.endsWith(".png")) return "image/png";
  if (lowerName.endsWith(".webp")) return "image/webp";
  return null;
}

export function evidenceFileProblem(file: File): string | null {
  if (file.size > EVIDENCE_MAX_BYTES) {
    return "That file is larger than 10 MB. Choose a smaller file.";
  }
  if (!evidenceFileType(file)) return "Choose a PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP file.";
  return null;
}

export function EvidenceDropZone({
  file,
  onFile,
  onRemove,
  disabled,
  error,
  inputId,
}: {
  file: File | null;
  onFile: (file: File) => void;
  onRemove: () => void;
  disabled: boolean;
  error?: string;
  inputId: string;
}) {
  const labelId = useId();
  const chooseId = useId();
  const hintId = useId();
  const errorId = useId();
  const [dragging, setDragging] = useState(false);

  const onDragOver = (event: DragEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!dragging) setDragging(true);
  };
  const onDragLeave = () => setDragging(false);
  const onDrop = (event: DragEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setDragging(false);
    if (disabled) return;
    const dropped = event.dataTransfer.files?.[0];
    if (dropped) onFile(dropped);
  };
  const onPick = (event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const picked = event.currentTarget.files?.[0];
    event.currentTarget.value = "";
    if (picked) onFile(picked);
  };

  return (
    <div className="log-evidence" role="group" aria-labelledby={labelId}>
      <span className="field-label">
        <span id={labelId}>Evidence</span>
        <span className="field-optional">Optional</span>
      </span>
      <div
        className="log-dropzone"
        data-dragging={dragging || undefined}
        onDragOver={onDragOver}
        onDragEnter={onDragOver}
        onDragLeave={onDragLeave}
        onDrop={onDrop}
      >
        {file ? (
          <div className="log-dropzone-file">
            <Icon name="check" size={16} />
            <div>
              <strong>{file.name}</strong>
              <small>{formatFileSize(file.size)}</small>
            </div>
            <Button variant="quiet" size="sm" disabled={disabled} onClick={onRemove}>
              Remove
            </Button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            <Icon name="upload" size={22} />
            <p>Drop a certificate here, or</p>
          </>
        )}
        <label className={buttonClassName("secondary")}>
          <span id={chooseId}>Choose a file</span>
          <input
            id={inputId}
            name="evidenceFile"
            type="file"
            className="sr-only"
            accept=".pdf,image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp"
            aria-labelledby={`${labelId} ${chooseId}`}
            aria-describedby={error ? `${hintId} ${errorId}` : hintId}
            aria-invalid={error ? true : undefined}
            disabled={disabled}
            onChange={onPick}
          />
        </label>
        <small className="field-hint" id={hintId}>
          PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 10 MB. It uploads after you log the activity.
        </small>
      </div>
      {error ? <FieldError id={errorId}>{error}</FieldError> : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

`app/screens/logActivity/ScanCertificate.tsx` (whole file):

```tsx
"use client";

import { useRef, useState, type ChangeEvent } from "react";
import { Button } from "../../components/Button";
import { Icon } from "../../components/Icon";
import { Modal } from "../../components/Modal";
import { ocrBundleCached } from "../../lib/certificateOcr";
import { DIALOG_NAMES } from "../../lib/copy";
import type { ActivityScanState } from "../../lib/workspaceTypes";

// "Scan a certificate" — the on-device reader as an opt-in secondary action
// (perf-07, app-ux-20). Nothing scans on its own: the button scans the
// attached image, or — with nothing attached — opens the rear camera and
// scans that pick once the sheet has accepted it. The first scan downloads
// ≈ 4.5 MB (the worker, one core and the English model, public/ocr); until
// the service worker holds the model (ocrBundleCached) a nested notice names
// that download and asks. The notice is a React child of the sheet, so the
// modal stack makes it the top dialog: Escape closes only the notice and the
// sheet's backdrop goes inert. The scan itself (the sequence guard, the
// suggestions) lives in the sheet — `onScan(file)`; this component only
// decides whether to ask first.
export function ScanCertificate({
  file,
  state,
  onPick,
  onScan,
  disabled,
}: {
  file: File | null;
  state: ActivityScanState;
  // The sheet attaches the camera pick (or refuses it); true when attached.
  onPick: (file: File) => boolean;
  onScan: (file: File) => void;
  disabled: boolean;
}) {
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState(false);
  // The file the open notice is about; read and cleared in its handlers only.
  const pendingFile = useRef<File | null>(null);
  const cameraRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const isPdf =
    file !== null &&
    (file.type === "application/pdf" || file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith(".pdf"));
  const scanning = state.phase === "scanning";

  const requestScan = async (target: File) => {
    if (await ocrBundleCached()) {
      onScan(target);
      return;
    }
    pendingFile.current = target;
    setNotice(true);
  };
  const onClick = () => {
    if (file) {
      void requestScan(file);
      return;
    }
    cameraRef.current?.click();
  };
  const onCameraPick = (event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const picked = event.currentTarget.files?.[0];
    event.currentTarget.value = "";
    if (!picked || !onPick(picked)) return;
    void requestScan(picked);
  };
  const dismiss = () => {
    pendingFile.current = null;
    setNotice(false);
  };
  const downloadAndScan = () => {
    const target = pendingFile.current;
    pendingFile.current = null;
    setNotice(false);
    if (target) onScan(target);
  };

  return (
    <div className="log-scan">
      <div className="log-scan-actions">
        <Button
          variant="secondary"
          icon={<Icon name="camera" size={16} />}
          disabled={disabled || isPdf || scanning}
          onClick={onClick}
        >
          Scan a certificate
        </Button>
        <input
          ref={cameraRef}
          type="file"
          className="sr-only"
          accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp"
          capture="environment"
          tabIndex={-1}
          aria-hidden="true"
          onChange={onCameraPick}
        />
        <small className="field-hint">
          {isPdf
            ? "PDFs can’t be scanned yet — enter the details by hand."
            : "Reads a JPEG, PNG or WebP on this device and suggests the title, date, credits and provider."}
        </small>
      </div>
      {state.phase !== "idle" ? (
        <div
          className="log-scan-status"
          data-phase={state.phase}
          role="status"
          aria-live="polite"
        >
          {scanning ? (
            <div
              className="log-scan-progress"
              role="progressbar"
              aria-label={state.label}
              aria-valuemin={0}
              aria-valuemax={100}
              aria-valuenow={Math.round(state.progress * 100)}
            >
              <span style={{ width: `${Math.round(state.progress * 100)}%` }} />
            </div>
          ) : (
            <Icon name={state.phase === "success" ? "check" : "info"} size={14} />
          )}
          <p>{state.label}</p>
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {notice && (
        <Modal title={DIALOG_NAMES.scanNotice} onClose={dismiss}>
          <p className="modal-prompt-body">
            Scanning happens on this device. The first scan downloads the
            reader and its English model — about 4.5 MB, once — and keeps them
            in this browser. Nothing from your certificate is sent anywhere.
          </p>
          <div className="form-actions">
            <Button variant="quiet" onClick={dismiss}>
              Not now
            </Button>
            <Button variant="primary" data-autofocus onClick={downloadAndScan}>
              Download and scan
            </Button>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

`AllocationTally.tsx` (whole file):

```tsx
import { allocationFigure } from "../../../lib/allocation";

// The running total under an allocator section: balanced (exact) or within
// the limit (ceiling), else how far off. Polite, so a screen reader hears the
// state settle as the amounts are typed.
export function AllocationTally({
  label,
  total,
  target,
  targetLabel,
  mode,
}: {
  label: string;
  total: number;
  target: number;
  targetLabel: string;
  mode: "exact" | "ceiling";
}) {
  const difference = Number((total - target).toFixed(4));
  const balanced =
    mode === "exact" ? Math.abs(difference) <= 0.0001 : difference <= 0.0001;
  const state = balanced
    ? mode === "exact"
      ? "Balanced"
      : "Within the limit"
    : difference > 0
      ? `${allocationFigure(difference)} over`
      : `${allocationFigure(-difference)} left to assign`;
  return (
    <p
      className="allocation-tally"
      data-state={balanced ? "balanced" : "unbalanced"}
      aria-live="polite"
    >
      <span className="allocation-tally-label">{label}</span>
      <span className="allocation-tally-figure">
        {allocationFigure(total)} of {allocationFigure(target)} {targetLabel}
      </span>
      <span className="allocation-tally-state">{state}</span>
    </p>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Checkbox, TextInput } from "../../../components/Form";
import { allocationAmount, seedAllocationAmounts } from "../../../lib/allocation";
import { compactNumber } from "../../../lib/format";
import { requirementStatus } from "../../../lib/readiness";
import type { Credential, Requirement, RequirementMatchPayload } from "../../../lib/workspaceTypes";
import { AllocationTally } from "./AllocationTally";

// National Registry accepted-credit allocation. The fields are read by
// nremtRequirementMatchPayload (app/lib/allocation.ts) straight from
// FormData — `requirementMatch:<id>` per requirement and the
// `acceptedEducationAttested` box — so their names are the contract; the
// Log sheet (Details, forced open), the Apply-to-another-credential modal and
// the Categorize modal all mount this with the same props.
export function NremtRequirementAllocator({
  credential,
  availableUnits,
  initialMatches = [],
}: {
  credential: Credential;
  availableUnits: number;
  initialMatches?: RequirementMatchPayload[];
}) {
  const [amounts, setAmounts] = useState<Record<string, string>>(() =>
    seedAllocationAmounts(initialMatches),
  );
  const selectable = credential.requirements.filter(
    (requirement) =>
      requirementStatus(requirement) === "applies" &&
      requirement.isActive !== false,
  );
  const national = selectable.find((requirement) =>
    requirement.ruleCategoryId?.endsWith("-national"),
  );
  const componentRequirements = selectable.filter(
    (requirement) =>
      requirement === national ||
      requirement.ruleCategoryId?.endsWith("-local") ||
      requirement.ruleCategoryId?.endsWith("-individual"),
  );
  const nationalTopics = selectable.filter(
    (requirement) =>
      requirement.relation === "nested" &&
      requirement.parentRequirementId === national?.id,
  );
  const overlappingRequirements = selectable.filter(
    (requirement) => requirement.relation === "overlapping",
  );

  const amountInput = (requirement: Requirement) => (
    <label className="allocator-row" key={requirement.id}>
      <span className="allocator-row-text">
        <strong>{requirement.name}</strong>
        <small>
          {requirement.relation === "nested"
            ? "Included within National"
            : requirement.relation === "overlapping"
              ? "Overlaps National; does not add credit"
              : `Cycle minimum ${compactNumber(requirement.requiredUnits)}`}
        </small>
      </span>
      <TextInput
        className="field-control-mono"
        aria-label={`${requirement.name} accepted credits`}
        name={`requirementMatch:${requirement.id}`}
        type="number"
        min="0"
        max={availableUnits > 0 ? availableUnits : undefined}
        step="0.1"
        inputMode="decimal"
        value={amounts[requirement.id] ?? "0"}
        onChange={(event) => {
          const entered = event.currentTarget.value;
          setAmounts((current) => ({
            ...current,
            [requirement.id]: entered,
          }));
        }}
        required
      />
    </label>
  );

  const componentTotal = componentRequirements.reduce(
    (sum, requirement) => sum + allocationAmount(amounts, requirement.id),
    0,
  );
  const nationalAmount = national
    ? allocationAmount(amounts, national.id)
    : 0;
  const topicTotal = nationalTopics.reduce(
    (sum, requirement) => sum + allocationAmount(amounts, requirement.id),
    0,
  );
  const overlapTotal = overlappingRequirements.reduce(
    (highest, requirement) =>
      Math.max(highest, allocationAmount(amounts, requirement.id)),
    0,
  );

  return (
    <fieldset className="allocator">
      <legend>National Registry accepted-credit allocation</legend>
      <p>
        Enter the portion NREMT accepts after any published course cap—not raw
        provider contact hours.
      </p>
      <section>
        <div className="allocator-heading">
          <strong>Component amounts</strong>
          <small>
            National + Local/State + Individual must equal the credits applied
            to this credential.
          </small>
        </div>
        {availableUnits > 0 ? (
          <AllocationTally
            label="Components"
            total={componentTotal}
            target={availableUnits}
            targetLabel="applied credits"
            mode="exact"
          />
        ) : (
          <p className="allocation-tally" data-state="waiting">
            <span className="allocation-tally-label">Components</span>
            <span className="allocation-tally-figure">
              Enter the credits to apply first
            </span>
          </p>
        )}
        <div className="allocator-list">
          {componentRequirements.map(amountInput)}
        </div>
      </section>
      <section>
        <div className="allocator-heading">
          <strong>National topic amounts</strong>
          <small>
            The five topics must total the National amount above. Assign each
            credited portion once.
          </small>
        </div>
        <AllocationTally
          label="Topics"
          total={topicTotal}
          target={nationalAmount}
          targetLabel="National credits"
          mode="exact"
        />
        <div className="allocator-list topics">
          {nationalTopics.map(amountInput)}
        </div>
      </section>
      <section>
        <div className="allocator-heading">
          <strong>Pediatric overlap</strong>
          <small>
            Enter pediatric content already included in a National topic. It
            does not increase National or overall credit.
          </small>
        </div>
        {overlappingRequirements.length ? (
          <AllocationTally
            label="Pediatric"
            total={overlapTotal}
            target={nationalAmount}
            targetLabel="National credits"
            mode="ceiling"
          />
        ) : null}
        <div className="allocator-list">
          {overlappingRequirements.map(amountInput)}
        </div>
      </section>
      <Checkbox
        name="acceptedEducationAttested"
        required
        label="This is accepted, post-cap NREMT education"
        description="I confirmed the provider and course qualify under current National Registry accepted-education rules, the content is direct EMS clinical patient care at or above this certification level, and these are the NREMT-accepted units after any standardized-course maximum. Academic courses are not used for National credit."
      />
    </fieldset>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Checkbox, Field, Select, TextInput } from "../../../components/Form";
import { allocationAmount, seedAllocationAmounts } from "../../../lib/allocation";
import { requirementStatus } from "../../../lib/readiness";
import type { Credential, Requirement, RequirementMatchPayload } from "../../../lib/workspaceTypes";
import { AllocationTally } from "./AllocationTally";

// CRCC accepted clock-hour allocation. Read by crcRequirementMatchPayload and
// crcApprovalPayload (app/lib/allocation.ts) from FormData:
// `requirementMatch:<id>` ×3, `crcApprovalType`, `crcProgramReference`,
// `crcApprovalAttested`. `includeApprovalFields={false}` (the Categorize
// modal) swaps the approval fields for the reconfirm box.
export function CrcRequirementAllocator({
  credential,
  availableUnits,
  initialMatches = [],
  includeApprovalFields = true,
  initialProgramReference = "",
}: {
  credential: Credential;
  availableUnits: number;
  initialMatches?: RequirementMatchPayload[];
  includeApprovalFields?: boolean;
  initialProgramReference?: string;
}) {
  const parsedInitialReference =
    /^CRCC (pre-approved|post-approved) \| (.+)$/.exec(
      initialProgramReference,
    );
  const initialApprovalType =
    parsedInitialReference?.[1] === "post-approved"
      ? "post_approved"
      : "pre_approved";
  const displayedProgramReference =
    parsedInitialReference?.[2] ?? initialProgramReference;
  const [amounts, setAmounts] = useState<Record<string, string>>(() =>
    seedAllocationAmounts(initialMatches),
  );
  const selectable = credential.requirements.filter(
    (requirement) =>
      requirementStatus(requirement) === "applies" &&
      requirement.isActive !== false,
  );
  const general = selectable.find((requirement) =>
    requirement.ruleCategoryId?.endsWith("-general"),
  );
  const professionalDevelopment = selectable.find((requirement) =>
    requirement.ruleCategoryId?.endsWith("-professional-development"),
  );
  const ethics = selectable.find((requirement) =>
    requirement.ruleCategoryId?.endsWith("-ethics"),
  );
  const exactRequirements = [
    general,
    professionalDevelopment,
    ethics,
  ].filter((requirement): requirement is Requirement =>
    Boolean(requirement),
  );

  const amountInput = (requirement: Requirement) => (
    <label className="allocator-row" key={requirement.id}>
      <span className="allocator-row-text">
        <strong>{requirement.name}</strong>
        <small>
          {requirement === ethics
            ? "Overlaps General / Other; does not add clock hours"
            : requirement === professionalDevelopment
              ? "Separate activity type; no more than 50 hours per cycle"
              : "Accepted CRC credit that is not Professional Development"}
        </small>
      </span>
      <TextInput
        className="field-control-mono"
        aria-label={`${requirement.name} accepted clock hours`}
        name={`requirementMatch:${requirement.id}`}
        type="number"
        min="0"
        max={availableUnits > 0 ? availableUnits : undefined}
        step="0.01"
        inputMode="decimal"
        value={amounts[requirement.id] ?? "0"}
        onChange={(event) => {
          const entered = event.currentTarget.value;
          setAmounts((current) => ({
            ...current,
            [requirement.id]: entered,
          }));
        }}
        required
      />
    </label>
  );

  const generalAmount = general ? allocationAmount(amounts, general.id) : 0;
  const creditTypeTotal =
    generalAmount +
    (professionalDevelopment
      ? allocationAmount(amounts, professionalDevelopment.id)
      : 0);
  const ethicsAmount = ethics ? allocationAmount(amounts, ethics.id) : 0;

  return (
    <fieldset className="allocator">
      <legend>CRCC accepted clock-hour allocation</legend>
      <p>
        Enter the exact hours CRCC accepts. General / Other plus Professional
        Development must equal the hours applied to this CRC; Ethics is the
        overlapping portion of General / Other.
      </p>
      {exactRequirements.length === 3 ? (
        <section>
          <div className="allocator-heading">
            <strong>Credit-type and ethics amounts</strong>
            <small>
              Assign every applied hour once between the two credit types, then
              enter any ethics portion already included in General / Other.
            </small>
          </div>
          {availableUnits > 0 ? (
            <AllocationTally
              label="General / Other + Professional Development"
              total={creditTypeTotal}
              target={availableUnits}
              targetLabel="applied hours"
              mode="exact"
            />
          ) : (
            <p className="allocation-tally" data-state="waiting">
              <span className="allocation-tally-label">
                General / Other + Professional Development
              </span>
              <span className="allocation-tally-figure">
                Enter the hours to apply first
              </span>
            </p>
          )}
          <AllocationTally
            label="Ethics"
            total={ethicsAmount}
            target={generalAmount}
            targetLabel="General / Other hours"
            mode="ceiling"
          />
          <div className="allocator-list">
            {exactRequirements.map(amountInput)}
          </div>
        </section>
      ) : (
        <p>
          This CRC template is missing an exact-allocation requirement. Refresh
          the credential before saving.
        </p>
      )}
      {includeApprovalFields ? (
        <>
          <Field
            label="CRCC approval pathway"
            hint="Choose post-approved only when the activity was submitted through CRCC’s individual review process."
          >
            <Select
              name="crcApprovalType"
              defaultValue={initialApprovalType}
              required
              options={[
                { value: "pre_approved", label: "CRCC pre-approved activity" },
                { value: "post_approved", label: "CRCC post-approved activity" },
              ]}
            />
          </Field>
          <Field
            label="CRCC approval number or program reference"
            hint="A current pre-approval number begins with 60007 or TRN. For post-approval, use the CRCC submission or decision reference."
          >
            <TextInput
              name="crcProgramReference"
              defaultValue={displayedProgramReference}
              placeholder="Approval number, program ID, or post-approval reference"
              maxLength={500}
              required
            />
          </Field>
          <Checkbox
            name="crcApprovalAttested"
            required
            label="These are CRCC-accepted hours"
            description="I confirmed the activity, approval pathway, program reference, and exact accepted hours in the current CRCC record. For a post-approved activity, CRCC accepted the submission, the review fee is paid, and I will keep the supporting decision and program proof. This same program has not already been submitted in this certification period."
          />
        </>
      ) : (
        <Checkbox
          name="crcApprovalAttested"
          required
          label="I rechecked this exact CRCC allocation"
          description="The corrected General / Other, Professional Development, and Ethics amounts match the saved CRCC approval record."
        />
      )}
    </fieldset>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Checkbox } from "../../../components/Form";
import {
  CFP_2027_GENERAL_CATEGORY_ID,
  DENTAL_AGGREGATE_BY_SUBTYPE_CATEGORY_ID,
  DENTAL_AGGREGATE_PARENT_CATEGORY_ID_SET,
  DENTAL_SUBTYPE_CATEGORY_IDS_BY_AGGREGATE,
  NJ_LCSW_CREDIT_CATEGORY_GROUP,
} from "../../../lib/catalogCategories";
import { compactNumber } from "../../../lib/format";
import { requirementKind, requirementStatus } from "../../../lib/readiness";
import {
  nextRequirementSelection,
  requirementIncompatibilityMessage,
} from "../../../lib/requirementCompatibility";
import type { Credential, Requirement } from "../../../lib/workspaceTypes";

// The requirement tags for a generic credential (Essentials of the Log
// sheet; also the Apply and Categorize modals). Each row is the Checkbox
// primitive — a visible native input named `requirementIds` — so FormData
// carries every checked id and forced colours draw the state without a rule.
// The exclusive-group and dental aggregate/subtype rules are unchanged
// (app/lib/requirementCompatibility.ts, the credentialRules constants).
export function RequirementPicker({
  credential,
  initialRequirementIds = [],
}: {
  credential: Credential | null;
  initialRequirementIds?: string[];
}) {
  const [selectedRequirementIds, setSelectedRequirementIds] = useState<
    string[]
  >(() => [...new Set(initialRequirementIds)]);
  const requiresCfpActivityType =
    credential?.requirements.some(
      (requirement) =>
        requirement.ruleCategoryId === CFP_2027_GENERAL_CATEGORY_ID,
    ) ?? false;
  const requiresMaximumClassification =
    credential?.requirements.some(
      (requirement) =>
        requirementKind(requirement) === "maximum" &&
        Boolean(requirement.exclusiveGroup) &&
        requirementStatus(requirement) === "applies" &&
        requirement.isActive !== false,
    ) ?? false;
  const requiresLcswCreditCategory =
    credential?.requirements.some(
      (requirement) =>
        requirement.exclusiveGroup === NJ_LCSW_CREDIT_CATEGORY_GROUP &&
        requirementStatus(requirement) === "applies" &&
        requirement.isActive !== false,
    ) ?? false;
  const selectable =
    credential?.requirements.filter(
      (requirement) =>
        requirementStatus(requirement) === "applies" &&
        requirement.isActive !== false &&
        requirement.isDentalCheckpoint !== true &&
        requirement.ruleCategoryId !== CFP_2027_GENERAL_CATEGORY_ID &&
        !DENTAL_AGGREGATE_PARENT_CATEGORY_ID_SET.has(
          requirement.ruleCategoryId ?? "",
        ),
    ) ?? [];
  const unresolved =
    credential?.requirements.filter(
      (requirement) =>
        requirementStatus(requirement) === "needs_confirmation",
    ).length ?? 0;

  const toggleRequirement = (requirement: Requirement, checked: boolean) => {
    setSelectedRequirementIds((current) => {
      let next = nextRequirementSelection(current, requirement, selectable, checked);
      const categoryId = requirement.ruleCategoryId ?? "";
      const aggregateCategoryId =
        DENTAL_AGGREGATE_BY_SUBTYPE_CATEGORY_ID.get(categoryId);
      const categoryIdByRequirementId = new Map(
        selectable.map((candidate) => [
          candidate.id,
          candidate.ruleCategoryId ?? "",
        ]),
      );
      const categoryIdOf = (requirementId: string) =>
        categoryIdByRequirementId.get(requirementId) ?? "";
      if (checked && aggregateCategoryId) {
        const aggregateRequirement = selectable.find(
          (candidate) =>
            candidate.ruleCategoryId === aggregateCategoryId,
        );
        if (
          aggregateRequirement &&
          !next.includes(aggregateRequirement.id)
        ) {
          // The aggregate belongs to its own exclusive group, so add it the
          // same way a direct click would; a raw append would leave two
          // members of that group checked and the save would conflict.
          next = nextRequirementSelection(
            next,
            aggregateRequirement,
            selectable,
            true,
          );
        }
      }
      if (!checked && aggregateCategoryId) {
        // Clearing the last subtype orphans the aggregate that was added with
        // it, and the server rejects an aggregate without a subtype.
        const subtypeCategoryIds =
          DENTAL_SUBTYPE_CATEGORY_IDS_BY_AGGREGATE.get(aggregateCategoryId);
        const keepsAnySubtype = next.some((requirementId) =>
          Boolean(subtypeCategoryIds?.has(categoryIdOf(requirementId))),
        );
        if (!keepsAnySubtype) {
          next = next.filter(
            (requirementId) =>
              categoryIdOf(requirementId) !== aggregateCategoryId,
          );
        }
      }
      // A subtype may only stay selected while its aggregate is. Unchecking
      // the aggregate, or replacing it through its exclusive group, drops the
      // subtypes the server would otherwise reject as orphaned.
      for (const [
        parentCategoryId,
        subtypeCategoryIds,
      ] of DENTAL_SUBTYPE_CATEGORY_IDS_BY_AGGREGATE) {
        const aggregateOffered = selectable.some(
          (candidate) => candidate.ruleCategoryId === parentCategoryId,
        );
        if (!aggregateOffered) continue;
        const aggregateSelected = next.some(
          (requirementId) => categoryIdOf(requirementId) === parentCategoryId,
        );
        if (aggregateSelected) continue;
        next = next.filter(
          (requirementId) =>
            !subtypeCategoryIds.has(categoryIdOf(requirementId)),
        );
      }
      return next;
    });
  };

  const rowHint = (requirement: Requirement) =>
    requirementIncompatibilityMessage(requirement, selectable) ??
    (requirementKind(requirement) === "maximum" && requirement.relation === "nested"
      ? `Counts up to ${compactNumber(requirement.requiredUnits)} ${credential?.unitLabel ?? "units"} and rolls up to its parent cap; select any other subject tags too`
      : requirementKind(requirement) === "maximum"
        ? `Counts up to ${compactNumber(requirement.requiredUnits)} ${credential?.unitLabel ?? "units"}`
        : requirement.relation === "nested"
          ? "Also rolls up to its parent requirement"
          : requirement.exclusiveGroup
            ? "Choose only one activity type from this group"
            : requirement.relation === "overlapping"
              ? "May overlap another selected requirement"
              : "Counts within the overall total");

  return (
    <fieldset className="requirement-picker">
      <legend>
        Requirements this activity satisfies{" "}
        <span className="field-optional">
          {requiresCfpActivityType ||
          requiresMaximumClassification ||
          requiresLcswCreditCategory
            ? "Activity type required"
            : "Optional"}
        </span>
      </legend>
      {selectable.length ? (
        <div className="requirement-choice-list">
          {selectable.map((requirement) => (
            <Checkbox
              key={requirement.id}
              className={
                requirement.relation === "nested"
                  ? "requirement-choice nested"
                  : "requirement-choice"
              }
              name="requirementIds"
              value={requirement.id}
              checked={selectedRequirementIds.includes(requirement.id)}
              onChange={(event) =>
                toggleRequirement(requirement, event.currentTarget.checked)
              }
              label={requirement.name}
              description={rowHint(requirement)}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <p className="requirement-picker-empty">
          {requiresCfpActivityType
            ? "Choose a CFP activity type before saving."
            : "Save without a tag and it will count toward the overall total."}
        </p>
      )}
      <small className="requirement-picker-hint">
        {requiresCfpActivityType
          ? "Choose Principal Topics, Practice Management, or Ethics. General CE is calculated from the selected activity type."
          : requiresMaximumClassification
            ? "Choose exactly one option from each capped activity-type group, plus every other rule this learning genuinely satisfies."
            : "Select every rule this learning genuinely satisfies. Overall credits are still counted only once."}
        {unresolved
          ? ` Confirm ${unresolved} conditional ${
              unresolved === 1 ? "rule" : "rules"
            } in the credential plan before tagging them.`
          : ""}
      </small>
    </fieldset>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { Button } from "../../components/Button";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/EmptyState";
import {
  Checkbox,
  DateInput,
  ErrorSummary,
  Field,
  Select,
  TextArea,
  TextInput,
} from "../../components/Form";
import { Icon } from "../../components/Icon";
import { Modal, Sheet, serializeForm } from "../../components/Modal";
import { useToast } from "../../components/Toast";
import { FORM_ACTION_KEY } from "../../lib/actionKeys";
import {
  ACTIVITY_DRAFT_MAX_UNITS,
  ACTIVITY_DRAFT_PROVIDER_MAX_LENGTH,
  ACTIVITY_DRAFT_TITLE_MAX_LENGTH,
  hasMeaningfulActivityDraft,
} from "../../lib/activityDraft";
import { isPriorPeriodCarryoverEntry } from "../../lib/activityRules";
import {
  crcApprovalPayload,
  crcRequirementMatchPayload,
  nremtRequirementMatchPayload,
} from "../../lib/allocation";
import { scanCertificateImage } from "../../lib/certificateOcr";
import { DIALOG_NAMES, type DescribedError } from "../../lib/copy";
import {
  confirmedCarryoverWindowStart,
  isCrcCredential,
  isNremtCredential,
} from "../../lib/credentialRules";
import { isOpenCycle } from "../../lib/cycles";
import { compactNumber, formatDate } from "../../lib/format";
import {
  ACTIVITY_FORMAT_OPTIONS,
  NOTES_MAX_LENGTH,
  activityPayload,
  hasUnrecoverableInput,
  validateLogActivity,
  type LogActivityField,
  type LogActivityValidation,
} from "../../lib/logActivityForm";
import { uploadEvidenceFile } from "../../lib/workspaceApi";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../lib/workspaceStore";
import type {
  ActivityScanState,
  CrcApprovalPayload,
  RequirementMatchPayload,
  Workspace,
} from "../../lib/workspaceTypes";
import {
  EvidenceDropZone,
  evidenceFileProblem,
  evidenceFileType,
} from "../logActivity/EvidenceDropZone";
import { ScanCertificate } from "../logActivity/ScanCertificate";
import { useActivityDraft } from "../logActivity/useActivityDraft";
import { CrcRequirementAllocator } from "../parts/allocators/CrcRequirementAllocator";
import { NremtRequirementAllocator } from "../parts/allocators/NremtRequirementAllocator";
import { RequirementPicker } from "../parts/allocators/RequirementPicker";

// The Log activity sheet (spec §6): ONE <form> in two steps — Essentials
// (title, completion date, credits, credential + requirement tags, the
// evidence drop zone, the opt-in scan) and a Details disclosure (provider,
// credits that count, the NREMT/CRCC allocator, format, notes, the evidence
// and carryover boxes) — under a sticky footer whose primary is the one verb.
// Not a wizard: Save from step one alone is the spec, Modal's dirty snapshot
// and Tab trap assume one stable form, and the three payload builders read
// FormData as they always did. Every Details control is mounted from the
// start and the section is hidden with the `hidden` attribute — never
// `disabled` (which would drop the fields from FormData and from submit),
// never unmounted. The sheet owns its credential (architecture-05): nothing
// app-wide moves while it is open. It owns its errors too (app-ux-24): one
// ErrorSummary for the form, one for a refused save, never the page banner.
// Closing asks only for what the browser draft cannot keep (a file, allocator
// amounts, tags, format, notes, a CRCC reference); title, date, credits,
// credential and provider persist through useActivityDraft, so Escape on a
// title-only sheet still closes at once (tests/e2e/primitives.spec.ts).

const IDLE_SCAN: ActivityScanState = {
  phase: "idle",
  label: "",
  progress: 0,
  suggestions: {},
};
const NO_ERRORS: LogActivityValidation = { fields: {}, summary: [] };
const DETAIL_FIELDS: readonly LogActivityField[] = [
  "provider",
  "allocatedUnits",
  "carryover",
  "format",
  "notes",
];

// ModalsHost renders this only under `workspace && activityOpen`; the guard
// here keeps the hooks below unconditional (rules-of-hooks) without a throw.
export function LogActivityModal() {
  const store = useWorkspace();
  if (!store.workspace) return null;
  return <LogActivitySheet workspace={store.workspace} />;
}

function LogActivitySheet({ workspace }: { workspace: Workspace }) {
  const store = useWorkspace();
  const toast = useToast();
  const { isOnline, pending, modals } = store;
  const today = store.today();
  const openCycles = workspace.credentials.filter(isOpenCycle);
  const preselectId = modals.activityPreselectId;
  const preselected = openCycles.find((candidate) => candidate.id === preselectId) ?? null;
  const defaultCredentialId =
    (workspace.activeCycleId &&
    openCycles.some((candidate) => candidate.id === workspace.activeCycleId)
      ? workspace.activeCycleId
      : openCycles[0]?.id) ?? "";

  // The credential this entry targets: a shortcut that named one wins, then
  // a restored draft's, then the active cycle, then the first open cycle.
  const [credentialId, setCredentialId] = useState(
    () => preselected?.id ?? defaultCredentialId,
  );
  const draft = useActivityDraft({
    namespace: workspace.user.draftStorageNamespace,
    legacyEmail: workspace.user.email,
    open: true,
    credentialId,
    preselectCredentialId: preselectId,
    today,
  });
  const { draft: fields, setDraft } = draft;
  // A restored draft re-targets the sheet (an inactive credential → none,
  // with the warning) unless a shortcut named one. Deferred one tick — an
  // effect may not set state synchronously (react-hooks/set-state-in-effect).
  const restoredTarget = !draft.restored
    ? null
    : (draft.restoredCredentialId ?? (draft.restoreWarning ? "" : null));
  useEffect(() => {
    if (restoredTarget === null || preselectId) return;
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => setCredentialId(restoredTarget), 0);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [restoredTarget, preselectId]);

  const [evidence, setEvidence] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [evidenceError, setEvidenceError] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined);
  const [scan, setScan] = useState<ActivityScanState>(IDLE_SCAN);
  const [detailsOpen, setDetailsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [notRequired, setNotRequired] = useState<boolean | null>(null);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<LogActivityValidation>(NO_ERRORS);
  const [serverError, setServerError] = useState<DescribedError | null>(null);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [discardPrompt, setDiscardPrompt] = useState(false);
  // Written in handlers and effects only, never during render (react-hooks/refs).
  const scanSequence = useRef(0);
  const formRef = useRef<HTMLFormElement>(null);
  const snapshot = useRef<string | null>(null);

  const formId = useId();
  const essentialsId = useId();
  const detailsId = useId();
  const detailsTitleId = useId();
  const evidenceId = useId();
  const ids: Record<LogActivityField, string> = {
    title: useId(),
    completionDate: useId(),
    totalUnits: useId(),
    allocatedUnits: useId(),
    credentialId: useId(),
    provider: useId(),
    carryover: useId(),
    format: useId(),
    notes: useId(),
  };

  // The backdrop's dirty check compares against a snapshot taken one tick
  // after mount — after the draft hook has restored — plus the attached file,
  // which lives in state rather than in the (cleared) file input. A draft
  // restored later than that reads as dirty, which keeps the backdrop from
  // discarding it: the safe direction.
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      snapshot.current = formRef.current ? serializeForm(formRef.current) : null;
    }, 0);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, []);

  const credential = openCycles.find((candidate) => candidate.id === credentialId) ?? null;
  const isNremt = isNremtCredential(credential);
  const isCrc = isCrcCredential(credential);
  const forcedDetails = isNremt || isCrc;
  const showDetails = forcedDetails || detailsOpen;
  const carryoverStart = confirmedCarryoverWindowStart(credential);
  const windowStart = carryoverStart ?? credential?.cycleStart;
  const isCarryover = isPriorPeriodCarryoverEntry(fields.completionDate, credential);
  const evidenceNotRequired = !isCarryover && (notRequired ?? isCrc);
  const busy = pending.form || uploading;
  const suggested = "Suggested from the scan — check it.";
  const dateHint = credential
    ? carryoverStart
      ? "Use a date in this cycle, or the actual prior-cycle date for confirmed carryover."
      : `Between ${formatDate(credential.cycleStart)} and ${formatDate(credential.deadline)}.`
    : undefined;

  const isDirty = () =>
    Boolean(evidence) ||
    (formRef.current !== null &&
      snapshot.current !== null &&
      serializeForm(formRef.current) !== snapshot.current);

  // Closing: persist the draft first; refuse (and say so) when the browser
  // will not keep it, otherwise close through the store.
  const closeSheet = () => {
    if (!draft.flush()) {
      toast.show({
        message:
          "This browser couldn’t save your draft. Keep the sheet open or log the activity before leaving.",
      });
      return false;
    }
    scanSequence.current += 1;
    modals.close("logActivity");
    return true;
  };
  const requestClose = () => {
    if (busy) return;
    const form = formRef.current;
    if (form && hasUnrecoverableInput(new FormData(form), Boolean(evidence))) {
      setDiscardPrompt(true);
      return;
    }
    closeSheet();
  };

  const acceptFile = (file: File): boolean => {
    const problem = evidenceFileProblem(file);
    if (problem) {
      setEvidenceError(problem);
      return false;
    }
    scanSequence.current += 1; // a new file cancels a scan in flight
    setEvidenceError(undefined);
    setEvidence(file);
    setScan(IDLE_SCAN);
    return true;
  };
  const removeEvidence = () => {
    scanSequence.current += 1;
    setEvidence(null);
    setEvidenceError(undefined);
    setScan(IDLE_SCAN);
  };

  // The reader, run only from ScanCertificate's button (never from a pick):
  // clears what an earlier scan suggested, reads on this device, and applies
  // suggestions worth ≥ 25 confidence, marking each field it filled.
  const runScan = async (target: File) => {
    const imageType = evidenceFileType(target);
    if (!imageType || imageType === "application/pdf") return;
    scanSequence.current += 1;
    const sequence = scanSequence.current;
    const previous = scan.suggestions;
    setDraft((current) => ({
      title: previous.title === current.title ? "" : current.title,
      provider: previous.provider === current.provider ? "" : current.provider,
      completionDate:
        previous.completionDate === current.completionDate ? today : current.completionDate,
      totalUnits:
        previous.credits !== undefined && String(previous.credits) === current.totalUnits
          ? ""
          : current.totalUnits,
      allocatedUnits:
        previous.credits !== undefined &&
        String(previous.credits) === current.totalUnits &&
        current.allocatedUnits === current.totalUnits
          ? ""
          : current.allocatedUnits,
    }));
    setScan({
      phase: "scanning",
      label: "Preparing the image on this device",
      progress: 0.02,
      suggestions: {},
    });
    try {
      const ocrFile =
        target.type === imageType
          ? target
          : new File([target], target.name, { type: imageType, lastModified: target.lastModified });
      const result = await scanCertificateImage(ocrFile, (scanProgress) => {
        if (scanSequence.current !== sequence) return;
        setScan((current) => ({
          ...current,
          phase: "scanning",
          label: scanProgress.label,
          progress: scanProgress.progress,
        }));
      });
      if (scanSequence.current !== sequence) return;
      const suggestions = result.confidence >= 25 ? result.suggestions : {};
      const count = Object.values(suggestions).filter((value) => value !== undefined).length;
      if (count) {
        setDraft((current) => {
          const suggestedUnits =
            suggestions.credits !== undefined ? String(suggestions.credits) : current.totalUnits;
          return {
            title: suggestions.title ?? current.title,
            provider: suggestions.provider ?? current.provider,
            completionDate: suggestions.completionDate ?? current.completionDate,
            totalUnits: suggestedUnits,
            allocatedUnits:
              !current.allocatedUnits || current.allocatedUnits === current.totalUnits
                ? suggestedUnits
                : current.allocatedUnits,
          };
        });
        setScan({
          phase: "success",
          label: `Found ${count} ${count === 1 ? "detail" : "details"}. Check each suggested field before you log.`,
          progress: 1,
          suggestions,
        });
      } else {
        setScan({
          phase: "manual",
          label:
            "No labelled details were clear enough to suggest. Enter them by hand; the file stays attached.",
          progress: 1,
          suggestions: {},
        });
      }
    } catch {
      if (scanSequence.current !== sequence) return;
      setScan({
        phase: "error",
        label:
          "This image couldn’t be read on this device. Enter the details by hand; the file stays attached.",
        progress: 0,
        suggestions: {},
      });
    }
  };

  const discardDraft = () => {
    scanSequence.current += 1;
    draft.discard(); // the hook clears storage, resets the fields and posts "The draft was cleared."
    setEvidence(null);
    setEvidenceError(undefined);
    setScan(IDLE_SCAN);
    setErrors(NO_ERRORS);
  };

  const submit = async (event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (busy) return;
    const form = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
    const input = {
      title: fields.title,
      completionDate: fields.completionDate,
      totalUnits: fields.totalUnits,
      allocatedUnits: fields.allocatedUnits,
      credentialId,
      provider: fields.provider,
      format: String(form.get("format") ?? ""),
      notes: String(form.get("notes") ?? ""),
      isNremt,
      window: credential && windowStart ? { start: windowStart, end: credential.deadline } : null,
      isCarryover,
      carryoverAttested: form.get("portalCarryoverAttested") === "on",
    };
    const validation = validateLogActivity(input, ids);
    const summary = [...validation.summary];
    let requirementIds: string[] | undefined;
    let requirementMatches: RequirementMatchPayload[] | undefined;
    let crc: CrcApprovalPayload | null = null;
    if (summary.length === 0 && credential) {
      const allocatedUnits =
        Number(input.allocatedUnits) > 0 ? Number(input.allocatedUnits) : Number(input.totalUnits);
      try {
        if (isNremt) {
          requirementMatches = nremtRequirementMatchPayload(form, credential, allocatedUnits);
        } else if (isCrc) {
          requirementMatches = crcRequirementMatchPayload(form, credential, allocatedUnits);
          crc = crcApprovalPayload(form);
        } else {
          requirementIds = form.getAll("requirementIds").map(String).filter(Boolean);
        }
      } catch (matchError) {
        // The builders throw their own user-facing sentences (app/lib/allocation.ts).
        summary.push({
          message:
            matchError instanceof Error
              ? matchError.message
              : isNremt
                ? "Review the National Registry credit allocation."
                : "Review the CRC clock-hour allocation.",
        });
      }
    }
    if (summary.length) {
      // A message about a Details field opens the disclosure so its link can focus the control.
      if (DETAIL_FIELDS.some((field) => validation.fields[field]) || forcedDetails) {
        setDetailsOpen(true);
      }
      setErrors({ fields: validation.fields, summary });
      return;
    }
    if (!credential) return;
    setErrors(NO_ERRORS);
    setServerError(null);
    const totalUnits = Number(input.totalUnits);
    const allocatedUnits =
      Number(input.allocatedUnits) > 0 ? Number(input.allocatedUnits) : totalUnits;
    const success =
      allocatedUnits === totalUnits
        ? `${compactNumber(totalUnits)} ${totalUnits === 1 ? "credit" : "credits"} logged.`
        : `${compactNumber(totalUnits)} credits logged; ${compactNumber(allocatedUnits)} counted for ${credential.credentialName}.`;
    const result = await store.run(
      "addActivity",
      activityPayload({
        ...input,
        requirementIds,
        requirementMatches,
        acceptedEducationAttested: isNremt ? true : undefined,
        crc,
        evidenceStatus: evidenceNotRequired ? "not_required" : "missing",
      }),
      { key: FORM_ACTION_KEY, success },
    );
    if (!result.ok) {
      setServerError(result.copy);
      return;
    }
    // A draft the browser will not clear stays until the 30-day purge
    // (app/lib/activityDraft.ts); nothing more to say about it here.
    draft.clearSaved();
    if (evidence) {
      // The order the sheet promises: the activity first, the file against
      // the id that save returned. A plain toast replaces the store's plain
      // success toast (toastQueue); a 401 is surfaced by the reload, whose
      // own 401 path drops the workspace.
      setUploading(true);
      let uploaded = false;
      try {
        const { response, parsed } = await uploadEvidenceFile(result.id, evidence);
        if (parsed.kind === "session-ended") {
          void store.reload();
        } else {
          uploaded = parsed.kind === "json" && response.ok && Boolean(parsed.data.evidence);
        }
      } catch {
        uploaded = false;
      }
      setUploading(false);
      if (uploaded) {
        void store.reload();
        toast.show({ message: `${compactNumber(totalUnits)} credits and evidence saved.` });
      } else {
        toast.show({
          message: "Activity logged, but the file did not upload. Add it from the Activity log.",
        });
      }
    }
    scanSequence.current += 1;
    modals.close("logActivity");
  };

  const footer = openCycles.length ? (
    <>
      {!isOnline ? (
        <p className="log-footer-note" role="status">
          You’re offline. Your draft stays in this browser until you reconnect.
        </p>
      ) : null}
      <Button variant="quiet" onClick={requestClose} disabled={busy}>
        Cancel
      </Button>
      <Button
        variant="primary"
        type="submit"
        form={formId}
        pending={busy}
        pendingLabel={uploading ? "Uploading evidence…" : "Logging…"}
        disabled={!isOnline}
      >
        Log activity
      </Button>
    </>
  ) : undefined;

  return (
    <Sheet
      title={DIALOG_NAMES.logActivity}
      eyebrow={preselected ? `For ${preselected.credentialName}` : undefined}
      onClose={requestClose}
      isDirty={isDirty}
      footer={footer}
    >
      {openCycles.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          compact
          title="Add an active credential first"
          body="Credits need an open renewal cycle so iTrack knows where to count them."
          action={{
            label: "Add credential",
            onClick: () => {
              if (closeSheet()) modals.open({ kind: "credentialSetup" });
            },
          }}
          icon={<Icon name="plus" size={22} />}
        />
      ) : (
        <form
          id={formId}
          ref={formRef}
          noValidate
          className="log-activity form-stack"
          onSubmit={(event) => void submit(event)}
        >
          {draft.restored ? (
            <div className="log-draft-note" role="status">
              <Icon name="refresh" size={15} />
              <span>Draft restored from this browser.</span>
              <Button variant="quiet" size="sm" disabled={busy} onClick={discardDraft}>
                Discard draft
              </Button>
            </div>
          ) : null}
          <section className="log-step" aria-labelledby={essentialsId}>
            <h3 id={essentialsId} className="log-step-title">
              Essentials
            </h3>
            <Field
              id={ids.title}
              label="Activity"
              hint={scan.suggestions.title ? suggested : "A course, conference, webinar or other completed learning."}
              error={errors.fields.title}
            >
              <TextInput
                name="title"
                autoFocus
                maxLength={ACTIVITY_DRAFT_TITLE_MAX_LENGTH}
                placeholder="e.g., Ethics in clinical practice"
                value={fields.title}
                data-suggested={scan.suggestions.title ? "true" : undefined}
                onChange={(event) => {
                  const title = event.currentTarget.value;
                  setDraft((current) => ({ ...current, title }));
                }}
              />
            </Field>
            <div className="form-grid">
              <Field
                id={ids.completionDate}
                label="Completion date"
                hint={scan.suggestions.completionDate ? suggested : dateHint}
                error={errors.fields.completionDate}
              >
                <DateInput
                  name="completionDate"
                  value={fields.completionDate}
                  min={windowStart}
                  max={credential?.deadline}
                  data-suggested={scan.suggestions.completionDate ? "true" : undefined}
                  onValueChange={(completionDate) => {
                    setDraft((current) => ({ ...current, completionDate }));
                  }}
                />
              </Field>
              <Field
                id={ids.totalUnits}
                label="Credits earned"
                hint={
                  scan.suggestions.credits !== undefined
                    ? suggested
                    : credential
                      ? `Counted in ${credential.unitLabel}.`
                      : undefined
                }
                error={errors.fields.totalUnits}
              >
                <TextInput
                  name="totalUnits"
                  type="number"
                  inputMode="decimal"
                  className="field-control-mono"
                  min={isCrc ? 0.01 : 0.1}
                  step={isCrc ? 0.01 : 0.1}
                  max={ACTIVITY_DRAFT_MAX_UNITS}
                  placeholder="1.0"
                  value={fields.totalUnits}
                  data-suggested={scan.suggestions.credits !== undefined ? "true" : undefined}
                  onChange={(event) => {
                    // Credits that count mirror the total until edited by hand.
                    const totalUnits = event.currentTarget.value;
                    setDraft((current) => ({
                      ...current,
                      totalUnits,
                      allocatedUnits:
                        !current.allocatedUnits || current.allocatedUnits === current.totalUnits
                          ? totalUnits
                          : current.allocatedUnits,
                    }));
                  }}
                />
              </Field>
            </div>
            <Field
              id={ids.credentialId}
              label="Credential"
              error={
                draft.restoreWarning && !credentialId
                  ? "The credential this draft was for is no longer active. Choose another."
                  : errors.fields.credentialId
              }
            >
              <Select
                name="credentialId"
                value={credentialId}
                placeholder="Choose a credential"
                options={openCycles.map((candidate) => ({
                  value: candidate.id,
                  label: `${candidate.credentialName} · ${candidate.jurisdiction}`,
                }))}
                onChange={(event) => {
                  const next = event.currentTarget.value;
                  setCredentialId(next);
                }}
              />
            </Field>
            {credential && !forcedDetails ? (
              <RequirementPicker key={credential.id} credential={credential} />
            ) : null}
            <EvidenceDropZone
              inputId={evidenceId}
              file={evidence}
              onFile={(file) => {
                acceptFile(file);
              }}
              onRemove={removeEvidence}
              disabled={busy}
              error={evidenceError}
            />
            <ScanCertificate
              file={evidence}
              state={scan}
              onPick={acceptFile}
              onScan={(target) => void runScan(target)}
              disabled={busy}
            />
          </section>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="log-details-toggle"
            aria-expanded={showDetails}
            aria-controls={detailsId}
            disabled={forcedDetails}
            onClick={() => setDetailsOpen((current) => !current)}
          >
            <span>Details</span>
            <span className="field-optional">
              {isNremt ? "Required for National Registry" : isCrc ? "Required for CRCC" : "Optional"}
            </span>
            <Icon name="chevronDown" size={18} />
          </button>
          <section
            id={detailsId}
            className="log-details"
            hidden={!showDetails}
            aria-labelledby={detailsTitleId}
          >
            <h3 id={detailsTitleId} className="log-step-title">
              Details
            </h3>
            <Field
              id={ids.provider}
              label="Provider"
              optional={!isNremt}
              hint={
                scan.suggestions.provider
                  ? suggested
                  : isNremt
                    ? "State EMS-approved, CAPCE or another accepted provider."
                    : undefined
              }
              error={errors.fields.provider}
            >
              <TextInput
                name="provider"
                maxLength={ACTIVITY_DRAFT_PROVIDER_MAX_LENGTH}
                placeholder="Organization or conference name"
                value={fields.provider}
                data-suggested={scan.suggestions.provider ? "true" : undefined}
                onChange={(event) => {
                  const provider = event.currentTarget.value;
                  setDraft((current) => ({ ...current, provider }));
                }}
              />
            </Field>
            <Field
              id={ids.allocatedUnits}
              label="Credits that count for this credential"
              hint="Lower this only when the issuing body caps how much of this activity may count."
              error={errors.fields.allocatedUnits}
            >
              <TextInput
                name="allocatedUnits"
                type="number"
                inputMode="decimal"
                className="field-control-mono"
                min={isCrc ? 0.01 : 0.1}
                step={isCrc ? 0.01 : 0.1}
                max={Number(fields.totalUnits) > 0 ? Number(fields.totalUnits) : ACTIVITY_DRAFT_MAX_UNITS}
                placeholder="1.0"
                value={fields.allocatedUnits}
                onChange={(event) => {
                  const allocatedUnits = event.currentTarget.value;
                  setDraft((current) => ({ ...current, allocatedUnits }));
                }}
              />
            </Field>
            {credential && isNremt ? (
              <NremtRequirementAllocator
                key={credential.id}
                credential={credential}
                availableUnits={Number(fields.allocatedUnits) || 0}
              />
            ) : null}
            {credential && isCrc ? (
              <CrcRequirementAllocator
                key={credential.id}
                credential={credential}
                availableUnits={Number(fields.allocatedUnits) || 0}
              />
            ) : null}
            <Field id={ids.format} label="Format" optional error={errors.fields.format}>
              <Select
                name="format"
                placeholder="Choose a format"
                defaultValue=""
                options={[...ACTIVITY_FORMAT_OPTIONS]}
              />
            </Field>
            <Field
              id={ids.notes}
              label="Notes"
              optional
              hint="Up to 2,000 characters."
              error={errors.fields.notes}
            >
              <TextArea name="notes" maxLength={NOTES_MAX_LENGTH} rows={3} />
            </Field>
            <Checkbox
              name="evidenceNotRequired"
              checked={evidenceNotRequired}
              disabled={isCarryover}
              onChange={(event) => {
                const checked = event.currentTarget.checked;
                setNotRequired(checked);
              }}
              label={
                isCrc
                  ? "Not required for CRCC pre-approved credit"
                  : "No evidence is required for this activity"
              }
              description="Keep this off unless the issuing body accepts the record without a certificate."
            />
            {isCarryover ? (
              <Checkbox
                id={ids.carryover}
                name="portalCarryoverAttested"
                label="The issuing authority permits this carryover"
                description="I chose the evidence-backed carryover source and only compatible classifiers, entered the actual prior-period date, and will keep the authority record."
              />
            ) : null}
          </section>
          {hasMeaningfulActivityDraft(fields) || draft.restored ? (
            <p className="log-draft-status" role="status" aria-live="polite">
              <strong>
                {draft.status === "saved"
                  ? "Saved in this browser"
                  : draft.status === "unavailable"
                    ? "Browser draft unavailable"
                    : "Saving in this browser"}
              </strong>{" "}
              Your title, date, credits, credential and provider are kept unencrypted in this
              browser until you log or discard them. Files and scan text are not.
            </p>
          ) : null}
          {errors.summary.length ? (
            <ErrorSummary title="Check the form" errors={errors.summary} />
          ) : null}
          {serverError ? (
            <ErrorSummary
              title="This activity was not logged"
              errors={[{ message: serverError.next }]}
              detail={serverError.detail ?? undefined}
            />
          ) : null}
        </form>
      )}
      {discardPrompt && (
        <Modal title={DIALOG_NAMES.discardActivity} onClose={() => setDiscardPrompt(false)}>
          <p className="modal-prompt-body">
            Your title, date, credits, credential and provider stay in this browser as a draft.
            The attached file and the requirement choices will be lost.
          </p>
          <div className="form-actions">
            <Button variant="secondary" data-autofocus onClick={() => setDiscardPrompt(false)}>
              Keep editing
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="destructive"
              onClick={() => {
                setDiscardPrompt(false);
                closeSheet();
              }}
            >
              Discard
            </Button>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}
    </Sheet>
  );
}
```

`app/screens/modals/EditActivityModal.tsx` (whole file):

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { Button } from "../../components/Button";
import { Checkbox, DateInput, ErrorSummary, Field, TextInput } from "../../components/Form";
import { Sheet, serializeForm } from "../../components/Modal";
import { useDiscardGuard } from "../../components/useDiscardGuard";
import {
  ACTIVITY_DRAFT_MAX_UNITS,
  ACTIVITY_DRAFT_PROVIDER_MAX_LENGTH,
  ACTIVITY_DRAFT_TITLE_MAX_LENGTH,
} from "../../lib/activityDraft";
import { allocationsFor } from "../../lib/activityRules";
import { DIALOG_NAMES, type DescribedError } from "../../lib/copy";
import type { Activity } from "../../lib/workspaceTypes";

// "Edit activity" — the edit variant of the Log sheet (copy table E). An
// uncontrolled form seeded from the activity, read as FormData on submit
// exactly as the old ActivityEditorModal did; the NREMT/CRCC reconfirm rows
// are the Checkbox primitive with their existing sentences; evidence is
// managed from the Activity log, so this only says so. The archive stays a
// two-step confirm inside the sheet (decision 9; Task 11 gives the log's
// rows a direct Archive with Undo). Closing a changed form asks first
// through useDiscardGuard; `isDirty` is one function shared by the guard and
// the Sheet's backdrop so the two never disagree.
export function EditActivityModal({
  activity,
  error,
  pending,
  isOnline,
  onClose,
  onSave,
  onArchive,
}: {
  activity: Activity;
  error: DescribedError | null;
  pending: boolean;
  isOnline: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSave: (input: {
    title: string;
    provider: string;
    completionDate: string;
    totalUnits: number;
    acceptedEducationAttested?: boolean;
    crcApprovalAttested?: boolean;
  }) => void;
  onArchive: () => void;
}) {
  const [confirmingArchive, setConfirmingArchive] = useState(false);
  const formRef = useRef<HTMLFormElement>(null);
  const snapshot = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const formId = useId();
  const titleId = useId();
  const dateId = useId();
  const unitsId = useId();
  const providerId = useId();
  const archiveTitleId = useId();
  const allocations = allocationsFor(activity);
  const hasNremtAllocation = allocations.some((allocation) =>
    allocation.credentialRuleSetId?.startsWith("nremt-"),
  );
  const hasCrcAllocation = allocations.some((allocation) =>
    allocation.credentialRuleSetId?.startsWith("crcc-"),
  );

  // The mount snapshot, one tick after the defaultValues have committed.
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      snapshot.current = formRef.current ? serializeForm(formRef.current) : null;
    }, 0);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, []);
  const isDirty = () =>
    formRef.current !== null &&
    snapshot.current !== null &&
    serializeForm(formRef.current) !== snapshot.current;
  const guard = useDiscardGuard({ formRef, onClose, isDirty });

  const handleSubmit = (event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (pending) return;
    const form = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
    onSave({
      title: String(form.get("title") ?? ""),
      provider: String(form.get("provider") ?? ""),
      completionDate: String(form.get("completionDate") ?? ""),
      totalUnits: Number(form.get("totalUnits")),
      acceptedEducationAttested: hasNremtAllocation
        ? form.get("acceptedEducationAttested") === "on"
        : undefined,
      crcApprovalAttested: hasCrcAllocation
        ? form.get("crcApprovalAttested") === "on"
        : undefined,
    });
  };

  const evidenceLine =
    activity.evidenceStatus === "not_required"
      ? "not required"
      : `${activity.evidenceCount ?? 0} on file`;

  const footer = (
    <>
      <Button variant="quiet" onClick={guard.requestClose} disabled={pending}>
        Cancel
      </Button>
      <Button
        variant="primary"
        type="submit"
        form={formId}
        pending={pending}
        pendingLabel="Saving…"
        disabled={!isOnline}
      >
        Save changes
      </Button>
    </>
  );

  return (
    <Sheet
      title={DIALOG_NAMES.editActivity}
      eyebrow={activity.title}
      onClose={guard.requestClose}
      isDirty={isDirty}
      footer={footer}
    >
      <div className="form-stack">
        {error ? (
          <ErrorSummary
            title="These changes did not save"
            errors={[{ message: error.next }]}
            detail={error.detail ?? undefined}
          />
        ) : null}
        <p className="modal-note">
          {allocations.length
            ? `This learning is used by ${allocations
                .map((allocation) => allocation.credentialName)
                .join(", ")}. ${
                hasNremtAllocation
                  ? "National Registry component and topic amounts stay exact, so a credit-total correction that would change that allocation must be logged as a corrected replacement record."
                  : hasCrcAllocation
                    ? "CRC credit-type and ethics amounts stay exact. Recheck any corrected activity details against the saved CRCC approval record."
                    : "If the corrected credit total is lower, any larger linked allocation and its requirement counts will be reduced to match."
              }`
            : "This record is not currently applied to a credential. Correcting it will not change renewal progress."}
        </p>
        <form id={formId} ref={formRef} className="form-stack" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
          <Field id={titleId} label="Activity">
            <TextInput
              name="title"
              autoFocus
              defaultValue={activity.title}
              maxLength={ACTIVITY_DRAFT_TITLE_MAX_LENGTH}
              required
            />
          </Field>
          <div className="form-grid">
            <Field
              id={dateId}
              label="Completion date"
              hint="Keep the date accurate for every linked credential cycle."
            >
              <DateInput name="completionDate" defaultValue={activity.completionDate} required />
            </Field>
            <Field
              id={unitsId}
              label="Credits earned"
              hint="Linked allocations above the corrected total will be reduced."
            >
              <TextInput
                name="totalUnits"
                type="number"
                inputMode="decimal"
                className="field-control-mono"
                min="0.01"
                max={ACTIVITY_DRAFT_MAX_UNITS}
                step="0.01"
                defaultValue={activity.totalUnits}
                required
              />
            </Field>
          </div>
          <Field
            id={providerId}
            label="Provider"
            optional={!hasNremtAllocation}
            hint={hasNremtAllocation ? "Required for National Registry" : undefined}
          >
            <TextInput
              name="provider"
              defaultValue={activity.provider ?? ""}
              maxLength={ACTIVITY_DRAFT_PROVIDER_MAX_LENGTH}
              required={hasNremtAllocation}
            />
          </Field>
          {hasNremtAllocation ? (
            <Checkbox
              name="acceptedEducationAttested"
              required
              label="Reconfirm accepted National Registry education"
              description="I rechecked the corrected provider, course, and post-cap credits against the current National Registry record."
            />
          ) : null}
          {hasCrcAllocation ? (
            <Checkbox
              name="crcApprovalAttested"
              required
              label="Reconfirm the saved CRCC approval record"
              description="The corrected activity title, provider, completion date, and credit total still match the saved CRCC approval or accepted post-approval record."
            />
          ) : null}
          <p className="edit-evidence-line">
            Evidence stays as it is — {evidenceLine}. Manage it from the Activity log.
          </p>
        </form>
        <section className="edit-archive" aria-labelledby={archiveTitleId}>
          <div>
            <strong id={archiveTitleId}>Archive this activity</strong>
            <p>Use archive when this learning should no longer count toward an open renewal.</p>
          </div>
          {!confirmingArchive ? (
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              disabled={pending || !isOnline}
              onClick={() => setConfirmingArchive(true)}
            >
              Archive activity
            </Button>
          ) : (
            <div className="edit-archive-confirm" role="alert">
              <p>
                <strong>Archive this activity?</strong>
                Its credits will leave active progress and exports. Evidence stays saved, and you
                can restore the activity later.
              </p>
              <div className="form-actions">
                <Button variant="quiet" disabled={pending} onClick={() => setConfirmingArchive(false)}>
                  Keep activity
                </Button>
                <Button
                  variant="destructive"
                  autoFocus
                  disabled={!isOnline}
                  pending={pending}
                  pendingLabel="Archiving…"
                  onClick={onArchive}
                >
                  Archive activity
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </section>
      </div>
      {guard.prompt}
    </Sheet>
  );
}
```

The `error` attribute at the host's site must be the `DescribedError | null` the host keeps for this editor since Task 5 (`errors=[{ message: error.next }]` was its contract); `npm run typecheck` below fails at that site — not in the component — if it is anything else, and the fix is at the site.
