- [ ] **Step 12: Replace `app/styles/log-activity.css` whole — first-class tokens, no literal, no alias, no duration literal**

The file today (after Task 6) opens with the Wave 3 banner and holds the sheet's legacy rules plus the three editor blocks; all of it goes. Every ink-on-fill pair below carries a claim in `tokens.css` (`--ink`/`--ink-muted` on `--paper`, `--paper-deep`, `--card`; `--ink-muted` and `--accent` on `--accent-soft`; `--ink-muted` on every `--state-*-soft`; each `--state-*` on its own soft fill; `--state-overdue` on `--state-overdue-soft`); the one transition reads `--duration-fill`.

```css
/*
 * Log activity (app/screens/modals/LogActivityModal.tsx, EditActivityModal.tsx,
 * app/screens/logActivity/*, app/screens/parts/allocators/*) — spec §6 Log
 * activity. A consumer for tools/contrast-audit.mjs: first-class tokens only,
 * no colour literal, no legacy alias, no duration literal (the scan progress
 * fill is the credit-bar moment, --duration-fill). Every ink-on-fill pair
 * carries a claim in tokens.css: --ink / --ink-muted on --paper, --paper-deep
 * and --card; --ink-muted and --accent on --accent-soft; --ink-muted on every
 * --state-*-soft; each --state-* on its own soft fill.
 */

/* ===== THE SHEET — one form, two steps: Essentials, then a Details disclosure ===== */
.log-activity {
  display: grid;
  gap: 20px;
}

.log-step {
  display: grid;
  gap: 16px;
}

.log-step-title {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-2xs);
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-eyebrow);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

/* The disclosure that opens step two. Its chevron turns instantly — no transition (mockup decision 6). */
.log-details-toggle {
  display: flex;
  width: 100%;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  min-height: var(--tap-comfortable);
  padding: 0 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: var(--card);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: 700;
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.log-details-toggle > .icon {
  margin-left: auto;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.log-details-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] > .icon {
  transform: rotate(180deg);
}

.log-details-toggle:disabled {
  cursor: default;
}

.log-details-toggle:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.log-details {
  display: grid;
  gap: 16px;
}

/* ===== EVIDENCE DROP ZONE ===== */
.log-evidence {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
}

.log-dropzone {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  justify-items: center;
  padding: 20px 16px;
  border: 1px dashed var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background: var(--paper);
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  text-align: center;
}

.log-dropzone > .icon {
  color: var(--accent);
}

.log-dropzone p {
  margin: 0;
}

.log-dropzone[data-dragging="true"] {
  border-style: solid;
  border-color: var(--accent);
  background: var(--accent-soft);
  color: var(--accent);
}

/* The label is dressed as a secondary button around a visually hidden file input; the ring follows the input's focus. */
.log-dropzone .btn:focus-within {
  outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.log-dropzone-file {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: var(--card);
  text-align: left;
}

.log-dropzone-file > .icon {
  color: var(--state-complete);
}

.log-dropzone-file strong {
  display: block;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
}

.log-dropzone-file small {
  display: block;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

/* ===== SCAN A CERTIFICATE — an opt-in secondary action (perf-07, app-ux-20) ===== */
.log-scan {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
}

.log-scan-actions {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
  justify-items: start;
}

.log-scan-status {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 9px 10px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: var(--accent-soft);
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
}

.log-scan-status > .icon {
  color: var(--accent);
}

.log-scan-status p {
  margin: 0;
}

.log-scan-status[data-phase="manual"],
.log-scan-status[data-phase="error"],
.log-scan-status[data-phase="pdf"] {
  background: var(--state-due-soon-soft);
}

.log-scan-status[data-phase="manual"] > .icon,
.log-scan-status[data-phase="error"] > .icon,
.log-scan-status[data-phase="pdf"] > .icon {
  color: var(--state-due-soon);
}

.log-scan-progress {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  height: 6px;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  background: var(--track);
}

.log-scan-progress > span {
  display: block;
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--accent);
  transition: width var(--duration-fill) var(--ease-out);
}

/* A field the scan filled: an accent bar at its left edge until the user checks it. */
.field-control[data-suggested="true"] {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: inset 3px 0 var(--accent);
}

/* ===== THE BROWSER DRAFT ===== */
.log-draft-note {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: var(--paper);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
}

.log-draft-note > .icon {
  color: var(--accent);
}

.log-draft-note > span {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
}

.log-draft-status,
.log-footer-note {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.log-draft-status strong {
  color: var(--ink);
}

/* The offline line takes the footer's full width, above the button row. */
.log-footer-note {
  flex: 1 0 100%;
}

/* ===== REQUIREMENT PICKER (generic credentials, in Essentials) ===== */
.requirement-picker {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0;
  border: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

.requirement-picker > legend {
  margin-bottom: 4px;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.requirement-choice-list {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 4px 16px;
}

.requirement-choice.nested {
  margin-left: 12px;
  border-left: 3px solid var(--line);
  padding-left: 10px;
}

.requirement-picker-hint,
.requirement-picker-empty {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  line-height: 1.45;
}

/* ===== NREMT / CRCC ALLOCATORS (in Details, forced open) ===== */
.allocator {
  display: grid;
  gap: 12px;
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 14px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background: var(--paper);
}

.allocator > legend {
  padding: 0 4px;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.allocator > p,
.allocator-heading small {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  line-height: 1.45;
}

.allocator > section {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
}

.allocator-heading {
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
}

.allocator-heading strong {
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
}

.allocator-list {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 8px;
}

.allocator-list.topics {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
}

.allocator-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 96px;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: var(--card);
}

.allocator-row-text strong,
.allocator-row-text small {
  display: block;
}

.allocator-row-text strong {
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
}

.allocator-row-text small {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  line-height: 1.35;
}

/* The row's control keeps the boundary and ring from primitives.css FORM; it drops to the 44px floor so three fit a row. */
.allocator-row .field-control {
  min-height: var(--tap-min);
  padding: 6px 8px;
}

.allocation-tally {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 4px 8px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 7px 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: var(--card);
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
}

.allocation-tally-label {
  font-weight: 700;
}

.allocation-tally-figure {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.allocation-tally-state {
  margin-left: auto;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.allocation-tally[data-state="balanced"] {
  border-color: var(--state-complete);
  background: var(--state-complete-soft);
  color: var(--state-complete);
}

.allocation-tally[data-state="unbalanced"] {
  border-color: var(--state-due-soon);
  background: var(--state-due-soon-soft);
  color: var(--state-due-soon);
}

/* ===== EDIT ACTIVITY (app/screens/modals/EditActivityModal.tsx) ===== */
.edit-evidence-line {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: var(--paper-deep);
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  line-height: 1.45;
}

.edit-archive {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding-top: 16px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.edit-archive strong {
  display: block;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
}

.edit-archive p {
  margin: 2px 0 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  line-height: 1.45;
}

.edit-archive-confirm {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border: 1px solid var(--state-overdue);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: var(--state-overdue-soft);
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
}

.edit-archive-confirm p {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.edit-archive-confirm strong {
  display: block;
  color: var(--state-overdue);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
}

.edit-archive-confirm .form-actions {
  padding-top: 0;
  border-top: 0;
}

@media (max-width: 540px) {
  .requirement-choice-list,
  .allocator-list,
  .allocator-list.topics {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }

  .requirement-choice.nested {
    margin-left: 8px;
  }

  .log-dropzone {
    padding: 16px 12px;
  }

  .edit-archive {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }

  .edit-archive > .btn {
    justify-self: start;
  }
}

/* Anything a finger hits inside the sheet keeps the --tap-min floor, whatever a later rule declares. */
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .log-activity .btn,
  .log-details-toggle {
    min-height: var(--tap-min);
  }
}
```

**Gotchas for this task:** Keep every `name=` the builders read — `requirementMatch:<id>`, `acceptedEducationAttested`, `crcApprovalType`, `crcProgramReference`, `crcApprovalAttested`, `requirementIds` — and the sheet's `title`, `completionDate`, `totalUnits`, `allocatedUnits`, `credentialId`, `provider`, `format`, `notes`, `evidenceNotRequired`, `portalCarryoverAttested`, `evidenceFile`: the e2e, the draft and `hasUnrecoverableInput` all key on them. The hidden Details section keeps its controls in `Modal.tsx`'s `FOCUSABLE` list (the trap filters only an element's OWN `hidden`/`aria-hidden`); that is harmless because the wrap targets are the header's close button (first) and the footer's primary (last), both visible, and the browser's own Tab skips `display: none` controls in between. The footer sits OUTSIDE the `<form>`, so its submit carries `form={formId}` and the form itself carries `noValidate` — native bubbles never fire, `validateLogActivity` is the only validator (a11y-09); the edit form keeps native validation as it always did. A message about a Details field opens the disclosure in the same event as `setErrors`, so the `ErrorSummary` link can focus the control. `ocrBundleCached` is awaited in a click handler, never during render; the notice `Modal` and the discard `Modal` are React children of the `Sheet` (the modal stack makes them top-most: Escape closes only the prompt, the sheet's backdrop goes inert) and are spelled `{x && (<Modal` — never `{x ? (<Modal`, which the modal-site guard would count as an ungated site demanding `setX(false)` in `handleSessionEnded`. `Sheet`'s `isDirty` includes `Boolean(evidence)` because the file input's value is cleared after every pick (the `File` lives in state), and its FormData snapshot is taken one tick after mount so a draft restored in the hook's own effect is in it — a restore that lands even later reads as dirty, which only keeps the backdrop from discarding it. The updater guard needs ≥ 7 `setX((current) =>` updaters under `app/` — the five field updaters and the two scan updaters in the sheet keep it satisfied on their own. The e2e OCR case fetches ≈ 4.5 MB from the dev server and ends in `data-phase="manual"` (the icon has no certificate text) — that is the pass, not `success`; it runs under `test.slow()` and asserts the phase with a 90 s timeout. The demo identity is read-only: the local-date and typing tests never submit; every other test in `log-activity.spec.ts` seeds under `freshIdentity()`. The archive confirmation's body sentence keeps today's words with the two copy-rule swaps ("proof" → "evidence", "record" → "activity") — the copy table's editor row names the alert title and the buttons; no other prose is added. `tests/e2e/primitives.spec.ts:30-47` is deliberately not edited: Escape on a title-dirty sheet still closes it, because a title is what the draft keeps.

### Task 11: Activity log: 50/page client-side table, four filters, filtered CSV export, direct row Archive with Undo, archived activities/credentials sections, pagination.ts + activityLog.ts, activity-log.css replaces history.css, activity-log.spec replaces history.spec

**Rationale:** spec §6 "Activity log (was History): paginated table (50 per page, perf-M-02), filters by credential, date range, tag; CSV export here; archived credentials section" (`docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-10-itrack-web-redesign-design.md:95`) and the §2 Wave 4 row ("each extracted to its own file as redesigned; copy rewritten … no code left in ITrackApp.tsx beyond composition"). Today the screen is `RecordsView` at `app/ITrackApp.tsx:8158-8568` (main @ `c6b1fe4`; Tasks 1–10 shift the numbers, not the text), mounted at `:4128-4169`: a slogan H1 ("Your learning, organized as you go."), a `.record-summary` stat strip carrying the `Export CSV` link, and EVERY non-archived activity as one `article.records-table` per row with no pagination — perf-M-02 measured the cost as DOM/render (7,668 nodes for 300 rows; the JSON parse was 0.8 ms), so the fix is client-side paging over the list the workspace already carries; a server page contract would be `route.ts` work and is deferred with the split (architecture-M-05). The two post-action focus moves reach across the tree by DOM id — `archiveActivityRecord` (`:3579-3611`) ends in `document.getElementById("archived-records-summary")?.focus()` and `restoreActivityRecord` (`:3613-3628`) in `document.getElementById("records-summary")?.focus()` — the architecture-14 finding, replaced here by refs inside the screen and a store that returns its result. Archiving today happens only through the editor's two-step confirm; the row gains a direct Archive because the write is reversible through the 10 s Undo toast (the app-ux-08 pattern). The log's own "Log activity" header action goes: the rail and the bottom nav already carry the one verb (app-ux-12), and the copy-table row for the Activity log (section F) writes every string this task renders — the functional H1 "Activity log", the caption "Logged activities", the evidence words, the pager count, the two empty states and the two archived disclosures; the archive/restore toasts are row 122 of the copy table ("Activity archived." / "Activity archived. Its evidence is kept." + Undo / "Activity restored."). `history.css` (382 lines) is entirely on legacy aliases and dies with the view; `activity-log.css` is born on first-class tokens with no hover tint, no shadow and no transition (spec §5.1 Motion — the 160 ms `.disclosure-chevron` literal in `legacy-shared.css:537` dies here with its last consumer).

**Decisions:** (1) Pagination is client-side over `workspace.activities`: `page` is React state, `paginate(filtered, page)` re-clamps on every render, so an archive that empties page 2 lands on page 1 without an effect, and every filter change sets page 1. (2) The legacy view's three modal props (`onEvidence`/`onAllocate`/`onClassify`) shrink to two quiet row buttons kept so no path is lost until Edit activity absorbs them (recorded for Task 19's deviations note as a Wave 5 follow-up): "Evidence" (`aria-label="Evidence for {title}"` → `modals.open({ kind: "evidence", activity })`, shown when the activity is not `not_required` or has a removal pending — the legacy Upload/Manage condition — and on a frozen row only when evidence is attached, the legacy "View proof") and "Apply…" (`aria-label="Apply {title} to another credential"` → `modals.open({ kind: "allocate", activity })`, shown when an open credential is not yet applied — the legacy "Use for another" condition). "Classify activity"/"Edit requirement tags" leave the log: requirement tags are edited from the credential detail's Activities section (Task 7) and the Edit sheet (Task 10); the row states the gap with "Not counted yet: needs an activity type". Both aria-labels are copy table F's "row quiet actions" row (owner 11). (3) Row Archive is direct (no confirm) and runs under `activityActionKey(activity.id)` so only that row shows pending; focus after a successful archive → the `#archived-activities-summary` disclosure (a ref), after a successful restore → the table caption (a ref, `tabIndex={-1}`); the `<summary>` gets NO `tabIndex` — it is natively focusable and must stay in the Tab order (a `tabIndex={-1}` would drop it out). (4) Export CSV is a PageHeader action — `<a className={buttonClassName("secondary")} href={exportHref(filters)}>` with no `download` attribute (the route sets `Content-Disposition`); no "Log activity" header action. (5) "Tag" = requirement name (`allocations[].categoryNames` else `categoryName`), the meaning of the CSV column "Requirement tags" — `app/lib/activityLog.ts` reads structural types so it imports nothing. (6) `exportHref` joins `encodeURIComponent` pairs, not `URLSearchParams` (which would emit `a+b`; the brief's own expectation is `credentialId=a%20b`); `url.searchParams.get` on the server decodes both the same. (7) `StatusPill` carries the evidence word with an instrument state — complete ("{n} on file"), due-soon ("Add evidence"), none ("Not required", "Removal pending") — text always in the DOM. (8) The table keeps explicit `role="table"/"rowgroup"/"row"/"columnheader"/"cell"` and `aria-labelledby` to its caption: at ≤ 820 px the rows become stacked cards through `display` changes, under which Chromium drops the implicit table roles. (9) `Icon` has no `className` prop (`app/components/Icon.tsx:146-154`: `name`, `size`, `strokeWidth`), so the chevron is wrapped in `<span className="activity-log-chevron" aria-hidden="true">`, exactly the shape the legacy `.disclosure-chevron` span had.

`tests/pagination.test.mjs` (whole file):

```js
// app/lib/pagination.ts is the Activity log's client-side pager (spec §6 Activity
// log, perf-M-02): fifty rows a page over the workspace list the client already
// holds, re-clamped on every render so a filter change or an archive never leaves
// the page index past the end. Pure and import-free, so it is tested here against
// the ESM that `npm run build:lib-test` emits (tests/cycles.test.mjs convention).
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import { PAGE_SIZE, clampPage, paginate } from "../.test-build/pagination.js";

const rows = (count) => Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => `row-${index + 1}`);

test("PAGE_SIZE is fifty and is the default page size", () => {
  assert.equal(PAGE_SIZE, 50);
  assert.equal(paginate(rows(51), 1).items.length, 50);
  assert.equal(paginate(rows(51), 1).pageCount, 2);
});

test("an empty list is one empty page whatever page is asked for", () => {
  const empty = { items: [], page: 1, pageCount: 1, start: 0, end: 0, total: 0 };
  assert.deepEqual(paginate([], 1), empty);
  assert.deepEqual(paginate([], 7), empty);
  assert.equal(clampPage(7, 0), 1);
});

test("exactly fifty rows are one page; fifty-one spill one row onto page two", () => {
  const fifty = paginate(rows(50), 1);
  assert.equal(fifty.pageCount, 1);
  assert.equal(fifty.items.length, 50);
  assert.equal(fifty.start, 0);
  assert.equal(fifty.end, 50);
  assert.equal(fifty.total, 50);
  assert.deepEqual(paginate(rows(51), 2), {
    items: ["row-51"],
    page: 2,
    pageCount: 2,
    start: 50,
    end: 51,
    total: 51,
  });
});

test("clampPage: 0, negatives, NaN and either Infinity fall to page 1; past the end lands on the last page; fractions floor", () => {
  for (const page of [0, -3, Number.NaN, Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY, Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY]) {
    assert.equal(clampPage(page, 120), 1, `page ${page}`);
  }
  assert.equal(clampPage(99, 120), 3);
  assert.equal(clampPage(2.7, 120), 2);
  assert.equal(clampPage(3, 120), 3);
  const last = paginate(rows(120), 99);
  assert.equal(last.page, 3);
  assert.deepEqual(last.items, rows(120).slice(100));
  assert.equal(last.start, 100);
  assert.equal(last.end, 120);
  assert.equal(paginate(rows(120), 2.7).page, 2);
});

test("a custom page size is honoured and the input list is never mutated", () => {
  const list = rows(7);
  const snapshot = [...list];
  assert.deepEqual(paginate(list, 2, 3), {
    items: ["row-4", "row-5", "row-6"],
    page: 2,
    pageCount: 3,
    start: 3,
    end: 6,
    total: 7,
  });
  assert.deepEqual(list, snapshot);
  assert.equal(clampPage(9, 7, 3), 3);
  // A nonsensical page size falls back to PAGE_SIZE rather than dividing by zero.
  assert.equal(paginate(list, 1, 0).pageCount, 1);
  assert.equal(paginate(list, 1, 0).items.length, 7);
});
```

```js
// app/lib/activityLog.ts is the pure half of the Activity log screen (spec §6):

// CSV column "Requirement tags"), the tag option list, and the export link that
// carries the same filters to GET /api/export. Structural types, no imports, so
// it never waits on the workspace types; tested against the build:lib-test ESM.
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import {
  EMPTY_FILTERS,
  activityTags,
  allocationTags,
  applyFilters,
  exportHref,
  hasFilters,
  tagOptions,
} from "../.test-build/activityLog.js";

const allocation = (credentialId, extra = {}) => ({ credentialId, ...extra });
const activity = (title, completionDate, allocations, extra = {}) => ({
  title,
  completionDate,
  allocations,
  ...extra,
});

const one = activity("one", "2026-03-01", [
  allocation("cred-a", { categoryNames: ["Ethics", "General"] }),
]);
const two = activity("two", "2026-02-15", [allocation("cred-b", { categoryName: "Clinical" })]);
const three = activity("three", "2026-01-20", [
  allocation("cred-a", { categoryName: "General" }),
  allocation("cred-b", { categoryNames: ["Ethics"] }),
]);
// A pre-allocation row: the top-level credentialId/categoryName are its one allocation.
const four = activity("four", "2025-12-31", undefined, {
  credentialId: "cred-c",
  categoryName: "Legacy",
});
// No allocation at all: applied to no credential, so no tag.
const five = activity("five", "2025-11-05", []);
const log = [one, two, three, four, five];
const titles = (list) => list.map((entry) => entry.title);

test("allocationTags: categoryNames when present, else categoryName, else nothing", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(allocationTags(allocation("c", { categoryNames: ["A", "B"] })), ["A", "B"]);
  assert.deepEqual(allocationTags(allocation("c", { categoryNames: [], categoryName: "Only" })), ["Only"]);
  assert.deepEqual(allocationTags(allocation("c", { categoryName: null })), []);
  assert.deepEqual(allocationTags(allocation("c")), []);
});

test("activityTags de-duplicates across allocations, keeps first-seen order and applies the legacy fallback", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(activityTags(one), ["Ethics", "General"]);
  assert.deepEqual(activityTags(three), ["General", "Ethics"]);
  assert.deepEqual(activityTags(four), ["Legacy"]);
  assert.deepEqual(activityTags(five), []);
  assert.deepEqual(activityTags({ completionDate: "2026-01-01" }), []);
});

test("tagOptions is distinct and sorted", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(tagOptions(log), ["Clinical", "Ethics", "General", "Legacy"]);
  assert.deepEqual(tagOptions([]), []);
});

test("hasFilters is false for EMPTY_FILTERS and true once any key is set", () => {
  assert.equal(hasFilters(EMPTY_FILTERS), false);
  assert.deepEqual(EMPTY_FILTERS, { credentialId: "", from: "", to: "", tag: "" });
  for (const key of ["credentialId", "from", "to", "tag"]) {
    assert.equal(hasFilters({ ...EMPTY_FILTERS, [key]: "x" }), true, key);
  }
});

test("each filter alone", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(titles(applyFilters(log, EMPTY_FILTERS)), ["one", "two", "three", "four", "five"]);
  assert.deepEqual(titles(applyFilters(log, { ...EMPTY_FILTERS, credentialId: "cred-a" })), ["one", "three"]);
  assert.deepEqual(titles(applyFilters(log, { ...EMPTY_FILTERS, credentialId: "cred-c" })), ["four"]);
  assert.deepEqual(titles(applyFilters(log, { ...EMPTY_FILTERS, credentialId: "nobody" })), []);
  // from/to are inclusive calendar-date bounds compared as ISO strings.
  assert.deepEqual(titles(applyFilters(log, { ...EMPTY_FILTERS, from: "2026-02-15" })), ["one", "two"]);
  assert.deepEqual(titles(applyFilters(log, { ...EMPTY_FILTERS, to: "2026-01-20" })), ["three", "four", "five"]);
  assert.deepEqual(titles(applyFilters(log, { ...EMPTY_FILTERS, tag: "Ethics" })), ["one", "three"]);
  assert.deepEqual(titles(applyFilters(log, { ...EMPTY_FILTERS, tag: "Legacy" })), ["four"]);

test("filters combine with AND and keep the input order; the input is never mutated", () => {
  const snapshot = [...log];

    credentialId: "cred-b",

    to: "2026-12-31",
    tag: "Ethics",

  assert.deepEqual(titles(applyFilters(log, { ...EMPTY_FILTERS, from: "2026-01-01", to: "2026-02-28" })), ["two", "three"]);
  assert.deepEqual(log, snapshot);
});

test("exportHref: bare without filters, encoded pairs in the fixed key order", () => {
  assert.equal(exportHref(EMPTY_FILTERS), "/api/export");
  assert.equal(
    exportHref({ credentialId: "a b", from: "2026-01-01", to: "", tag: "" }),
    "/api/export?credentialId=a%20b&from=2026-01-01",
  );
  assert.equal(
    exportHref({ credentialId: "", from: "", to: "2026-12-31", tag: "Ethics & law/policy" }),

    "/api/export?credentialId=c&from=2026-01-01&to=2026-06-30&tag=General",

});
```

`app/lib/pagination.ts` (whole file; no import):

```ts
// Client-side paging for the Activity log (spec §6 Activity log, perf-M-02). The
// workspace already carries every activity; what cost was rendering them all at
// once, so the screen renders one page of fifty. Pure: the page index lives in
// React state and `paginate` re-clamps it on every render, so a shrinking list
// (a filter, an archive) never leaves the index past the end. No import — it
// unit-tests build-free through build:lib-test (tests/pagination.test.mjs).
export const PAGE_SIZE = 50;

export type Page<T> = {
  items: T[];
  page: number;
  pageCount: number;
  // Zero-based slice bounds: items are list[start, end).
  start: number;
  end: number;
  total: number;
};

function sizeOf(pageSize: number): number {
  return Number.isFinite(pageSize) && pageSize >= 1 ? Math.floor(pageSize) : PAGE_SIZE;
}

function pageCountOf(total: number, pageSize: number): number {
  return Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / pageSize));
}

/** 1 for anything below 1, NaN or ±Infinity; the last page for anything past it; fractions floor. */
export function clampPage(page: number, total: number, pageSize: number = PAGE_SIZE): number {
  const pageCount = pageCountOf(total, sizeOf(pageSize));
  if (!Number.isFinite(page)) return 1;
  const whole = Math.floor(page);
  if (whole < 1) return 1;
  return Math.min(whole, pageCount);
}

export function paginate<T>(list: readonly T[], page: number, pageSize: number = PAGE_SIZE): Page<T> {
  const size = sizeOf(pageSize);
  const total = list.length;
  const current = clampPage(page, total, size);
  const start = (current - 1) * size;
  const items = list.slice(start, start + size);
  return {
    items,
    page: current,
    pageCount: pageCountOf(total, size),
    start,
    end: start + items.length,
    total,
  };
}
```

`app/lib/activityLog.ts` (whole file; no import — structural types so it never waits on the workspace types):

```ts
// The pure half of the Activity log screen (spec §6 Activity log): the four
// filters, the tag option list and the export link. A "tag" is a requirement
// name — `allocations[].categoryNames` when the allocation has matched
// requirements, else its direct `categoryName` — the same meaning as the CSV
// column "Requirement tags" (app/api/export/route.ts). Dates are compared as
// ISO calendar strings (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive at both ends, with no clock read.
export type ActivityLogFilters = {
  credentialId: string;
  from: string;
  to: string;
  tag: string;
};

export const EMPTY_FILTERS: ActivityLogFilters = { credentialId: "", from: "", to: "", tag: "" };

export type LogAllocationLike = {
  credentialId: string;
  categoryName?: string | null;
  categoryNames?: string[];
};

export type LogActivityLike = {
  completionDate: string;
  allocations?: LogAllocationLike[];
  // Pre-allocation rows carry their one allocation on the activity itself.
  credentialId?: string | null;
  categoryName?: string | null;
};

// The same fallback allocationsFor() applies (app/lib/activityRules.ts): a row
// without an allocations array but with a credentialId is one allocation.
function allocationsOf(activity: LogActivityLike): LogAllocationLike[] {
  if (activity.allocations?.length) return activity.allocations;
  if (!activity.credentialId) return [];
  return [{ credentialId: activity.credentialId, categoryName: activity.categoryName }];
}

export function allocationTags(allocation: LogAllocationLike): string[] {
  if (allocation.categoryNames?.length) return allocation.categoryNames;
  return allocation.categoryName ? [allocation.categoryName] : [];
}

/** Distinct tags across the activity's allocations, in first-seen order. */
export function activityTags(activity: LogActivityLike): string[] {
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for (const allocation of allocationsOf(activity)) {
    for (const tag of allocationTags(allocation)) seen.add(tag);
  }
  return [...seen];
}

/** Every tag in the log, distinct and sorted — the Tag filter's options. */
export function tagOptions(activities: readonly LogActivityLike[]): string[] {
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for (const activity of activities) {
    for (const tag of activityTags(activity)) seen.add(tag);
  }
  return [...seen].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
}

export function hasFilters(filters: ActivityLogFilters): boolean {
  return Boolean(filters.credentialId || filters.from || filters.to || filters.tag);
}

export function applyFilters<T extends LogActivityLike>(
  activities: readonly T[],
  filters: ActivityLogFilters,
): T[] {
  return activities.filter((activity) => {
    if (
      filters.credentialId &&
      !allocationsOf(activity).some((allocation) => allocation.credentialId === filters.credentialId)
    ) {
      return false;
    }
    if (filters.from && activity.completionDate < filters.from) return false;
    if (filters.to && activity.completionDate > filters.to) return false;
    if (filters.tag && !activityTags(activity).includes(filters.tag)) return false;
    return true;
  });
}

const EXPORT_KEYS: ReadonlyArray<keyof ActivityLogFilters> = ["credentialId", "from", "to", "tag"];

/**
 * The CSV link for the current filters: bare when nothing is set, otherwise the
 * set keys in a fixed order, each value percent-encoded (encodeURIComponent —
 * a space is %20; the route's URLSearchParams reads %20 and + alike).
 */
export function exportHref(filters: ActivityLogFilters): string {
  const pairs = EXPORT_KEYS.filter((key) => filters[key]).map(
    (key) => `${key}=${encodeURIComponent(filters[key])}`,
  );
  return pairs.length ? `/api/export?${pairs.join("&")}` : "/api/export";
}
```

```ts
// A calendar-date step with no clock read (the shape of app/lib/dates.ts
// addDaysIso): noon UTC keeps the date stable in every runner zone. Exported so
// a spec can name the same date the seed used.
export function addDays(iso: string, days: number): string {
  const date = new Date(`${iso.slice(0, 10)}T12:00:00.000Z`);
  date.setUTCDate(date.getUTCDate() + days);
  return date.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}
```

```ts
import { addDays, expect, freshIdentity, LOG_SHEET_NAME, test } from "./fixtures";

// Replaces tests/e2e/history.spec.ts and the "a real confirmation" describe of
// tests/e2e/toast.spec.ts. Spec §6 Activity log: a 50-per-page table over the
// workspace the client already holds (perf-M-02), the four filters, the CSV
// export carrying those filters, row Archive with Undo whose focus lands on the
// archived disclosure through a ref rather than a DOM id (architecture-14), and
// the two archived disclosures. The demo identity is read-only — its one
// activity is page 1 of 1 — so every write runs under freshIdentity(). Runs in
// all four projects: the phone projects stack the rows into cards, and the
// explicit table roles keep `getByRole("table")` true there.

const TABLE = { name: "Logged activities" };

test("the demo log is one page of one row, exports a CSV, and its Edit control names the row", async ({ page, context, app }) => {
  await app.goto("/history");
  await expect(page).toHaveTitle("Activity log · iTrack");
  await expect(app.tab("Activity log")).toHaveAttribute("aria-current", "page");
  await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { level: 1, name: "Activity log" })).toBeVisible();
  const table = page.getByRole("table", TABLE);
  await expect(table).toContainText("Ethics in Digital Practice");
  await expect(
    page.getByRole("navigation", { name: "Pages" }).getByRole("status"),
  ).toHaveText("Page 1 of 1 · Showing 1–1 of 1");
  // The demo activity is tagged with its Ethics requirement, so the Tag filter
  // offers it (a tag is a requirement name — the CSV's "Requirement tags").
  await expect(page.getByLabel("Tag").locator("option", { hasText: "Ethics" })).toHaveCount(1);

  const exportLink = page.getByRole("link", { name: "Export CSV" });
  await expect(exportLink).toHaveAttribute("href", "/api/export");
  const csv = await context.request.get("/api/export");
  expect(csv.status()).toBe(200);
  expect(csv.headers()["content-type"]).toContain("text/csv");
  const body = await csv.text();
  expect(body).toContain("Requirement tags");
  expect(body).toContain("Ethics in Digital Practice");

  // The row's control names its record, so it is unambiguous read aloud.
  await table.getByRole("button", { name: "Edit Ethics in Digital Practice" }).click();
  const editor = app.dialog("Edit activity");
  await expect(editor).toBeVisible();
  // Read-only against the demo: close without saving.
  await editor.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel" }).click();
  await expect(editor).toHaveCount(0);
  app.expectNoErrors();
});

test.describe("fifty-one activities", () => {
  test.use({ identity: freshIdentity() });

  test("page one holds fifty rows, page two the fifty-first, and the pager's ends are disabled", async ({ page, app }) => {
    const { id } = await app.seedCredential();
    await app.seedActivities(id, 51);
    await app.goto("/history");
    const rows = page.getByRole("table", TABLE).locator("tbody tr");
    const pager = page.getByRole("navigation", { name: "Pages" });
    const count = pager.getByRole("status");

    await expect(rows).toHaveCount(50);
    await expect(count).toHaveText("Page 1 of 2 · Showing 1–50 of 51");
    await expect(pager.getByRole("button", { name: "Previous" })).toBeDisabled();
    // The workspace lists newest first, so the last-seeded row leads page one.
    await expect(rows.first()).toContainText("E2E activity 051");

    await pager.getByRole("button", { name: "Next" }).click();
    await expect(rows).toHaveCount(1);
    await expect(rows.first()).toContainText("E2E activity 001");
    await expect(count).toHaveText("Page 2 of 2 · Showing 51–51 of 51");
    await expect(pager.getByRole("button", { name: "Next" })).toBeDisabled();

    await pager.getByRole("button", { name: "Previous" }).click();
    await expect(rows).toHaveCount(50);
    await expect(count).toHaveText("Page 1 of 2 · Showing 1–50 of 51");
    app.expectNoErrors();
  });

  test("the four filters narrow the table, reset the page, and ride on the export link", async ({ page, context, app }) => {
    const { id } = await app.seedCredential();
    await app.seedActivities(id, 51);
    await app.goto("/history");
    const rows = page.getByRole("table", TABLE).locator("tbody tr");
    const count = page.getByRole("navigation", { name: "Pages" }).getByRole("status");
    const filters = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Filters" });
    const exportLink = page.getByRole("link", { name: "Export CSV" });

    // From the 46th seeded date: activities 046–051.
    const from = addDays("2026-02-01", 45);
    const to = addDays("2026-02-01", 47);
    await filters.getByLabel("From").fill(from);
    await expect(rows).toHaveCount(6);
    await expect(count).toHaveText("Page 1 of 1 · Showing 1–6 of 6");
    await filters.getByLabel("To").fill(to);
    await expect(rows).toHaveCount(3);
    await expect(exportLink).toHaveAttribute("href", `/api/export?from=${from}&to=${to}`);
    await filters.getByRole("button", { name: "Clear filters" }).click();
    await expect(rows).toHaveCount(50);
    await expect(filters.getByRole("button", { name: "Clear filters" })).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(exportLink).toHaveAttribute("href", "/api/export");

    // A second credential with one tagged activity: the credential and tag filters.
    const { id: otherId } = await app.seedCredential({ credentialName: "E2E other credential" });
    const general = (await app.workspace()).credentials.find((credential) => credential.id === otherId)
      ?.requirements?.[0];
    expect(general?.name).toBe("General");
    await app.seedActivity(otherId, { title: "E2E other course", requirementIds: [general!.id] });
    await app.goto("/history");
    await filters.getByLabel("Credential").selectOption(otherId);
    await expect(rows).toHaveCount(1);
    await expect(rows.first()).toContainText("E2E other course");
    await expect(rows.first()).toContainText("General");
    await expect(exportLink).toHaveAttribute("href", `/api/export?credentialId=${otherId}`);
    const csv = await context.request.get(`/api/export?credentialId=${otherId}`);
    expect(csv.status()).toBe(200);
    const body = await csv.text();
    expect(body).toContain("E2E other course");
    expect(body).not.toContain("E2E activity 001");

    await filters.getByLabel("Tag").selectOption("General");
    await expect(rows).toHaveCount(1);
    await expect(exportLink).toHaveAttribute("href", `/api/export?credentialId=${otherId}&tag=General`);
    // The tag alone, any credential: still the one tagged row.
    await filters.getByLabel("Credential").selectOption("");
    await expect(rows).toHaveCount(1);
    await expect(exportLink).toHaveAttribute("href", "/api/export?tag=General");
    app.expectNoErrors();
  });
});

    const table = page.getByRole("table", TABLE);
    await expect(table).toContainText("E2E archive me");
    await table.getByRole("button", { name: "Archive E2E archive me" }).click();

    const status = page.locator('.toast-region [role="status"] .toast');
    // run()'s plain "Activity archived." is replaced by the Undo toast.
    await expect(status).toContainText("Activity archived. Its evidence is kept.");
    await expect(status.getByRole("button", { name: "Undo" })).toBeVisible();
    // The only activity is archived, so the table gives way to the empty state.
    await expect(page.getByRole("table", TABLE)).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { level: 2, name: "No activities logged yet" })).toBeVisible();
    const summary = page.locator("#archived-activities-summary");
    await expect(summary).toHaveText(/^Archived activities \(1\)/);
    // Focus went to the disclosure, never into the toast.
    await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(() => document.activeElement?.id ?? "")).toBe("archived-activities-summary");
    expect(await page.evaluate(() => Boolean(document.activeElement?.closest(".toast-region")))).toBe(false);

    await summary.click();
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Restore E2E archive me" }).click();
    await expect(page.getByRole("table", TABLE)).toContainText("E2E archive me");
    await expect(page.locator("#archived-activities-summary")).toHaveCount(0);
    // A restore lands on the table's caption.
    await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(() => document.activeElement?.tagName ?? "")).toBe("CAPTION");
    app.expectNoErrors();
  });

  test("Undo on the toast restores the row", async ({ page, app }) => {
    const { id } = await app.seedCredential();
    await app.seedActivity(id, { title: "E2E undo me" });
    await app.goto("/history");
    await page.getByRole("table", TABLE).getByRole("button", { name: "Archive E2E undo me" }).click();
    const status = page.locator('.toast-region [role="status"] .toast');
    await expect(status).toContainText("Activity archived. Its evidence is kept.");
    await status.getByRole("button", { name: "Undo" }).click();
    // The restore's own success message takes the slot the Undo toast left.
    await expect(status).toContainText("Activity restored.");
    await expect(page.getByRole("table", TABLE)).toContainText("E2E undo me");
    await expect(page.locator("#archived-activities-summary")).toHaveCount(0);
    app.expectNoErrors();
  });

  test("an archived credential is listed under Archived credentials, freezes its rows, and is restored from there", async ({ page, app }) => {
    const { id } = await app.seedCredential();
    await app.seedActivity(id, { title: "E2E frozen course" });
    const before = await app.workspace();
    await app.act("archiveCredential", {
      credentialId: id,
      expectedRevision: before.credentials[0].revision ?? 1,
    });
    await app.goto("/history");
    const table = page.getByRole("table", TABLE);
    // The activity's credential is archived: the row is read-only.
    await expect(table.getByText("Read only · closed cycle")).toBeVisible();
    await expect(table.getByRole("button", { name: "Archive E2E frozen course" })).toHaveCount(0);
    const summary = page.locator("#archived-credentials-summary");
    await expect(summary).toHaveText(/^Archived credentials \(1\)/);
    await summary.click();
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Restore E2E custom credential" }).click();
    await expect(page.locator("#archived-credentials-summary")).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(table.getByRole("button", { name: "Archive E2E frozen course" })).toBeVisible();
    expect((await app.workspace()).credentials).toHaveLength(1);
    app.expectNoErrors();
  });
});

test.describe("an empty log", () => {
  test.use({ identity: freshIdentity() });

  test("the empty state opens the Log sheet, and a filter that matches nothing offers Clear filters", async ({ page, app }) => {
    await app.goto("/history");
    const empty = page.locator(".empty-state");
    await expect(empty.getByRole("heading", { level: 2, name: "No activities logged yet" })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByRole("link", { name: "Export CSV" })).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.getByRole("region", { name: "Filters" })).toHaveCount(0);
    // Scoped to the empty state: the rail (desktop) and the bottom nav (phone)

    await expect(app.dialog(LOG_SHEET_NAME)).toBeVisible();
    await page.keyboard.press("Escape");

    await app.seedActivity(id, { title: "E2E lonely course" });

    await page.getByRole("region", { name: "Filters" }).getByLabel("From").fill("2030-01-01");
    await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { level: 2, name: "No activities match these filters" })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByRole("table", TABLE)).toHaveCount(0);
    await page.locator(".empty-state").getByRole("button", { name: "Clear filters" }).click();
    await expect(page.getByRole("table", TABLE)).toContainText("E2E lonely course");
    app.expectNoErrors();
```

```ts
  async function archiveActivity(activity: Activity): Promise<ActionResult> {
    const result = await run(
      "archiveActivity",
      { activityId: activity.id, expectedRevision: activity.revision },
      { key: activityActionKey(activity.id), success: "Activity archived." },
    );
    if (!result.ok) return result;
    setEditingActivity(null);
    // Reversible: the Undo toast (10 s, a11y-08) posts the inverse write at the
    // revision the archive just produced. The plain success toast run() showed
    // is replaced by this one (toastQueue: an action toast takes the slot).
    toast.show({
      message: "Activity archived. Its evidence is kept.",
      action: {
        label: "Undo",
        onClick: () => {
          void run(
            "restoreActivity",
            { activityId: activity.id, expectedRevision: activity.revision + 1 },
            { key: activityActionKey(activity.id), success: "Activity restored." },
          );
        },
      },
    });
    return result;
  }

  async function restoreActivity(activity: Activity): Promise<ActionResult> {
    return run(
      "restoreActivity",
      { activityId: activity.id, expectedRevision: activity.revision },
      { key: activityActionKey(activity.id), success: "Activity restored." },
    );
  }
```

`app/screens/ActivityLog.tsx` (whole file):

```tsx
"use client";

import { useId, useMemo, useRef, useState, type ChangeEvent } from "react";
import { Button } from "../components/Button";
import { EmptyState } from "../components/EmptyState";
import { DateInput, Field, Select } from "../components/Form";
import { Icon } from "../components/Icon";
import { PageHeader } from "../components/PageHeader";
import { StatusPill } from "../components/instruments/StatusPill";
import { activityActionKey, credentialActionKey } from "../lib/actionKeys";
import {
  EMPTY_FILTERS,
  allocationTags,
  applyFilters,
  exportHref,
  hasFilters,
  tagOptions,
  type ActivityLogFilters,
} from "../lib/activityLog";
import { activityIsMutable, allocationsFor } from "../lib/activityRules";
import { buttonClassName } from "../lib/buttonClass";
import { isOpenCycle } from "../lib/cycles";
import { compactNumber, formatDate } from "../lib/format";
import type { InstrumentState } from "../lib/instruments";
import { ACTIVITY_FORMAT_OPTIONS } from "../lib/logActivityForm";
import { paginate } from "../lib/pagination";
import type { SelectOption } from "../lib/selectFilter";
import { useWorkspace } from "../lib/workspaceStore";
import type { Activity, Credential } from "../lib/workspaceTypes";

// Spec §6 Activity log (was History): one page of fifty over the workspace the
// client already holds (perf-M-02), the four filters, the CSV export carrying
// them, row Archive with Undo, and the two archived disclosures. Every string
// is copy-table section F; the two focus moves after an archive and a restore
// are refs in this file, not DOM ids reached from the store (architecture-14).
// No clock read: dates are compared as ISO strings in app/lib/activityLog.ts.

const EMPTY_ACTIVITIES: Activity[] = [];

// "Live course" … — the Log sheet's own option list, so the two agree.
const FORMAT_LABELS: Record<string, string> = Object.fromEntries(
  ACTIVITY_FORMAT_OPTIONS.map((option) => [option.value, option.label]),
);

type EvidenceWord = { state: InstrumentState; text: string };

// The evidence pill: the word is in the DOM, the state is the colour (a11y-11).
function evidenceWord(activity: Activity): EvidenceWord {
  if (activity.evidenceDeletionPendingCount) {
    return { state: "none", text: "Removal pending" };
  }
  if (activity.evidenceStatus === "attached") {
    return { state: "complete", text: `${activity.evidenceCount || 1} on file` };
  }
  if (activity.evidenceStatus === "missing") {
    return { state: "due-soon", text: "Add evidence" };
  }
  return { state: "none", text: "Not required" };
}

function hasEvidenceToShow(activity: Activity): boolean {
  return (
    activity.evidenceStatus === "attached" ||
    Boolean(activity.evidenceDeletionPendingCount)
  );
}

function ActivityRow({
  activity,
  credentials,
  actionsDisabled,
  archiving,
  onEdit,
  onEvidence,
  onApply,
  onArchive,
}: {
  activity: Activity;
  credentials: readonly Credential[];
  actionsDisabled: boolean;
  archiving: boolean;
  onEdit: () => void;
  onEvidence: () => void;
  onApply: () => void;
  onArchive: () => void;
}) {
  const mutable = activityIsMutable(activity, credentials);
  const allocations = allocationsFor(activity);
  const evidence = evidenceWord(activity);
  const format = activity.format ? FORMAT_LABELS[activity.format] : undefined;
  // A live row manages its evidence unless none is required (the legacy
  // Upload/Manage rule); a read-only row can still open what is attached
  // (the legacy View proof rule). Both open the Evidence modal.
  const showEvidence = mutable
    ? activity.evidenceStatus !== "not_required" ||
      Boolean(activity.evidenceDeletionPendingCount)
    : hasEvidenceToShow(activity);
  // An open credential this activity is not yet applied to (the legacy
  // "Use for another" rule).
  const canApply =
    mutable &&
    credentials.some(
      (credential) =>
        isOpenCycle(credential) &&
        !allocations.some(
          (allocation) => allocation.credentialId === credential.id,
        ),
    );
  return (
    <tr role="row" data-frozen={mutable ? undefined : "true"}>
      <td role="cell" data-label="Activity">
        <strong className="activity-log-title">{activity.title}</strong>
        {activity.provider ? <small>{activity.provider}</small> : null}
        {format ? <small>{format}</small> : null}
      </td>
      <td role="cell" data-label="Date" className="num">
        <time dateTime={activity.completionDate}>
          {formatDate(activity.completionDate)}
        </time>
      </td>
      <td role="cell" data-label="Credential">
        {allocations.length
          ? allocations.map((allocation) => (
              <span className="activity-log-allocation" key={allocation.id}>
                {allocation.credentialName}
                <small>
                  {allocationTags(allocation).join(" · ") || "General"} ·{" "}
                  {compactNumber(allocation.allocatedUnits)}
                </small>
                {allocation.classificationStatus === "needs_classification" ? (
                  <small>Not counted yet: needs an activity type</small>
                ) : null}
              </span>
            ))
          : "Not applied to a credential"}
      </td>
      <td role="cell" data-label="Credits" className="num">
        {compactNumber(activity.totalUnits)}
      </td>
      <td role="cell" data-label="Evidence">
        <StatusPill state={evidence.state}>{evidence.text}</StatusPill>
      </td>
      <td role="cell" className="activity-log-actions">
        {mutable ? (
          <>
            <Button
              variant="quiet"
              size="sm"
              aria-label={`Edit ${activity.title}`}
              disabled={actionsDisabled}
              onClick={onEdit}
            >
              Edit
            </Button>
            {showEvidence ? (
              <Button
                variant="quiet"
                size="sm"
                aria-label={`Evidence for ${activity.title}`}
                disabled={actionsDisabled}
                onClick={onEvidence}
              >
                Evidence
              </Button>
            ) : null}
            {canApply ? (
              <Button
                variant="quiet"
                size="sm"
                aria-label={`Apply ${activity.title} to another credential`}
                disabled={actionsDisabled}
                onClick={onApply}
              >
                Apply…
              </Button>
            ) : null}
            <Button
              variant="quiet"
              size="sm"
              aria-label={`Archive ${activity.title}`}
              disabled={actionsDisabled}
              pending={archiving}
              pendingLabel="Archiving…"
              onClick={onArchive}
            >
              Archive
            </Button>
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            {showEvidence ? (
              <Button
                variant="quiet"
                size="sm"
                aria-label={`Evidence for ${activity.title}`}
                onClick={onEvidence}
              >
                Evidence
              </Button>
            ) : null}
            <span className="activity-log-frozen">Read only · closed cycle</span>
          </>
        )}
      </td>
    </tr>
  );
}

export function ActivityLog() {
  const store = useWorkspace();
  const captionId = useId();
  const captionRef = useRef<HTMLTableCaptionElement>(null);
  // The <summary> is natively focusable and stays in the Tab order: no tabIndex.
  const archivedRef = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState<ActivityLogFilters>(EMPTY_FILTERS);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const workspace = store.workspace;
  const activities = workspace ? workspace.activities : EMPTY_ACTIVITIES;
  const filtered = useMemo(
    () => applyFilters(activities, filters),
    [activities, filters],
  );
  const tags = useMemo(() => tagOptions(activities), [activities]);
  if (!workspace) return null;

  const { credentials, archivedActivities, archivedCredentials } = workspace;
  const actionsDisabled = !store.isOnline;
  // Re-clamped on every render: an archive that empties page 2 lands on page 1,
  // and a filter change (which sets page 1) never shows an empty page.
  const shown = paginate(filtered, page);
  const credentialOptions: SelectOption[] = [
    ...credentials,
    ...archivedCredentials,
  ].map((credential) => ({
    value: credential.id,
    label: credential.credentialName,
    keywords: credential.jurisdiction,
  }));

  const setFilter = (key: keyof ActivityLogFilters, value: string) => {
    setFilters((current) => ({ ...current, [key]: value }));
    setPage(1);
  };
  const clear = () => {
    setFilters(EMPTY_FILTERS);
    setPage(1);
  };
  const onSelect =
    (key: "credentialId" | "tag") => (event: ChangeEvent<HTMLSelectElement>) => {
      // Read before the updater runs: an updater must not touch the event.
      const value = event.currentTarget.value;
      setFilter(key, value);
    };
  const archive = async (activity: Activity) => {
    const result = await store.actions.archiveActivity(activity);
    if (!result.ok) return;
    // The refetched workspace mounts the disclosure on the next commit.
    window.setTimeout(() => archivedRef.current?.focus(), 0);
  };
  const restore = async (activity: Activity) => {
    const result = await store.actions.restoreActivity(activity);
    if (!result.ok) return;
    window.setTimeout(() => captionRef.current?.focus(), 0);
  };

  return (
    <div className="activity-log">
      <PageHeader
        title="Activity log"
        lede="Every activity you have logged, with its credits and evidence."
        actions={
          activities.length ? (
            <a className={buttonClassName("secondary")} href={exportHref(filters)}>
              <Icon name="arrowDown" size={16} />
              Export CSV
            </a>
          ) : null
        }
      />
      {activities.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          title="No activities logged yet"
          body="Log a course, conference, webinar or other completed activity and it will appear here."
          action={{
            label: "Log activity",
            onClick: () =>
              store.modals.open({ kind: "logActivity", preselectCredentialId: "" }),
          }}
        />
      ) : (
        <>
          <section className="activity-log-filters" aria-label="Filters">
            <Field label="Credential">
              <Select
                name="logCredential"
                placeholder="All credentials"
                searchLabel="Search credentials"
                value={filters.credentialId}
                onChange={onSelect("credentialId")}
                options={credentialOptions}
              />
            </Field>
            <Field label="From">
              <DateInput
                name="logFrom"
                value={filters.from}
                onValueChange={(iso) => setFilter("from", iso)}
              />
            </Field>
            <Field label="To">
              <DateInput
                name="logTo"
                value={filters.to}
                onValueChange={(iso) => setFilter("to", iso)}
              />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Tag">
              <Select
                name="logTag"
                placeholder="All tags"
                searchLabel="Search tags"
                value={filters.tag}
                onChange={onSelect("tag")}
                options={tags.map((tag) => ({ value: tag, label: tag }))}
              />
            </Field>
            {hasFilters(filters) ? (
              <Button variant="quiet" size="sm" onClick={clear}>
                Clear filters
              </Button>
            ) : null}
          </section>
          {filtered.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState
              compact
              title="No activities match these filters"
              body="Clear a filter to see more of your log."
              action={{ label: "Clear filters", onClick: clear }}
            />
          ) : (
            <>
              <div className="activity-log-table-wrap">
                <table
                  className="activity-log-table"
                  role="table"
                  aria-labelledby={captionId}
                >
                  <caption id={captionId} ref={captionRef} tabIndex={-1}>
                    Logged activities
                  </caption>
                  <thead role="rowgroup">
                    <tr role="row">
                      <th scope="col" role="columnheader">Activity</th>
                      <th scope="col" role="columnheader">Date</th>
                      <th scope="col" role="columnheader">Credential</th>
                      <th scope="col" role="columnheader" className="num">Credits</th>
                      <th scope="col" role="columnheader">Evidence</th>
                      <th scope="col" role="columnheader">
                        <span className="sr-only">Actions</span>
                      </th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody role="rowgroup">
                    {shown.items.map((activity) => (
                      <ActivityRow
                        key={activity.id}
                        activity={activity}
                        credentials={credentials}
                        actionsDisabled={actionsDisabled}
                        archiving={store.pending.isPending(activityActionKey(activity.id))}
                        onEdit={() => store.modals.open({ kind: "editActivity", activity })}
                        onEvidence={() => store.modals.open({ kind: "evidence", activity })}
                        onApply={() => store.modals.open({ kind: "allocate", activity })}
                        onArchive={() => void archive(activity)}
                      />
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
              <nav className="activity-log-pager" aria-label="Pages">
                <Button
                  variant="secondary"
                  size="sm"
                  disabled={shown.page === 1}
                  onClick={() => setPage(shown.page - 1)}
                >
                  Previous
                </Button>
                <p className="activity-log-count" role="status" aria-live="polite">
                  Page {shown.page} of {shown.pageCount} · Showing {shown.start + 1}–
                  {shown.end} of {shown.total}
                </p>
                <Button
                  variant="secondary"
                  size="sm"
                  disabled={shown.page === shown.pageCount}
                  onClick={() => setPage(shown.page + 1)}
                >
                  Next
                </Button>
              </nav>
            </>
          )}
        </>
      )}
      {archivedActivities.length ? (
        <details className="activity-log-archived">
          <summary id="archived-activities-summary" ref={archivedRef}>
            Archived activities ({archivedActivities.length})
            <span className="activity-log-chevron" aria-hidden="true">
              <Icon name="chevronDown" size={16} />
            </span>
          </summary>
          <ul>
            {archivedActivities.map((activity) => {
              const mutable = activityIsMutable(activity, credentials);
              const restoring = store.pending.isPending(activityActionKey(activity.id));
              return (
                <li className="activity-log-archived-row" key={activity.id}>
                  <div>
                    <strong>{activity.title}</strong>
                    <small>
                      {formatDate(activity.completionDate)}
                      {activity.provider ? ` · ${activity.provider}` : ""} ·{" "}
                      {compactNumber(activity.totalUnits)} credits
                    </small>
                  </div>
                  <div className="activity-log-actions">
                    {hasEvidenceToShow(activity) ? (
                      <Button
                        variant="quiet"
                        size="sm"
                        aria-label={`Evidence for ${activity.title}`}
                        onClick={() => store.modals.open({ kind: "evidence", activity })}
                      >
                        Evidence
                      </Button>
                    ) : null}
                    {mutable ? (
                      <Button
                        variant="secondary"
                        size="sm"
                        aria-label={`Restore ${activity.title}`}
                        disabled={actionsDisabled}
                        pending={restoring}
                        pendingLabel="Restoring…"
                        onClick={() => void restore(activity)}
                      >
                        Restore
                      </Button>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="activity-log-frozen">Read only · closed cycle</span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
        </details>
      ) : null}
      {archivedCredentials.length ? (
        <details className="activity-log-archived">
          <summary id="archived-credentials-summary">
            Archived credentials ({archivedCredentials.length})
            <span className="activity-log-chevron" aria-hidden="true">
              <Icon name="chevronDown" size={16} />
            </span>
          </summary>
          <ul>
            {archivedCredentials.map((credential) => {
              const busy = store.pending.isPending(credentialActionKey(credential.id));
              return (
                <li className="activity-log-archived-row" key={credential.id}>
                  <div>
                    <strong>{credential.credentialName}</strong>
                    <small>
                      {credential.jurisdiction} · Renew by {formatDate(credential.deadline)}
                    </small>
                  </div>
                  <div className="activity-log-actions">
                    <Button
                      variant="secondary"
                      size="sm"
                      aria-label={`Restore ${credential.credentialName}`}
                      disabled={actionsDisabled}
                      pending={busy}
                      pendingLabel="Restoring…"
                      onClick={() => void store.actions.restoreCredential(credential)}
                    >
                      Restore
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      variant="quiet"
                      size="sm"
                      aria-label={`Delete ${credential.credentialName}`}
                      disabled={actionsDisabled || busy}
                      onClick={() => store.modals.open({ kind: "deleteCredential", credential })}
                    >
                      Delete…
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
        </details>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

Why this shape passes the react-hooks 7 rules at error: every hook runs before the `if (!workspace) return null;` early return (rules-of-hooks); `useMemo` lists every value it reads (exhaustive-deps, preserve-manual-memoization); `EMPTY_ACTIVITIES` is a module constant so the memo input is stable when the workspace is null; `ActivityRow`, `evidenceWord` and `hasEvidenceToShow` are module-level (static-components); the refs are read only inside event callbacks and their `setTimeout` (refs); no `Date`/`localStorage` read in render (purity); `setFilters((current) => …)` never touches the event — the value is read first (the updater guard in `tests/app-source-guards.test.mjs:33-46`, and one more functional updater toward its `seen >= 7` floor). `isOpenCycle` is the one open-cycle test (the `!== "renewed"` guard). ```

```css
/* Activity log — app/screens/ActivityLog.tsx (Wave 4 Task 11; spec §6 Activity

 * --ink-muted on --card / --paper-deep (claimed in tokens.css). No hover tint
 * (a row is not a control), no shadow, no transition (spec §5.1 Motion: the
 * chevron rotates instantly). Replaces history.css. */

.activity-log {
  display: grid;
  gap: 24px;
}

/* FILTERS — one card, fields side by side while they fit, one column on a phone. */
.activity-log-filters {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr));
  align-items: end;
  gap: 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background: var(--card);
  padding: 16px;
}

/* TABLE — the card clips nothing vertically; wide content scrolls inside it. */
.activity-log-table-wrap {
  overflow-x: auto;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background: var(--card);
}

.activity-log-table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
}

.activity-log-table caption {
  padding: 14px 16px 6px;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: var(--text-xl);
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-display);
  text-align: left;
}

/* Focused after a restore; the ring sits inside the card that clips its overflow. */
.activity-log-table caption:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring);
  outline-offset: -3px;
}

.activity-log-table th {
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: var(--paper-deep);
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-2xs);
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-eyebrow);
  text-align: left;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.activity-log-table td {
  padding: 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  vertical-align: top;
}

.activity-log-table tbody tr:last-child td {
  border-bottom: 0;
}

/* Dates and counts: the mono face, tabular figures, right-aligned in a column. */
.activity-log-table .num {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  text-align: right;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.activity-log-title {
  display: block;
  font-weight: 700;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.activity-log-table small {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 2px;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
}

.activity-log-allocation {
  display: block;
}

.activity-log-allocation + .activity-log-allocation {
  margin-top: 6px;
}

.activity-log-table tr[data-frozen] td {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.activity-log-frozen {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: 700;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.activity-log-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 8px;
}

/* PAGER */
.activity-log-pager {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
}

.activity-log-count {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

/* ARCHIVED DISCLOSURES — a card whose summary is the full-width row. */
.activity-log-archived {
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background: var(--card);
}

.activity-log-archived > summary {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  min-height: var(--tap-min);
  padding: 10px 16px;
  color: var(--ink);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: 700;
  list-style: none;
}

.activity-log-archived > summary::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}

/* The summary spans a card that clips its overflow, so the ring is drawn inside. */
.activity-log-archived > summary:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring);
  outline-offset: -3px;
}

.activity-log-chevron {
  display: flex;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

/* Instant — no transition (spec §5.1 Motion). */
.activity-log-archived[open] > summary .activity-log-chevron {
  transform: rotate(180deg);
}

.activity-log-archived > ul {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  list-style: none;
}

.activity-log-archived-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.activity-log-archived-row:last-child {
  border-bottom: 0;
}

.activity-log-archived-row strong,
.activity-log-archived-row small {
  display: block;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.activity-log-archived-row strong {
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
}

.activity-log-archived-row small {
  margin-top: 2px;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
}

/*
 * PHONE — the rows stack into cards, each cell carrying its own label from
 * data-label, the column head visually hidden. The explicit table roles in the
 * markup keep the semantics Chromium drops once a row is no longer
 * display: table-row. Nothing is wider than the viewport (reflow.spec.ts).
 */
@media (max-width: 820px) {
  .activity-log {
    gap: 16px;
  }

  .activity-log-table,
  .activity-log-table caption,
  .activity-log-table thead,
  .activity-log-table tbody,
  .activity-log-table td {
    display: block;
  }

  .activity-log-table thead {
    position: absolute;
    width: 1px;
    height: 1px;
    overflow: hidden;
    clip: rect(0 0 0 0);
    clip-path: inset(50%);
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .activity-log-table tbody tr {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    gap: 4px 12px;

  .activity-log-table tbody tr:last-child {
    border-bottom: 0;
  }

  .activity-log-table td {
    padding: 0;

  .activity-log-table td::before {
    content: attr(data-label);
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
    color: var(--ink-muted);
    font-size: var(--text-2xs);
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: var(--tracking-eyebrow);
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .activity-log-table td.num {
    text-align: left;
  }

  .activity-log-table td[data-label="Credits"] {
    grid-column: 2;

  }

  .activity-log-table td.activity-log-actions {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    margin-top: 4px;
  }

  .activity-log-table td.activity-log-actions::before {
    content: none;
  }

  .activity-log-count {
    text-align: center;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 540px) {
  .activity-log-archived-row {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .activity-log-pager {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: center;
  }
}
```

**Gotchas for this task:** `Icon` takes only `name`, `size`, `strokeWidth` — never pass it `className`; the chevron's class lives on the wrapping `span`. The `<summary>` is natively focusable and stays in the Tab order — do not give it `tabIndex={-1}` (that removes it from the sequence); the `<caption>` is not natively focusable, so it does carry `tabIndex={-1}`. `Select` renders `<option value="">` for `placeholder`, which is why `selectOption("")` clears a filter in the spec and why the two filters never grow a search box on the demo (< 12 options — `SEARCHABLE_OPTION_COUNT`); a spec must not depend on the search input. `URLSearchParams` would encode a space as `+`; `exportHref` uses `encodeURIComponent` so the test's `%20` holds and the server's `url.searchParams.get` reads both. Under `display: block`/`grid` Chromium drops a table's implicit roles, so the markup sets `role="table"/"rowgroup"/"row"/"columnheader"/"cell"` explicitly and names the table through `aria-labelledby` as well as the caption; the ≤ 820 px rules therefore set `display: block` on the table, caption, head, body and cells, not only on the rows. `.activity-log-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto }` is the only horizontal scroller — `html`/`body` never hide overflow (reflow.spec.ts asserts it). The archive/restore focus moves run in `window.setTimeout(…, 0)` after the awaited store call because the refetched workspace mounts the disclosure (and remounts the table) on the following commit — exactly the legacy sequence, minus the DOM id. `store.actions.archiveActivity` is also what the Edit sheet's Archive calls, so its `pending` prop in `ModalsHost` reads the activity key too (Step 8); the sheet closes itself on success through `setEditingActivity(null)` inside the store. An activity whose credential is archived reads as read-only here because `activityIsMutable` looks only in `workspace.credentials` — Task 3's server gate (409 `credential_archived`) covers the stale-tab case and the store maps it through `describeApiError`. The seeded fixture activities carry no requirement tag (a custom credential's category is a requirement the payload has to name), which is why the filter spec seeds its tagged activity with `requirementIds: [general.id]`; if `addActivity` ever refuses fifty-one 2-unit activities on a 10-unit credential (no such check exists today — excess lands in `totalExcessUnits`), seed `seedActivities(id, 51, { totalUnits: 0.1, allocatedUnits: 0.1 })`. The alias block's `≥ 40` floor (Task 8 re-pinned it from 100 in the commit that pruned the block below 100) is a Wave-4-wide budget until Task 18 rewrites that test: prune only names with no consumer, and stop at 40. `tests/e2e/screenshots.spec.ts` and `parity.spec.ts` stay env-gated (the Activity log's pixels change on purpose; Task 19 re-shoots).
