```tsx
"use client";

import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { Button } from "../../components/Button";
import { ErrorSummary, Field, TextInput, type ErrorSummaryEntry } from "../../components/Form";
import { Sheet } from "../../components/Modal";
import { ACCOUNT_ERROR_COPY, useAccountApi, type PendingEmail } from "./useAccountApi";

// The three Account sheets (spec §6 Account; app-ux-M-02). Each owns its
// pending flag and its own ErrorSummary — never the page banner — and posts
// through useAccountApi, which maps the gateway's code to the sentence shown.
// Account renders them as `{open && (<…Sheet`: not `<…Modal` sites, so the
// modal-site guard counts none of them, and their open flags are Account's.
// Every form is noValidate so the browser's own bubbles never pre-empt the
// inline errors (a11y-09).

const MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 12;

export function ChangeEmailSheet({
  initialEmail,
  mailConfigured,
  onClose,
  onSent,
}: {
  initialEmail: string;
  mailConfigured: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSent: (pending: PendingEmail) => void;
}) {
  const api = useAccountApi();
  const [newEmail, setNewEmail] = useState(initialEmail);
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function submit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (pending || !mailConfigured) return;
    setPending(true);
    setError(null);
    const result = await api.email(newEmail.trim(), password);
    setPending(false);
    if (result.ok) {
      onSent(result.data.pending);
      return;
    }
    setError(result.message);
  }

  return (
    <Sheet title="Change email" eyebrow="Sign-in" onClose={onClose}>
      <form className="form-stack" noValidate onSubmit={(event) => void submit(event)}>
        <p className="account-sheet-lede">
          We’ll send a confirmation link to the new address. Your email changes only
          after you open it, and you’ll sign in again afterwards.
        </p>
        <Field
          id="account-new-email"
          label="New email"
          hint={mailConfigured ? undefined : ACCOUNT_ERROR_COPY.mail_unconfigured}
        >
          <TextInput
            type="email"
            name="email"
            autoComplete="email"
            inputMode="email"
            required
            autoFocus
            value={newEmail}
            onChange={(event) => {
              const value = event.currentTarget.value;
              setNewEmail(value);
            }}
          />
        </Field>
        <Field id="account-email-password" label="Current password">
          <TextInput
            type="password"
            name="password"
            autoComplete="current-password"
            required
            value={password}
            onChange={(event) => {
              const value = event.currentTarget.value;
              setPassword(value);
            }}
          />
        </Field>
        {error ? <ErrorSummary title="Change email" errors={[{ message: error }]} /> : null}
        <div className="form-actions">
          <Button variant="quiet" onClick={onClose}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button type="submit" variant="primary" disabled={!mailConfigured} pending={pending}>
            Send confirmation link
          </Button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </Sheet>
  );
}

export function ChangePasswordSheet({
  onClose,
  onChanged,
}: {
  onClose: () => void;
  onChanged: () => void;
}) {
  const api = useAccountApi();
  const [current, setCurrent] = useState("");
  const [next, setNext] = useState("");
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState("");
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<{ next?: string; confirm?: string }>({});
  const [serverError, setServerError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const summary: ErrorSummaryEntry[] = [
    ...(fieldErrors.next ? [{ fieldId: "account-new-password", message: fieldErrors.next }] : []),
    ...(fieldErrors.confirm
      ? [{ fieldId: "account-confirm-password", message: fieldErrors.confirm }]
      : []),
  ];

  async function submit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (pending) return;
    const problems: { next?: string; confirm?: string } = {};
    if (next.length < MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH) problems.next = "Use at least 12 characters.";
    if (confirm !== next) problems.confirm = "These don’t match.";
    setFieldErrors(problems);
    setServerError(null);
    if (problems.next || problems.confirm) return;
    setPending(true);
    const result = await api.password(current, next);
    setPending(false);
    if (result.ok) {
      onChanged();
      return;
    }
    setServerError(result.message);
  }

  return (
    <Sheet title="Change password" eyebrow="Sign-in" onClose={onClose}>
      <form className="form-stack" noValidate onSubmit={(event) => void submit(event)}>
        <Field id="account-current-password" label="Current password">
          <TextInput
            type="password"
            name="currentPassword"
            autoComplete="current-password"
            required
            autoFocus
            value={current}
            onChange={(event) => {
              const value = event.currentTarget.value;
              setCurrent(value);
            }}
          />
        </Field>
        <Field
          id="account-new-password"
          label="New password"
          hint="At least 12 characters."
          error={fieldErrors.next}
        >
          <TextInput
            type="password"
            name="newPassword"
            autoComplete="new-password"
            minLength={MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH}
            required
            value={next}
            onChange={(event) => {
              const value = event.currentTarget.value;
              setNext(value);
            }}
          />
        </Field>
        <Field id="account-confirm-password" label="Confirm new password" error={fieldErrors.confirm}>
          <TextInput
            type="password"
            name="confirmPassword"
            autoComplete="new-password"
            required
            value={confirm}
            onChange={(event) => {
              const value = event.currentTarget.value;
              setConfirm(value);
            }}
          />
        </Field>
        {summary.length ? (
          <ErrorSummary errors={summary} />
        ) : serverError ? (
          <ErrorSummary title="Change password" errors={[{ message: serverError }]} />
        ) : null}
        <div className="form-actions">
          <Button variant="quiet" onClick={onClose}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button type="submit" variant="primary" pending={pending}>
            Change password
          </Button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </Sheet>
  );
}

export function DeleteAccountSheet({ email, onClose }: { email: string; onClose: () => void }) {
  const api = useAccountApi();
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  // Case-insensitive, like the gateway's own comparison.
  const matches = confirm.trim().toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase();

  async function submit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (pending || !matches) return;
    setPending(true);
    setError(null);
    const result = await api.remove(confirm.trim(), password);
    if (result.ok) {
      // The answer already cleared the cookie; the landing page is next.
      window.location.assign("/");
      return;
    }
    setPending(false);
    setError(result.message);
  }

  return (
    <Sheet title="Delete this account" eyebrow="Danger zone" onClose={onClose}>
      <form className="form-stack" noValidate onSubmit={(event) => void submit(event)}>
        <p className="account-sheet-lede">
          This permanently deletes everything for <strong>{email}</strong>. Download your
          data first if you want to keep it.
        </p>
        <Field id="account-delete-confirm" label="Type your email to confirm">
          <TextInput
            name="confirmEmail"
            autoComplete="off"
            autoCapitalize="none"
            spellCheck={false}
            inputMode="email"
            autoFocus
            value={confirm}
            onChange={(event) => {
              const value = event.currentTarget.value;
              setConfirm(value);
            }}
          />
        </Field>
        <Field id="account-delete-password" label="Your password">
          <TextInput
            type="password"
            name="password"
            autoComplete="current-password"
            required
            value={password}
            onChange={(event) => {
              const value = event.currentTarget.value;
              setPassword(value);
            }}
          />
        </Field>
        {error ? (
          <ErrorSummary title="Delete this account" errors={[{ message: error }]} />
        ) : null}
        <div className="form-actions">
          <Button variant="quiet" onClick={onClose}>
            Keep my account
          </Button>
          <Button
            type="submit"
            variant="destructive"
            disabled={!matches}
            pending={pending}
            pendingLabel="Deleting…"
          >
            Delete my account
          </Button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </Sheet>
  );
}
```

(Every `onChange` reads `event.currentTarget.value` into a local before the setter is called — the updater guard in `tests/app-source-guards.test.mjs:33-46` scans `setX((current) => …)` bodies only, but the pattern is kept uniform. `disabled={!matches}` on the delete submit is native `disabled`: a control that cannot act; `pending` is for the write on the wire.)

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { Button } from "../../components/Button";
import {
  Checkbox,
  ErrorSummary,
  Field,
  Select,
  type ErrorSummaryEntry,
} from "../../components/Form";
import { Icon } from "../../components/Icon";
import { REMINDERS_ACTION_KEY, TIME_ZONE_ACTION_KEY } from "../../lib/actionKeys";
import { isValidTimeZone } from "../../lib/dates";
import type { SelectOption } from "../../lib/selectFilter";
import { deviceTimeZone, type PushDeviceState } from "../../lib/webPush";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../lib/workspaceStore";
import type { ReminderPreferencesInput, Workspace } from "../../lib/workspaceTypes";
import { useCalendarActions } from "../hooks/useCalendarActions";
import { usePushDevice } from "../hooks/usePushDevice";

// spec §6 Account "reminders (time zone auto-detected, quiet hours)"; app-ux-14
// (no "Today"), app-ux-15 (no push copy while the server has no VAPID key).
// The former "Due-date check-ins" modal as one inline form. Two groups: the
// schedule (time zone, lead days, in-app, check-in time, quiet hours) always
// renders — it is a stored preference the scheduler honours wherever push is
// configured — and the phone-alert controls (the switch, the device block, its
// buttons, the device count) are hidden whole while push is "unconfigured", so
// a save can never send pushEnabled:true the server would 409. Uncontrolled
// fields read through FormData on submit; the time-zone select is keyed on
// the saved zone so the one-tap offer's refetch re-seeds it.

export type PushDevice = ReturnType<typeof usePushDevice>;
type Preferences = Workspace["reminderPreferences"];

const LEAD_DAY_OPTIONS = [90, 30, 7, 1] as const;

// Module level: no Intl or Date call happens during render.
const HOUR_LABEL = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", { hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit" });
export const HOUR_OPTIONS: readonly SelectOption[] = Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, hour) => ({
  value: String(hour),
  label: HOUR_LABEL.format(new Date(2020, 0, 1, hour)),
}));
const QUIET_OPTIONS: readonly SelectOption[] = [{ value: "", label: "Off" }, ...HOUR_OPTIONS];
const ZONE_NAMES: readonly string[] =
  typeof Intl.supportedValuesOf === "function" ? Intl.supportedValuesOf("timeZone") : [];

// Every IANA zone this engine knows plus the stored and the device zones, so
// the select can always show the saved value (an older engine's shorter list,
// a stored alias such as US/Eastern). ≥ 12 options: the Select grows its
// search input on its own (SEARCHABLE_OPTION_COUNT).
export function zoneOptionsFor(stored: string, device: string): SelectOption[] {
  const names = new Set<string>([stored, device, ...ZONE_NAMES]);
  return [...names]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .sort()
    .map((zone) => ({ value: zone, label: zone }));
}

// The form → payload read, and the two client rules: a real IANA zone, and
// quiet hours that are both set or both off (copy table section G).
export function readReminderForm(
  form: FormData,
  saved: Preferences,
  phoneAlertsShown: boolean,
): { input: ReminderPreferencesInput; errors: ErrorSummaryEntry[] } {
  const errors: ErrorSummaryEntry[] = [];
  const timeZone = String(form.get("timeZone") ?? saved.timeZone);
  if (!isValidTimeZone(timeZone)) {
    errors.push({ fieldId: "reminder-time-zone", message: "Choose a valid time zone." });
  }
  const leadDays = form
    .getAll("leadDays")
    .map((value) => Number(value))
    .filter((value) => Number.isInteger(value) && value >= 0);
  const quietStart = String(form.get("quietHoursStart") ?? "");
  const quietEnd = String(form.get("quietHoursEnd") ?? "");
  if ((quietStart === "") !== (quietEnd === "")) {
    errors.push({
      fieldId: "reminder-quiet-start",
      message: "Set both quiet hours, or turn both off.",
    });
  }
  const hour = form.get("pushHourLocal");
  return {
    input: {
      inAppEnabled: form.get("inAppEnabled") === "on",
      // A disabled or unmounted switch is absent from FormData: keep the
      // stored value rather than turning alerts off behind the user's back.
      pushEnabled: phoneAlertsShown ? form.get("pushEnabled") === "on" : saved.pushEnabled,
      pushHourLocal: hour === null ? (saved.pushHourLocal ?? 9) : Number(hour),
      leadDays,
      timeZone,
      quietHoursStart: quietStart === "" ? null : Number(quietStart),
      quietHoursEnd: quietEnd === "" ? null : Number(quietEnd),
    },
    errors,
  };
}

// The server's four field-level refusals, by code → the field they belong to
// and the copy table's sentence. Any other code shows the store's mapped
// `copy.next` with no field link.
const REMINDER_FIELD_ERRORS: Readonly<Record<string, ErrorSummaryEntry>> = {
  invalid_time_zone: { fieldId: "reminder-time-zone", message: "Choose a valid time zone." },
  invalid_push_hour: { fieldId: "reminder-push-hour", message: "Choose a check-in hour." },
  push_subscription_required: {
    fieldId: "reminder-push-enabled",
    message: "Connect a device before turning on phone alerts.",
  },
  invalid_quiet_hours: {
    fieldId: "reminder-quiet-start",
    message: "Quiet hours need a start and an end.",
  },
};

// The device block's sentences — app/ITrackApp.tsx:9393-9428 minus the
// "unconfigured" pair, which is never rendered (app-ux-15).
function deviceHeading(state: PushDeviceState, prefs: Preferences): string {
  switch (state) {
    case "checking":
      return "Checking phone-alert support…";
    case "install_required":
      return "Add iTrack to your Home Screen first.";
    case "unsupported":
      return "Use calendar alerts on this device.";
    case "denied":
      return "Alerts are blocked in device settings.";
    case "subscribed":
      return prefs.pushEnabled
        ? "Phone alerts are on for this device."
        : "This device is connected, but alerts are paused.";
    case "error":
      return "Phone-alert status needs another check.";
    default:
      return prefs.activePushDeviceCount > 0
        ? "Add this device to your phone alerts."
        : "Get renewal check-ins on this device.";
  }
}

function deviceBody(state: PushDeviceState, prefs: Preferences): string {
  switch (state) {
    case "install_required":
      return "On iPhone and iPad, Apple enables web alerts only for apps opened from the Home Screen.";
    case "unsupported":
      return "This browser cannot receive web push, but your phone calendar can still deliver the same lead-day schedule.";
    case "denied":
      return "Allow notifications for iTrack in your phone or browser settings, then check again.";
    case "subscribed":
      return prefs.pushEnabled
        ? `Private check-ins arrive around ${prefs.pushHourLocal ?? 9}:00 in ${prefs.timeZone}.`
        : "Resume delivery when you are ready; the device connection is still saved.";
    default:
      return "Permission is requested only after you tap the button below.";
  }
}

export function ReminderSettings({ workspace, push }: { workspace: Workspace; push: PushDevice }) {
  const store = useWorkspace();
  const { isOnline, pending, actions, zoneSuggestion, dismissZoneOffer, focusRequest, requestFocus } =
    store;
  const calendar = useCalendarActions(store);
  const prefs = workspace.reminderPreferences;
  const headingRef = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<ErrorSummaryEntry[]>([]);
  const deviceZone = useMemo(() => deviceTimeZone(), []);
  const zoneOptions = useMemo(() => zoneOptionsFor(prefs.timeZone, deviceZone), [prefs.timeZone, deviceZone]);
  const saving = pending.isPending(REMINDERS_ACTION_KEY);
  const phoneAlertsShown = push.pushDeviceState !== "unconfigured";
  const switchDisabled = prefs.activePushDeviceCount === 0 && !prefs.pushEnabled;

  // Home's "Reminder settings" lands here: nav.setTab("profile") then
  // requestFocus("reminders"). Deferred so it runs after PageHeader's own
  // heading focus; the ref is read inside the timer, never during render.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (focusRequest !== "reminders") return;
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      headingRef.current?.focus();
      requestFocus(null);
    }, 0);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [focusRequest, requestFocus]);

  async function submit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (saving) return;
    const { input, errors: problems } = readReminderForm(
      new FormData(event.currentTarget),
      prefs,
      phoneAlertsShown,
    );
    setErrors(problems);
    if (problems.length) return;
    const result = await actions.saveReminderPreferences(input);
    if (result.ok) return;
    const mapped = result.code ? REMINDER_FIELD_ERRORS[result.code] : undefined;
    setErrors([mapped ?? { message: result.copy.next }]);
  }

  return (
    <section className="account-section" id="reminders" aria-labelledby="reminders-title">
      <div className="account-section-head">
        <h2 id="reminders-title" ref={headingRef} tabIndex={-1} className="account-section-title">
          Reminders
        </h2>
        <p className="account-section-lede">
          Check-ins appear on Home before each due date. Phone alerts are optional and private.
        </p>
      </div>

      {zoneSuggestion && isOnline ? (
        <div className="account-notice" role="status">
          <div>
            <strong>Your device is in {zoneSuggestion}.</strong>
            <small>Reminders and default dates use UTC until you choose a zone.</small>
          </div>
          <div className="account-actions">
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="primary"
              pending={pending.isPending(TIME_ZONE_ACTION_KEY)}
              onClick={() => void actions.adoptDeviceTimeZone()}
            >
              Use {zoneSuggestion}
            </Button>
            <Button size="sm" variant="quiet" onClick={dismissZoneOffer}>
              Not now
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <form className="account-form" aria-busy={saving} noValidate onSubmit={(event) => void submit(event)}>
        <Field
          id="reminder-time-zone"
          label="Time zone"
          hint={`Detected on this device: ${deviceZone}`}
        >
          <Select
            key={prefs.timeZone}
            name="timeZone"
            options={zoneOptions}
            defaultValue={prefs.timeZone}
            searchLabel="Search time zones"
            required
          />
        </Field>
        <Button
          size="sm"
          variant="quiet"
          onClick={(event) => {
            // Inside the form: the select is reached through the form, so no
            // ref crosses the Select primitive.
            const select = event.currentTarget.form?.elements.namedItem("timeZone");
            if (select instanceof HTMLSelectElement) {
              select.value = deviceZone;
              select.focus();
            }
          }}
        >
          Use this device’s time zone
        </Button>

        <fieldset className="account-fieldset">
          <legend>Check in before a due date</legend>
          {LEAD_DAY_OPTIONS.map((days) => (
            <Checkbox
              key={days}
              name="leadDays"
              value={days}
              defaultChecked={prefs.leadDays.includes(days)}
              label={`${days} ${days === 1 ? "day" : "days"} before`}
            />
          ))}
        </fieldset>

        <Checkbox
          id="reminder-in-app"
          name="inAppEnabled"
          defaultChecked={prefs.inAppEnabled}
          label="Show check-ins on Home"
          description="Upcoming due dates and follow-ups appear on Home."
        />

        {phoneAlertsShown ? (
          <Checkbox
            id="reminder-push-enabled"
            name="pushEnabled"
            defaultChecked={prefs.pushEnabled}
            disabled={switchDisabled}
            label="Send phone alerts"
            description={
              switchDisabled
                ? "Connect this device below first."
                : "Private check-ins reach only the devices you connect. The alert says “iTrack check-in”, never a credential."
            }
          />
        ) : null}

        <Field id="reminder-push-hour" label="Check-in time" hint="In the time zone above.">
          <Select
            name="pushHourLocal"
            options={HOUR_OPTIONS}
            defaultValue={String(prefs.pushHourLocal ?? 9)}
          />
        </Field>
        <div className="form-grid">
          <Field id="reminder-quiet-start" label="Quiet from">
            <Select
              name="quietHoursStart"
              options={QUIET_OPTIONS}
              defaultValue={prefs.quietHoursStart === null ? "" : String(prefs.quietHoursStart)}
            />
          </Field>
          <Field
            id="reminder-quiet-end"
            label="Quiet until"
            hint="Alerts due inside quiet hours wait until they end."
          >
            <Select
              name="quietHoursEnd"
              options={QUIET_OPTIONS}
              defaultValue={prefs.quietHoursEnd === null ? "" : String(prefs.quietHoursEnd)}
            />
          </Field>
        </div>

        {phoneAlertsShown ? (
          <>
            <div
              className="account-device"
              data-state={push.pushDeviceState}
              aria-live="polite"
              aria-busy={push.pushPending}
            >
              <span className="account-device-mark">
                <Icon
                  name={
                    push.pushDeviceState === "subscribed"
                      ? "check"
                      : push.pushDeviceState === "denied"
                        ? "alert"
                        : "shield"
                  }
                  size={17}
                />
              </span>
              <div>
                <strong>{deviceHeading(push.pushDeviceState, prefs)}</strong>
                <small>{deviceBody(push.pushDeviceState, prefs)}</small>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="account-actions">
              {push.pushDeviceState === "install_required" ? (
                <Button variant="primary" pending={push.pushPending} onClick={() => void push.install()}>
                  Add to Home Screen
                </Button>
              ) : push.pushDeviceState === "available" || push.pushDeviceState === "error" ? (
                <Button
                  variant="primary"
                  disabled={!isOnline}
                  pending={push.pushPending}
                  onClick={() => void push.enable()}
                >
                  {prefs.pushEnabled ? "Add this device" : "Turn on phone alerts"}
                </Button>
              ) : push.pushDeviceState === "denied" ? (
                <Button variant="secondary" pending={push.pushPending} onClick={() => void push.refresh()}>
                  Check again
                </Button>
              ) : push.pushDeviceState === "subscribed" ? (
                <>
                  {!prefs.pushEnabled ? (
                    <Button
                      variant="primary"
                      disabled={!isOnline}
                      pending={push.pushPending}
                      onClick={() => void push.enable()}
                    >
                      Resume phone alerts
                    </Button>
                  ) : null}
                  <Button
                    variant="secondary"
                    disabled={push.pushPending || !isOnline || !prefs.pushEnabled}
                    onClick={() => void push.test()}
                  >
                    Send a test
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    variant="quiet"
                    disabled={push.pushPending || !isOnline}
                    onClick={() => void push.disable()}
                  >
                    Turn off on this device
                  </Button>
                </>
              ) : null}
            </div>
            {prefs.activePushDeviceCount > 0 ? (
              <small className="account-device-count">
                {prefs.activePushDeviceCount} connected{" "}
                {prefs.activePushDeviceCount === 1 ? "device" : "devices"} on this account
              </small>
            ) : null}
          </>
        ) : null}

        {errors.length ? <ErrorSummary title="Reminders were not saved" errors={errors} /> : null}

        <div className="form-actions">
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => void calendar.addAllCheckInsToCalendar()}>
            Add all check-ins to calendar
          </Button>
          <Button type="submit" variant="primary" pending={saving} pendingLabel="Saving…">
            Save reminders
          </Button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </section>
  );
}
```

(The Select for the zone carries `key={prefs.timeZone}`: after `adoptDeviceTimeZone`'s refetch the saved zone changes and the uncontrolled select re-seeds with `defaultValue` — the assertion `local-dates.spec.ts:36` and account.spec's "the reminders form saves quiet hours and the time zone" read. `hint` on the quiet-end Field only: the copy table gives one hint for the pair. `phoneAlertsShown` is `false` only for `"unconfigured"`; `"checking"`, `"unsupported"` and `"denied"` still render the block with their own sentences.)

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { Button } from "../../components/Button";
import { Icon } from "../../components/Icon";
import { CreditBar } from "../../components/instruments/CreditBar";
import { WEEKLY_GOAL_ACTION_KEY, questActionKey } from "../../lib/actionKeys";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/format";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../lib/workspaceStore";
import type { Workspace } from "../../lib/workspaceTypes";

// app-ux-13: the gamification left Home (Task 8) and lives here, folded. A
// <details> closed by default and never persisted; the level and every quest
// bar are CreditBars (role="progressbar", the one fill moment). The weekly
// target keeps its radio group name "Weekly action target" and 44 px rows;
// the copy is copy table section G "Momentum". Strings the store owns: the
// two weekly-target toasts and "Momentum updated." on a claim.

const WEEKLY_GOAL_PRESETS = [
  { label: "Light", value: 1 },
  { label: "Steady", value: 3 },
  { label: "Balanced", value: 4 },
  { label: "Focused", value: 5 },
  { label: "Ambitious", value: 7 },
] as const;

const actionsWord = (count: number) => (count === 1 ? "action" : "actions");

export function MomentumSection({ workspace }: { workspace: Workspace }) {
  const { actions, pending } = useWorkspace();
  const { progression, profile } = workspace;
  const level = progression.level;
  const xpToNextLevel = Math.max(0, level.nextLevelXp - progression.lifetimeXp);
  const currentWeeklyGoal = profile.weeklyGoal;
  const scheduledWeeklyGoal = profile.nextWeeklyGoal;
  const scheduledEffectiveOn = profile.nextWeeklyGoalEffectiveOn;
  const savedWeeklyGoal =
    typeof scheduledWeeklyGoal === "number" ? scheduledWeeklyGoal : currentWeeklyGoal;
  const [weeklyGoalChoice, setWeeklyGoalChoice] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const selectedWeeklyGoal = weeklyGoalChoice ?? savedWeeklyGoal;
  const weeklyGoalChanged = selectedWeeklyGoal !== savedWeeklyGoal;
  const weeklyGoalPending = pending.isPending(WEEKLY_GOAL_ACTION_KEY);
  const keepCurrent =
    selectedWeeklyGoal === currentWeeklyGoal && typeof scheduledWeeklyGoal === "number";

  function submitWeeklyGoal(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!weeklyGoalChanged || weeklyGoalPending) return;
    void actions.updateWeeklyGoal(selectedWeeklyGoal);
  }

  return (
    <details className="account-momentum" id="account-momentum">
      <summary className="account-momentum-summary">
        <span className="account-eyebrow">Momentum</span>
        <span className="account-momentum-line">
          Level {level.number} · {level.title} ·{" "}
          <span className="account-mono">{progression.lifetimeXp} XP</span>
        </span>
        <Icon name="chevronDown" size={18} />
      </summary>
      <div className="account-momentum-body">
        <div className="account-level">
          <strong>
            {level.progressPercent}% to level {level.number + 1}
          </strong>
          <small>{xpToNextLevel} XP to go</small>
          <CreditBar
            counted={Math.max(0, progression.lifetimeXp - level.floorXp)}
            required={Math.max(0, level.nextLevelXp - level.floorXp)}
            state="on-track"
            label={`${level.progressPercent}% toward level ${level.number + 1}`}
          />
        </div>

        <form className="account-form" aria-busy={weeklyGoalPending} onSubmit={submitWeeklyGoal}>
          <fieldset className="account-pace" disabled={weeklyGoalPending}>
            <legend>Weekly action target</legend>
            <p className="account-hint">
              Your current target is {currentWeeklyGoal} {actionsWord(currentWeeklyGoal)} each
              week. Changes start next Monday. Missed days don’t break your rhythm.
            </p>
            {typeof scheduledWeeklyGoal === "number" && scheduledEffectiveOn ? (
              <div className="account-notice" role="status">
                <Icon name="clock" size={16} />
                <div>
                  <strong>
                    {scheduledWeeklyGoal} {actionsWord(scheduledWeeklyGoal)} starting{" "}
                    {formatDate(scheduledEffectiveOn)}
                  </strong>
                  <small>Choose another target below to replace this scheduled change.</small>
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : null}
            <div className="account-pace-options">
              {WEEKLY_GOAL_PRESETS.map((preset) => (
                <label className="account-pace-option" key={preset.value}>
                  <input
                    type="radio"
                    name="weeklyGoal"
                    value={preset.value}
                    checked={selectedWeeklyGoal === preset.value}
                    onChange={() => setWeeklyGoalChoice(preset.value)}
                  />
                  <span>
                    <strong>{preset.label}</strong>
                    <small>
                      {preset.value} {actionsWord(preset.value)}
                    </small>
                  </span>
                </label>
              ))}
            </div>
          </fieldset>
          <div className="form-actions account-pace-actions">
            <span className="account-hint" aria-live="polite">
              {weeklyGoalPending
                ? "Saving your weekly target."
                : weeklyGoalChanged
                  ? "Ready to schedule."
                  : "Your saved target is selected."}
            </span>
            <Button
              type="submit"
              variant="primary"
              disabled={!weeklyGoalChanged}
              pending={weeklyGoalPending}
              pendingLabel="Scheduling…"
            >
              {keepCurrent ? "Keep current target" : "Start next Monday"}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>

        <div className="account-quests">
          <div className="account-quests-head">
            <strong>Weekly quests</strong>
            <small>
              {formatDate(progression.week.startsOn, { month: "short", day: "numeric" })} –{" "}
              {formatDate(progression.week.endsOn, { month: "short", day: "numeric" })}
            </small>
            <span className="account-mono">
              {Math.min(progression.weekActions, progression.weeklyGoal)}/{progression.weeklyGoal}{" "}
              actions
            </span>
          </div>
          {progression.quests.length ? (
            progression.quests.map((quest) => {
              const done = Math.min(quest.progress, quest.target);
              const claiming = pending.isPending(questActionKey(quest.key));
              return (
                <article
                  className="account-quest"
                  key={quest.key}
                  data-state={quest.claimed ? "claimed" : quest.claimable ? "claimable" : "open"}
                >
                  <span className="account-quest-mark">
                    <Icon
                      name={quest.claimed ? "check" : quest.completed ? "diamondFilled" : "diamond"}
                      size={15}
                    />
                  </span>
                  <div>
                    <strong>{quest.title}</strong>
                    <small>{quest.description}</small>
                    <CreditBar
                      counted={done}
                      required={quest.target}
                      state={quest.claimed ? "complete" : "on-track"}
                      label={`${quest.title}: ${done} of ${quest.target}`}
                    />
                  </div>
                  {quest.claimable ? (
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      variant="primary"
                      pending={claiming}
                      pendingLabel="Claiming…"
                      onClick={() => void actions.claimWeeklyQuest(quest)}
                    >
                      +{quest.rewardXp} XP
                    </Button>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="account-quest-count account-mono">
                      {quest.claimed ? "Claimed" : `${done}/${quest.target}`}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </article>
              );
            })
          ) : (
            <p className="account-hint">
              Nothing needs a quest right now. Your record is calm and clear.
            </p>
          )}
        </div>

        <p className="account-momentum-note" role="status" data-status={progression.momentum.status}>
          <Icon name={progression.momentum.activeThisWeek ? "trendingUp" : "circle"} size={14} />
          <span>
            <strong>
              {progression.momentum.activeThisWeek
                ? `${progression.momentum.activeWeeks}-week rhythm`
                : progression.momentum.status === "grace_week"
                  ? "A gentle grace week"
                  : "Ready when you are"}
            </strong>
            {progression.momentum.activeThisWeek
              ? " Meaningful work—not app opens—keeps this moving."
              : progression.momentum.status === "grace_week"
                ? " One quiet week does not erase the work you already did."
                : " Your first useful compliance action starts the rhythm."}
          </span>
        </p>

        <ul className="account-badges">
          {profile.badges.map((badge) => {
            const earned = Boolean(badge.earned || badge.earnedAt);
            return (
              <li key={badge.id} data-earned={earned || undefined}>
                <Icon name={earned ? "diamondFilled" : "diamond"} size={17} />
                <div>
                  <strong>{badge.name}</strong>
                  <small>{badge.description}</small>
                </div>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      </div>
    </details>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { Button } from "../components/Button";
import { ErrorSummary, Field, TextInput } from "../components/Form";
import { Icon } from "../components/Icon";
import { PageHeader } from "../components/PageHeader";
import { useToast } from "../components/Toast";
import { buttonClassName } from "../lib/buttonClass";
import { firstName } from "../lib/format";
import { useWorkspace } from "../lib/workspaceStore";
import { ChangeEmailSheet, ChangePasswordSheet, DeleteAccountSheet } from "./account/AccountSheets";
import { MomentumSection } from "./account/MomentumSection";
import { ReminderSettings } from "./account/ReminderSettings";
import { ACCOUNT_ERROR_COPY, useAccountApi, type PendingEmail } from "./account/useAccountApi";
import { usePushDevice } from "./hooks/usePushDevice";

// spec §6 Account; app-ux-13, app-ux-14, app-ux-15, app-ux-M-02, critic-06.
// One functional H1 and seven sections in this order — Profile, Email,
// Password, Reminders, Install, Your data, Danger zone — with Momentum folded
// between Your data and Danger zone, Sign out after, and the boundary line
// last. The demo identity (the local preview) has no sign-in: its self-service
// controls render disabled and no sheet ever opens. The sheets are
// `{open && (<…Sheet` children of this screen (uncounted by the modal-site
// guard); the install-help sheet stays a ModalsHost site behind
// usePushDevice().install().

const NAME_MAX = 80;

export function Account() {
  const store = useWorkspace();
  const { workspace, accountNotice, clearAccountNotice } = store;
  const push = usePushDevice(store);
  const api = useAccountApi();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [pendingEmail, setPendingEmail] = useState<PendingEmail | null>(null);
  const [mailConfigured, setMailConfigured] = useState(true);
  const [emailOpen, setEmailOpen] = useState(false);
  const [passwordOpen, setPasswordOpen] = useState(false);
  const [deleteOpen, setDeleteOpen] = useState(false);
  const [nameSaving, setNameSaving] = useState(false);
  const [nameError, setNameError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [emailBusy, setEmailBusy] = useState(false);
  const isDemo = Boolean(workspace?.user.isDemo);
  const userEmail = workspace?.user.email ?? "";

  // GET /account fills the pending email change and whether mail is set up.
  // Deferred like every launch read; a failed load (the dev server has no
  // gateway) leaves the defaults: no pending change, mail assumed configured
  // — the POST answers 503 mail_unconfigured, which the sheet shows.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isDemo) return;
    let cancelled = false;
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      void api.load().then((result) => {
        if (cancelled || !result.ok) return;
        setPendingEmail(result.data.pendingEmail);
        setMailConfigured(result.data.mailConfigured);
      });
    }, 0);
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      window.clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, [api, isDemo]);

  // The gateway's ?notice=email-changed (Task 14), read once by the store.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (accountNotice !== "email-changed" || !userEmail) return;
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      toast.show({ message: `Your email is now ${userEmail}.` });
      clearAccountNotice();
    }, 0);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [accountNotice, userEmail, toast, clearAccountNotice]);

  async function saveName(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (nameSaving) return;
    const name = String(new FormData(event.currentTarget).get("name") ?? "").trim();
    if (name.length < 1 || name.length > NAME_MAX) {
      setNameError(ACCOUNT_ERROR_COPY.name_invalid);
      return;
    }
    setNameSaving(true);
    setNameError(null);
    const result = await api.profile(name);
    setNameSaving(false);
    if (!result.ok) {
      setNameError(result.message);
      return;
    }
    toast.show({ message: "Your name is saved." });
    // ensureUser mirrored the new name on that request; the refetch shows it.
    await store.reload();
  }

  async function cancelEmailChange() {
    if (emailBusy) return;
    setEmailBusy(true);
    const result = await api.cancelEmail();
    setEmailBusy(false);
    if (!result.ok) {
      toast.show({ message: result.message, tone: "error" });
      return;
    }
    setPendingEmail(null);
    toast.show({ message: "The email change was cancelled." });
  }

  if (!workspace) return null;
  const displayName = workspace.user.displayName;
  const initial = firstName(displayName).slice(0, 1).toUpperCase();

  return (
    <div className="account-screen">
      <PageHeader
        eyebrow="Account"
        title="Your account"
        lede="Sign-in, reminders, your data and momentum."
      />

      <section className="account-section" id="account-profile" aria-labelledby="account-profile-title">
        <div className="account-section-head">
          <h2 id="account-profile-title" className="account-section-title">
            Profile
          </h2>
        </div>
        <div className="account-identity">
          <span className="account-avatar" aria-hidden="true">
            {initial}
          </span>
          <div>
            <strong className="account-name">{displayName}</strong>
            <span className="account-email">{workspace.user.email}</span>
          </div>
          {isDemo ? <span className="account-badge">Local preview</span> : null}
        </div>
        {isDemo ? (
          <p className="account-hint">The local preview keeps its name.</p>
        ) : (
          <form className="account-form" noValidate onSubmit={(event) => void saveName(event)}>
            <Field
              id="account-display-name"
              label="Display name"
              hint="Shown on your Home greeting and on renewal packets."
              error={nameError ?? undefined}
            >
              <TextInput
                name="name"
                defaultValue={displayName}
                required
                maxLength={NAME_MAX}
                autoComplete="name"
              />
            </Field>
            {nameError ? (
              <ErrorSummary errors={[{ fieldId: "account-display-name", message: nameError }]} />
            ) : null}
            <div className="form-actions">
              <Button type="submit" variant="secondary" pending={nameSaving}>
                Save name
              </Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        )}
      </section>

      <section className="account-section" id="account-email" aria-labelledby="account-email-title">
        <div className="account-section-head">
          <h2 id="account-email-title" className="account-section-title">
            Email
          </h2>
          {isDemo ? (
            <p className="account-section-lede">The local preview has no sign-in to change.</p>
          ) : null}
        </div>
        <div className="account-row">
          <span className="account-row-label">Signed in as</span>
          <span className="account-row-value">{workspace.user.email}</span>
          <Button variant="secondary" disabled={isDemo} onClick={() => setEmailOpen(true)}>
            Change email
          </Button>
        </div>
        {pendingEmail ? (
          <div className="account-notice" role="status">
            <p>
              <strong>Check {pendingEmail.newEmail} for a confirmation link.</strong> Until you
              confirm, {workspace.user.email} stays your sign-in.
            </p>
            <div className="account-actions">
              <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={() => setEmailOpen(true)}>
                Resend
              </Button>
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant="quiet"
                pending={emailBusy}
                onClick={() => void cancelEmailChange()}
              >
                Cancel change
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </section>

      <section className="account-section" id="account-password" aria-labelledby="account-password-title">
        <div className="account-section-head">
          <h2 id="account-password-title" className="account-section-title">
            Password
          </h2>
          {isDemo ? (
            <p className="account-section-lede">The local preview has no sign-in to change.</p>
          ) : null}
        </div>
        <div className="account-row">
          <span className="account-row-label">Password</span>
          <span className="account-row-value account-row-value-mono" aria-hidden="true">
            ••••••••••
          </span>
          <Button variant="secondary" disabled={isDemo} onClick={() => setPasswordOpen(true)}>
            Change password
          </Button>
        </div>
      </section>

      <ReminderSettings workspace={workspace} push={push} />

      <section className="account-section" id="account-install" aria-labelledby="account-install-title">
        <div className="account-section-head">
          <h2 id="account-install-title" className="account-section-title">
            Install
          </h2>
          {push.isStandalone ? null : (
            <p className="account-section-lede">
              Add iTrack to your phone for a full-screen workspace that opens from your Home
              Screen. Installing doesn’t turn on alerts.
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
        {push.isStandalone ? (
          <p className="account-installed">
            <Icon name="check" size={14} />
            Installed on this device.
          </p>
        ) : (
          <div className="account-actions">
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => void push.install()}>
              {push.pushDeviceState === "install_required"
                ? "Add to Home Screen"
                : push.installAvailable
                  ? "Install on this device"
                  : "How to install"}
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}
      </section>

      <section className="account-section" id="account-data" aria-labelledby="account-data-title">
        <div className="account-section-head">
          <h2 id="account-data-title" className="account-section-title">
            Your data
          </h2>
          <p className="account-section-lede">
            Everything iTrack holds for you, in files you can keep.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="account-actions">
          <a className={buttonClassName("primary")} href="/api/export/all" download>
            Download everything
          </a>
          <a className={buttonClassName("secondary")} href="/api/export" download>
            Activities (CSV)
          </a>
        </div>
        <p className="account-hint">
          A zip with your credentials, activities, check-ins and reminder settings as JSON and
          CSV, plus every evidence file.
        </p>
      </section>

      <MomentumSection workspace={workspace} />

      <section className="account-section" id="account-danger" aria-labelledby="account-danger-title">
        <div className="account-section-head">
          <h2 id="account-danger-title" className="account-section-title">
            Danger zone
          </h2>
          <p className="account-section-lede">
            {isDemo
              ? "The local preview can’t be deleted."
              : "Deleting your account removes every credential, activity, evidence file and reminder, and your sign-in. It can’t be undone."}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="account-actions">
          <Button variant="destructive" disabled={isDemo} onClick={() => setDeleteOpen(true)}>
            Delete account…
          </Button>
        </div>
      </section>

      {isDemo ? null : (
        <section className="account-section account-signout" aria-label="Sign out">
          <form method="post" action="/auth/logout">
            <Button type="submit" variant="secondary">
              Sign out
            </Button>
          </form>
        </section>
      )}

      <p className="account-boundary">
        iTrack is an organizer, not an issuing authority. Your board’s current instructions
        control.
      </p>

      {emailOpen && (
        <ChangeEmailSheet
          initialEmail={pendingEmail?.newEmail ?? ""}
          mailConfigured={mailConfigured}
          onClose={() => setEmailOpen(false)}
          onSent={(pending) => {
            setEmailOpen(false);
            setPendingEmail(pending);
            toast.show({ message: "Check the new address for a confirmation link." });
          }}
        />
      )}
      {passwordOpen && (
        <ChangePasswordSheet
          onClose={() => setPasswordOpen(false)}
          onChanged={() => {
            setPasswordOpen(false);
            toast.show({ message: "Password changed. Other devices were signed out." });
          }}
        />
      )}
      {deleteOpen && (
        <DeleteAccountSheet email={workspace.user.email} onClose={() => setDeleteOpen(false)} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

(`if (!workspace) return null;` sits after every hook — `Account` is only ever rendered inside the loaded branch of the route switch, the guard is for the type. The logout form is spelled `method="post" action="/auth/logout"` in that order — `tests/app-source-guards.test.mjs:100-107` looks for exactly that. Every `Sheet` site is `{flag && (` — the modal-site guard's regex needs ` ? (` and a `<…Modal` tag, so it counts none of these.)

### Task 17: Renewal packet re-themed: packetTheme.ts (light token mirror asserted against tokens.css, seven faces, audited stylesheet), renewalPacket.ts rewritten (five sections, no ids, state word, holder's zone, copy tables), CSP font-src 'self', renewalPacketFilename, rendered-html/isolation/packet specs rewritten, axe on the packet

**Rationale:** spec §6 Packet says only "Packet re-themed in the new tokens; internal ids removed (app-ux-19)", and §6's copy rules bind it like every screen ("credits that count" / "credits still needed", never "countable units" or "classification gaps"; "categorize", "evidence"; a server string is never the visible sentence). Today the packet is the retired product on paper. `app/lib/renewalPacket.ts` (936 lines, import-free) inlines the old palette as nine literals in its `:root` (`--ink: #173c32 … --amber-soft: #fff1cf`, `:520-531`) plus stray literals at `:533` (`#e8eeea`), `:555` (`#fff`), `:597` (`#edf1ee` / `#596760`), `:619-621` (`#e8cf98`/`#bcd9ca`, `#fffaf0`/`#f2faf5`), `:673` (`#d5a748`/`#fff9eb`/`#635634`) and `:688` (`#fff`); the body is `Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui …` at `14px` (`:539-540`), `h1`/`h2` are Georgia serif at `38px`/`24px` (`:545-546`), and the error page (`renderRenewalPacketError`, `:874-936`) carries twelve more literals (`:892-921`) and Georgia (`:907`) — none of which any gate sees, because `tools/contrast-audit.mjs` walks only `app/**/*.css` and the five gateway pages (`collectStylesheets`, `:219-225`) and the px-font-size guard walks `.css` only (`tests/app-source-guards.test.mjs:241-267`). Internal identifiers are printed as `data-requirement-id` (`:293-295`), `data-activity-id` (`:325-327`), `data-task-id` (`:388`), `data-evidence-id` (`:422`) and a per-file `/api/evidence/<uuid>/download` link (`evidenceHref` `:164-173`, rendered `:432-437`) — app-ux-19 ("leaks internal identifiers"); the old product name leaks through `<meta name="license-lantern-packet-version">` (`:517`, explicitly renameable per `tests/protected-identifiers.test.mjs:12-16`) and the footer `Account: <email>` (`:866`). Server vocabulary is title-cased raw by `words()` (`:148-152`): `requirement.relation` (`:298`), `task.kind` (`:394-395`, "Personal · Personal" for a personal task), `submissionAttestationKind` (`:813`, "Owner Attested") and `source.reviewStatus` + "Template version N" (`:844-848`) — §6's "never raw" rule. Timestamps are formatted in UTC regardless of the holder (`formatTimestamp` `:126-138`, `timeZone: "UTC"`; `formatDate` `:114-124` slices instants to a date) — critic-01 (the CSV export already reads the stored zone: `app/api/export/route.ts:113-123`), and nothing carries a zone into the renderer: `credentialIdFromRequest` (`app/api/export/packet/route.ts:69-82`) 400s any extra query key, while `getWorkspace` already returns `reminderPreferences.timeZone` (`app/api/workspace/route.ts:5272`). The route's enforced CSP is `default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'sha256-…'; …` (`packet/route.ts:264`; the error page's at `:57-58`) with no `font-src`, so the three self-hosted faces cannot load until `font-src 'self'` is added (`/fonts/` is public and immutable: `deploy/railway/gateway.mjs:39`, `public/_headers`). `compactNumber`/`formatDate`/`formatFileSize` exist twice (architecture-07) — the packet keeps its own three because they are the zone-explicit, worker-side variants (a calendar day pinned at noon UTC; `Intl` numbers to two places), documented as such below. Pins that name the old contract and are rewritten here, not deleted (Global Constraints: the rendered-html packet subtests are behaviour tests over the built worker): `tests/rendered-html.test.mjs` `:23861-23864` (Content-Disposition `credential-packet-…`), `:23875-23983` (meta, nine section ids, `data-total-*`, `data-*-id`, the evidence link, "Confirm applicability", "Proof removal pending", "marked as missing proof", "allocated to this cycle", "Owner Attested", "Template version 7", "Final verification required", "Print / Save as PDF"), `:24026-24030` / `:24046-24049` / `:24100-24105` (the three error bodies), `tests/isolation.test.mjs:718` (the 404 JSON), `tests/e2e/packet.spec.ts:11,21,32`, `tests/protected-identifiers.test.mjs:14` (comment), and `tests/e2e/axe.spec.ts:52-60` (`ROUTES`, which has no packet entry). This task makes the packet the ledger on paper: a pure theme module whose light tokens are asserted value-for-value against `app/styles/tokens.css:7-158`, the seven `@font-face` rules of `app/styles/fonts.css:11-72` and its three metric-matched fallbacks (`:80-82`) reproduced from `FONT_FILES` (`app/lib/fonts.ts:15-23`), a generated stylesheet the contrast audit can read as a token file (its first rule is `:root {`, `tools/contrast-audit.mjs:171-175`), a five-section document with no id, the state word from `STATE_LABELS` (`app/lib/instruments.ts:42-49`) computed by the route through `stateOf` (`:209-216`), the holder's stored zone on every instant, and the copy tables of copy-table section H.

**Decisions.** (1) The per-file `/api/evidence/<uuid>/download` link goes — it is the last id-bearing string and is useless on paper; the SHA-256 stays as a file fingerprint a board can check against the file it receives. (2) The holder's contact email stays on the cover under "Prepared for" (a licensee's contact line); the old `Account: <email>` footer goes. (3) Accounts still on the stored `"UTC"` literal (`app/lib/dates.ts:47-50`: "never chosen") print "UTC" explicitly — no client-side reformat script; Account's zone auto-detect (Task 16) fixes the source. (4) Light only (`color-scheme: light`): a print document, like `app/manifest.ts`. (5) One noun, "Renewal packet": filename prefix `renewal-packet-`, function `renewalPacketFilename`, the detail link (Task 7), the Home header link (Task 8); the document `<title>` is `{credentialName} · Renewal packet`. (6) The rendered-html packet subtests are behaviour tests over the built worker (headers, the evidence SQL's isolation of deleting/archived/foreign rows, zero R2 calls): their string and attribute assertions are rewritten to the new contract, never deleted; the subtest is retitled without the banned word. (7) A signed-out packet tab on production gets the gateway's JSON 401 (`gateway.mjs:333-347`) before the worker — a Wave 5 gateway matter, recorded in Task 19's memory note; the worker's own 401 body still changes here because `tests/rendered-html.test.mjs` exercises it. (8) The attestation-kind, task-kind, format and review-status copy tables live inline in `renewalPacket.ts` (self-contained; the credential detail's vocabulary is its own). (9) Print body `11pt` under `@media print` only — a print length, not a screen size; every screen size is a `--text-*` token or a rem/em/% length. (10) The "Check before you submit" notice sits on `--paper-deep` with `--ink` (14.1:1, a claimed pair) and a 4 px `--state-due-soon` left edge, not on `--state-due-soon-soft`: `--ink` on a soft fill carries no claim in `tokens.css` and this task adds none (Global Constraints, colour literals) — every ink-on-fill pairing the packet paints is one `tokens.css` already claims: `--ink`/`--ink-muted` on `--paper`/`--paper-deep`/`--card`, `--accent` on `--paper-deep`/`--card`/`--accent-soft`, `--on-accent` on `--accent`, each `--state-*` on its `--state-*-soft`, `--state-neutral` on `--state-neutral-soft`. (11) `formatDate` (calendar days: cycle dates, completion and due dates, the source's effective/verified dates, `acceptedAt` — an `isoDateField`) keeps the noon-UTC path so a day never shifts; only instants take the zone: `generatedAt`, evidence `createdAt` (SQLite `CURRENT_TIMESTAMP`, `db/runtime.ts:265`), a task's `completedAt` (`route.ts:8652`, `CURRENT_TIMESTAMP`), `officialRecordAttestedAt` (`route.ts:11338`, an ISO instant) and `submittedAt` (stored as the form's date, but an instant in the built-worker fixture) — `formatInstantDate` passes a bare `YYYY-MM-DD` through `formatDate` and parses ISO and SQLite `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (UTC) forms otherwise.

```ts
export type RenewalPacketEvidence = { activityTitle: string; fileName: string; contentType: string; sizeBytes: number; sha256: string; createdAt: string };
export type RenewalPacketData = {
  owner: { displayName: string; email: string };
  credential: { credentialName: string; profession: string; jurisdiction: string; issuer: string; cycleStart: string; deadline: string; status: string; state: InstrumentState; lifecycleKind: "renewal" | "compliance_period" | "automatic_renewal"; totalRequired: number; totalLoggedUnits: number; totalExcessUnits: number; totalEarned: number; totalRemaining: number; unclassifiedUnits: number; unitLabel: string; submittedAt: string | null; confirmationNumber: string | null; submissionProof: string | null; submissionAttestationKind: string | null; acceptedAt: string | null; acceptanceReference: string | null; officialRecordAttestedAt: string | null };
  source: { title: string | null; url: string | null; effectiveDate: string | null; lastVerifiedAt: string | null; reviewStatus: string };
  requirements: RenewalPacketRequirement[]; tasks: RenewalPacketTask[]; activities: RenewalPacketActivity[]; evidence: RenewalPacketEvidence[];
  generatedAt: string; generatedZone: string;
};
export const RENEWAL_PACKET_PRINT_SCRIPT = 'document.getElementById("print-packet")?.addEventListener("click",()=>{(document.fonts?document.fonts.ready:Promise.resolve()).then(()=>window.print());});';
export function renewalPacketFilename(credentialName: string, deadline: string): string;  // `renewal-packet-${slug ≤ 72 || "credential"}-${deadline matches YYYY-MM-DD ? deadline : "cycle"}.html`
export function renderRenewalPacket(data: RenewalPacketData): string;
export function renderRenewalPacketError(title: string, message: string): string;
```

```js
// The renewal packet's theme is the light ledger, value for value (spec §6
// Packet; app-ux-19). app/lib/packetTheme.ts mirrors the light :root of
// app/styles/tokens.css because the packet's CSP (default-src 'none';
// style-src 'unsafe-inline') can load no stylesheet; this suite reads
// tokens.css only through tools/contrast-audit.mjs — the sanctioned walker
// (architecture-03: no test reads a stylesheet under app/ as text) — and
// audits the generated sheet with the same tool that gates every .css under
// app/. Build-free after `npm run build:lib-test`.
import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import {
  auditStylesheet,
  collectStylesheets,
  tokenBlocks,
  tokenValues,
} from "../tools/contrast-audit.mjs";
import { FONT_FILES } from "../.test-build/fonts.js";
import {
  PACKET_LIGHT_TOKENS,
  PACKET_STATUS_STATES,
  packetErrorStylesheet,
  packetFontFaces,
  packetRootBlock,
  packetStylesheet,
} from "../.test-build/packetTheme.js";

const TOKEN_FILE = "app/styles/tokens.css";
const stripComments = (css) => css.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, "");

test("the packet theme is the light ledger, value for value", () => {
  const sheet = collectStylesheets().find((candidate) => candidate.path === TOKEN_FILE);
  assert.ok(sheet, `${TOKEN_FILE} is walked by the audit`);
  const light = tokenValues(sheet.css, tokenBlocks(sheet.css).light);
  const names = Object.keys(PACKET_LIGHT_TOKENS);
  assert.ok(names.length >= 30, `the packet consumes ${names.length} light tokens`);
  for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(PACKET_LIGHT_TOKENS)) {
    assert.equal(value, light.get(name), `${name} mirrors tokens.css`);
  }
  // The three faces and the rem scale come along unchanged, so the packet
  // never declares a size or a face the app does not.
  for (const name of ["--font-display", "--font-body", "--font-mono", "--text-2xs", "--text-3xl", "--radius-pill"]) {
    assert.ok(names.includes(name), name);
  }
});

test("packetRootBlock is the first rule of both sheets and carries every packet token", () => {
  const root = packetRootBlock();
  assert.match(root, /^:root \{\n  color-scheme: light;\n/);
  assert.match(root, /\n\}$/);
  for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(PACKET_LIGHT_TOKENS)) {
    assert.ok(root.includes(`\n  ${name}: ${value};\n`), name);
  }
  assert.ok(packetStylesheet().startsWith(root), "the packet sheet opens with the root block");
  assert.ok(packetErrorStylesheet().startsWith(root), "the error sheet opens with the root block");
});

test("the seven faces are declared from FONT_FILES with swap, one unicode-range and the fonts.css fallbacks", () => {
  const faces = packetFontFaces();
  for (const href of Object.values(FONT_FILES)) {
    assert.ok(faces.includes(`src: url(${href}) format("woff2");`), href);
  }
  assert.equal((faces.match(/@font-face \{/g) ?? []).length, 10, "seven faces plus three metric-matched fallbacks");
  assert.equal((faces.match(/font-display: swap;/g) ?? []).length, 7);
  assert.equal((faces.match(/unicode-range: U\+0000-00FF, U\+0131, U\+0152-0153, /g) ?? []).length, 7);
  for (const family of ['"Bricolage Grotesque"', '"Atkinson Hyperlegible"', '"iTrack Mono"']) {
    assert.ok(faces.includes(`font-family: ${family};`), family);
  }
  assert.match(faces, /font-style: italic;\n  font-weight: 400;/);
  assert.match(
    faces,
    /@font-face \{ font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Fallback"; src: local\("Arial"\), local\("ArialMT"\); size-adjust: 99\.69%; ascent-override: 95\.30%; descent-override: 29\.09%; line-gap-override: 0\.00%; \}/,
  );
  assert.match(
    faces,
    /@font-face \{ font-family: "Bricolage Grotesque Fallback"; src: local\("Arial"\), local\("ArialMT"\); size-adjust: 102\.71%; ascent-override: 90\.54%; descent-override: 26\.29%; line-gap-override: 0\.00%; \}/,
  );
  assert.match(
    faces,
    /@font-face \{ font-family: "iTrack Mono Fallback"; src: local\("Menlo"\), local\("Menlo-Regular"\); size-adjust: 99\.66%; ascent-override: 102\.85%; descent-override: 27\.59%; line-gap-override: 0\.00%; \}/,
  );
  assert.doesNotMatch(faces, /font-optical-sizing|font-variation-settings|googleapis|gstatic/);
  // A caller may hand in other names (a test build), and the shape is the same.
  const custom = packetFontFaces({
    displayBold: "/fonts/a.woff2",
    displayBlack: "/fonts/b.woff2",
    body: "/fonts/c.woff2",
    bodyBold: "/fonts/d.woff2",
    bodyItalic: "/fonts/e.woff2",
    mono: "/fonts/f.woff2",
    monoMedium: "/fonts/g.woff2",
  });
  assert.match(custom, /src: url\(\/fonts\/c\.woff2\) format\("woff2"\);/);
});

test("the packet stylesheet carries no literal outside its :root, no px font-size, only packet tokens, and the Letter page", () => {
  const css = packetStylesheet();
  const report = auditStylesheet(css, { path: "app/lib/packetTheme.ts", kind: "tokens" });
  assert.deepEqual(report.literals, [], "every colour after the :root is a var(--…)");
  assert.equal(report.claims.length, 0, "the root carries values, never a claim of its own");
  const code = stripComments(css);
  assert.doesNotMatch(code, /font-size\s*:\s*[^;]*\d+px/, "every size is a token or a rem/em/% length");
  const printAt = code.indexOf("@media print");
  assert.ok(printAt > 0, "the print block exists");
  assert.doesNotMatch(code.slice(0, printAt), /\d+pt\b/, "pt is a print length only");
  assert.match(code.slice(printAt), /font-size: 11pt;/);
  assert.match(code, /@page \{ size: Letter; margin: 14mm; \}/);
  assert.match(code, /\.toolbar \{ display: none; \}/);
  for (const state of PACKET_STATUS_STATES) {
    assert.ok(code.includes(`.status-pill[data-state="${state}"]`), `a pill rule for ${state}`);
  }
  assert.match(code, /font-family: "Bricolage Grotesque";/);
  // Every var() the sheet reads is a packet token or one of the two
  // element-scoped pill properties — no legacy alias, no undefined name.
  const declared = new Set([...Object.keys(PACKET_LIGHT_TOKENS), "--state-ink", "--state-soft"]);
  const referenced = [...code.matchAll(/var\((--[a-z0-9-]+)/g)].map((match) => match[1]);
  assert.ok(referenced.length > 40, `the sheet reads ${referenced.length} tokens`);
  for (const name of referenced) {
    assert.ok(declared.has(name), `${name} is declared by the packet root`);
  }
  assert.doesNotMatch(code, /transition|animation/, "nothing in a print document moves");
});

test("the error stylesheet is the same theme: no literal outside its :root, the button, the two faces it uses", () => {
  const css = packetErrorStylesheet();
  const report = auditStylesheet(css, { path: "app/lib/packetTheme.ts", kind: "tokens" });
  assert.deepEqual(report.literals, []);
  assert.equal(report.claims.length, 0);
  const code = stripComments(css);
  assert.doesNotMatch(code, /font-size\s*:\s*[^;]*\d+px/);
  assert.match(code, /\.btn \{/);
  assert.match(code, /\.btn-secondary \{/);
  assert.match(code, /font-family: "Bricolage Grotesque";/);
  const declared = new Set(Object.keys(PACKET_LIGHT_TOKENS));
  for (const match of code.matchAll(/var\((--[a-z0-9-]+)/g)) {
    assert.ok(declared.has(match[1]), `${match[1]} is declared by the packet root`);
  }
});
```

```js
test("submission, acceptance, the checklist and the rules source use the copy tables", () => {
  const html = renderRenewalPacket(fixture());
  assert.match(html, /<h3>Submission<\/h3>\s*<p><b>Date:<\/b> Not recorded<\/p>\s*<p><b>Confirmation number:<\/b> Not recorded<\/p>\s*<p><b>Reference:<\/b> Not recorded<\/p>\s*<p><b>Attested:<\/b> Not recorded<\/p>/);
  assert.match(html, /<h3>Acceptance<\/h3>\s*<p><b>Date:<\/b> Not recorded<\/p>\s*<p><b>Reference:<\/b> Not recorded<\/p>\s*<p><b>Official record confirmed:<\/b> Not recorded<\/p>/);
  assert.match(html, /<h3>Checklist<\/h3>/);
  assert.match(html, /<th scope="col">Task<\/th><th scope="col">Kind<\/th><th scope="col">Due<\/th><th scope="col">Done<\/th><th scope="col">Status<\/th>/);
  assert.match(html, /<td>Review the board portal<\/td>\s*<td>Review<\/td>\s*<td class="mono">Sep 1, 2026<\/td>\s*<td class="mono">Aug 20, 2026<\/td>\s*<td><span class="status-pill" data-state="complete">Done<\/span><\/td>/);
  assert.match(html, /<td>Book the ethics course<\/td>\s*<td>Your task<\/td>\s*<td class="mono">—<\/td>\s*<td class="mono">—<\/td>\s*<td><span class="status-pill" data-state="due-soon">Open<\/span><\/td>/);
  assert.match(html, /<h3>Rules source<\/h3>\s*<p><b>Fixture Rules 2026<\/b><\/p>\s*<p>Effective Jan 1, 2026 · Last reviewed Jun 30, 2026<\/p>\s*<p><a href="https:\/\/example\.test\/rules\?part=one&amp;note=two" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Official source<\/a><\/p>/);
  assert.match(html, /<p class="notice"><b>Check before you submit\.<\/b> This packet is your iTrack record\. The board’s current rules, portal and records control\.<\/p>/);

  const submitted = renderRenewalPacket(
    fixture({
      credential: {
        status: "submitted",
        state: "submitted",
        submittedAt: "2026-07-25T15:30:00.000Z",
        confirmationNumber: "CONF-1",
        submissionProof: "Receipt 9",
        submissionAttestationKind: "owner_attested",
        acceptedAt: "2026-08-01",
        acceptanceReference: "REF-2",
        officialRecordAttestedAt: "2026-08-02T02:00:00.000Z",
      },
      source: { reviewStatus: "needs_review" },
      tasks: [{ title: "Send it", kind: "submission", status: "pending", dueDate: "2026-12-31", completedAt: null, isPersonal: false }],
    }),
  );
  assert.match(submitted, /<span class="status-pill" data-state="submitted">Submitted<\/span>/);
  assert.match(submitted, /<p><b>Date:<\/b> Jul 25, 2026<\/p>\s*<p><b>Confirmation number:<\/b> CONF-1<\/p>\s*<p><b>Reference:<\/b> Receipt 9<\/p>\s*<p><b>Attested:<\/b> Attested by the licensee<\/p>/);
  // acceptedAt is a calendar day; the official-record instant is in the
  // holder's zone (02:00Z on Aug 2 is the evening of Aug 1 in New York).
  assert.match(submitted, /<h3>Acceptance<\/h3>\s*<p><b>Date:<\/b> Aug 1, 2026<\/p>\s*<p><b>Reference:<\/b> REF-2<\/p>\s*<p><b>Official record confirmed:<\/b> Aug 1, 2026<\/p>/);
  assert.match(submitted, /<td>Send it<\/td>\s*<td>Submission<\/td>\s*<td class="mono">Dec 31, 2026<\/td>/);
  assert.match(submitted, /<p>Effective Jan 1, 2026 · Review pending<\/p>/);

  const kinds = (kind) =>
    renderRenewalPacket(fixture({ credential: { submissionAttestationKind: kind } })).match(/<b>Attested:<\/b> ([^<]+)</)[1];
  assert.equal(kinds("isc2_requirements_satisfied"), "ISC2 requirements satisfied");
  assert.equal(kinds("compliance_period_complete"), "Compliance period complete");
  assert.equal(kinds("nremt_requirements_satisfied"), "NREMT requirements satisfied");
  assert.equal(kinds("nremt_late_reinstatement_requirements_satisfied"), "NREMT late-reinstatement requirements satisfied");
  assert.equal(kinds("crcc_requirements_satisfied"), "CRCC requirements satisfied");
  assert.equal(kinds("something_new"), "Recorded", "an unknown kind is never shown raw");

  const compliance = renderRenewalPacket(fixture({ credential: { lifecycleKind: "compliance_period" } }));
  assert.match(compliance, /<h3>Compliance checkpoint<\/h3>/);
  assert.match(compliance, /<h3>Period complete<\/h3>/);
  const automatic = renderRenewalPacket(fixture({ credential: { lifecycleKind: "automatic_renewal" } }));
  assert.match(automatic, /<h3>Dashboard checkpoint<\/h3>/);
  assert.match(automatic, /<h3>Renewal confirmed<\/h3>/);
  const custom = renderRenewalPacket(fixture({ source: { title: null, url: null, effectiveDate: null, lastVerifiedAt: null, reviewStatus: "custom" } }));
  assert.match(custom, /<p><b>Your own plan<\/b><\/p>\s*<p>No source link on this plan\.<\/p>/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(custom, /Effective/);
  const http = renderRenewalPacket(fixture({ source: { url: "http://example.test/insecure" } }));
  assert.match(http, /No source link on this plan\./, "only an https source is linked");
});

test("instants print in the holder's zone; calendar dates do not move", () => {
  const newYork = renderRenewalPacket(fixture());
  assert.match(newYork, /<footer>Generated Sep 16, 2026, 2:14 PM EDT · iTrack · itrackceu\.com<\/footer>/);
  assert.match(newYork, /<td class="mono">Feb 11, 2026<\/td>/, "03:30Z on Feb 12 is the evening of Feb 11 in New York");
  assert.match(newYork, /<td class="mono">Aug 20, 2026<\/td>/, "SQLite's CURRENT_TIMESTAMP is read as UTC, then placed in the zone");
  const utc = renderRenewalPacket(fixture({ generatedZone: "UTC" }));
  assert.match(utc, /<footer>Generated Sep 16, 2026, 6:14 PM UTC · iTrack · itrackceu\.com<\/footer>/);
  assert.match(utc, /<td class="mono">Feb 12, 2026<\/td>/);
  assert.match(utc, /<td class="mono">Aug 21, 2026<\/td>/);
  for (const html of [newYork, utc]) {
    assert.match(html, /Jan 1, 2026 – Dec 31, 2027/, "cycle dates are calendar days");
    assert.match(html, /<td class="mono">May 4, 2026<\/td>/, "completion dates are calendar days");
  }
  const odd = renderRenewalPacket(fixture({ generatedZone: "Not/AZone" }));
  assert.match(odd, /Generated Sep 16, 2026, 6:14 PM UTC/, "an unusable zone falls back to UTC instead of throwing");
});

});

      activities: [{ title: "<img src=x onerror=alert('activity')> Ethics", provider: "P & Q", format: "conference", completionDate: "2026-03-01", totalUnits: 1, allocatedUnits: 1, categoryNames: ["A <b>"], classificationStatus: "classified", evidenceStatus: "attached", evidenceReference: "Ref <x>", evidenceDeletionPendingCount: 0 }],
```

Replace `tests/e2e/packet.spec.ts` whole (34 lines at main @c6b1fe4; Task 7 rewrote its line 11 to the new link name) with:

```ts
// The renewal packet as the owner sees it (spec §6 Packet; app-ux-19,
// critic-01): reached from the credential detail's "Renewal packet" link,
// rendered on the light tokens with the three faces loading under the CSP's
// font-src 'self', five sections in order, no internal identifier in the
// document, the print sheet, the holder's zone in the footer, and a 404 page
// for anyone else. The built worker's contract — headers, the evidence SQL's
// isolation, escaping — is tests/rendered-html.test.mjs's. Fresh identity: the
// demo email carries the protected `license-lantern` literal, which this spec
// asserts is absent from the page.
import { expect, freshIdentity, test } from "./fixtures";

test.use({ identity: freshIdentity() });

const SECTIONS = ["Requirements", "Activities", "Evidence", "Submission and acceptance", "Notes"];

test("the detail links to the renewal packet, which renders on the tokens for its owner and 404s for anyone else", async ({ page, context, app }) => {
  const name = `E2E packet ${Date.now().toString(36)}`;
  const { id } = await app.seedCredential({ credentialName: name });
  const { id: activityId } = await app.seedActivity(id, { title: "E2E packet course" });
  await app.goto(`/credentials/${id}`);
  const link = page.getByRole("link", { name: "Renewal packet" });
  await expect(link).toBeVisible();
  const href = await link.getAttribute("href");
  if (href === null) throw new Error("the packet link has no href");
  expect(href).toBe(`/api/export/packet?credentialId=${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);

  // The owner's packet: a document, not the app. The CSP lets the faces in.
  const response = await page.goto(href);
  expect(response?.status()).toBe(200);
  expect(response?.headers()["content-security-policy"]).toContain("font-src 'self'");
  expect(response?.headers()["content-disposition"]).toMatch(/^inline; filename="renewal-packet-e2e-packet-[a-z0-9]+-2027-12-31\.html"$/);
  await expect(page.locator("h1")).toHaveText(name);
  await expect(page.locator('meta[name="itrack-packet-version"]')).toHaveCount(1);
  await expect(page.locator('meta[name="itrack-packet-version"]')).toHaveAttribute("content", "2");
  expect(await page.getByRole("heading", { level: 2 }).allTextContents()).toEqual(SECTIONS);
  await expect(page.getByText("E2E packet course")).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "Print or save as PDF" })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.locator("footer")).toHaveText(/^Generated .+ (UTC|[A-Z]{2,5}) · iTrack · itrackceu\.com$/);

  // app-ux-19: nothing internal reaches the paper.
  const html = await page.content();
  expect(html).not.toContain(id);
  expect(html).not.toContain(activityId);
  expect(html).not.toMatch(/data-[a-z-]+-id=/);
  expect(html).not.toContain("/api/evidence/");
  expect(html).not.toContain("license-lantern");
  expect(html).toMatch(/@media print/);
  expect(html).toMatch(/@page \{ size: Letter; margin: 14mm; \}/);

  // The faces load under the CSP: the body face (every paragraph) and the
  // display face at 700 (the h1) report `loaded`; a blocked font reports
  // `error`. document.fonts.check() is not used — it answers true for a
  // family no @font-face declares.
  const loaded = await page.evaluate(async () => {
    await document.fonts.ready;
    return Array.from(document.fonts)
      .filter((face) => face.status === "loaded")
      .map((face) => `${face.family.replace(/["']/g, "")} ${face.weight}`);
  });
  expect(loaded).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(["Atkinson Hyperlegible 400", "Bricolage Grotesque 700"]));

  // The print sheet hides the toolbar and nothing else changes.
  await page.emulateMedia({ media: "print" });
  await expect(page.getByRole("navigation", { name: "Packet actions" })).toBeHidden();
  await expect(page.locator("h1")).toHaveText(name);
  await page.emulateMedia({ media: null });
  await expect(page.getByRole("navigation", { name: "Packet actions" })).toBeVisible();

  // A credential the caller does not own is not found — as a page and as JSON.
  const foreign = await page.goto("/api/export/packet?credentialId=not-mine");
  expect(foreign?.status()).toBe(404);
  expect(foreign?.headers()["content-security-policy"]).toContain("font-src 'self'");
  await expect(page.locator("h1")).toHaveText("Packet unavailable");
  await expect(page.getByRole("link", { name: "Try again" })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole("link", { name: "Back to iTrack" })).toBeVisible();
  const json = await context.request.get(href.replace(id, "not-mine"), {
    headers: { accept: "application/json" },
  });
  expect(json.status()).toBe(404);
  expect(await json.json()).toEqual({
    error: "That credential is not in your account. Open the packet again from Credentials.",
    code: "credential_not_found",
  });
  app.expectNoErrors();
});
```
