Create `app/lib/packetTheme.ts` (the 35 values below are `app/styles/tokens.css:13-15, 25-26, 33-34, 45-48, 63-70, 128-131, 139-143, 150-157` verbatim — Step 5's first test fails on any byte that differs; the `@font-face` rules and fallbacks are `app/styles/fonts.css:11-72, 80-82` verbatim, the file names read from `FONT_FILES`):

```ts
/**
 * The renewal packet's theme (spec §6 Packet; app-ux-19). The packet is a
 * standalone HTML document served by app/api/export/packet/route.ts under
 * `default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'`, so it can
 * load no stylesheet from app/styles/: its sheet is generated here as one
 * string. PACKET_LIGHT_TOKENS mirrors the light `:root` of
 * app/styles/tokens.css value for value — tests/packet-theme.test.mjs reads
 * tokens.css through tools/contrast-audit.mjs and asserts every entry equal,
 * so a palette change fails loudly instead of drifting. packetRootBlock() is
 * the FIRST rule of both sheets, which is what makes tools/contrast-audit.mjs
 * read the string as a token file: the block is masked and any colour
 * literal after it is reported. Every later rule is var(--…) only, every
 * size a --text-* token or a rem/em/% length; the one `pt` sits inside
 * `@media print` (a print length, not a screen size).
 *
 * Light only, by design — a print document (`color-scheme: light`), like
 * app/manifest.ts. The seven faces are the same latin subsets the app
 * preloads (app/lib/fonts.ts), declared with the unicode-range and the three
 * metric-matched local() fallbacks of app/styles/fonts.css, reproduced here
 * because the packet cannot import that file. Every ink-on-fill pairing the
 * rules paint is one tokens.css claims: --ink and --ink-muted on --paper,
 * --paper-deep and --card; --accent on --paper-deep, --card and
 * --accent-soft; --on-accent on --accent; each --state-* on its soft fill.
 *
 * Pure and DOM-free; the only import is `./fonts.js` (the `.js` suffix is
 * what `npm run build:lib-test`'s `tsc --module nodenext` emit resolves).
 */
import { FONT_FILES } from "./fonts.js";

/** The names the packet consumes, each value byte-identical to tokens.css's light block. */
export const PACKET_LIGHT_TOKENS: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {
  "--paper": "#f5f2ea",
  "--paper-deep": "#ebe7dc",
  "--card": "#fffdf8",
  "--ink": "#1c1a17",
  "--ink-muted": "#5e5a52",
  "--line": "#dad5c8",
  "--line-strong": "#847f74",
  "--accent": "#2743b8",
  "--accent-hover": "#1b2f86",
  "--accent-soft": "#e3e8fa",
  "--on-accent": "#fffdf8",
  "--state-overdue": "#b3261e",
  "--state-overdue-soft": "#fbe4e2",
  "--state-due-soon": "#8a5a00",
  "--state-due-soon-soft": "#fbefd3",
  "--state-complete": "#22694e",
  "--state-complete-soft": "#ddf0e6",
  "--state-neutral": "#5e5a52",
  "--state-neutral-soft": "#ebe7dc",
  "--radius-sm": "8px",
  "--radius-md": "12px",
  "--radius-pill": "999px",
  "--font-display":
    '"Bricolage Grotesque", "Bricolage Grotesque Fallback", "Atkinson Hyperlegible", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif',
  "--font-body":
    '"Atkinson Hyperlegible", "Atkinson Hyperlegible Fallback", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif',
  "--font-mono":
    '"iTrack Mono", "iTrack Mono Fallback", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace',
  "--tracking-display": "-0.02em",
  "--tracking-eyebrow": "0.08em",
  "--text-2xs": "0.75rem",
  "--text-xs": "0.8125rem",
  "--text-sm": "0.875rem",
  "--text-md": "1rem",
  "--text-lg": "1.125rem",
  "--text-xl": "1.375rem",
  "--text-2xl": "1.75rem",
  "--text-3xl": "2.25rem",
};

/**
 * The pill states the packet paints, in the order the sheet declares them.
 * They are the InstrumentState vocabulary of app/lib/instruments.ts (the
 * same data-state contract as the StatusPill instrument), spelled here so
 * this module stays import-free beyond fonts.
 */
export const PACKET_STATUS_STATES = [
  "overdue",
  "due-soon",
  "on-track",
  "submitted",
  "complete",
  "none",
] as const;

export type PacketStatusState = (typeof PACKET_STATUS_STATES)[number];

const STATE_PAIRS: Record<PacketStatusState, readonly [ink: string, soft: string]> = {
  overdue: ["--state-overdue", "--state-overdue-soft"],
  "due-soon": ["--state-due-soon", "--state-due-soon-soft"],
  "on-track": ["--accent", "--accent-soft"],
  submitted: ["--state-complete", "--state-complete-soft"],
  complete: ["--state-complete", "--state-complete-soft"],
  none: ["--state-neutral", "--state-neutral-soft"],
};

/** `:root { color-scheme: light; --name: value; … }` — the first rule of every packet sheet. */
export function packetRootBlock(): string {
  const lines = Object.entries(PACKET_LIGHT_TOKENS).map(
    ([name, value]) => `  ${name}: ${value};`,
  );
  return `:root {\n  color-scheme: light;\n${lines.join("\n")}\n}`;
}

type PacketFontFiles = { readonly [K in keyof typeof FONT_FILES]: string };

/** fonts.css:17 — one latin range for every face. */
const UNICODE_RANGE =
  "U+0000-00FF, U+0131, U+0152-0153, U+02BB-02BC, U+02C6, U+02DA, U+02DC, U+0304, U+0308, U+0329, U+2000-206F, U+20AC, U+2122, U+2191, U+2193, U+2212, U+2215, U+FEFF, U+FFFD";

const FACES: ReadonlyArray<{
  family: string;
  style: "normal" | "italic";
  weight: number;
  file: keyof PacketFontFiles;
}> = [
  { family: "Bricolage Grotesque", style: "normal", weight: 700, file: "displayBold" },
  { family: "Bricolage Grotesque", style: "normal", weight: 800, file: "displayBlack" },
  { family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible", style: "normal", weight: 400, file: "body" },
  { family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible", style: "normal", weight: 700, file: "bodyBold" },
  { family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible", style: "italic", weight: 400, file: "bodyItalic" },
  { family: "iTrack Mono", style: "normal", weight: 400, file: "mono" },
  { family: "iTrack Mono", style: "normal", weight: 500, file: "monoMedium" },
];

/** fonts.css:80-82 verbatim: the metric-matched local() fallbacks, so the swap never moves a line. */
const FALLBACK_FACES = [
  '@font-face { font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Fallback"; src: local("Arial"), local("ArialMT"); size-adjust: 99.69%; ascent-override: 95.30%; descent-override: 29.09%; line-gap-override: 0.00%; }',
  '@font-face { font-family: "Bricolage Grotesque Fallback"; src: local("Arial"), local("ArialMT"); size-adjust: 102.71%; ascent-override: 90.54%; descent-override: 26.29%; line-gap-override: 0.00%; }',
  '@font-face { font-family: "iTrack Mono Fallback"; src: local("Menlo"), local("Menlo-Regular"); size-adjust: 99.66%; ascent-override: 102.85%; descent-override: 27.59%; line-gap-override: 0.00%; }',
];

/** The seven @font-face rules of fonts.css built from the manifest, plus the three fallbacks. */
export function packetFontFaces(files: PacketFontFiles = FONT_FILES): string {
  const faces = FACES.map(
    (face) =>
      `@font-face {\n  font-family: "${face.family}";\n  font-style: ${face.style};\n  font-weight: ${face.weight};\n  font-display: swap;\n  src: url(${files[face.file]}) format("woff2");\n  unicode-range: ${UNICODE_RANGE};\n}`,
  );
  return [...faces, ...FALLBACK_FACES].join("\n");
}

/** The filled control, shared by the packet's toolbar and the error page's actions. */
const BUTTON_RULES = `.btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); font: inherit; font-weight: 700; padding: .625rem .875rem; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; }
.btn:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); }
.btn:focus-visible, a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }`;

const EYEBROW_RULE = `.eyebrow { margin: 0 0 .375rem; color: var(--ink-muted); font-size: var(--text-2xs); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: var(--tracking-eyebrow); text-transform: uppercase; }`;

/**
 * Screen rules. Surfaces: the page is --paper, the sheet --card, the toolbar
 * and the cover's facts --paper-deep / --paper. Type: the display face for
 * h1/h2, the body face everywhere else, the mono face for dates, counts and
 * the SHA-256. Nothing moves (no transition, no animation): a document.
 */
const SCREEN_RULES = `* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { background: var(--paper); }
body { max-width: 56rem; margin: 1.5rem auto; background: var(--card); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: var(--text-sm); line-height: 1.45; }
main { padding: 2.75rem 3rem 3.5rem; }
h1 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: var(--text-3xl); letter-spacing: var(--tracking-display); line-height: 1.08; margin: 0 0 .5rem; }
h2 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: var(--text-xl); letter-spacing: var(--tracking-display); margin: 0 0 .75rem; }
h3 { font-size: var(--text-sm); margin: 0 0 .2rem; }
p { margin: 0 0 .5rem; }
small { display: block; margin-top: .125rem; color: var(--ink-muted); font-size: var(--text-xs); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
${EYEBROW_RULE}
a { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 700; text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.toolbar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: .875rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--paper-deep); padding: .625rem .75rem; }
.toolbar a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; }
${BUTTON_RULES}
.status-pill { --state-ink: var(--state-neutral); --state-soft: var(--state-neutral-soft); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: var(--radius-pill); padding: .25rem .5rem; font-size: var(--text-2xs); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.25; white-space: nowrap; background: var(--state-soft); color: var(--state-ink); }
.pills { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .25rem; }
.cover { padding: 1.25rem 0 1.5rem; }
.cover-line { margin: 0 0 .75rem; color: var(--ink-muted); }
.cover > .status-pill { margin-bottom: 1.25rem; }
.cover dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: .625rem; margin: 0 0 1.25rem; }
.cover dl > div { min-width: 0; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--paper); padding: .75rem; }
.cover dt { color: var(--ink-muted); font-size: var(--text-2xs); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: var(--tracking-eyebrow); text-transform: uppercase; }
.cover dd { margin: 0; color: var(--ink); font-size: var(--text-md); font-weight: 700; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.settled { color: var(--ink-muted); }
section { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 1.75rem 0 .25rem; }
table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: var(--text-sm); }
caption { text-align: left; color: var(--ink-muted); font-size: var(--text-xs); padding-bottom: .5rem; }
th { text-align: left; color: var(--ink-muted); font-size: var(--text-2xs); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: var(--tracking-eyebrow); text-transform: uppercase; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-strong); padding: .5rem .5rem .5rem 0; }
td { vertical-align: top; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding: .625rem .5rem .625rem 0; }
td.num, th.num { text-align: right; }
.mono, td.num { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
td.mono { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.still-needed { margin: .75rem 0 0; padding-left: 1.25rem; color: var(--ink-muted); }
.still-needed li + li { margin-top: .25rem; }
.note, .empty { color: var(--ink-muted); }
.empty { border: 1px dashed var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: .875rem 1rem; }
.attestation-cards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: .75rem; }
.attestation-card { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: 1rem; }
.attestation-card p { margin: 0 0 .375rem; color: var(--ink-muted); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.attestation-card b { color: var(--ink); }
#notes h3 { margin-top: 1.25rem; }
.notice { margin: 1.5rem 0 0; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-left: 4px solid var(--state-due-soon); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--paper-deep); padding: .875rem 1rem; color: var(--ink); }
footer { margin-top: 1.875rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding-top: 1rem; color: var(--ink-muted); font-size: var(--text-xs); }
@media (max-width: 680px) {
  body { margin: 0; }
  main { padding: 1.75rem 1.25rem; }
  .cover dl, .attestation-cards { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .toolbar { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; }
}`;

/**
 * Print rules. The @page line is byte-identical to the pin in
 * tests/rendered-html.test.mjs; 11pt is a print length. Pills and the notice
 * keep their fills on paper; the toolbar is a screen control.
 */
const PRINT_RULES = `@media print {
  @page { size: Letter; margin: 14mm; }
  html, body { background: var(--card); }
  body { max-width: none; margin: 0; font-size: 11pt; }
  main { padding: 0; }
  .toolbar { display: none; }
  a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
  h2 { break-after: avoid; }
  tr, .cover, .notice, .attestation-card { break-inside: avoid; }
  thead { display: table-header-group; }
  .status-pill, .notice { print-color-adjust: exact; -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact; }
  p, li { orphans: 3; widows: 3; }
}`;

/** The packet's whole inline stylesheet: root, faces, screen rules, one pill rule per state, print rules. */
export function packetStylesheet(): string {
  const pills = PACKET_STATUS_STATES.map((state) => {
    const [ink, soft] = STATE_PAIRS[state];
    return `.status-pill[data-state="${state}"] { --state-ink: var(${ink}); --state-soft: var(${soft}); }`;
  });
  return [packetRootBlock(), packetFontFaces(), SCREEN_RULES, ...pills, PRINT_RULES].join("\n");
}

/** The error page's stylesheet: the same root and faces, a centred card, the same button. */
export function packetErrorStylesheet(): string {
  const rules = `* { box-sizing: border-box; }
body { display: grid; min-height: 100vh; margin: 0; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: var(--text-md); line-height: 1.55; place-items: center; padding: 1.5rem; }
main { width: min(100%, 32rem); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--card); padding: 2rem; }
${EYEBROW_RULE}
h1 { margin: .75rem 0 .5rem; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: var(--text-2xl); letter-spacing: var(--tracking-display); line-height: 1.1; }
p { margin: 0; color: var(--ink-muted); }
nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .625rem; margin-top: 1.5rem; }
${BUTTON_RULES}
.btn-secondary { border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); background: var(--card); color: var(--accent); }
.btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--paper-deep); }`;
  return [packetRootBlock(), packetFontFaces(), rules].join("\n");
}
```

```ts
/**
 * The renewal packet: one credential's cycle on paper (spec §6 Packet;
 * app-ux-19, app-ux-11, critic-01, architecture-07). A complete HTML
 * document rendered by app/api/export/packet/route.ts — self-contained (the
 * inline stylesheet comes from ./packetTheme.js; the one inline script is
 * hashed into the route's CSP), light only, and free of internal
 * identifiers: every row is named by what a board can read — a requirement's
 * name, an activity's title and date, a file's name, size, type and SHA-256 —
 * never by a database id, and no data-* attribute but a pill's state reaches
 * the markup. Instants (the generation time, an evidence file's upload time,
 * a task's completion, the official-record attestation) print in the
 * holder's stored reminder zone; calendar days (cycle dates, completion and
 * due dates, the source's dates, an acceptance date) are pinned at noon UTC
 * so they never shift. Copy follows copy-table section H: the state word is
 * STATE_LABELS's, server vocabulary (attestation kinds, task kinds, activity
 * formats, review status) goes through the tables below, and an unknown key
 * prints a neutral word, never the raw string.
 *
 * The three formatters here are the worker-side, zone-explicit variants —
 * app/lib/format.ts's client formatDate parses in the browser's zone and its
 * compactNumber rounds to one place — so they stay deliberately separate.
 *
 * Pure: no React, DOM or D1; imports carry the `.js` suffix
 * `npm run build:lib-test` needs (tests/renewal-packet.test.mjs runs against
 * the emitted ESM).
 */
import { STATE_LABELS, type InstrumentState } from "./instruments.js";
import { packetErrorStylesheet, packetStylesheet } from "./packetTheme.js";

export type RenewalPacketRequirement = {
  name: string;
  requiredUnits: number;
  earnedUnits: number;
  rawEarned: number;
  excessUnits: number;
  remainingUnits: number | null;
  progressPercent: number | null;
  kind: "minimum" | "maximum" | "informational";
  relation: "independent" | "nested" | "overlapping";
  applicabilityStatus: "applies" | "not_applicable" | "needs_confirmation";
  isActive: boolean;
  conditionNote: string | null;
};

export type RenewalPacketTask = {
  title: string;
  kind: string;
  status: string;
  dueDate: string | null;
  completedAt: string | null;
  isPersonal: boolean;
};

export type RenewalPacketActivity = {
  title: string;
  provider: string;
  format: string | null;
  completionDate: string;
  totalUnits: number;
  allocatedUnits: number;
  categoryNames: string[];
  classificationStatus: "classified" | "needs_classification";
  evidenceStatus: string;
  evidenceReference: string | null;
  evidenceDeletionPendingCount: number;
};

export type RenewalPacketEvidence = {
  activityTitle: string;
  fileName: string;
  contentType: string;
  sizeBytes: number;
  sha256: string;
  createdAt: string;
};

export type RenewalPacketData = {
  owner: {
    displayName: string;
    email: string;
  };
  credential: {
    credentialName: string;
    profession: string;
    jurisdiction: string;
    issuer: string;
    cycleStart: string;
    deadline: string;
    status: string;
    /** stateOf(credential, now) — computed by the route, which alone holds the credential's id. */
    state: InstrumentState;
    lifecycleKind: "renewal" | "compliance_period" | "automatic_renewal";
    totalRequired: number;
    totalLoggedUnits: number;
    totalExcessUnits: number;
    totalEarned: number;
    totalRemaining: number;
    unclassifiedUnits: number;
    unitLabel: string;
    submittedAt: string | null;
    confirmationNumber: string | null;
    submissionProof: string | null;
    submissionAttestationKind: string | null;
    acceptedAt: string | null;
    acceptanceReference: string | null;
    officialRecordAttestedAt: string | null;
  };
  source: {
    title: string | null;
    url: string | null;
    effectiveDate: string | null;
    lastVerifiedAt: string | null;
    reviewStatus: string;
  };
  requirements: RenewalPacketRequirement[];
  tasks: RenewalPacketTask[];
  activities: RenewalPacketActivity[];
  evidence: RenewalPacketEvidence[];
  /** An ISO instant. */
  generatedAt: string;
  /** The holder's stored reminder zone (an IANA name; "UTC" when never chosen). */
  generatedZone: string;
};

/**
 * Waits for the faces before printing so the print dialog renders the
 * display face rather than its fallback. The route hashes this string into
 * the packet's script-src on every request, so editing it needs no
 * bookkeeping.
 */
export const RENEWAL_PACKET_PRINT_SCRIPT =
  'document.getElementById("print-packet")?.addEventListener("click",()=>{(document.fonts?document.fonts.ready:Promise.resolve()).then(()=>window.print());});';

/* -------------------------------------------------------------- copy tables */

/** copy-table H: renewal_submissions.attestation_kind → the printed words. */
const ATTESTATION_LABELS: ReadonlyMap<string, string> = new Map([
  ["isc2_requirements_satisfied", "ISC2 requirements satisfied"],
  ["compliance_period_complete", "Compliance period complete"],
  ["nremt_requirements_satisfied", "NREMT requirements satisfied"],
  [
    "nremt_late_reinstatement_requirements_satisfied",
    "NREMT late-reinstatement requirements satisfied",
  ],
  ["crcc_requirements_satisfied", "CRCC requirements satisfied"],
  ["owner_attested", "Attested by the licensee"],
]);

/** copy-table H: checklist_tasks.kind → the printed word; a personal task is "Your task". */
const TASK_KIND_LABELS: ReadonlyMap<string, string> = new Map([
  ["review", "Review"],
  ["progress", "Progress"],
  ["submission", "Submission"],
  ["personal", "Your task"],
]);

/** Task 4's activities.format → the Log sheet's option label (copy-table E). */
const FORMAT_LABELS: ReadonlyMap<string, string> = new Map([
  ["live_course", "Live course"],
  ["live_webinar", "Live webinar"],
  ["self_study", "On-demand or self-study"],
  ["conference", "Conference"],
  ["other", "Other"],
]);

function attestationLabel(kind: string | null): string {
  if (!kind) return "Not recorded";
  return ATTESTATION_LABELS.get(kind) ?? "Recorded";
}

function taskKindLabel(task: RenewalPacketTask): string {
  if (task.isPersonal) return "Your task";
  return TASK_KIND_LABELS.get(task.kind) ?? "Task";
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers */

function escapeHtml(value: unknown): string {
  return String(value ?? "")
    .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
    .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
    .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
    .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
    .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
}

function compactNumber(value: number): string {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", {
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  }).format(Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0);
}

/** "1 file" / "3 files" — the copy table's "one …" / "{n} …s" rule. */
function count(n: number, singular: string, plural: string): string {
  return `${compactNumber(n)} ${n === 1 ? singular : plural}`;
}

const CALENDAR_DATE = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;
/** SQLite's CURRENT_TIMESTAMP — UTC, no zone designator. */
const SQLITE_TIMESTAMP = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}$/;

/**
 * A zone Intl accepts, else UTC. The route already guards the stored zone
 * with isValidTimeZone; this keeps the renderer total for any caller.
 */
function usableZone(zone: string): string {
  try {
    new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", { timeZone: zone });
    return zone;
  } catch {
    return "UTC";
  }
}

/** A calendar day (YYYY-MM-DD, or a value whose first ten characters are one): the same day everywhere, so it is pinned at noon UTC. */
function formatDate(value: string | null): string {
  if (!value) return "Not recorded";
  const parsed = new Date(`${value.slice(0, 10)}T12:00:00.000Z`);
  if (Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())) return value;
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
    month: "short",
    day: "numeric",
    year: "numeric",
    timeZone: "UTC",
  }).format(parsed);
}

/** An ISO instant, or SQLite's "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" (UTC). */
function parseInstant(value: string): Date | null {
  const text = value.trim();
  const iso = SQLITE_TIMESTAMP.test(text) ? `${text.replace(" ", "T")}Z` : text;
  const parsed = new Date(iso);
  return Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime()) ? null : parsed;
}

/** The calendar day an instant fell on where the holder stands; a bare calendar day passes through formatDate. */
function formatInstantDate(value: string | null, zone: string): string {
  if (!value) return "Not recorded";
  if (CALENDAR_DATE.test(value.trim())) return formatDate(value);
  const parsed = parseInstant(value);
  if (!parsed) return value;
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
    month: "short",
    day: "numeric",
    year: "numeric",
    timeZone: usableZone(zone),
  }).format(parsed);
}

/** Date, time and zone abbreviation where the holder stands: "Sep 16, 2026, 2:14 PM EDT". */
function formatTimestamp(value: string, zone: string): string {
  const parsed = parseInstant(value);
  if (!parsed) return value;
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
    month: "short",
    day: "numeric",
    year: "numeric",
    hour: "numeric",
    minute: "2-digit",
    timeZoneName: "short",
    timeZone: usableZone(zone),
  })
    .format(parsed)
    // ICU 72+ sets a narrow no-break space before AM/PM; the copy table's form
    // is a plain space.
    .replace(/[\u202f\u00a0]/g, " ");
}

function formatFileSize(bytes: number): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(bytes) || bytes <= 0) return "0 KB";
  if (bytes < 1_048_576) {
    return `${Math.max(1, Math.round(bytes / 1024))} KB`;
  }
  return `${(bytes / 1_048_576).toFixed(1)} MB`;
}

/** Only an https source is linked; anything else prints as no link. */
function safeSourceUrl(value: string | null): string | null {
  if (!value) return null;
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(value);
    return parsed.protocol === "https:" ? parsed.href : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/** The StatusPill instrument's contract: the class, the state, the word. */
function pill(state: InstrumentState, label: string): string {
  return `<span class="status-pill" data-state="${state}">${escapeHtml(label)}</span>`;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- readiness */

function requirementStatus(requirement: RenewalPacketRequirement): {
  label: string;
  state: InstrumentState;
} {
  if (requirement.applicabilityStatus === "needs_confirmation") {
    return { label: "Applies? Not decided", state: "due-soon" };
  }
  if (
    !requirement.isActive ||
    requirement.applicabilityStatus === "not_applicable"
  ) {
    return { label: "Not applicable", state: "none" };
  }
  if (requirement.kind === "informational") {
    return { label: "Condition", state: "none" };
  }
  if (requirement.kind === "maximum") {
    return requirement.excessUnits > 0
      ? {
          label: `${compactNumber(requirement.excessUnits)} over cap`,
          state: "overdue",
        }
      : { label: "Within cap", state: "complete" };
  }
  const remaining = requirement.remainingUnits ?? 0;
  if (remaining <= 0) return { label: "Met", state: "complete" };
  return { label: `${compactNumber(remaining)} still needed`, state: "due-soon" };
}

/** The cover's "Still needed" list (copy-table H, readinessIssues). */
function readinessIssues(data: RenewalPacketData): string[] {
  const issues: string[] = [];
  const { credential } = data;
  const unit = credential.unitLabel;
  if (credential.totalRemaining > 0) {
    issues.push(
      `${compactNumber(credential.totalRemaining)} ${unit} still needed toward the total.`,
    );
  }
  if (credential.unclassifiedUnits > 0) {
    issues.push(
      `${compactNumber(credential.unclassifiedUnits)} ${unit} are not in a category yet, so they do not count yet.`,
    );
  }
  const short = data.requirements.filter(
    (requirement) =>
      requirement.isActive &&
      requirement.applicabilityStatus === "applies" &&
      requirement.kind === "minimum" &&
      (requirement.remainingUnits ?? 0) > 0,
  ).length;
  if (short) {
    issues.push(`${count(short, "requirement", "requirements")} still short.`);
  }
  const undecided = data.requirements.filter(
    (requirement) => requirement.applicabilityStatus === "needs_confirmation",
  ).length;
  if (undecided) {
    issues.push(
      `${count(undecided, "requirement needs", "requirements need")} a yes or no on whether it applies.`,
    );
  }
  const open = data.tasks.filter((task) => task.status !== "completed").length;
  if (open) {
    issues.push(`${count(open, "checklist task", "checklist tasks")} still open.`);
  }
  const noEvidence = data.activities.filter(
    (activity) => activity.evidenceStatus === "missing",
  ).length;
  if (noEvidence) {
    issues.push(`${count(noEvidence, "activity", "activities")} without evidence.`);
  }
  const removing = data.activities.filter(
    (activity) => activity.evidenceDeletionPendingCount > 0,
  ).length;
  if (removing) {
    issues.push(
      `${count(removing, "activity", "activities")} with evidence being removed.`,
    );
  }
  return issues;
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------- sections */

function renderCover(data: RenewalPacketData, issues: string[]): string {
  const { credential, owner } = data;
  const done = data.tasks.filter((task) => task.status === "completed").length;
  // A completed compliance period is "Complete", never "Renewed".
  const stateWord =
    credential.lifecycleKind === "compliance_period" &&
    credential.state === "complete"
      ? "Complete"
      : STATE_LABELS[credential.state];
  const excess =
    credential.totalExcessUnits > 0
      ? `<small>${escapeHtml(compactNumber(credential.totalLoggedUnits))} logged · ${escapeHtml(
          compactNumber(credential.totalExcessUnits),
        )} over a category cap</small>`
      : "";
  const stillNeeded = issues.length
    ? `<ul class="still-needed">${issues
        .map((issue) => `<li>${escapeHtml(issue)}</li>`)
        .join("")}</ul>`
    : '<p class="settled">Nothing outstanding in this record.</p>';
  return `<header class="cover" id="cover">
      <p class="eyebrow">Renewal packet</p>
      <h1>${escapeHtml(credential.credentialName)}</h1>
      <p class="cover-line">${escapeHtml(credential.profession)} · ${escapeHtml(
        credential.jurisdiction,
      )} · ${escapeHtml(credential.issuer)}</p>
      ${pill(credential.state, stateWord)}
      <dl>
        <div><dt>Prepared for</dt><dd>${escapeHtml(owner.displayName)} · ${escapeHtml(
          owner.email,
        )}</dd></div>
        <div><dt>Cycle</dt><dd class="mono">${escapeHtml(
          formatDate(credential.cycleStart),
        )} – ${escapeHtml(formatDate(credential.deadline))}</dd></div>
        <div><dt>Credits that count</dt><dd class="mono">${escapeHtml(
          compactNumber(credential.totalEarned),
        )} / ${escapeHtml(compactNumber(credential.totalRequired))} ${escapeHtml(
          credential.unitLabel,
        )}${excess}</dd></div>
        <div><dt>Checklist</dt><dd class="mono">${done} / ${data.tasks.length} done</dd></div>
        <div><dt>Evidence</dt><dd>${escapeHtml(
          count(data.evidence.length, "file", "files"),
        )}</dd></div>
      </dl>
      <p class="eyebrow">Still needed</p>
      ${stillNeeded}
    </header>`;
}

function renderRequirements(data: RenewalPacketData): string {
  if (!data.requirements.length) {
    return '<p class="empty">This credential has one overall total and no categories.</p>';
  }
  const rows = data.requirements
    .map((requirement) => {
      const status = requirementStatus(requirement);
      const notes: string[] = [];
      if (requirement.conditionNote) notes.push(requirement.conditionNote);
      if (requirement.relation === "nested") {
        notes.push("Counts within the overall total");
      }
      if (requirement.relation === "overlapping") {
        notes.push("May overlap another category");
      }
      const counted =
        requirement.kind === "informational"
          ? "—"
          : compactNumber(requirement.earnedUnits);
      const required =
        requirement.kind === "informational"
          ? "Condition"
          : requirement.kind === "maximum"
            ? `${compactNumber(requirement.requiredUnits)} cap`
            : compactNumber(requirement.requiredUnits);
      return `<tr>
          <td>${escapeHtml(requirement.name)}${notes
            .map((note) => `<small>${escapeHtml(note)}</small>`)
            .join("")}</td>
          <td class="num">${escapeHtml(counted)}</td>
          <td class="num">${escapeHtml(required)}</td>
          <td>${pill(status.state, status.label)}</td>
        </tr>`;
    })
    .join("\n");
  const capNote =
    data.credential.totalExcessUnits > 0
      ? '\n      <p class="note">The total applies each category’s cap. Rows show the category’s own count.</p>'
      : "";
  return `<table>
        <caption>Counted against required, per category.</caption>
        <thead><tr><th scope="col">Requirement</th><th scope="col" class="num">Counted</th><th scope="col" class="num">Required</th><th scope="col">Status</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>${rows}</tbody>
      </table>${capNote}`;
}

function renderActivities(data: RenewalPacketData): string {
  if (!data.activities.length) {
    return '<p class="empty">No activities are logged to this cycle yet.</p>';
  }
  const unit = data.credential.unitLabel;
  // Newest first; the workspace order is by allocation, not by date.
  const sorted = [...data.activities].sort(
    (a, b) =>
      b.completionDate.localeCompare(a.completionDate) ||
      a.title.localeCompare(b.title),
  );
  const rows = sorted
    .map((activity) => {
      const details: string[] = [activity.provider || "—"];
      const format = activity.format ? FORMAT_LABELS.get(activity.format) : undefined;
      if (format) details.push(format);
      if (activity.totalUnits !== activity.allocatedUnits) {
        details.push(
          `${compactNumber(activity.allocatedUnits)} of ${compactNumber(
            activity.totalUnits,
          )} ${unit} applied to this credential`,
        );
      }
      const pills: string[] = [];
      if (activity.evidenceStatus === "attached") {
        pills.push(pill("complete", "Evidence attached"));
      } else if (activity.evidenceStatus === "not_required") {
        pills.push(pill("none", "No evidence needed"));
      } else {
        pills.push(pill("due-soon", "No evidence"));
      }
      if (activity.evidenceDeletionPendingCount > 0) {
        pills.push(pill("due-soon", "Being removed"));
      }
      if (activity.classificationStatus !== "classified") {
        pills.push(pill("due-soon", "Not yet categorized"));
      }
      const reference = activity.evidenceReference
        ? `<small>Reference: ${escapeHtml(activity.evidenceReference)}</small>`
        : "";
      return `<tr>
          <td class="mono">${escapeHtml(formatDate(activity.completionDate))}</td>
          <td>${escapeHtml(activity.title)}${details
            .map((detail) => `<small>${escapeHtml(detail)}</small>`)
            .join("")}</td>
          <td class="num">${escapeHtml(compactNumber(activity.allocatedUnits))}</td>
          <td>${escapeHtml(
            activity.categoryNames.length
              ? activity.categoryNames.join(" · ")
              : "None",
          )}</td>
          <td><span class="pills">${pills.join(" ")}</span>${reference}</td>
        </tr>`;
    })
    .join("\n");
  return `<table>
        <caption>Logged to this cycle, newest first.</caption>
        <thead><tr><th scope="col">Date</th><th scope="col">Activity</th><th scope="col" class="num">Credits (${escapeHtml(
          unit,
        )})</th><th scope="col">Categories</th><th scope="col">Evidence</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>${rows}</tbody>
      </table>`;
}

function renderEvidence(data: RenewalPacketData): string {
  const lede =
    "<p>Files are listed, not embedded. Download them from the activity in iTrack.</p>";
  if (!data.evidence.length) {
    return `${lede}\n      <p class="empty">No files are attached to this cycle.</p>`;
  }
  const rows = data.evidence
    .map(
      (file) => `<tr>
          <td>${escapeHtml(file.fileName)}</td>
          <td>${escapeHtml(file.activityTitle)}</td>
          <td class="mono">${escapeHtml(
            formatInstantDate(file.createdAt, data.generatedZone),
          )}</td>
          <td class="num">${escapeHtml(formatFileSize(file.sizeBytes))}</td>
          <td class="mono">${escapeHtml(file.contentType)}</td>
          <td class="mono">SHA-256 ${escapeHtml(file.sha256)}</td>
        </tr>`,
    )
    .join("\n");
  return `${lede}
      <table>
        <thead><tr><th scope="col">File</th><th scope="col">For</th><th scope="col">Added</th><th scope="col" class="num">Size</th><th scope="col">Type</th><th scope="col">SHA-256</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>${rows}</tbody>
      </table>`;
}

function renderAttestation(data: RenewalPacketData): string {
  const { credential } = data;
  const compliance = credential.lifecycleKind === "compliance_period";
  const automatic = credential.lifecycleKind === "automatic_renewal";
  const checkpointTitle = compliance
    ? "Compliance checkpoint"
    : automatic
      ? "Dashboard checkpoint"
      : "Submission";
  const completionTitle = compliance
    ? "Period complete"
    : automatic
      ? "Renewal confirmed"
      : "Acceptance";
  const zone = data.generatedZone;
  const line = (label: string, value: string) =>
    `<p><b>${label}:</b> ${escapeHtml(value)}</p>`;
  return `<div class="attestation-cards">
        <article class="attestation-card">
          <h3>${escapeHtml(checkpointTitle)}</h3>
          ${line("Date", formatInstantDate(credential.submittedAt, zone))}
          ${line("Confirmation number", credential.confirmationNumber || "Not recorded")}
          ${line("Reference", credential.submissionProof || "Not recorded")}
          ${line("Attested", attestationLabel(credential.submissionAttestationKind))}
        </article>
        <article class="attestation-card">
          <h3>${escapeHtml(completionTitle)}</h3>
          ${line("Date", formatDate(credential.acceptedAt))}
          ${line("Reference", credential.acceptanceReference || "Not recorded")}
          ${line(
            "Official record confirmed",
            formatInstantDate(credential.officialRecordAttestedAt, zone),
          )}
        </article>
      </div>`;
}

function renderNotes(data: RenewalPacketData): string {
  const zone = data.generatedZone;
  const checklist = data.tasks.length
    ? `<table>
        <thead><tr><th scope="col">Task</th><th scope="col">Kind</th><th scope="col">Due</th><th scope="col">Done</th><th scope="col">Status</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>${data.tasks
          .map((task) => {
            const done = task.status === "completed";
            return `<tr>
          <td>${escapeHtml(task.title)}</td>
          <td>${escapeHtml(taskKindLabel(task))}</td>
          <td class="mono">${escapeHtml(task.dueDate ? formatDate(task.dueDate) : "—")}</td>
          <td class="mono">${escapeHtml(
            done ? formatInstantDate(task.completedAt, zone) : "—",
          )}</td>
          <td>${pill(done ? "complete" : "due-soon", done ? "Done" : "Open")}</td>
        </tr>`;
          })
          .join("\n")}</tbody>
      </table>`
    : '<p class="empty">No checklist for this cycle.</p>';
  const sourceUrl = safeSourceUrl(data.source.url);
  const sourceTitle = data.source.title || "Your own plan";
  const review =
    data.source.reviewStatus === "needs_review"
      ? "Review pending"
      : `Last reviewed ${formatDate(data.source.lastVerifiedAt)}`;
  const sourceDates = data.source.title
    ? `\n      <p>Effective ${escapeHtml(formatDate(data.source.effectiveDate))} · ${escapeHtml(review)}</p>`
    : "";
  const sourceLink = sourceUrl
    ? `<p><a href="${escapeHtml(sourceUrl)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Official source</a></p>`
    : "<p>No source link on this plan.</p>";
  return `<h3>Checklist</h3>
      ${checklist}
      <h3>Rules source</h3>
      <p><b>${escapeHtml(sourceTitle)}</b></p>${sourceDates}
      ${sourceLink}
      <p class="notice"><b>Check before you submit.</b> This packet is your iTrack record. The board’s current rules, portal and records control.</p>`;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- documents */

/** `renewal-packet-<slug>-<deadline>.html`: a header-safe stem (letters, digits, hyphens) and the deadline when it is a calendar day. */
export function renewalPacketFilename(
  credentialName: string,
  deadline: string,
): string {
  const safeName =
    credentialName
      .normalize("NFKD")
      .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
      .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "")
      .slice(0, 72) || "credential";
  const safeDeadline = CALENDAR_DATE.test(deadline) ? deadline : "cycle";
  return `renewal-packet-${safeName}-${safeDeadline}.html`;
}

export function renderRenewalPacket(data: RenewalPacketData): string {
  const issues = readinessIssues(data);
  const title = `${data.credential.credentialName} · Renewal packet`;
  // <meta name="itrack-packet-version"> is informational, not a contract
  // (ios-coupling-11); Wave 4 renamed it away from the old product name.
  return `<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <meta name="itrack-packet-version" content="2">
  <title>${escapeHtml(title)}</title>
  <style>${packetStylesheet()}</style>
</head>
<body>
  <main>
    <nav class="toolbar" aria-label="Packet actions">
      <a href="/">Back to iTrack</a>
      <button id="print-packet" type="button" class="btn">Print or save as PDF</button>
    </nav>
    ${renderCover(data, issues)}
    <section id="requirements" aria-labelledby="requirements-title">
      <h2 id="requirements-title">Requirements</h2>
      ${renderRequirements(data)}
    </section>
    <section id="activities" aria-labelledby="activities-title">
      <h2 id="activities-title">Activities</h2>
      ${renderActivities(data)}
    </section>
    <section id="evidence" aria-labelledby="evidence-title">
      <h2 id="evidence-title">Evidence</h2>
      ${renderEvidence(data)}
    </section>
    <section id="attestation" aria-labelledby="attestation-title">
      <h2 id="attestation-title">Submission and acceptance</h2>
      ${renderAttestation(data)}
    </section>
    <section id="notes" aria-labelledby="notes-title">
      <h2 id="notes-title">Notes</h2>
      ${renderNotes(data)}
    </section>
    <footer>Generated ${escapeHtml(
      formatTimestamp(data.generatedAt, data.generatedZone),
    )} · iTrack · itrackceu.com</footer>
  </main>
  <script>${RENEWAL_PACKET_PRINT_SCRIPT}</script>
</body>
</html>`;
}

export function renderRenewalPacketError(title: string, message: string): string {
  return `<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <meta name="robots" content="noindex, noarchive">
  <title>${escapeHtml(title)} · iTrack</title>
  <style>${packetErrorStylesheet()}</style>
</head>
<body>
  <main>
    <p class="eyebrow">iTrack</p>
    <h1>${escapeHtml(title)}</h1>
    <p>${escapeHtml(message)}</p>
    <nav aria-label="Recovery actions">
      <a class="btn" href="">Try again</a>
      <a class="btn btn-secondary" href="/">Back to iTrack</a>
    </nav>
  </main>
</body>
</html>`;
}
```

```ts
import { getD1 } from "@/db";
import { resolveRequestIdentity } from "@/db/identity";
import { ensureUser, initializeDatabase } from "@/db/runtime";
import { isValidTimeZone, UTC_FALLBACK_ZONE } from "@/app/lib/dates";
import { stateOf } from "@/app/lib/instruments";
import {
  type RenewalPacketData,
  RENEWAL_PACKET_PRINT_SCRIPT,
  renderRenewalPacket,
  renderRenewalPacketError,
  renewalPacketFilename,
} from "@/app/lib/renewalPacket";
import { getWorkspace } from "@/app/api/workspace/route";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

// The evidence inventory the packet lists: what a board can read. The ids
// stay in the JOIN below and never reach the row (app-ux-19).
type EvidenceInventoryRow = {
  activityTitle: string;
  fileName: string;
  contentType: string;
  sizeBytes: number;
  sha256: string;
  createdAt: string;
};

// The packet is a self-contained document: an inline stylesheet generated
// from app/lib/packetTheme.ts, the three self-hosted faces (a font-src of
// self: /fonts/ is public and immutable on the gateway), and one inline
// script admitted by its hash. Nothing else may load.
const PACKET_CSP_HEAD =
  "default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'";
const PACKET_CSP_TAIL =
  "base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; object-src 'none'";

// copy-table H: the page title per status. The 404 title is pinned by
// tests/isolation.test.mjs and tests/e2e/packet.spec.ts.
function packetErrorTitle(status: number) {
  if (status === 401) return "Sign in to continue";
  if (status === 404) return "Packet unavailable";
  if (status >= 500) return "Packet unavailable right now";
  return "Open the packet from a credential";
}

function packetError(
  request: Request,
  error: string,
  code: string,
  status: number,
) {
  const commonHeaders = {
    "Cache-Control": "no-store",
    "Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy": "same-origin",
    "X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff",
    "X-Robots-Tag": "noindex, noarchive",
  };
  if (request.headers.get("accept")?.includes("application/json")) {
    return Response.json(
      { error, code },
      {
        status,
        headers: commonHeaders,
      },
    );
  }
  const headers = new Headers({
    ...commonHeaders,
    "Content-Security-Policy": `${PACKET_CSP_HEAD}; ${PACKET_CSP_TAIL}`,
    "Content-Type": "text/html; charset=utf-8",
    "Referrer-Policy": "no-referrer",
    "X-Frame-Options": "DENY",
  });
  return new Response(renderRenewalPacketError(packetErrorTitle(status), error), {
    status,
    headers,
  });
}

// Exactly one credentialId and no other key: the holder's zone never rides
// the URL (it comes from the stored reminder preference below).
function credentialIdFromRequest(request: Request) {
  const url = new URL(request.url);
  const credentialIds = url.searchParams.getAll("credentialId");
  if (
    credentialIds.length !== 1 ||
    [...url.searchParams.keys()].some((key) => key !== "credentialId")
  ) {
    return null;
  }
  const credentialId = credentialIds[0];
  return /^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,160}$/.test(credentialId)
    ? credentialId
    : null;
}

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  try {
    const identity = await resolveRequestIdentity(request);
    if (!identity) {
      return packetError(
        request,
        "Sign in to open this renewal packet.",
        "authentication_required",
        401,
      );
    }

    const credentialId = credentialIdFromRequest(request);
    if (!credentialId) {
      return packetError(
        request,
        "This link is missing a credential. Open the packet from the credential in iTrack.",
        "invalid_credential_id",
        400,
      );
    }

    const database = getD1();
    await initializeDatabase(database);
    await ensureUser(database, identity);

    const workspace = await getWorkspace(database, identity);
    // An archived credential is hidden from Home and Credentials, not from
    // its own paper trail: the packet keeps opening (spec §4, app-ux-03).
    const credential = [
      ...workspace.credentials,
      ...workspace.archivedCredentials,
    ].find((candidate) => candidate.id === credentialId);
    if (!credential) {
      return packetError(
        request,
        "That credential is not in your account. Open the packet again from Credentials.",
        "credential_not_found",
        404,
      );
    }

    // The holder's zone (critic-01): the stored reminder zone, "UTC" until the
    // account chooses one; an invalid stored value falls back the same way
    // app/api/export/route.ts does for the CSV filename.
    const zone = isValidTimeZone(workspace.reminderPreferences.timeZone)
      ? workspace.reminderPreferences.timeZone
      : UTC_FALLBACK_ZONE;

    const activities = workspace.activities.flatMap((activity) => {
      const allocation = activity.allocations.find(
        (candidate) => candidate.credentialId === credential.id,
      );
      if (!allocation) return [];
      return [
        {
          title: activity.title,
          provider: activity.provider,
          format: activity.format ?? null,
          completionDate: activity.completionDate,
          totalUnits: activity.totalUnits,
          allocatedUnits: allocation.allocatedUnits,
          categoryNames: allocation.categoryNames,
          classificationStatus: allocation.classificationStatus,
          evidenceStatus: activity.evidenceStatus,
          evidenceReference: activity.evidenceReference,
          evidenceDeletionPendingCount:
            activity.evidenceDeletionPendingCount,
        },
      ];
    });

    const evidenceResult = await database
      .prepare(
        `SELECT
          activity.title AS activityTitle,
          evidence.original_filename AS fileName,
          evidence.content_type AS contentType,
          evidence.size_bytes AS sizeBytes,
          evidence.sha256,
          evidence.created_at AS createdAt
        FROM evidence_files evidence
        JOIN activities activity
          ON activity.id = evidence.activity_id
          AND activity.user_id = evidence.user_id
        JOIN activity_allocations allocation
          ON allocation.activity_id = activity.id
        JOIN credentials credential
          ON credential.id = allocation.credential_id
          AND credential.user_id = evidence.user_id
        WHERE evidence.user_id = ?
          AND credential.id = ?
          AND evidence.status = 'ready'
          AND activity.archived_at IS NULL
        ORDER BY activity.completion_date DESC, evidence.created_at DESC`,
      )
      .bind(identity.userId, credential.id)
      .all<EvidenceInventoryRow>();

    const packet: RenewalPacketData = {
      owner: {
        displayName: identity.displayName,
        email: identity.email,
      },
      credential: {
        credentialName: credential.credentialName,
        profession: credential.profession,
        jurisdiction: credential.jurisdiction,
        issuer: credential.issuer,
        cycleStart: credential.cycleStart,
        deadline: credential.deadline,
        status: credential.status,
        // The only place the credential's id meets the packet: the state
        // word is computed here and the renderer never sees the id.
        state: stateOf(
          {
            id: credential.id,
            status: credential.status,
            deadline: credential.deadline,
            cycleStart: credential.cycleStart,
            acceptedAt: credential.acceptedAt ?? null,
          },
          Date.now(),
        ),
        lifecycleKind: credential.lifecycleKind,
        totalRequired: credential.totalRequired,
        totalLoggedUnits: credential.totalLoggedUnits,
        totalExcessUnits: credential.totalExcessUnits,
        totalEarned: credential.totalEarned,
        totalRemaining: credential.totalRemaining,
        unclassifiedUnits: credential.unclassifiedUnits,
        unitLabel: credential.unitLabel,
        submittedAt: credential.submittedAt,
        confirmationNumber: credential.confirmationNumber,
        submissionProof: credential.submissionProof,
        submissionAttestationKind: credential.submissionAttestationKind,
        acceptedAt: credential.acceptedAt,
        acceptanceReference: credential.acceptanceReference,
        officialRecordAttestedAt: credential.officialRecordAttestedAt,
      },
      source: {
        title: credential.sourceTitle,
        url: credential.sourceUrl,
        effectiveDate: credential.ruleEffectiveDate,
        lastVerifiedAt: credential.ruleLastVerifiedAt,
        reviewStatus: credential.ruleReviewStatus ?? "custom",
      },
      requirements: credential.requirements.map((requirement) => ({
        name: requirement.name,
        requiredUnits: requirement.requiredUnits,
        earnedUnits: requirement.earnedUnits,
        rawEarned: requirement.rawEarned,
        excessUnits: requirement.excessUnits,
        remainingUnits: requirement.remainingUnits,
        progressPercent: requirement.progressPercent,
        kind: requirement.kind,
        relation: requirement.relation,
        applicabilityStatus: requirement.applicabilityStatus,
        isActive: requirement.isActive,
        conditionNote: requirement.conditionNote,
      })),
      tasks: credential.tasks.map((task) => ({
        title: task.title,
        kind: task.kind,
        status: task.status,
        dueDate: task.dueDate,
        completedAt: task.completedAt,
        isPersonal: task.isPersonal,
      })),
      activities,
      evidence: evidenceResult.results.map((file) => ({
        ...file,
        sizeBytes: Number(file.sizeBytes),
      })),
      generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      generatedZone: zone,
    };

    const printScriptDigest = await crypto.subtle.digest(
      "SHA-256",
      new TextEncoder().encode(RENEWAL_PACKET_PRINT_SCRIPT),
    );
    const printScriptHash = btoa(
      String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(printScriptDigest)),
    );
    const headers = new Headers({
      "Cache-Control": "no-store",
      "Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy": "same-origin",
      "Content-Disposition": `inline; filename="${renewalPacketFilename(
        credential.credentialName,
        credential.deadline,
      )}"`,
      "Content-Security-Policy": `${PACKET_CSP_HEAD}; script-src 'sha256-${printScriptHash}'; ${PACKET_CSP_TAIL}`,
      "Content-Type": "text/html; charset=utf-8",
      "Referrer-Policy": "no-referrer",
      "X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff",
      "X-Frame-Options": "DENY",
      "X-Robots-Tag": "noindex, noarchive",
    });
    return new Response(renderRenewalPacket(packet), { headers });
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unexpected error";
    console.error("Credential packet error", message);
    return packetError(
      request,
      "The packet could not be prepared. Try again in a moment.",
      "internal_error",
      500,
    );
  }
}
```

(`credential.acceptedAt ?? null` guards the `CycleLike.acceptedAt?: string | null` parameter against a workspace row typed `string | null`; `activity.format ?? null` reads Task 4's field. `generatedAt` stays an unsliced `new Date().toISOString()` — the critic-01 guard in `tests/app-source-guards.test.mjs:202-215` bans only the sliced UTC "today" form.)

Gotchas for the executor: `credentialIdFromRequest` 400s any query key but `credentialId` — the zone never rides the URL, it comes from `workspace.reminderPreferences.timeZone` (`"UTC"` until Account's auto-detect lands, so a fresh e2e identity prints "… UTC"). `formatDate` (noon UTC) is for calendar days only; `formatInstantDate`/`formatTimestamp` take the zone and also accept SQLite's `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (`created_at`, `completed_at` are `CURRENT_TIMESTAMP`) — never route an instant through `formatDate`, and never a calendar day through `new Date(value)` (the evening off-by-one critic-01 names). ICU 72+ puts a narrow no-break space before "PM"; `formatTimestamp` normalises it, which is why the unit test can pin `2:14 PM EDT`. The demo identity's email contains the protected `license-lantern` literal, so the "no license-lantern" assertions run under `freshIdentity()` in the spec and under `owner@example.com` in rendered-html, never against the demo packet (the axe entry uses the demo packet and asserts nothing about its text). `document.fonts.check()` answers true for a family no `@font-face` declares — the spec reads `FontFace.status` instead; a missing `font-src 'self'` shows as those faces reporting `error`, not as a console `Error` the fixture would collect. The `<style>` body is `packetStylesheet()` byte for byte (the renderer test compares them), so a CSS edit belongs in `packetTheme.ts`, never in the template. `tests/rendered-html.test.mjs`'s packet fixture answers as `Casey Owner` (the `oai-authenticated-user-full-name` header) rather than the users row's `Casey <Owner>` — the cover prints the identity, exactly as the route always did. `stateOf` needs the credential's `id` for `CycleLike`; the route builds that object inline and hands the renderer only the resulting state, so `RenewalPacketData` stays id-free by type. The `.notice` paints `--ink` on `--paper-deep`, not on `--state-due-soon-soft`, because that soft fill has no `--ink` claim (decision 10) — do not "restore" the soft fill without first adding the claim to both blocks of `tokens.css`, which is outside this task.

After Tasks 7–11, 16 and 17 every screen is its own file on first-class tokens, so what remains of Wave 3's scaffolding is exactly the scaffolding: `app/styles/legacy-shared.css` (1,260 lines at main @ `c6b1fe4`, cut down by every screen task since — the `.button*` family `:5-80` that the `Button` primitive replaced, `.action-spinner` `:389-400` with its `spin 0.7s` literal, the LEGACY BANNERS AND LOAD STATES block `:899-1191` with the `shimmer 1.8s` literal at `:1100`, the LEGACY DISPLAY FACE rule `:1241-1260`), the LEGACY ALIASES `:root` at the end of `tokens.css` (`:303-423` at `c6b1fe4`, 112 `var()`-only names the screen tasks pruned as their sole consumers left), and the three surfaces no screen task owned: the hydration placeholder, the offline / load-failure cards and the page-level banners (`app/screens/WorkspaceStates.tsx` and `app/screens/parts/Banners.tsx`, moved verbatim by Task 5 from `app/ITrackApp.tsx:10764-10860` and `:3942-3994`, still on `.view-stack`, `.loading-heading`, `.offline-workspace`, `.offline-banner`, `.error-banner`, `.zone-banner`). This task restyles those three on `shell.css` and deletes the rest, then pins the result: the contrast test's alias allow-list (`tests/contrast-audit.test.mjs:25-33`) and its `legacyAliasNames()` reader (`:41-49`), which today ASSERT the block exists, are rewritten to assert its absence over a literal `RETIRED_ALIASES` list, and `tests/app-source-guards.test.mjs` gains the composition-root guard (`app/ITrackApp.tsx` ≤ 160 lines, one host element, the fifteen composed components and nothing else, no state/effect/fetch/handler), a legacy-gone guard (the exact stylesheet list, the block's banner gone, one top-level `:root`, the twelve imports) and a retired-alias scan over every `.ts`/`.tsx`/`.css` under `app/`. Findings and minors closed here: architecture-04 / app-ux-24 for the page banner — it now carries only `error.page` (a reload or a keyed row-write failure, never a form's) as `copy.what` + `copy.next` with one "Reload workspace" action (copy table A, "page banner" row), never a raw server sentence; the carried Wave 3 minor "phone banners render above PageHeader" — the root rendered the banners before `ErrorBoundary`, so on the phone they sat above the sticky app bar and scrolled away under it; `Banners` is now rendered by each screen right after its `<PageHeader …/>`, so the bar is the first element in `main` and a banner sits under it (a new `shell.spec.ts` case measures it); two of the five carried duration literals (`legacy-shared.css:399` `spin 0.7s` on `.action-spinner`, `:1100` `shimmer 1.8s` on the placeholder) die with the file — the placeholder is static, and the `Button` pending spinner in `primitives.css` stays the one allowed non-token animation (Global Constraints, Motion); architecture-14 in its last form — the root reaches into no screen (no id, no `querySelector`, no banner slot): the banners read the store, the screens mount them; and the copy rules — the offline banner's "upload proof" sentence goes, replaced by `OFFLINE_ERROR` (copy table A). a11y-14's px guard keeps its `scanned >= 9` floor without re-pinning: 13 stylesheets remain under `app/`.

**Decisions.** (1) **Banners live in the screens, gated on a workspace.** Each of the five screens renders `<Banners />` on the line after its `<PageHeader …/>`; the root renders none. All three tones need a loaded workspace — offline with nothing loaded is the offline card, a failed load is the failure card, and each says it once — so `Banners()` returns `null` without one and the three workspace states do not mount it (the brief's "the three states render it at their top" would be dead code: nothing it could show there). The group is a `.app-banners` 12 px stack so an offline banner over a failed-refetch banner keeps its distance without a `margin-bottom` fighting the screen's own grid gap (the brief's `margin: 0 0 16px` on `.app-banner` is replaced by the wrapper — a margin on a grid item adds to the parent's gap). (2) **The zone offer hides on the Account tab.** Task 16's Reminders section carries the same offer inline with the same "Use {zone}" button; two of them on `/profile` would be a strict-mode violation in `tests/e2e/account.spec.ts`. `Banners` reads `store.nav.route.tab` and omits the zone tone there; `tests/e2e/local-dates.spec.ts` still taps the Home banner's "Use America/New_York". (3) **Copy: nothing new.** The offline banner speaks `OFFLINE_ERROR.what` / `.next` (copy table A, `runAction` 2268 row); the failure banner speaks `error.page.what` / `.next` + "Reload workspace" (copy table A, page-banner row); the zone banner keeps "Your device is in {zone}" / "Reminders and default dates currently use UTC." / "Use {zone}" / "Not now" verbatim; the offline card keeps its two sentences verbatim (`c6b1fe4 :10802-10807`; no banned word, no pin) and drops its "Connection paused" kicker; the failure card keeps its five pinned strings (copy table A, `WorkspaceLoadFailure` row) — the title from the HTTP status, the body `copy.next`. The brief's "You’re offline" / "Your saved record is safe. Reconnect to load it." are not in the copy table and are not written. (4) **The state cards keep an `h1`.** No `PageHeader` is mounted in those states, so the card's heading is the page's one H1 (`docs/DESIGN-SYSTEM.md`, PageHeader: one H1 per page); `tests/e2e/session-ended-mid-save.spec.ts` and `axe.spec.ts` find them by name, not level. (5) **The placeholder is static** — three blocks of `--paper-deep` bars behind a `--line` hairline; `aria-busy="true"`, `aria-label="Loading iTrack"` and the sr-only sentence are byte-identical (`tests/e2e/fixtures.ts` `goto` waits on the first two; `tests/rendered-html.test.mjs:654-655,676` pin all three in the server-rendered HTML). (6) **The composition-root guard is prescriptive**, as the brief spells it: `≤ 160` lines, the only host element `div`, the component set exactly the fifteen names, and the banned patterns `use(State|Reducer|Effect|LayoutEffect|Ref)(`, `fetch(`, `localStorage`, `onClick=`, `style={`, `handleSessionEnded`, `setWorkspace`, `runAction` — `useMemo`/`useCallback` allowed (`Routed` memoises the announcement, the detail lookup and the log opener). It reads a comment-stripped source. (7) **`globals.css` keeps Task 6's import order** — `modals.css` after `log-activity.css`, where Task 6 placed it and Task 11 kept it (the brief lists `modals` after `account`; moving an import moves its cascade position, and nothing asks for that). The legacy-gone guard pins the twelve imports in that order. // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

```js
// composition", the legacy stylesheets and the LEGACY ALIASES block gone, and
// no retired alias name anywhere under app/. The three guards read a
// comment-stripped source, so a comment may name what they ban.

const escapeRegExp = (text) => text.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");

// Block comments and whole-line // comments blanked with newlines kept, so a
// reported position is the file's own; a `//` after code (`https://` in a
// string) is left alone.
function stripComments(source) {
  const blank = (text) => text.replace(/[^\n]/g, " ");
  return source.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, blank).replace(/^[ \t]*\/\/[^\n]*/gm, blank);
}

test("app/ITrackApp.tsx is a composition root: providers + route switch only (spec §2 Wave 4 finish gate)", () => {
  const sources = readClientSources();
  const root = sources.find(({ file }) => file === "ITrackApp.tsx");
  assert.ok(root, "app/ITrackApp.tsx exists — the five route pages import { ITrackApp } from it");
  assert.match(root.source, /^export function ITrackApp\(\)/m, "the named export the route pages import");
  const lines = root.source.split("\n").length;
  assert.ok(lines <= 160, `app/ITrackApp.tsx is ${lines} lines; the composition root is at most 160`);
  const code = stripComments(root.source);
  for (const [pattern, why] of ROOT_BANNED) {
    assert.doesNotMatch(code, pattern, `app/ITrackApp.tsx matches ${pattern}: ${why}`);
  }
  const hosts = [...new Set([...code.matchAll(/<([a-z][a-z0-9]*)\b/g)].map((m) => m[1]))];
  assert.deepEqual(hosts, ["div"], "the only host element is the data-app-root div; everything else is a component");
  const components = [...new Set([...code.matchAll(/<([A-Z][A-Za-z]*)\b/g)].map((m) => m[1]))].sort();
  assert.deepEqual(
    components,
    ROOT_COMPONENTS,
    "the provider tree, the shell, the boundary, the modal host, the three workspace states and the five screens — nothing else is composed here",
  );
  assert.ok(sources.some(({ file }) => file.startsWith("screens/")), "screens live under app/screens/");
});
```

```ts

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Carried Wave 3 minor: the page-level banners (offline, a failed refetch,
// the time-zone offer) used to render above PageHeader, so on the phone the
// offer sat above the sticky app bar and scrolled away under it. Task 18
// renders them inside each screen right after its PageHeader: the bar is the
// first thing in main, a banner sits under it. A fresh identity — the zone
// offer needs a stored zone of 'UTC' (every new account) and a device zone
// that differs (timezoneId below); seeding a credential makes Home the ledger
// rather than the first-run card, so the header carries its full shape.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
test.describe("banner placement", () => {
  test.use({ identity: freshIdentity(), timezoneId: "America/New_York" });

  test("a banner sits under the app bar, never above it", async ({ page, app }) => {
    await app.seedCredential();
    await app.goto("/");
    const bar = page.locator("header.page-header");
    const banner = page.locator('.app-banner[data-tone="zone"]');
    await expect(banner).toBeVisible();
    await expect(banner.getByRole("button", { name: "Use America/New_York" })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(banner.getByRole("button", { name: "Not now" })).toBeVisible();
    // DOM order: the banner follows the header inside main.
    expect(
      await page.evaluate(() => {
        const header = document.querySelector("header.page-header");
        const notice = document.querySelector('.app-banner[data-tone="zone"]');
        if (!header || !notice) return false;
        const follows = (header.compareDocumentPosition(notice) & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING) !== 0;
        return follows && notice.closest("#main-content") !== null;
      }),
      "the banner is rendered after the page header, inside main",
    ).toBe(true);
    // Geometry: at scroll 0 the banner's top edge is at or below the bar's bottom edge.
    const barBox = await bar.boundingBox();
    const bannerBox = await banner.boundingBox();
    if (!barBox || !bannerBox) throw new Error("the page header or the zone banner did not render");
    expect(bannerBox.y, "the banner starts under the bar").toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(barBox.y + barBox.height - 1);
    if (isPhone()) {
      expect(
        await bar.evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).position),
        "the phone header is the sticky app bar the banner sits under",
      ).toBe("sticky");
    }
    app.expectNoErrors();
  });
});
```

```css
/* ===== APP BANNERS (app/screens/parts/Banners.tsx) ===== */
/*
 * The page-level notices — offline, a page-level failure, the one-tap
 * time-zone offer — in one shape, rendered by each screen right after its
 * PageHeader and never by the root: on the phone the sticky app bar is the
 * first thing in main and a banner sits under it, not above it (the Wave 3

 * offline banner over a failed-refetch banner keeps its distance without a
 * margin fighting the screen's own gap. Every ink is a claimed pair
 * (tokens.css): the strong is the tone's state ink on its soft fill, the

  display: grid;
  gap: 12px;

  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;

}

.app-banner small {

}

  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;

}

  background: var(--state-overdue-soft);
}

.app-banner[data-tone="error"] strong {
  color: var(--state-overdue);
}

.app-banner[data-tone="offline"] {
  background: var(--state-due-soon-soft);
}

.app-banner[data-tone="offline"] strong {
  color: var(--state-due-soon);
}

.app-banner[data-tone="zone"] {
  background: var(--accent-soft);
}

.app-banner[data-tone="zone"] strong {
  color: var(--accent);
}

@media (max-width: 540px) {
  /* The actions take a row of their own under the text; the icon keeps its column. */
```

```tsx
import { Button } from "../components/Button";
import { Icon } from "../components/Icon";
import {
  SERVER_UNAVAILABLE_ERROR,
  SESSION_ENDED_ERROR,
  type DescribedError,
} from "../lib/copy";

// What the routed screen (app/ITrackApp.tsx `Screen`) shows in place of a
// screen while there is no workspace. Nothing here renders <Banners />: all
// three banner tones need a loaded workspace, and each of these cards says
// its one thing itself.

// The hydration placeholder keeps its three contracts byte for byte:
// `aria-busy="true"` + `aria-label="Loading iTrack"` is what every e2e `goto`
// waits to see leave (tests/e2e/fixtures.ts), and both are pinned with the
// sr-only sentence by tests/rendered-html.test.mjs — the shell is
// server-rendered, so they are in the HTML before hydration. It is static:
// the old shimmer was a legacy duration literal, not a spec motion moment.
export function LoadingDashboard() {
  return (
    <div
      className="loading-dashboard"
      role="status"
      aria-busy="true"
      aria-label="Loading iTrack"
    >
      <div className="loading-dashboard-block">
        <span className="loading-dashboard-bar" data-w="1" />
        <span className="loading-dashboard-bar" data-w="2" />
      </div>
      <div className="loading-dashboard-block">
        <span className="loading-dashboard-bar" data-w="3" />
      </div>
      <div className="loading-dashboard-block">
        <span className="loading-dashboard-bar" data-w="3" />
        <span className="loading-dashboard-bar" data-w="2" />
      </div>
      <p className="sr-only">Loading your renewal workspace</p>
    </div>
  );
}

// Offline with nothing loaded. The two sentences are the c6b1fe4 ones, kept
// verbatim (no copy-table row, no banned word, nothing pins them); the
// "Connection paused" kicker is gone — the heading is the message. The h1 is
// the page's one H1: no PageHeader is mounted in this state.
export function OfflineWorkspace() {
  return (
    <section className="offline-workspace" role="status">
      <Icon name="zap" size={22} />
      <h1>Your cloud record is still protected.</h1>
      <p>
        iTrack could not load this device’s signed-in workspace while offline.
        Reconnect and it will retry automatically; no credential, certificate,
        or account data was cached here.
      </p>
    </section>
  );
}

// The five kept strings (copy table A, the `WorkspaceLoadFailure` row): three
// titles chosen by the HTTP status — the very words `copy.what` carries for a
// 401 (SESSION_ENDED_ERROR) and a 5xx (SERVER_UNAVAILABLE_ERROR), plus the
// network sentence for everything else — and the two button labels.
// tests/e2e/session-ended-mid-save.spec.ts pins "Your sign-in needs to be
// refreshed." + "Reload and sign in"; tests/e2e/axe.spec.ts pins "iTrack is
// temporarily unavailable.". The body under the title is `copy.next`.
const UNREACHABLE_TITLE = "We couldn’t reach your workspace.";

export function WorkspaceLoadFailure({
  status,
  copy,
  onRetry,
}: {
  status: number | null;
  copy: DescribedError;
  onRetry: () => void;
}) {
  const authenticationFailure = status === 401 || status === 403;
  const serviceFailure = status !== null && status >= 500;
  const title = authenticationFailure
    ? SESSION_ENDED_ERROR.what
    : serviceFailure
      ? SERVER_UNAVAILABLE_ERROR.what
      : UNREACHABLE_TITLE;
  return (
    <section className="load-failure" role="alert">
      <Icon name="alert" size={22} />
      <h1>{title}</h1>
      <p>{copy.next}</p>
      <div className="load-failure-actions">
        <Button
          variant="primary"
          onClick={authenticationFailure ? () => window.location.reload() : onRetry}
        >
          {authenticationFailure ? "Reload and sign in" : "Try again"}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { Button } from "../../components/Button";
import { Icon } from "../../components/Icon";
import { TIME_ZONE_ACTION_KEY } from "../../lib/actionKeys";
import { OFFLINE_ERROR } from "../../lib/copy";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../lib/workspaceStore";

// The page-level notices, rendered by every screen right after its
// PageHeader — never by the composition root, so on the phone the sticky
// app bar is the first thing in main and a banner sits under it (the Wave 3
// minor). Three tones, all gated on a loaded workspace (without one the
// routed screen is the offline card, the failure card or the placeholder,
// each saying its own thing once):
//   offline — the record is loaded and the device lost the network
//             (OFFLINE_ERROR: the same words run() answers a write with);
//   error   — a refetch or a keyed row write failed (`error.page`; a form's
//             failure never lands here — architecture-04, app-ux-24);
//   zone    — the one-tap time-zone offer (critic-01), except on the Account
//             tab, whose Reminders section carries the same offer inline.
export function Banners() {
  const store = useWorkspace();
  const { workspace, isOnline, zoneSuggestion, dismissZoneOffer } = store;
  const pageError = store.error.page;
  const onAccount = store.nav.route.tab === "profile";

  if (!workspace) return null;

  const showOffline = !isOnline;
  // The offer itself — only while the stored zone is the literal 'UTC' and
  // the device reports a real, different zone, and not after a "Not now" in
  // this session or on an earlier visit on this device — is the store's
  // `zoneSuggestion` (Task 16: one owner, shared with the Account Reminders
  // section, so a "Not now" in either place hides both on the same commit).
  // This component decides only the tab it shows on.
  const showZone = isOnline && !onAccount && zoneSuggestion !== null;
  if (!showOffline && !pageError && !showZone) return null;

  return (
    <div className="app-banners">
      {showOffline ? (
        <div className="app-banner" data-tone="offline" role="status">
          <Icon name="zap" size={18} />
          <div>
            <strong>{OFFLINE_ERROR.what}</strong>
            <small>{OFFLINE_ERROR.next}</small>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {pageError ? (
        <div className="app-banner" data-tone="error" role="alert">
          <Icon name="alert" size={18} />
          <div>
            <strong>{pageError.what}</strong>
            <small>{pageError.next}</small>
          </div>
          <div className="app-banner-actions">
            <Button
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => {
                store.error.clearPage();
                void store.reload();
              }}
            >
              Reload workspace
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {showZone && zoneSuggestion ? (
        <div className="app-banner" data-tone="zone" role="status">
          <Icon name="clock" size={18} />
          <div>
            <strong>Your device is in {zoneSuggestion}</strong>
            <small>Reminders and default dates currently use UTC.</small>
          </div>
          <div className="app-banner-actions">
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="primary"
              pending={store.pending.isPending(TIME_ZONE_ACTION_KEY)}
              onClick={() => void store.actions.adoptDeviceTimeZone()}
            >
              Use {zoneSuggestion}
            </Button>
            <Button size="sm" variant="quiet" onClick={dismissZoneOffer}>
              Not now
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```
