The file is now the composition root exactly as Task 5 shaped it and Tasks 7–11 and 16 re-pointed it — for the record and for the guard (Step 2 pins this shape: fifteen components, one host element, no state, no handler), it reads:

```tsx
"use client";

import { useCallback, useMemo } from "react";
import { AppShell } from "./components/AppShell";
import { ErrorBoundary } from "./components/ErrorBoundary";
import { RouteAnnouncementContext } from "./components/RouteAnnouncement";
import { buildPath } from "./lib/navigation";
import { useNavigation, type Navigation } from "./lib/useNavigation";
import { useReminderLaunch } from "./lib/useReminderLaunch";
import { WorkspaceProvider, useWorkspace } from "./lib/workspaceStore";
import type { Credential } from "./lib/workspaceTypes";
import { Account } from "./screens/Account";
import { ActivityLog } from "./screens/ActivityLog";
import { CredentialDetail } from "./screens/CredentialDetail";
import { Credentials } from "./screens/Credentials";
import { Home } from "./screens/Home";
import { ModalsHost } from "./screens/modals/ModalsHost";
import { LoadingDashboard, OfflineWorkspace, WorkspaceLoadFailure } from "./screens/WorkspaceStates";

// The composition root (spec §2, Wave 4 finish gate): the provider, the
// shell, the boundary, the route switch and the modal host — nothing else.
// State lives in app/lib/workspaceStore.tsx, behaviour in the screens under
// app/screens/, the page-level banners in each screen after its PageHeader.
// tests/app-source-guards.test.mjs pins this shape; the five route pages
// import { ITrackApp } from here.
export function ITrackApp() {
  const nav = useNavigation();
  return (
    <WorkspaceProvider nav={nav}>
      <Routed nav={nav} />
    </WorkspaceProvider>
  );
}

function Routed({ nav }: { nav: Navigation }) {
  const store = useWorkspace();
  const { highlightedReminderKey } = useReminderLaunch(store, nav);
  const detailId = nav.route.detail?.id ?? "";
  const workspace = store.workspace;
  // An archived credential resolves too: the detail stays on its URL as a
  // read-only record (Task 7); a dead id resolves to null and the provider
  // replaces the URL.
  const detail = useMemo(
    () =>
      workspace
        ? (workspace.credentials.find((candidate) => candidate.id === detailId) ??
          workspace.archivedCredentials.find((candidate) => candidate.id === detailId) ??
          null)
        : null,
    [workspace, detailId],
  );
  const announcement = useMemo(
    () => ({
      route: nav.route,
      credentialName: detail?.credentialName ?? null,
      navigations: nav.navigations,
    }),
    [nav.route, nav.navigations, detail],
  );
  const openLog = useCallback(
    () => store.modals.open({ kind: "logActivity", preselectCredentialId: "" }),
    [store.modals],
  );
  return (
    <div className="app-root" data-app-root>
      <RouteAnnouncementContext value={announcement}>
        <AppShell activeTab={nav.route.tab} onNavigate={nav.setTab} onLogActivity={openLog}>
          <ErrorBoundary resetKey={buildPath(nav.route)}>
            <Screen nav={nav} detail={detail} highlightedReminderKey={highlightedReminderKey} />
          </ErrorBoundary>
        </AppShell>
      </RouteAnnouncementContext>
      <ModalsHost />
    </div>
  );
}

function Screen({
  nav,
  detail,
  highlightedReminderKey,
}: {
  nav: Navigation;
  detail: Credential | null;
  highlightedReminderKey: string;
}) {
  const store = useWorkspace();
  const { workspace, status } = store;
  if (!workspace) {
    if (!store.isOnline || status.kind === "offline") return <OfflineWorkspace />;
    if (status.kind === "failed") {
      return (
        <WorkspaceLoadFailure
          status={status.httpStatus}
          copy={status.copy}
          onRetry={() => void store.reload()}
        />
      );
    }
    return <LoadingDashboard />;
  }
  if (nav.route.detail) return detail ? <CredentialDetail credential={detail} /> : null;
  switch (nav.route.tab) {
    case "home":
      return <Home highlightedReminderKey={highlightedReminderKey} />;
    case "credentials":
      return <Credentials />;
    case "history":
      return <ActivityLog />;
    default:
      return <Account />;
  }
}
```

    await app.goto("/");

    const input = dropZoneInput(sheet);

    await input.setInputFiles(await certificatePng());

    await expect(sheet.getByText("certificate.png")).toBeVisible();

    await expect(notice).toBeVisible();
    await audit(page, "scan-notice");

  });

    const sheets: ReadonlyArray<[label: string, opener: string, name: string]> = [
      ["account-email", "Change email", "Change email"],
      ["account-password", "Change password", "Change password"],
      ["account-delete", "Delete account…", "Delete this account"],
    ];
    for (const [label, opener, name] of sheets) {
      // The opener is the only button of that name while the sheet is closed;

      await page.keyboard.press("Escape");

Every test's annotation reads like `discard-prompt (phone-dark): {"minor":0,"moderate":0,"serious":0,"critical":0}` (moderate/minor counts are information, never asserted), and each `axe-<label>` attachment under `test-results/` holds the full result. These are gates over work Tasks 7, 10, 11, 16 and 17 shipped, so a first run that passes is the expected outcome. A red line names `<rule id> [<impact>] <help>` and the failing nodes' selectors; fix the markup in the owning file and re-run — never reach for `.exclude(…)`, `.disableRules(…)` or `.withTags(…)`. The suspects, by rule (impacts are axe-core 4.13.0's):

| Rule (impact) | Where it can come from on a Wave 4 surface | Fix (in the owner's file) |
|---|---|---|
| `aria-prohibited-attr` (serious) | an `aria-label` on a role-less `<div>`/`<span>`/`<p>` — a drop zone, a prompt body, a filter row | `grep -rn 'aria-label=' app/screens app/components \| grep -v 'role=\|<button\|<nav\|<section\|<input\|<select\|<a \|<ul\|<label\|<table\|<form'` lists survivors; add `role="group"` or drop the label where visible text already names the element |
| `label` / `select-name` (critical) | a filter `Select` or the drop zone's file input rendered outside `Field` | wrap in `Field`, or give the input the `Field`'s id through `inputId` |
| `duplicate-id-aria` (critical) | two dialogs open at once (the sheet and its prompt / notice) sharing a fixed id, or two `Field`s sharing an `inputId` | `useId()` per instance |
| `aria-dialog-name` (serious) | a `Modal`/`Sheet` whose `title` is empty | every sheet passes a non-empty `title` |
| `color-contrast` (serious) | an ink on a fill without a claim in `tokens.css` — the `node.any[0].data` in the attachment carries `fgColor`/`bgColor`/`contrastRatio` | re-point the rule to a claimed pairing (`--ink`/`--ink-muted` on `--paper`/`--paper-deep`/`--card`; `--ink-muted` or `--accent` on `--accent-soft`; each `--state-*` on its `--state-*-soft`; the `--on-inverse` family on `--inverse-surface`), never a literal |
| `scrollable-region-focusable` (serious) | the Activity log's table wrapper overflowing at the phone widths with no focusable child | the `caption` already carries `tabIndex={-1}`; give the wrapper `tabIndex={0}`, `role="region"` and an `aria-label` |
| `nested-interactive` (serious) | a `Button` inside a `<summary>` or inside a `<label>` | move the control out of the outer one |
| `aria-hidden-focus` (serious) | a focusable element inside `aria-hidden="true"` | remove the attribute — the modal stack uses `inert` |
| `landmark-unique` (moderate — annotated, not asserted) | two `section[aria-label]`s with the same name | not a gate failure; rename one |

`tests/e2e/screenshots.spec.ts` is 55 lines at c6b1fe4 (`OUT` at `:14`, `FULL` at `:15`, the `test.skip` at `:17-20`, one test at `:23-55`). Replace it whole:

```bash
cat > tests/e2e/screenshots.spec.ts <<'SCREENSHOTS_TS'
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import type { Page } from "@playwright/test";
import { expect, freshIdentity, test } from "./fixtures";

// The spec §2 Wave 4 finish-gate evidence: every shipped surface in every
// project, written under docs/design/wave4/ and committed (docs/design/wave3/
// is the Wave 3 set, kept as history). Off by default so the ordinary e2e
// run never writes into docs/; WAVE4_SCREENSHOTS=1 captures the viewport
// (the packet, a document, always the whole page), =full every page (for a
// local look only — never committed). The demo identity is read-only; the
// three Account sheets (disabled for the local preview) and the first-run
// Home need a fresh account. The clock and the time zone are fixed so every
// date reads the same in all four projects; fonts are awaited so the shots
// show the shipped faces, not the metric-matched fallbacks; `scale: "css"`
// keeps the phone shots at 390×844 rather than the descriptor's 3×.
const OUT = fileURLToPath(new URL("../../docs/design/wave4/", import.meta.url));
const FULL = process.env.WAVE4_SCREENSHOTS === "full";

test.skip(
  !process.env.WAVE4_SCREENSHOTS,
  "set WAVE4_SCREENSHOTS=1 (or =full) to capture the Wave 4 gate screenshots",
);
test.use({ timezoneId: "America/New_York" });

async function prepare(page: Page) {
  await page.clock.setFixedTime(new Date("2026-09-15T15:00:00"));
  await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: "reduce" });
}

async function shoot(page: Page, slug: string, fullPage: boolean) {
  await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready.then(() => undefined));
  await page.screenshot({
    path: path.join(OUT, `${slug}-${test.info().project.name}.png`),
    fullPage,
    animations: "disabled",
    scale: "css",
  });
}

test("captures every demo surface in this project's scheme and viewport", async ({ page, app }) => {
  await prepare(page);
  const id = await app.demoCredentialId();
  const surfaces: ReadonlyArray<[slug: string, route: string]> = [
    ["home", "/"],
    ["credentials", "/credentials"],
    ["credential-detail", `/credentials/${id}`],
    ["activity-log", "/history"],
    ["account", "/profile"],
    ["not-found", "/nonexistent"],
    ["styleguide", "/styleguide"],
  ];
  for (const [slug, route] of surfaces) {
    await app.goto(route);
    await shoot(page, slug, FULL);
  }
  await app.goto("/");
  const sheet = await app.openLog();
  // A fixed-position sheet is captured with the viewport, never full-page.
  await shoot(page, "log-activity", false);
  const details = sheet.getByRole("button", { name: /^Details/ });
  await details.click();
  await expect(details).toHaveAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
  await shoot(page, "log-activity-details", false);
  // The packet is a server-rendered document with no hydration placeholder:
  // page.goto rather than app.goto, and always the whole page.
  await page.goto(`/api/export/packet?credentialId=${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
  await page.waitForLoadState("networkidle");
  await shoot(page, "packet", true);
  app.expectNoErrors();
});

test.describe("fresh", () => {
  test.use({ identity: freshIdentity() });

  test("captures the first-run Home and the three Account sheets", async ({ page, app }) => {
    await prepare(page);
    await app.goto("/");
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("heading", { level: 2, name: "Add your first credential" }),
    ).toBeVisible();
    await shoot(page, "home-first-run", FULL);
    await app.goto("/profile");
    const sheets: ReadonlyArray<[slug: string, opener: string, name: string]> = [
      ["account-password", "Change password", "Change password"],
      ["account-email", "Change email", "Change email"],
      ["account-delete", "Delete account…", "Delete this account"],
    ];
    for (const [slug, opener, name] of sheets) {
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: opener, exact: true }).click();
      await expect(app.dialog(name)).toBeVisible();
      await shoot(page, slug, false);
      await page.keyboard.press("Escape");
      await expect(app.dialog(name)).toHaveCount(0);
    }
    app.expectNoErrors();
  });
});

Append the sixth — the account routes' public face after a deploy, unauthenticated, one login-free probe with two answers (Tasks 12–13: the CSRF check runs before the session check, and the `/account` branch runs before the session proxy):

```bash
tail -3 tests/live/live-smoke.spec.ts
cat >> tests/live/live-smoke.spec.ts <<'LIVE_SIXTH'

test("/account/delete never runs unauthenticated: a JSON 401 with the origin, a 403 without it", async ({ request, baseURL }) => {
  // account-routes.mjs: the Origin/Referer check answers before the session
  // check, and the session check before anything reads the body — so neither
  // request reaches the auth store, the limiters or the worker. No login, so
  // this costs nothing against the per-IP login bucket.
  const origin = baseURL;
  if (!origin) throw new Error("playwright.live.config.ts sets baseURL from LIVE_BASE_URL");
  const body = { email: "nobody@example.test", password: "not-a-password" };
  const withOrigin = await request.post("/account/delete", {
    headers: { origin, accept: "application/json" },
    data: body,
    maxRedirects: 0,
  });
  expect(withOrigin.status()).toBe(401);
  expect(((await withOrigin.json()) as { code?: string }).code).toBe("authentication_required");
  const noOrigin = await request.post("/account/delete", {
    headers: { accept: "application/json" },
    data: body,
    maxRedirects: 0,
  });
  expect(noOrigin.status()).toBe(403);
  expect(((await noOrigin.json()) as { code?: string }).code).toBe("cross_origin_request");
});

  assert.ok(doc.indexOf("## Printed documents") < doc.indexOf("## Tests"), "Printed documents precedes Tests");

  assert.match(doc, /WAVE4_SCREENSHOTS=1 E2E_BASE_URL=http:\/\/localhost:3100 npx playwright test/);
  assert.match(doc, /\.ledger-row\[data-motion="fold"\]/);
  assert.match(doc, /app\/lib\/packetTheme\.ts/);
  assert.match(doc, /app\/lib\/workspaceStore\.tsx/);

    assert.ok(existsSync(path.join(root, `tests/e2e/${name}.spec.ts`)), `tests/e2e/${name}.spec.ts exists on disk`);

The motion bullet (replaces the whole "Motion is three moments" bullet, whose last words are "leaves the check visible."):

```bash
cat > "$SCRATCH/design-system-motion.md" <<'MOTION_MD'
- **Motion is three moments, and nothing else moves.** (1) A credit bar filling to its
  new value: `.credit-bar-fill { transition: width var(--duration-fill) var(--ease-out) }`
  (400 ms). (2) A ring segment completing, then its check drawing: the arc eases
  `stroke-dasharray` over `--duration-fill`, and `cycle-ring-check-draw` runs for
  `--duration-complete` (320 ms) after that same delay — only when the value crosses 1
  after mount (`data-motion="complete"`), never on first paint. (3) A card folding to the
  ledger row when a cycle closes: `.ledger-row[data-motion="fold"]` in `home.css` runs the
  `ledger-fold` keyframes over `var(--duration-fold) var(--ease-out)` (360 ms) — set once
  by the store (`markSeriesClosed`) when `markRenewalAccepted` succeeds and the successor
  row mounts, cleared on `animationend`, zero under `prefers-reduced-motion` through the
  token. No motion duration literal appears outside `tokens.css`: the three moments read
  the tokens, and the only other animation in the system is the Button pending spinner
  (`spin`, 0.7 s, hidden under reduced motion); the pre-Wave-3 transitions died with
  `legacy-shared.css` and the old screen stylesheets. Everything else is instant: no press
  scale, no hover lift, no sheet slide, no scrim fade, no screen push, no edge-swipe or
  drag-dismiss gesture (mockup README, decision 6); disclosure chevrons rotate without a
  transition; rows never react to hover. `prefers-reduced-motion` zeroes the three
  durations in `tokens.css`, `globals.css` clamps every animation and transition to
  0.01 ms, `instruments.css` sets the two instrument moments to `none` at their own
  specificity (and honours a `reducedMotion` prop the same way), and the check keyframes
  carry their own start value so a frozen animation still leaves the check visible.
MOTION_MD
```

The `## Printed documents` section (inserted before `## Tests`):

```bash
cat > "$SCRATCH/design-system-printed.md" <<'PRINTED_MD'
## Printed documents

The renewal packet (`GET /api/export/packet?credentialId=…`, `app/api/export/packet/route.ts`)
is a standalone document rendered by the pure `app/lib/renewalPacket.ts`
(`renderRenewalPacket`, `renderRenewalPacketError`, `renewalPacketFilename` →
`renewal-packet-<slug>-<deadline>.html`, `<meta name="itrack-packet-version">`). It cannot
load a stylesheet — its CSP is `default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; font-src
'self'; script-src 'sha256-…'` — so `app/lib/packetTheme.ts` generates one:
`packetRootBlock()` mirrors the light `:root` of `tokens.css` value for value
(`PACKET_LIGHT_TOKENS`; `tests/packet-theme.test.mjs` fails on any drift, reading
`tokens.css` only through `tools/contrast-audit.mjs`'s `tokenValues`), `packetFontFaces()`
inlines the seven `@font-face` rules from `FONT_FILES` and the three metric-matched
fallbacks, and `packetStylesheet()` is audited by `auditStylesheet(…, { kind: "tokens" })`
— every colour a `var(--…)`, every size a `--text-*` token or rem, no literal outside its
own `:root`, `11pt` only under `@media print` (a print length, not a screen size). The
packet is light-only (`color-scheme: light`): it is printed, like `app/manifest.ts`'s
splash. It carries no internal id — requirements are named, activities go by title and
date, files by name and SHA-256 — and every instant is formatted in the account's
reminder zone (`generatedZone`). It is under the axe gate (`packet` in
`tests/e2e/axe.spec.ts`) and the screenshot gate (`packet` under `docs/design/wave4/`).
PRINTED_MD
```

Splice all five on their anchors. The script lives in the scratchpad (its anchors carry apostrophes, which a `node -e '…'` inside a bash single-quoted string cannot) and refuses to write if any anchor is absent or ambiguous:

```bash
cat > "$SCRATCH/splice-design-system.mjs" <<'SPLICE_MJS'
// Task 19: splice the five scratch texts into docs/DESIGN-SYSTEM.md on text
// anchors. Run from the worktree root with SCRATCH set. No line number is
// trusted (Task 18 shortened the file); a missing or ambiguous anchor throws
// before anything is written.
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";

const file = "docs/DESIGN-SYSTEM.md";
let src = readFileSync(file, "utf8");
const part = (name) => readFileSync(`${process.env.SCRATCH}/${name}`, "utf8").trimEnd();

function once(anchor, label) {
  const at = src.indexOf(anchor);
  if (at < 0) throw new Error(`${label}: anchor not found: ${JSON.stringify(anchor.slice(0, 60))}`);
  if (src.indexOf(anchor, at + 1) >= 0) throw new Error(`${label}: anchor is not unique`);
  return at;
}
function replaceBetween(startAnchor, endAnchor, replacement, label) {
  const start = once(startAnchor, label);
  const endAt = src.indexOf(endAnchor, start);
  if (endAt < 0) throw new Error(`${label}: end anchor not found`);
  src = src.slice(0, start) + replacement + src.slice(endAt + endAnchor.length);
}

// 1. the Shell token row: the ledger column is consumed now
const shellFrom = "declared now and consumed in Wave 4 with the Home extraction";
once(shellFrom, "shell row");
src = src.replace(shellFrom, "consumed by `app/styles/home.css` (the Home ledger grid)");
// 2. ## Screens before ## Geometry, depth, motion
const geometry = "\n## Geometry, depth, motion\n";
once(geometry, "geometry heading");
src = src.replace(geometry, "\n" + part("design-system-screens.md") + "\n\n## Geometry, depth, motion\n");
// 3. the motion bullet, whole
replaceBetween("- **Motion is three moments, and nothing else moves.**", "leaves the check visible.", part("design-system-motion.md"), "motion bullet");
// 4. the ledger bullet, whole (the file spells the apostrophe in "Home's" as ASCII U+0027)
replaceBetween("- Home's own two-column ledger", "sits full-width under the hero.", part("design-system-ledger.md"), "ledger bullet");
// 5. forced colours: the legacy check rows are gone
replaceBetween("`legacy-shared.css`:\nthe legacy custom check rows", "it is a native input.", "Every check row — the credential checklist, the requirement picker, the reminder lead\ndays — is the native `Checkbox` primitive, which needs no rule.", "forced colours");
// 6 + 7. Printed documents, then Tests, to the end of the file
const tests = "\n## Tests\n";
const at = once(tests, "tests heading");
src = src.slice(0, at) + "\n" + part("design-system-printed.md") + "\n\n" + part("design-system-tests.md") + "\n";
writeFileSync(file, src);
console.log("spliced");
SPLICE_MJS
SCRATCH="$SCRATCH" node "$SCRATCH/splice-design-system.mjs"
grep -n '^## ' docs/DESIGN-SYSTEM.md
grep -n 'WAVE3_\|parity\|consumed in Wave 4\|Until then\|until Wave 4\|history\.css\|matrix 46' docs/DESIGN-SYSTEM.md; echo "stale grep exit $?"
git diff --stat docs/DESIGN-SYSTEM.md
```

(1) Home's countdown numeral is `--text-3xl` (2.25 rem, 36 px) at weight 800, not the artboard's 40 px — the rem scale has no 40 px step. (2) The phone row ring is the 72 px `CycleRing` mount scaled to 56 px by CSS (the SVG has a `viewBox`; the geometry lands within a pixel of `RING_SIZES[56]`), not a second mount behind a media query. (3) The phone keeps the "Next twelve months" timeline card, last in the column; the phone artboard omits it. (4) The Home header carries both mockup actions — "Renewal packet" (secondary, for the most urgent open row) and "Log activity" (primary) — on desktop only; the phone's bottom nav carries the one Log button. (5) Activities gained `format` and `notes` (migration `0015_wave4_fields`; the Log activity Details step, the Activity log, the CSV export and the packet show them). (6) Check-in titles are not the stored task titles: `checkInTitle` derives a ≤ 9-word title from the task kind (review / progress / submission / personal) on the client, and the full managed title moves to the row's sub-line. (7) The Activity log keeps an Evidence and an Apply-to-another-credential row action until Edit activity absorbs both. (8) The packet keeps each file's SHA-256 and the holder's contact email on its cover — a fingerprint and a contact line, not internal ids. (9) A signed-out packet tab still receives the gateway's JSON 401 (`{"error":"unauthenticated"}`) rather than a sign-in page — a gateway matter for Wave 5.
- **Carried into Wave 5 from Wave 4:** `/ocr/*` still lacks immutable cache headers in `public/_headers` and the gateway, and the two unused tesseract core variants still ship (perf-07 c/d); the signed-out packet tab's JSON 401 above; folding the Activity log's Evidence and Apply actions into Edit activity; the Escape-on-dirty contract is per sheet (the Log sheet persists its draft and asks only for input the draft cannot keep — a file, requirement choices, the Details fields — while the edit forms ask whenever the form changed); the ~111 server-source pins in `tests/rendered-html.test.mjs` retire with the `route.ts` split (architecture-M-05); email change is inert in production until `RESEND_API_KEY` and `AUTH_EMAIL_FROM` are set on Railway (section 10, item 1).

- **Identity as shipped in Wave 4 (amends the "No identity change … `sha256(email)`" sentence above; architecture-M-03):** the hashed address is the account's sign-up address (`users.identity_email` in `/data/auth.db`, backfilled from `email` for every existing row and unique), forwarded to the worker as `oai-authenticated-user-email`; the contact address (`users.email`) is forwarded beside it as `oai-authenticated-user-contact-email` and is the only thing an email change moves (`POST /account/email` → an `email_changes` token → `/verify` with the password → `confirmEmailChange`) — D1 and R2 are never re-keyed, and `getWorkspace().user.email` reports the contact address. Account deletion is `POST /account/delete` → `beginDeletion` (the row parked under `deleting_at`, every session dropped) → the gateway's own worker call `deleteWorkspace` (one D1 batch in dependency order, then an R2 prefix delete, guarded by `x-itrack-internal-secret`) → `deleteUser` → a cleared cookie, retried three times in-request and by the 15-minute sweep. Chris's production row backfills `identity_email` to `christophertskerritt@gmail.com`, so nothing migrates.

```bash
export PATH="$HOME/.local/node/node-v22.22.0-darwin-arm64/bin:$PATH"
cd "/Users/chrisskerritt/Documents/New project/Vigilo-wt/wave4"
SCRATCH="<session scratchpad directory>"
python3 - "$SCRATCH/runcheck-totals.txt" <<'PY'
import pathlib, re, sys

totals = dict(line.split() for line in pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text().split("\n") if line.strip())
m, s, a, acc, te, al = (totals[k] for k in ("matrix", "seed", "actions", "account", "throwaway-empty", "all"))
counts = f"(matrix {m} · seed {s} · actions {a} · account {acc} · throwaway-empty {te} · all {al})"

header = f"""#!/usr/bin/env bash
# iTrack gateway run-check (Waves 1-4). Modes:
#   matrix           — gateway matrix, no login (25) + the self-hosted fonts, unauthenticated (21)  ({m})   usable against production
#   seed             — login as ops + GET /api/workspace + the shell's font preloads                  ({s})   runs initializeDatabase + ensureUser
#   actions          — seed + every credential/preference action + the /api/export/all zip           ({a})   NEVER against production (creates/deletes data, rewrites the time zone)
#   account          — the throwaway account through /account/*: password, profile, delete           ({acc})  NEVER against production (deletes wave4-throwaway@example.test)
#   throwaway-empty  — after a restart: the re-created throwaway's workspace is empty                 ({te})   NEVER against production
#   all              — matrix + actions + account                                                    ({al})
# Usage: B=http://localhost:8080 OPS_PASSWORD=... THROWAWAY_PASSWORD=... bash deploy/railway/runcheck.sh <mode>
"""
script = pathlib.Path("deploy/railway/runcheck.sh")
text = script.read_text()
body = text[text.index("set -u\n"):]
script.write_text(header + body)
print(f"deploy/railway/runcheck.sh: header rewritten {counts}")

for doc in ("README.md", "docs/DESIGN-SYSTEM.md"):
    path = pathlib.Path(doc)
    lines = path.read_text().split("\n")
    hits = 0
    for index, line in enumerate(lines):
        if "runcheck.sh all" in line:
            replaced, n = re.subn(r"\(matrix[^)]*\)", counts, line)
            if n:
                lines[index] = replaced
                hits += n
    if hits != 1:
        sys.exit(f"{doc}: expected exactly one '(matrix …)' parenthetical on a line naming runcheck.sh all, found {hits} — edit that line by hand to carry {counts} and re-run")
    path.write_text("\n".join(lines))
    print(f"{doc}: counts written")
PY
```

```bash
export PATH="$HOME/.local/node/node-v22.22.0-darwin-arm64/bin:$PATH"
cd "/Users/chrisskerritt/Documents/New project/Vigilo-wt/wave4"
SCRATCH="<session scratchpad directory>"
